name: Erdos865.inter_T3_T4_le
statement:
theorem inter_T3_T4_le {m : ℕ} {B : Finset ℕ} (hB : FoldedOK m B) {α β : ℕ}
    (hα : α ∈ B) (hβ : β ∈ B) (hαβ : α < β) (hmin : ∀ x ∈ B, α ≤ x)
    (hmin2 : ∀ x ∈ B, x ≠ α → β ≤ x) (hsum : α + β < m)
    (hnc : α + β ∉ collisions m B) : (T3 m B α ∩ T4 m B β).card ≤ 2

name: Erdos865.union_card_le

name: Erdos865.card_reflB

name: Erdos865.collisions_mono

name: Erdos865.collisions_reflB_card

name: Erdos865.core_step
statement:
theorem core_step {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : FoldedOK m S) {α β : ℕ}
    (hα : α ∈ S) (hβ : β ∈ S) (hαβ : α < β) (hmin : ∀ x ∈ S, α ≤ x)
    (hmin2 : ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ α → β ≤ x) (hsum : α + β < m)
    (IH : ∀ S', FoldedOK m S' → S'.card < S.card →
      4 * S'.card ≤ 4 * (collisions m S').card + m + 8) :
    4 * S.card ≤ 4 * (collisions m S).card + m + 8

statement:

name: Erdos865.lowSums_mono

name: Erdos865.card_XY_E
statement:
theorem card_XY_E (A : Finset ℕ) (N h : ℕ) :
    (Xset A h).card + (Yset A N h).card + (Eset A N h).card = (h - 1) + (Bset A N h).card

statement:

name: Erdos865.foldedOK_Bset

name: Erdos865.folding_lemma
statement:
theorem folding_lemma {A : Finset ℕ} {N h : ℕ} (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hh : h ∈ A) :
    4 * ((Xset A h).card + (Yset A N h).card)
      + 4 * (Eset A N h \ collisions h (Bset A N h)).card ≤ 5 * h + 4

name: Erdos865.card_A_bound
statement:
theorem card_A_bound {A : Finset ℕ} {N : ℕ} (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N) (h : ℕ) :
    A.card ≤ (Xset A h).card + (Yset A N h).card + 2 + (N - 2 * h)

name: Erdos865.case1_I_sub
statement:
theorem case1_I_sub {A : Finset ℕ} {H p q : ℕ} (_hqlo : H ≤ q)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) :
    Finset.Ico (max p (2 * H - q) + 1) q ⊆
      Eset A (2 * H) q \ collisions q (Bset A (2 * H) q)

name: Erdos865.case2_Bset_disjoint
Erdos865.case2_I_sub
statement:
theorem case2_I_sub {A : Finset ℕ} {H p q : ℕ} (hple : q - p ≤ p)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) :
    Finset.Ico 1 (q - p) \ A ⊆ Eset A (2 * H) p \ collisions p (Bset A (2 * H) p)

name: Erdos865.even_bound
statement:
theorem even_bound (H : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) : 4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

name: Erdos865.even_bound_case1
statement:
theorem even_bound_case1 {H p q : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ} (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hq : q ∈ A) (hqlo : H ≤ q) (hqhi : q ≤ 2 * H)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (_hp : p ∈ A) (_hplo : 1 ≤ p) (hphi : p ≤ H)
    (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) (hcase : q - H ≤ 4 * (H - p)) :
    4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

name: Erdos865.even_bound_case2
statement:
theorem even_bound_case2 {H p q : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ} (hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H))
    (hA : IsTripleFree A) (hqlo : H ≤ q) (hqhi : q ≤ 2 * H)
    (hqmin : ∀ a ∈ A, H ≤ a → q ≤ a) (hp : p ∈ A) (hplo : 1 ≤ p) (hphi : p ≤ H)
    (hpmax : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ H → a ≤ p) (hcase : 4 * (H - p) < q - H)
    (IH : ∀ H' (A' : Finset ℕ), H' < H → A' ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * H') → IsTripleFree A' →
      4 * A'.card ≤ 5 * H' + 24) :
    4 * A.card ≤ 5 * H + 24

statement:

name: Erdos865.sharpness

      8 * A.card = 5 * (8 * M) + 16

name: Erdos97Octagon.gram3_expand
statement:
lemma gram3_expand (a b c : Plane) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => (⟪(![a, b, c]) i, (![a, b, c]) j⟫_ℝ : ℝ)).det =
      ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, b⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, a⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪a, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, a⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, b⟫_ℝ -
        ⟪a, c⟫_ℝ * ⟪b, b⟫_ℝ * ⟪c, a⟫_ℝ

name: Erdos97Octagon.gram_det_eq_zero
statement:

name: Erdos97Octagon.cm4_normalized_eq_zero

    (a b c d : Plane) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    cm4 (sqDist a b / s) (sqDist a c / s) (sqDist a d / s)
      (sqDist b c / s) (sqDist b d / s) (sqDist c d / s) = 0

name: Erdos97Octagon.cm4_sqDist_eq_zero
statement:

      (sqDist b c) (sqDist b d) (sqDist c d) = 0

name: Erdos97Octagon.inner_sub_sub_eq
statement:

name: Erdos97Octagon.four_points_not_pairwise_equidistant
statement:
theorem four_points_not_pairwise_equidistant
    {a b c d : Plane} {r : ℝ}
    (had : a ≠ d)
    (dab : dist a b = r) (dac : dist a c = r) (dad : dist a d = r)
    (dbc : dist b c = r) (dbd : dist b d = r) (dcd : dist c d = r) :
    False

name: Erdos97Octagon.linearIndependent_of_regular_gram
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_regular_gram
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {u v w : E} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (huu : ⟪u, u⟫_ℝ = s) (hvv : ⟪v, v⟫_ℝ = s) (hww : ⟪w, w⟫_ℝ = s)
    (huv : ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = s / 2) (huw : ⟪u, w⟫_ℝ = s / 2)
    (hvw : ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ = s / 2) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ ![u, v, w]

name: Erdos97Octagon.equidistantCentres_card_le_two
statement:
theorem equidistantCentres_card_le_two
    {p : Vertex → Plane} (hC : ConvexIndependent ℝ p)
    {a b : Vertex} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun v => dist (p v) (p a) = dist (p v) (p b)).card ≤ 2

    {p : Vertex → Plane} (hC : ConvexIndependent ℝ p)

    False

name: Erdos97Octagon.no_unit_pentagon_centre
statement:

    {o a b c d e : Plane} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (oa : dist o a = R) (ob : dist o b = R) (oc : dist o c = R)
    (od : dist o d = R) (oe : dist o e = R)
    (ab : dist a b = R) (bc : dist b c = R) (cd : dist c d = R)
    (de : dist d e = R) (ea : dist e a = R) : False

name: Erdos97Octagon.dist_eq_radius_of_labelledEdge
statement:
theorem dist_eq_radius_of_labelledEdge
    {p : Vertex → Plane} {Q : OctagonIncidence} {radius : Vertex → ℝ}
    (hR : ∀ v w, w ∈ Q.targets v → dist (p v) (p w) = radius v)
    {root a b : Vertex} (hab : Q.LabelledEdge root a b) :
    dist (p a) (p b) = radius root

name: Erdos97Octagon.exists_positive_radii
statement:
theorem exists_positive_radii
    {p : Vertex → Plane} (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (Q : OctagonIncidence) (hR : Realises p Q) :
    ∃ radius : Vertex → ℝ,
      (∀ v, 0 < radius v) ∧
        ∀ v w, w ∈ Q.targets v → dist (p v) (p w) = radius v

name: Erdos97Octagon.radius_eq_of_mutual

    {p : Vertex → Plane} {Q : OctagonIncidence} {radius : Vertex → ℝ}

    {a b : Vertex} (hab : Q.Mutual a b) :

statement:
theorem canonicalize_rowOne
    {p : Vertex → Plane} {Q : OctagonIncidence}
    (hC : ConvexIndependent ℝ p) (hR : Realises p Q) (hN : Q.Normalized)
    (index : Fin 35) (hrow : Q.targets 1 = packedRow (rowOneMask index)) :
    ∃ orbit : Fin 7, ∃ p' : Vertex → Plane, ∃ Q' : OctagonIncidence,
      ConvexIndependent ℝ p' ∧ Realises p' Q' ∧ Q'.Normalized ∧
        Q'.PairSparse ∧ Q'.Balanced ∧
        Q'.targets 1 = packedRow (canonicalRowMask orbit)

    (i j : Fin m) :
    (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
      (((g i : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((g j : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 2

    6 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (i : ℝ) ^ 2 =
      (m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * (m : ℝ) - 1)

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.twoMulCardSumSquaresSubSquareEqSumPairsDiffSquare
statement:
lemma twoMulCardSumSquaresSubSquareEqSumPairsDiffSquare
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → ℝ) :
    2 * ((s.card : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2) - (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ^ 2) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, (g i - g j) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.varianceLowerBoundFinsetNat
statement:
theorem varianceLowerBoundFinsetNat (T : Finset ℕ) :
    (T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((T.card : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / 12 ≤
      (T.card : ℝ) * (∑ t ∈ T, (t : ℝ) ^ 2) -
        (∑ t ∈ T, (t : ℝ)) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.imageSubsetSumsCard
statement:

    (A.powerset.image (fun S ↦ S.sum id)).card = 2 ^ A.card

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.leoMoserVarianceBound
LeanPool.ErdosMoser.secondMomentSubsetSums
statement:
theorem secondMomentSubsetSums (B : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    4 * ∑ S ∈ B.powerset, (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ^ 2 =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ B.card *
        ((∑ i ∈ B, f i ^ 2) + (∑ i ∈ B, f i) ^ 2)

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.sumSubsetSums
statement:
theorem sumSubsetSums (B : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    2 * ∑ T ∈ B.powerset, (∑ i ∈ T, f i) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ B.card * ∑ i ∈ B, f i

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.varianceIdentitySubsetSums
statement:
theorem varianceIdentitySubsetSums (B : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    4 * (∑ S ∈ B.powerset, (∑ i ∈ S, f i) ^ 2) -
        (2 : ℝ) ^ B.card * (∑ i ∈ B, f i) ^ 2 =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ B.card * ∑ i ∈ B, f i ^ 2

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.erdosMoserMaxBound
statement:
theorem erdosMoserMaxBound {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (h : HasDistinctSubsetSums A) :
    (4 : ℝ) ^ A.card - 1 ≤
      3 * A.card * ((A.max' hA : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2

name: LeanPool.ErdosMoser.erdosMoserMaxSqrt
statement:
theorem erdosMoserMaxSqrt {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (h : HasDistinctSubsetSums A) :
    Real.sqrt (((4 : ℝ) ^ A.card - 1) / (3 * A.card)) ≤
      ((A.max' hA : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Finset.exists_cycleDecomp
statement:
theorem exists_cycleDecomp {E : Finset (Sym2 V)} (hdiag : ∀ e ∈ E, ¬ e.IsDiag)
    (heven : ∀ v : V, Even (E.cycleEdgeDegree v)) :
    ∃ cs : List (List V), (∀ c ∈ cs, c.Nodup ∧ 3 ≤ c.length) ∧
      (cs.flatMap List.cycleEdges).Nodup ∧ (cs.flatMap List.cycleEdges).toFinset = E

name: Finset.exists_cycleDecomp_finset
statement:
theorem exists_cycleDecomp_finset {E : Finset (Sym2 V)} (hdiag : ∀ e ∈ E, ¬ e.IsDiag)
    (heven : ∀ v : V, Even (E.cycleEdgeDegree v)) :
    ∃ Cs : List (Finset (Sym2 V)),
      (∀ C ∈ Cs, ∃ l : List V, l.Nodup ∧ 3 ≤ l.length ∧ C = l.cycleEdges.toFinset) ∧
      Cs.Pairwise Disjoint ∧ ∀ e : Sym2 V, e ∈ E ↔ ∃ C ∈ Cs, e ∈ C

name: Finset.exists_cycle_of_even
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_of_even {E : Finset (Sym2 V)} (hne : E.Nonempty)

    ∃ l : List V, l.Nodup ∧ 3 ≤ l.length ∧ ∀ e ∈ l.cycleEdges, e ∈ E

name: Finset.exists_edge_pairing_of_even
statement:
theorem exists_edge_pairing_of_even {E : Finset (Sym2 V)}
    (heven : ∀ v : V, Even (E.cycleEdgeDegree v)) :
    ∃ pair : V → Sym2 V → Sym2 V, ∀ v : V, ∀ e ∈ E, v ∈ e →
      pair v e ∈ E ∧ v ∈ pair v e ∧ pair v e ≠ e ∧ pair v (pair v e) = e

    [∀ v, Fintype (G.neighborSet v)]
    (heven : ∀ v : V, Even (G.degree v)) :
    ∃ cs : List (List V), (∀ c ∈ cs, c.Nodup ∧ 3 ≤ c.length) ∧

    ∃ pair : V → Sym2 V → Sym2 V, ∀ v : V, ∀ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, v ∈ e →

    {T : Set ℕ} (hT : ∀ n ∈ T, ∀ z ∈ ball c (2 * ρ), 0 < (expIterate n z).im)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ n : T, ∀ x ∈ ball c ρ, ∀ y ∈ ball c ρ, ‖x - y‖ < δ →
      ‖(expIterate n.1 x - Complex.I) / (expIterate n.1 x + Complex.I)

lemma fact_fact_iso_comm_left : (F : FactorizationSystem L R) → {X Y : C} →  (f : X ⟶ Y) →

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_is_unique'
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_is_unique' {L R : MorphismProperty C} (F : FactorizationSystem L R)
  {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E E' : C) (s : X ⟶ E) (hs : L s) (p : E ⟶ Y) (hp : R p) (fact : s ≫ p = f)
  (s' : X ⟶ E') (hs' : L s') (p' : E' ⟶ Y) (hp' : R p') (fact' : s' ≫ p' = f)
  (i i' : E ≅ E') (comm₁ : s ≫ i.hom = s') (comm₂ : i.hom ≫ p' = p) (comm₁' : s ≫ i'.hom = s')
  (comm₂' : i'.hom ≫ p' = p) : i = i'

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_is_unique_slice
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_is_unique_slice : {X : C} → {L R : MorphismProperty C} →
    (F : FactorizationSystem L R) → {f g : Over X} → (φ : f ⟶ g) → (im : Over X) → (left : f ⟶ im) →
    (p : (MorphismPropertySlice L X) left) → (right : im ⟶ g) →
    (q : (MorphismPropertySlice R X) right) → (fact : left ≫ right = φ) →
    (i : imageSlice F φ ≅ im) → (comm₁ : leftMapSlice F φ ≫ i.hom = left) →
    (comm₂ : i.hom ≫ right = rightMapSlice F φ) →
    i = (factorizationIsoSlice F φ im left p right q fact).fst

name: Feige.exists_insertionPairScore_of_transfer
statement:
theorem exists_insertionPairScore_of_transfer
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    {A B F w θ a : ℕ → ℝ} {p c d old : ℝ}
    {gLower gUpper : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ r, B r = A r + w r)
    (hF : ∀ r, F r = A r + θ r * w r)
    (hθ : Antitone θ)
    (hθ0 : θ 0 = 1) (hθk : θ k = 0)
    (hac : ∀ j < k, c ≤ a j)
    (hcd : 0 < c + d)
    (hw : ∀ j < k, 0 ≤ w j)
    (htransfer : ∀ j < k,
      insertionTransfer A F θ p j =
        ((a j - c) / (c + d)) * w j * (θ j - θ (j + 1)))
    (hg : ∀ j < k, gLower j ≤ gUpper j)
    (hold : old =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
        (independentLowerMass F p j * gLower j +
          independentUpperMass F p j * gUpper j)) :
    ∃ j < k,
      old ≤ insertionPairScore A B w gLower gUpper k j

name: Feige.exists_localInsertion_score_of_transfer
statement:
theorem exists_localInsertion_score_of_transfer
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    {A B F w θ a : ℕ → ℝ} {p c d old : ℝ}
    {gLower gUpper score : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ r, B r = A r + w r)
    (hF : ∀ r, F r = A r + θ r * w r)
    (hθ : Antitone θ)
    (hθ0 : θ 0 = 1) (hθk : θ k = 0)
    (hac : ∀ j < k, c ≤ a j)
    (hcd : 0 < c + d)
    (hw : ∀ j < k, 0 ≤ w j)
    (htransfer : ∀ j < k,
      insertionTransfer A F θ p j =
        ((a j - c) / (c + d)) * w j * (θ j - θ (j + 1)))
    (hg : ∀ j < k, gLower j ≤ gUpper j)
    (hold : old =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
        (independentLowerMass F p j * gLower j +
          independentUpperMass F p j * gUpper j))
    (haverage :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
          insertionWeight θ j * score j) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
          (insertedLowerMass B w θ j * gLower j +
            insertedUpperMass A θ j * gUpper j)) :
    ∃ j < k, old ≤ score j

name: Feige.exists_score_ge_of_le_convex_average

statement:
theorem localInsertion_average_pair_payoff_le
    {k : ℕ} {A B F w θ a : ℕ → ℝ} {p c d : ℝ}
    {gLower gUpper : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ r, B r = A r + w r)
    (hF : ∀ r, F r = A r + θ r * w r)
    (hθ : Antitone θ)
    (hac : ∀ j < k, c ≤ a j)
    (hcd : 0 < c + d)
    (hw : ∀ j < k, 0 ≤ w j)
    (htransfer : ∀ j < k,
      insertionTransfer A F θ p j =
        ((a j - c) / (c + d)) * w j * (θ j - θ (j + 1)))

name: Feige.sum_upward_transfers_improve
statement:
theorem sum_upward_transfers_improve
    {k : ℕ}
    {newLower newUpper oldLower oldUpper η gLower gUpper : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hlower : ∀ j < k, newLower j - oldLower j = -η j)
    (hupper : ∀ j < k, newUpper j - oldUpper j = η j)
    (hη : ∀ j < k, 0 ≤ η j)
    (hg : ∀ j < k, gLower j ≤ gUpper j) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
        (oldLower j * gLower j + oldUpper j * gUpper j)) ≤

name: Feige.weighted_insertionPairScore_eq

statement:
theorem exponentialTransfer_eq24
    (hwPlus : wPlus = uPlus + vPlus)
    (hwMinus : wMinus = uMinus + vMinus)
    (hBPlus : BPlus = APlus + wPlus)
    (hBMinus : BMinus = AMinus + wMinus)
    (hA : d * (APlus - AMinus) = a * uPlus + b * uMinus)
    (hB : c * (BPlus - BMinus) = a * vPlus + b * vMinus) :

name: Feige.exponentialTransfer_identity
statement:
theorem exponentialTransfer_identity
    (hwPlus : wPlus = uPlus + vPlus)
    (hwMinus : wMinus = uMinus + vMinus)
    (hwPlus0 : wPlus ≠ 0)
    (hwMinus0 : wMinus ≠ 0)
    (hBPlus : BPlus = APlus + wPlus)
    (hBMinus : BMinus = AMinus + wMinus)
    (hFPlus : FPlus = BPlus - vPlus)
    (hFMinus : FMinus = BMinus - vMinus)
    (hthetaPlus : thetaPlus = uPlus / wPlus)
    (hthetaMinus : thetaMinus = uMinus / wMinus)
    (hA : d * (APlus - AMinus) = a * uPlus + b * uMinus)
    (hB : c * (BPlus - BMinus) = a * vPlus + b * vMinus)
    (hcd0 : c + d ≠ 0) :
    (1 - thetaMinus) * (APlus - AMinus) -
        (c / (c + d)) * (FPlus - FMinus) =
      ((a - c) / (c + d)) * wPlus * (thetaPlus - thetaMinus)

name: Feige.ExponentialStein.integral_Ioi_mul_deriv_one_kink
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_mul_deriv_one_kink
    {u v u' v' : ℝ → ℝ} {k a' b' : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k)
    (hu_cont : Continuous u) (hv_cont : Continuous v)
    (hu : ∀ x, 0 < x → x ≠ k → HasDerivAt u (u' x) x)
    (hv : ∀ x, 0 < x → HasDerivAt v (v' x) x)
    (hu'_fin : IntervalIntegrable u' volume 0 k)
    (hv'_fin : IntervalIntegrable v' volume 0 k)
    (huv'_int : IntegrableOn (u * v') (Ioi 0))
    (hu'v_int : IntegrableOn (u' * v) (Ioi 0))
    (h_zero : u 0 * v 0 = a')
    (h_top : Tendsto (u * v) atTop (𝓝 b')) :
    ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), u x * v' x =
      b' - a' - ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), u' x * v x

name: Feige.ExponentialStein.two_sided_integral_Ioi
statement:
theorem two_sided_integral_Ioi
    {φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ} {y a b : ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ x, HasDerivAt φ (φ' x) x)
    (hintPlus : IntegrableOn
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y + a * e) * exp (-e)) (Ioi 0))
    (hintDerivPlus : IntegrableOn
      (fun e : ℝ => a * φ' (y + a * e) * exp (-e)) (Ioi 0))
    (hzeroPlus : Tendsto
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y + a * e) * exp (-e))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (φ y)))
    (htopPlus : Tendsto
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y + a * e) * exp (-e)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hintMinus : IntegrableOn
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y - b * e) * exp (-e)) (Ioi 0))
    (hintDerivMinus : IntegrableOn
      (fun e : ℝ => (-b) * φ' (y - b * e) * exp (-e)) (Ioi 0))
    (hzeroMinus : Tendsto
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y - b * e) * exp (-e))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (φ y)))
    (htopMinus : Tendsto
      (fun e : ℝ => φ (y - b * e) * exp (-e)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (∫ e : ℝ in Ioi 0, φ (y + a * e) * exp (-e)) -
        (∫ e : ℝ in Ioi 0, φ (y - b * e) * exp (-e)) =
      (∫ e : ℝ in Ioi 0, a * φ' (y + a * e) * exp (-e)) +
        b * (∫ e : ℝ in Ioi 0, φ' (y - b * e) * exp (-e))

name: Feige.TransferStein.equation23_A
statement:
theorem equation23_A
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {d a b : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hPlus : Integrable (phiPlus d a) μ)
    (hMinus : Integrable (phiMinus d b) μ)
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable (phiDerivPlus d a) μ)
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable (phiDerivMinus d b) μ) :
    d * (APlus μ d a - AMinus μ d b) =
      a * uPlus μ d a + b * uMinus μ d b

name: Feige.TransferStein.equation23_B

    (hPlus : Integrable (psiPlus c a) μ)
    (hMinus : Integrable (psiMinus c b) μ)
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable (psiDerivPlus c a) μ)
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable (psiDerivMinus c b) μ) :
    c * (BPlus μ c a - BMinus μ c b) =
      a * vPlus μ c a + b * vMinus μ c b

name: Feige.TransferStein.integral_phi_two_sided
statement:
theorem integral_phi_two_sided
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {d a b : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hPlus : Integrable (phiPlus d a) μ)
    (hMinus : Integrable (phiMinus d b) μ)
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable (phiDerivPlus d a) μ)
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable (phiDerivMinus d b) μ) :
    (∫ y, phiPlus d a y ∂μ) - (∫ y, phiMinus d b y ∂μ) =
      (∫ y, phiDerivPlus d a y ∂μ) +
        ∫ y, phiDerivMinus d b y ∂μ

name: Feige.TransferStein.integral_phi_two_sided_prod
statement:
theorem integral_phi_two_sided_prod
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [SFinite μ] {d a b : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hPlus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPhi d (p.1 + a * p.2) * exp (-p.2))
      (μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))))
    (hMinus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPhi d (p.1 - b * p.2) * exp (-p.2))
      (μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))))
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        a * transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 + a * p.2) * exp (-p.2))
      (μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))))
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        b * transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 - b * p.2) * exp (-p.2))
      (μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))) :
    (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        transferPhi d (p.1 + a * p.2) * exp (-p.2)
          ∂μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) -
      (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        transferPhi d (p.1 - b * p.2) * exp (-p.2)
          ∂μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) =
    (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        a * transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 + a * p.2) * exp (-p.2)
          ∂μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))) +
      ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        b * transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 - b * p.2) * exp (-p.2)
          ∂μ.prod (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))

name: Feige.TransferStein.equation23_A_probability
statement:
theorem equation23_A_probability
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {d a b : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 < d) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hPlus : Integrable (phiPlus d a) μ)
    (hMinus : Integrable (phiMinus d b) μ)
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable (phiDerivPlus d a) μ)
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable (phiDerivMinus d b) μ)
    (hLawDerivPlus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 + a * p.2))
      (μ.prod (expMeasure 1)))
    (hLawDerivMinus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPhiDeriv d (p.1 - b * p.2))
      (μ.prod (expMeasure 1))) :
    d * ((∫ z, transferPhi d z ∂zPlusLaw μ a) -
      ∫ z, transferPhi d z ∂zMinusLaw μ b) =
      a * uProbability (zPlusLaw μ a) d +
        b * uProbability (zMinusLaw μ b) d

name: Feige.TransferStein.equation23_B_probability
statement:
theorem equation23_B_probability
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {c a b : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hPlus : Integrable (psiPlus c a) μ)
    (hMinus : Integrable (psiMinus c b) μ)
    (hDerivPlus : Integrable (psiDerivPlus c a) μ)
    (hDerivMinus : Integrable (psiDerivMinus c b) μ)
    (hLawDerivPlus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPsiDeriv c (p.1 + a * p.2))
      (μ.prod (expMeasure 1)))
    (hLawDerivMinus : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => transferPsiDeriv c (p.1 - b * p.2))
      (μ.prod (expMeasure 1))) :
    c * ((∫ z, transferPsi c z ∂zPlusLaw μ a) -
      ∫ z, transferPsi c z ∂zMinusLaw μ b) =
      a * vProbability (zPlusLaw μ a) c +
        b * vProbability (zMinusLaw μ b) c

      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => f (p.1 - b * p.2)) (μ.prod (expMeasure 1))) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂zMinusLaw μ b =
      ∫ y, (∫ e in Ioi 0, f (y - b * e) * exp (-e) ∂volume) ∂μ

name: Feige.TransferStein.integral_zPlusLaw

name: Feige.Lemma43.complete
statement:
theorem complete
    {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hfmeas : Measurable f)
    (hflc : LikelihoodRatio.FourPointLogConcave f)
    (νP νM : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure νP]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure νM] {a b c d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hrel : ProbabilityRelations νP νM c d)
    (hA : d * (A νP d - A νM d) =
      a * u νP d + b * u νM d)
    (hB : c * (B νP c - B νM c) =
      a * v νP c + b * v νM c)
    (hid : DensityIdentification f νP νM a b c d) :
    ((1 - theta νM c d) * (A νP d - A νM d) -
          (c / (c + d)) * (F νP - F νM) =
        ((a - c) / (c + d)) * w νP c d *
          (theta νP c d - theta νM c d)) ∧
      theta νM c d ≤ theta νP c d ∧
      0 < w νP c d ∧ 0 < w νM c d

statement:
theorem theta_order

    (hflc : LikelihoodRatio.FourPointLogConcave f)
    (νP νM : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure νP]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure νM] {a b c d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hid : DensityIdentification f νP νM a b c d) :
    theta νM c d ≤ theta νP c d

name: Feige.Lemma43.theta_plus_ge_theta_minus_of_fourPoint
statement:
theorem theta_plus_ge_theta_minus_of_fourPoint
    {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hfmeas : Measurable f)
    (hflc : LikelihoodRatio.FourPointLogConcave f)
    {a b c d uP uM vP vM : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (huP0 : 0 ≤ uP) (huM0 : 0 ≤ uM)
    (hvM0 : 0 ≤ vM)
    (hwP : 0 < uP + vP) (hwM : 0 < uM + vM)
    (huP : ENNReal.ofReal uP = LikelihoodRatio.uIntegral
      (LikelihoodRatio.fPlus f a) d)
    (huM : ENNReal.ofReal uM = LikelihoodRatio.uIntegral
      (LikelihoodRatio.fMinus f b) d)
    (hvP : ENNReal.ofReal vP = LikelihoodRatio.vIntegral
      (LikelihoodRatio.fPlus f a) c)
    (hvM : ENNReal.ofReal vM = LikelihoodRatio.vIntegral
      (LikelihoodRatio.fMinus f b) c) :
    uM / (uM + vM) ≤ uP / (uP + vP)

name: Feige.Lemma43.transfer_identity

theorem transfer_identity

    [IsProbabilityMeasure νM] {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hrel : ProbabilityRelations νP νM c d)
    (hA : d * (A νP d - A νM d) =
      a * u νP d + b * u νM d)
    (hB : c * (B νP c - B νM c) =
      a * v νP c + b * v νM c) :
    (1 - theta νM c d) * (A νP d - A νM d) -
        (c / (c + d)) * (F νP - F νM) =
      ((a - c) / (c + d)) * w νP c d *
        (theta νP c d - theta νM c d)

name: Feige.Lemma43Complete.complete_for_density
statement:
theorem complete_for_density
    {f : ℝ → ENNReal} (hf : Measurable f)
    (hflc : LikelihoodRatio.FourPointLogConcave f)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (volume.withDensity f)]
    {a b c d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    let νP := zPlusLaw (volume.withDensity f) a
    let νM := zMinusLaw (volume.withDensity f) b
    ((1 - Lemma43.theta νM c d) *
          (Lemma43.A νP d - Lemma43.A νM d) -
          (c / (c + d)) * (Lemma43.F νP - Lemma43.F νM) =
        ((a - c) / (c + d)) * Lemma43.w νP c d *
          (Lemma43.theta νP c d - Lemma43.theta νM c d)) ∧
      Lemma43.theta νM c d ≤ Lemma43.theta νP c d ∧
      0 < Lemma43.w νP c d ∧ 0 < Lemma43.w νM c d

name: Feige.Lemma43Complete.equation23_A_probability_auto
statement:
theorem equation23_A_probability_auto
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

    d * ((∫ z, transferPhi d z ∂zPlusLaw μ a) -
      ∫ z, transferPhi d z ∂zMinusLaw μ b) =
      a * uProbability (zPlusLaw μ a) d +
        b * uProbability (zMinusLaw μ b) d

        b * vProbability (zMinusLaw μ b) c

    (γ β : ι → ℝ) (hγ : ∀ i, 0 < γ i) (hβ : ∀ i, 0 < β i)
    (S : Finset ι) (changed : ι)
    {c d : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d) :
    theta
        (zMinusLaw
          (volume.withDensity
            (finiteSignedExpSumDensity
              (commonFactors γ β hγ hβ S changed)))
          (β changed)) c d ≤
      theta
        (zPlusLaw
          (volume.withDensity
            (finiteSignedExpSumDensity
              (commonFactors γ β hγ hβ S changed)))
          (γ changed)) c d

name: Feige.Lemma43.finiteSignedExp_insertion_conclusions
statement:
theorem finiteSignedExp_insertion_conclusions
    (Fs : List LikelihoodRatio.SignedExpFactor)
    {upper old width interpolation : ℕ → ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    {a b c d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hreal :
      RealizesInsertionEdge upper old width interpolation j
        (TransferStein.zPlusLaw
          (volume.withDensity
            (LikelihoodRatio.finiteSignedExpSumDensity Fs)) a)
        (TransferStein.zMinusLaw
          (volume.withDensity
            (LikelihoodRatio.finiteSignedExpSumDensity Fs)) b)
        c d) :
    insertionTransfer upper old interpolation (c / (c + d)) j =
        ((a - c) / (c + d)) * width j *
          (interpolation j - interpolation (j + 1)) ∧
      interpolation (j + 1) ≤ interpolation j ∧
      0 < width j

name: Feige.Lemma43.insertionTransfer_eq_of_realizesInsertionEdge
statement:
theorem insertionTransfer_eq_of_realizesInsertionEdge
    {upper old width interpolation : ℕ → ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    {νP νM : Measure ℝ} {a c d : ℝ}
    (hreal :
      RealizesInsertionEdge upper old width interpolation j νP νM c d)
    (hid :
      (1 - theta νM c d) * (A νP d - A νM d) -
          (c / (c + d)) * (F νP - F νM) =
        ((a - c) / (c + d)) * w νP c d *
          (theta νP c d - theta νM c d)) :
    insertionTransfer upper old interpolation (c / (c + d)) j =
      ((a - c) / (c + d)) * width j *
        (interpolation j - interpolation (j + 1))

name: Feige.Lemma43.insertion_conclusions_of_complete
statement:
theorem insertion_conclusions_of_complete
    {upper old width interpolation : ℕ → ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    {f : ℝ → ENNReal} {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hreal :
      RealizesInsertionEdge upper old width interpolation j
        (TransferStein.zPlusLaw (volume.withDensity f) a)
        (TransferStein.zMinusLaw (volume.withDensity f) b) c d)
    (hcomplete : CompleteConclusion f a b c d) :
    insertionTransfer upper old interpolation (c / (c + d)) j =
        ((a - c) / (c + d)) * width j *
          (interpolation j - interpolation (j + 1)) ∧
      interpolation (j + 1) ≤ interpolation j ∧
      0 < width j

name: Feige.Lemma43.insertion_order_widths_of_realizesInsertionEdge
statement:
theorem insertion_order_widths_of_realizesInsertionEdge
    {upper old width interpolation : ℕ → ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    {νP νM : Measure ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
    (hreal :
      RealizesInsertionEdge upper old width interpolation j νP νM c d)
    (horder : theta νM c d ≤ theta νP c d)
    (hwP : 0 < w νP c d) :
    interpolation (j + 1) ≤ interpolation j ∧
      0 < width j

name: Feige.Lemma43.terminal_insertion_conclusions
statement:
theorem terminal_insertion_conclusions
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hpos : μ (Set.Ioi 0) = 0)
    {upper old width interpolation : ℕ → ℝ} {j : ℕ}
    {c d : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hreal :
      RealizesInsertionEdge upper old width interpolation j
        (TransferStein.zPlusLaw μ 1)
        (TransferStein.zMinusLaw μ 1) c d) :
    insertionTransfer upper old interpolation (c / (c + d)) j =
        ((1 - c) / (c + d)) * width j *
          (interpolation j - interpolation (j + 1)) ∧
      interpolation (j + 1) ≤ interpolation j ∧
      0 < width j

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.corollary_2
statement:
theorem corollary_2 {K : Type*} [Field K] [Finite K] (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0)
    (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (φ : V →ₗ[K] ((Fin n → K) → K)) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Finite) :
    ∃ T : Set V,
      T.Finite ∧ T.ncard ≤ n ∧ T ⊆ Submodule.span K S ∧
        ZeroSet (φ '' T) = ZeroSet (φ '' S)

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.corollary_3
statement:
theorem corollary_3 {K : Type*} [Field K] [Finite K] (n : ℕ)
    (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (φ : V →ₗ[K] (Projectivization K (Fin (n + 1) → K) → K)) (S : Set V) (hS : S.Finite)
    (h_nonempty : ZeroSet (φ '' S) ≠ ∅) :
    ∃ T : Set V,
      T.Finite ∧ T.ncard ≤ n ∧ T ⊆ Submodule.span K S ∧
        ZeroSet (φ '' T) = ZeroSet (φ '' S)

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.prop_1
statement:
theorem prop_1 (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) :
    ∃ (X : Set (Fin (n + 1) → F)) (f : Fin (n + 1) → X → F),
      X.ncard =
          (Fintype.card F ^ (n + 1) - Fintype.card F) / (Fintype.card F - 1) + 1 ∧
        (∀ x : X, ∃ i, f i x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (g : Fin n → X → F), (∀ j, g j ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range f)) →
          ∃ x : X, ∀ j, g j x = 0)

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.remark_example
statement:
theorem remark_example (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) :
    let f : Fin n → (Fin n → F) → F := fun i x => x i
    ZeroSet (Set.range f) = {0} ∧
    ∀ (g : Fin (n - 1) → (Fin n → F) → F),
      (∀ j, g j ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range f)) →
      (ZeroSet (Set.range g)).ncard ≥ Fintype.card F

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.theorem_1
statement:
theorem theorem_1 {X : Type*} [Finite X] (n : ℕ) (S : Set (X → F)) (hS : S.Finite)
    (hn : S.ncard > n)
    (hX : Nat.card X ≤
      (Fintype.card F ^ (n + 1) - Fintype.card F) / (Fintype.card F - 1)) :
    ∃ T : Set (X → F),
      T ⊆ Submodule.span F S ∧ T.Finite ∧ T.ncard ≤ n ∧ ZeroSet T = ZeroSet S

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.theorem_1_aux
statement:
lemma theorem_1_aux {X : Type*} [Finite X] (n : ℕ) (f : X → (Fin (n + 1) → F))
    (hX : Nat.card X ≤
      (Fintype.card F ^ (n + 1) - Fintype.card F) / (Fintype.card F - 1)) :
    ∃ M : (Fin (n + 1) → F) →ₗ[F] (Fin n → F),
      {x | M (f x) = 0} = {x | f x = 0}

name: LeanPool.Fineqs.theorem_1_base_case
statement:
lemma theorem_1_base_case {X : Type*} [Finite X] (n : ℕ) (S : Set (X → F))
    (hS : S.Finite) (h_card : S.ncard = n + 1)
    (hX : Nat.card X ≤
      (Fintype.card F ^ (n + 1) - Fintype.card F) / (Fintype.card F - 1)) :
    ∃ T : Set (X → F),
      T ⊆ Submodule.span F S ∧ T.Finite ∧ T.ncard ≤ n ∧ ZeroSet T = ZeroSet S

@[simp]
theorem graphRealizationSignedMap_edgePath
    {U W : Type u} [Quiver.{u} U] [Quiver.{u} W]
    (f : U → W) (g : Quiver.Total U → Quiver.Total W)
    (r : Quiver.Total U → C(I, I))
    (h0 : ∀ e : Quiver.Total U,
      graphRealizationQuotient
          (Sum.inr ⟨graphDiscreteEdge (g e), r e 0⟩) =
        graphVertex (f e.left))
    (h1 : ∀ e : Quiver.Total U,
      graphRealizationQuotient
          (Sum.inr ⟨graphDiscreteEdge (g e), r e 1⟩) =
        graphVertex (f e.right))

      graphEdgePath (g e) (r e t)

    (h0 : ∀ e : Quiver.Total U,

          (Sum.inr ⟨graphDiscreteEdge (g e), r e 0⟩) =

    (h1 : ∀ e : Quiver.Total U,
      graphRealizationQuotient
          (Sum.inr ⟨graphDiscreteEdge (g e), r e 1⟩) =

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_and
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_and [L.Structure V] {n : ℕ}
    {ϕ ψ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V} :
    (ϕ ∧' ψ).Realize s xs ↔ ϕ.Realize s xs ∧ ψ.Realize s xs

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_or
statement:

    {ϕ ψ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V} :
    (ϕ ∨' ψ).Realize s xs ↔ ϕ.Realize s xs ∨ ψ.Realize s xs

name: FirstOrder.Language.ReplaceFV.BoundedFormula.realize_replaceFV
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_replaceFV {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V}
    {ϕ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n} {tsN : ℕ → L.Term (ℕ ⊕ Fin n)} :
    (BoundedFormula.replaceFV ϕ tsN).Realize s xs ↔
    ϕ.Realize (fun k => Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) (tsN k)) xs

name: FirstOrder.Language.ReplaceFV.Term.realize_liftAt'
statement:
theorem realize_liftAt' {n n' : ℕ} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V}
    {xs1 : Fin (n + n') → V} {t : L.Term (ℕ ⊕ Fin n)} :
    (∀ (k : Fin n), xs1 (k.castAdd n')= xs k) →
    Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs1) (Term.liftAt n' n t)
    = Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) t

name: FirstOrder.Language.ReplaceFV.Term.realize_liftAt'_one
statement:
theorem realize_liftAt'_one {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V}
    {t : L.Term (ℕ ⊕ Fin n)} {a : V} :
    Term.realize (Sum.elim s (Fin.snoc xs a)) (Term.liftAt 1 n t)
    = Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) t

name: FirstOrder.Language.ReplaceFV.Term.realize_replaceFV
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realize_replaceFV {n : ℕ} {s : ℕ → V} {xs : Fin n → V}
    {t : L.Term (ℕ ⊕ Fin n)} {tsN : ℕ → L.Term (ℕ ⊕ Fin n)} :
    Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) (Term.replaceFV t tsN) =
    Term.realize (Sum.elim (fun k => Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) (tsN k)) xs) t

name: FirstOrder.Language.ReplaceFV.realize_liftAt'
statement:
theorem realize_liftAt' {n' m : ℕ} {h_n_prime_nezero : n' > 0} {s : ℕ → V} :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {φ : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n} (xs : Fin (n + n') → V), m ≤ n →
    ((liftAt n' m φ).Realize s xs ↔ φ.Realize s (xs ∘ fun (i : Fin n) =>
    if ↑i < m then Fin.castAdd n' i else i.addNat n'))

    (fun k ↦ Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs)  (makeTsN ts k)) =
    replaceInitialValues s (fun (i : Fin (m+1)) ↦
    Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) (makeTsN ts i.val))

    Term.realize (Sum.elim s xs) (makeTsN ![t₁, t₂] k)) =

name: FirstOrder.ZFC.realize_separation'_lift
statement:

theorem realize_separation'_lift [ModelSets V] {n : ℕ}

name: Valuation.exists_max_val_no_cancel
statement:
lemma Valuation.exists_max_val_no_cancel
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [Nonempty J]
    (u : J → L) (u_sub : J → vL.valuationSubring) (hu_eq : ∀ j, (u_sub j : L) = u j)
    (hu_val_one : ∀ j, vL (u j) = 1)
    (hu_res_indep : LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vK.valuationSubring)
      (fun j => IsLocalRing.residue vL.valuationSubring (u_sub j))) :
    ∀ (d : J → K), (∃ j, d j ≠ 0) →
      ∃ j0, vL (∑ j, algebraMap K L (d j) * u j) = vL (algebraMap K L (d j0) * u j0) ∧
      ∀ j, vL (algebraMap K L (d j) * u j) ≤ vL (algebraMap K L (d j0) * u j0)

    {I J : Type*} [Finite I] [Fintype J]

name: GKPCarry.badCarryStateAux_ne_good_iff_carryCount_lt_needed
statement:
lemma badCarryStateAux_ne_good_iff_carryCount_lt_needed :
    ∀ digits : List ℕ, (∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < 3) →
      ∀ state : BadCarryState,
        badCarryStateAux digits state ≠ .good ↔
          ternaryDoubleCarryCountAux digits state.incomingCarry <
            state.neededCarries
  | [], _hdigits, state => by
      cases state <;>
        simp [badCarryStateAux, BadCarryState.neededCarries,
          ternaryDoubleCarryCountAux]
  | digit :: digits, hdigits, state => by
      have hdigit : digit < 3

name: GKPCarry.badCarryStateAux_oneCarryNoCarry_ne_good_iff_allZeroOrOne
statement:
lemma badCarryStateAux_oneCarryNoCarry_ne_good_iff_allZeroOrOne :
    ∀ digits : List ℕ,
      badCarryStateAux digits .oneCarryNoCarry ≠ .good ↔
        badCarryAllZeroOrOne digits
  | [] => by simp [badCarryStateAux, badCarryAllZeroOrOne]
  | digit :: digits => by
      by_cases hdigit : digit < 2
      · simp [badCarryStateAux, badCarryStateStep, hdigit,
          badCarryAllZeroOrOne_cons_of_lt hdigit,
          badCarryStateAux_oneCarryNoCarry_ne_good_iff_allZeroOrOne digits]
      · have hshape : ¬ badCarryAllZeroOrOne (digit :: digits)

name: GKPCarry.badCarryStateAux_oneCarryOut_ne_good_iff
statement:
lemma badCarryStateAux_oneCarryOut_ne_good_iff :
    ∀ digits : List ℕ,
      badCarryStateAux digits .oneCarryOut ≠ .good ↔
        digits = [] ∨
          ∃ highs : List ℕ,
            badCarryAllZeroOrOne highs ∧ digits = 0 :: highs
  | [] => by simp [badCarryStateAux]
  | digit :: digits => by
      by_cases hdigit : digit = 0
      · subst digit
        simp [badCarryStateAux, badCarryStateStep,
          badCarryStateAux_oneCarryNoCarry_ne_good_iff_allZeroOrOne digits]
      · simp [badCarryStateAux, badCarryStateStep, hdigit,
          badCarryStateAux_good]

name: GKPCarry.badCarryStateAux_zeroCarry_ne_good_iff_shape
statement:
lemma badCarryStateAux_zeroCarry_ne_good_iff_shape :
    ∀ digits : List ℕ,

        badCarryLanguageShape digits
  | [] => by
      simp [badCarryStateAux, badCarryLanguageShape, badCarryAllZeroOrOne]
  | digit :: digits => by
      by_cases hsmall : digit < 2
      · have htwo : digit ≠ 2

name: GapCVP.liftStatement_stepAux
statement:
theorem liftStatement_stepAux [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq K']
    (stack : K → K') (label : Λ → Λ')
    (read : σ' → σ) (write : σ' → σ → σ') (onHalt : TM2.Stmt Γ Λ' σ')
    (state : σ → σ')
    (embedStacks : (∀ k, List (Γ (stack k))) → ∀ k, List (Γ k))
    (configuration : TM2.Cfg (fun k => Γ (stack k)) Λ σ → TM2.Cfg Γ Λ' σ')
    (read_state : ∀ s, read (state s) = s)
    (write_state : ∀ s t, write (state s) t = state t)
    (read_stacks : ∀ source k, embedStacks source (stack k) = source k)
    (update_stacks : ∀ source k value,
      embedStacks (Function.update source k value) =
        Function.update (embedStacks source) (stack k) value)
    (goto_configuration : ∀ l s source,
      configuration ⟨some l, s, source⟩ = ⟨some (label l), state s, embedStacks source⟩)
    (halt_configuration : ∀ s source,
      TM2.stepAux onHalt (state s) (embedStacks source) = configuration ⟨none, s, source⟩)
    (statement : TM2.Stmt (fun k => Γ (stack k)) Λ σ) (s : σ)
    (source : ∀ k, List (Γ (stack k))) :
    TM2.stepAux (liftStatement stack label read write onHalt statement)
        (state s) (embedStacks source) =
      configuration (TM2.stepAux statement s source)

theorem walk_len : ∀ (x : Vertex) (l : List Arc) (y : Vertex),
    IsWalk tail head x l y → l.length + rank x ≤ rank y

name: GoemansFlow.walksFrom_complete
statement:
theorem walksFrom_complete : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Vertex) (l : List Arc) (y : Vertex),
    l.length ≤ n → IsWalk tail head x l y → (l, y) ∈ walksFrom n x

name: GoemansFlow.walksFrom_s_eq
statement:
theorem walksFrom_s_eq : walksFrom 4 Vertex.s =
    [([], Vertex.s),
     ([Arc.st1], Vertex.t1),
     ([Arc.st2], Vertex.t2),
     ([Arc.su], Vertex.u),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.ut3], Vertex.t3),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.uv], Vertex.v),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.uv, Arc.vt1], Vertex.t1),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.uv, Arc.vw], Vertex.w),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.uv, Arc.vw, Arc.wt2], Vertex.t2),
     ([Arc.su, Arc.uv, Arc.vw, Arc.wt3], Vertex.t3)]

name: GranvilleMoore.binomPoly_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem binomPoly_zero (p : ℕ) : binomPoly p 0 = 1

name: GranvilleMoore.cPoly_succ
statement: theorem cPoly_succ (p j : ℕ) : cPoly p (j + 1) = cPoly p j * (X + C ((p : ℤ) ^ j))

name: GranvilleMoore.cPoly_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem cPoly_zero (p : ℕ) : cPoly p 0 = 1

name: GranvilleMoore.collapsedCoeff_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem collapsedCoeff_zero_left (p m : ℕ) :
    collapsedCoeff p 0 m = if m = 0 then 1 else 0

name: GranvilleMoore.eval_binomPoly
statement:
theorem eval_binomPoly (p m : ℕ) (z : ℚ) :
    (binomPoly p m).eval z =
      (m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ * ∏ s ∈ Finset.range m, ((z - 1) / ((p : ℚ) - 1) - s)

name: GranvilleMoore.iteratedFermatQuot_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iteratedFermatQuot_succ (p j k : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    iteratedFermatQuot p (j + 1) k x =
      (iteratedFermatQuot p j (k + 1) x - iteratedFermatQuot p j k x) / (p : ℚ) ^ (k + 1)

name: GranvilleMoore.iteratedFermatQuot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iteratedFermatQuot_zero (p k : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    iteratedFermatQuot p 0 k x = (x : ℚ) ^ p ^ k

name: GranvilleMoore.monic_cPoly
statement: theorem monic_cPoly (p j : ℕ) : (cPoly p j).Monic

name: GranvilleMoore.natDegree_binomPoly_le
statement: theorem natDegree_binomPoly_le (p m : ℕ) : (binomPoly p m).natDegree ≤ m

name: GranvilleMoore.natDegree_cPoly
statement: @[simp] theorem natDegree_cPoly (p j : ℕ) : (cPoly p j).natDegree = j

name: GranvilleMoore.pow_eq_one_add_pow_mul_unitQuot
statement:
theorem pow_eq_one_add_pow_mul_unitQuot {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((x : ℚ) ^ (p - 1)) ^ p ^ k = 1 + (p : ℚ) ^ (k + 1) * unitQuot p x k

name: GranvilleMoore.unitQuot_eq
statement:
theorem unitQuot_eq (p : ℕ) (x : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    unitQuot p x k = (((x ^ (p - 1)) ^ p ^ k - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (p : ℚ) ^ (k + 1)

name: GranvilleMoore.unitQuot_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem unitQuot_zero (p : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    unitQuot p x 0 = ((x ^ (p - 1) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.fermatQuotient_eq_div
statement:
theorem fermatQuotient_eq_div (p : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    fermatQuotient p x = ((x : ℚ) ^ (p - 1) - 1) / (p : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.fermatQuotient_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fermatQuotient_one (p : ℕ) : fermatQuotient p 1 = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.frobeniusExponent_eq_sum
statement:
theorem frobeniusExponent_eq_sum (p k : ℕ) :
    frobeniusExponent p k = ∑ r ∈ range k, p ^ r

name: GranvilleMoore.frobeniusExponent_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frobeniusExponent_one (p : ℕ) : frobeniusExponent p 1 = 1

name: GranvilleMoore.frobeniusExponent_succ
statement:
theorem frobeniusExponent_succ (p k : ℕ) :
    frobeniusExponent p (k + 1) = frobeniusExponent p k + p ^ k

name: GranvilleMoore.frobeniusExponent_succ'
statement:
theorem frobeniusExponent_succ' (p k : ℕ) :
    frobeniusExponent p (k + 1) = 1 + p * frobeniusExponent p k

name: GranvilleMoore.frobeniusExponent_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frobeniusExponent_zero (p : ℕ) : frobeniusExponent p 0 = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.natCast_mul_fermatQuotient
statement:
theorem natCast_mul_fermatQuotient {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : ℤ) :
    (p : ℚ) * fermatQuotient p x = (x : ℚ) ^ (p - 1) - 1

name: GranvilleMoore.fermatUnit_eq_one_add_natCast_mul_fermatQuotient
statement:
theorem fermatUnit_eq_one_add_natCast_mul_fermatQuotient {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : ℤ) :
    (fermatUnit p x : ℚ) = 1 + (p : ℚ) * fermatQuotient p x

name: GranvilleMoore.pow_pow_eq_mul_pow_frobeniusExponent
statement:
theorem pow_pow_eq_mul_pow_frobeniusExponent {M : Type*} [Monoid M] {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : M) (k : ℕ) :
    x ^ p ^ k = x * (x ^ (p - 1)) ^ frobeniusExponent p k

name: GranvilleMoore.sub_one_mul_frobeniusExponent
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_frobeniusExponent (p k : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * frobeniusExponent p k = p ^ k - 1

name: GranvilleMoore.sub_one_mul_frobeniusExponent_add_one
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_frobeniusExponent_add_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * frobeniusExponent p k + 1 = p ^ k

name: GranvilleMoore.C_mul_binomPoly_eq_prod
statement:
theorem C_mul_binomPoly_eq_prod {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
    C ((m.factorial : ℚ) * ((p : ℚ) - 1) ^ m) * binomPoly p m
      = ∏ s ∈ range m, (X - 1 - C ((s : ℚ) * ((p : ℚ) - 1)))

name: GranvilleMoore.div_sub_one_eq_natCast_frobeniusExponent
statement:
theorem div_sub_one_eq_natCast_frobeniusExponent {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (i : ℕ) :
    ((p : ℚ) ^ i - 1) / ((p : ℚ) - 1) = (frobeniusExponent p i : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.eval_binomPoly_pow_eq_choose
statement:
theorem eval_binomPoly_pow_eq_choose {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (m i : ℕ) :
    (binomPoly p m).eval ((p : ℚ) ^ i) = ((frobeniusExponent p i).choose m : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.padicValRat_natCast_sub_one
statement:
theorem padicValRat_natCast_sub_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    padicValRat p ((p : ℚ) - 1) = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.prod_pow_sub_pow_eq_pow_mul
statement:
theorem prod_pow_sub_pow_eq_pow_mul {p n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℤ) ^ n - (p : ℤ) ^ r)
      = (p : ℤ) ^ (∑ r ∈ range j, r) * ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℤ) ^ (n - r) - 1)

name: GranvilleMoore.prod_pow_sub_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem prod_pow_sub_pow_eq_zero {p n j : ℕ} (h : n < j) :
    ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℤ) ^ n - (p : ℤ) ^ r) = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.sum_range_choose_two
statement:
theorem sum_range_choose_two (d : ℕ) :
    ∑ c ∈ range (d + 1), Nat.choose c 2 = Nat.choose (d + 1) 3

name: GranvilleMoore.collapsedCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem collapsedCoeff_eq_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {j m : ℕ} (h : m < j) :
    collapsedCoeff p j m = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.exists_intCast_eq_factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff
statement:
theorem exists_intCast_eq_factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (j m : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, (m.factorial : ℚ) * ((p : ℚ) - 1) ^ m * collapsedCoeff p j m
      = (p : ℚ) ^ j.choose 2 * (a : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.exists_int_factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff_self
statement:
theorem exists_int_factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff_self {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, (j.factorial : ℚ) * ((p : ℚ) - 1) ^ j * collapsedCoeff p j j
      = (p : ℚ) ^ j.choose 2 * (((p : ℚ) - 1) ^ j + (p : ℚ) * (a : ℚ))

name: GranvilleMoore.factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff_self
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_pow_mul_collapsedCoeff_self {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (j : ℕ) :
    (j.factorial : ℚ) * ((p : ℚ) - 1) ^ j * collapsedCoeff p j j
      = (p : ℚ) ^ j.choose 2 * ∏ s ∈ range j, ((p : ℚ) ^ (s + 1) - 1)

name: GranvilleMoore.le_padicValRat_collapsedCoeff
statement:
theorem le_padicValRat_collapsedCoeff {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {j m : ℕ}
    (h : collapsedCoeff p j m ≠ 0) :
    (j.choose 2 : ℤ) - padicValRat p (m.factorial : ℚ)
      ≤ padicValRat p (collapsedCoeff p j m)

name: GranvilleMoore.prod_pow_sub_pow_rat_eq_pow_mul
statement:
theorem prod_pow_sub_pow_rat_eq_pow_mul {p n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℚ) ^ n - (p : ℚ) ^ r)
      = (p : ℚ) ^ j.choose 2 * ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℚ) ^ (n - r) - 1)

name: GranvilleMoore.prod_pow_sub_pow_rat_eq_zero
statement:
theorem prod_pow_sub_pow_rat_eq_zero {p n j : ℕ} (h : n < j) :
    ∏ r ∈ range j, ((p : ℚ) ^ n - (p : ℚ) ^ r) = 0

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ladderMatrix_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℤ) (i : ℕ) (r j : Fin d) :
    ladderMatrix p x i r j = iteratedFermatQuot p (min (r : ℕ) i) ((r : ℕ) - i) (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_row
statement:
theorem ladderMatrix_row (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℤ) (i : ℕ) (r : Fin d) :
    ladderMatrix p x i r = fun j => iteratedFermatQuot p (min (r : ℕ) i) ((r : ℕ) - i) (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_row_of_ge
statement:
theorem ladderMatrix_row_of_ge {p : ℕ} {x : Fin d → ℤ} {i : ℕ} {r : Fin d} (h : i ≤ (r : ℕ)) :
    ladderMatrix p x i r = fun j => iteratedFermatQuot p i ((r : ℕ) - i) (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_row_of_le
statement:
theorem ladderMatrix_row_of_le {p : ℕ} {x : Fin d → ℤ} {i : ℕ} {r : Fin d} (h : (r : ℕ) ≤ i) :
    ladderMatrix p x i r = fun j => iteratedFermatQuot p (r : ℕ) 0 (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.mooreMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mooreMatrix_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → R) (i j : Fin d) :
    mooreMatrix p x i j = x j ^ p ^ (i : ℕ)

name: GranvilleMoore.mooreMatrix_apply_zero
statement:
theorem mooreMatrix_apply_zero (p : ℕ) (x : Fin (d + 1) → R) (j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    mooreMatrix p x 0 j = x j

name: GranvilleMoore.mooreMatrix_map
statement:
theorem mooreMatrix_map [Monoid S] (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → R) (f : R →* S) :
    (mooreMatrix p x).map f = mooreMatrix p fun j => f (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.mooreMatrix_succ_apply
statement:
theorem mooreMatrix_succ_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Fin (d + 1) → R) (i : Fin d) (j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    mooreMatrix p x i.succ j = mooreMatrix p x i.castSucc j ^ p

name: GranvilleMoore.det_ladderMatrix_step
statement:
theorem det_ladderMatrix_step {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : Fin d → ℤ) (i : ℕ) :
    (ladderMatrix p x i).det
      = (p : ℚ) ^ Nat.choose (d - i) 2 * (ladderMatrix p x (i + 1)).det

name: GranvilleMoore.det_mooreMatrix_eq_pow_mul_det_ladderMatrix
statement:
theorem det_mooreMatrix_eq_pow_mul_det_ladderMatrix {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : Fin d → ℤ) :
    ((mooreMatrix p x).det : ℚ)
      = (p : ℚ) ^ Nat.choose (d + 1) 3 * (ladderMatrix p x (d - 1)).det

name: GranvilleMoore.iteratedFermatQuot_sub_iteratedFermatQuot
statement:
theorem iteratedFermatQuot_sub_iteratedFermatQuot {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    iteratedFermatQuot p a (b + 1) x - iteratedFermatQuot p a b x
      = (p : ℚ) ^ (b + 1) * iteratedFermatQuot p (a + 1) b x

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_last_apply
statement:
theorem ladderMatrix_last_apply (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℤ) (r j : Fin d) :
    ladderMatrix p x (d - 1) r j = iteratedFermatQuot p (r : ℕ) 0 (x j)

name: GranvilleMoore.ladderMatrix_zero
statement:
theorem ladderMatrix_zero (p : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℤ) :
    ladderMatrix p x 0 = (mooreMatrix p x).map (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℚ))

name: GranvilleMoore.sum_range_sub_choose_two
statement:
theorem sum_range_sub_choose_two (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), Nat.choose (n - i) 2 = Nat.choose (n + 1) 3

statement:
theorem dvd_fermatUnit_sub_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {x : ℤ} (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) :

theorem fermatQuotient_eq_intCast {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {x : ℤ} (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) :

statement:
theorem not_dvd_fermatUnit {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {x : ℤ} (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) :

name: GranvilleMoore.pow_dvd_fermatUnit_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_fermatUnit_pow_sub_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {x : ℤ}
    (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) (k : ℕ) : (p : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) ∣ fermatUnit p x ^ p ^ k - 1

name: GranvilleMoore.unitQuot_eq_intCast
statement:
theorem unitQuot_eq_intCast {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {x : ℤ}
    (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) (k : ℕ) : ∃ g : ℤ, unitQuot p x k = (g : ℚ)

name: GranvilleMoore.dvd_factorial_mul_sub_exceptional
statement:
theorem dvd_factorial_mul_sub_exceptional {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) {x : ℤ}
    (hx : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x) {z q : ℤ} (hz : iteratedFermatQuot p (p - 1) 0 x = (z : ℚ))
    (hq : fermatQuotient p x = (q : ℚ)) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ ((p - 1).factorial : ℤ) * z - (x * q ^ (p - 1) - x * q)

GranvilleMoore.iteratedFermatQuot_eq_mul_sum
statement:
theorem iteratedFermatQuot_eq_mul_sum {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) {x : ℤ} {j k : ℕ} {g : ℤ}
    (hg : unitQuot p x k = (g : ℚ)) :
    iteratedFermatQuot p j k x
      = (x : ℚ) ^ p ^ k / (p : ℚ) ^ (j * k + Nat.choose (j + 1) 2) *
          ∑ m ∈ range (frobeniusExponent p j + 1),
            collapsedCoeff p j m * ((p : ℚ) ^ (k + 1) * (g : ℚ)) ^ m

GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow (c v : Fin n → R) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
    (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    M.det = (∏ j, c j) * ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j - v i)

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain R] (c v : Fin n → R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hc : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    M.det = 0 ↔ ∃ i j, v i = v j ∧ i ≠ j

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_exponents
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_exponents (c v : Fin n → R) (f : Fin n → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ f i) :
    M.det = (∏ j, c j) * (Matrix.of fun i j => v j ^ f i).det

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_ne_zero_iff [IsDomain R] (c v : Fin n → R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hc : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    M.det ≠ 0 ↔ Function.Injective v

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow (c v : Fin n → R) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
    (iLast : Fin n) (e : ℕ) (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    (M.updateRow iLast fun j => c j * v j ^ e).det
      = (∏ j, c j) * (Matrix.of fun i j => v j ^ (if i = iLast then e else (i : ℕ))).det

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow_last
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow_last (c v : Fin (n + 1) → R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    (M.updateRow (Fin.last n) fun j => c j * v j ^ n).det
      = (∏ j, c j) * ∏ i : Fin (n + 1), ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j - v i)

name: GranvilleMoore.det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow_sub
statement:
theorem det_of_eq_mul_pow_updateRow_sub (c v : Fin n → R) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
    {iLast i₁ : Fin n} (hne : iLast ≠ i₁) (k : R)
    (h : ∀ i j, M i j = c j * v j ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    (M.updateRow iLast fun j => c j * (v j ^ (iLast : ℕ) - k * v j ^ (i₁ : ℕ))).det
      = (∏ j, c j) * ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j - v i)

GranvilleMoore.not_pow_succ_dvd_det_mooreMatrix_iff
statement:
theorem not_pow_succ_dvd_det_mooreMatrix_iff (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hdp : d ≤ p) {x : Fin d → ℤ} (hx : ∀ j, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x j) {q : Fin d → ℤ}
    (hq : ∀ j, fermatQuotient p (x j) = (q j : ℚ)) (_hdet : (mooreMatrix p x).det ≠ 0) :
    ¬ (p : ℤ) ^ (Nat.choose (d + 1) 3 + 1) ∣ (mooreMatrix p x).det
      ↔ Function.Injective fun j => ((q j : ℤ) : ZMod p)

name: GranvilleMoore.pow_dvd_det_mooreMatrix
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_det_mooreMatrix (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p) (_hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdp : d ≤ p)
    {x : Fin d → ℤ} (hx : ∀ j, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x j) (_hdet : (mooreMatrix p x).det ≠ 0) :
    (p : ℤ) ^ Nat.choose (d + 1) 3 ∣ (mooreMatrix p x).det

name: GranvilleMoore.prod_factorial_mul_intCast_det_ladderMatrix_last
statement:
theorem prod_factorial_mul_intCast_det_ladderMatrix_last (hp : p.Prime) (hodd : Odd p)
    (_hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdp : d ≤ p - 1) {x : Fin d → ℤ} (hx : ∀ j, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x j) {D : ℤ}
    (hD : (ladderMatrix p x (d - 1)).det = (D : ℚ)) {q : Fin d → ℤ}
    (hq : ∀ j, fermatQuotient p (x j) = (q j : ℚ)) :
    (∏ i : Fin d, (((i : ℕ).factorial : ℕ) : ZMod p)) * ((D : ℤ) : ZMod p)

    {U V : Opens X} (a : ToType ((Y'.obj j₀).obj (op U)))
    (b : ToType ((Y'.obj j₀).obj (op V)))
    (h : ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.obj j).map (Opens.infLELeft U V).op)
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.map f).app (op U)) a) =
     ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.obj j).map (Opens.infLERight U V).op)
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.map f).app (op V)) b)) :
    ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.obj j').map (Opens.infLELeft U V).op)
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.map (f ≫ g)).app (op U)) a) =
    ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.obj j').map (Opens.infLERight U V).op)
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((Y'.map (f ≫ g)).app (op V)) b)

theorem aggregate_eq_from_component_eq {n : Nat}
    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n) (γ : ℝ)
    (hcomp : ∀ i,
      w.x i * d.ds i + w.s i * d.dx i = γ * mu w - w.x i * w.s i)
    (hscalar :
      w.tau * d.dkappa + w.kappa * d.dtau = γ * mu w - w.tau * w.kappa) :
    hdot w.x w.tau d.ds d.dkappa + hdot d.dx d.dtau w.s w.kappa
      = -(1 - γ) * gap w

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_centerSq_step_eq
statement:
theorem predictor_centerSq_step_eq {n : Nat}
    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n) (α : ℝ)
    (hdir : HSDStepDirection w d 0) :
    centerSq (addStep w d α).x (addStep w d α).tau
      (addStep w d α).s (addStep w d α).kappa
      (mu (addStep w d α)) =
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ((1 - α) * (w.x i * w.s i - mu w) +
          α ^ 2 * (d.dx i * d.ds i)) ^ 2) +
        ((1 - α) * (w.tau * w.kappa - mu w) +
          α ^ 2 * (d.dtau * d.dkappa)) ^ 2

    (hdir : HSDStepDirection w d 0) :
    centerSq (addStep w d (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n))).x
      (addStep w d (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n))).tau
      (addStep w d (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n))).s
      (addStep w d (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n))).kappa
      (mu (addStep w d (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n)))) =
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        ((1 - ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n)) *
            (w.x i * w.s i - mu w) +
          (ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n)) ^ 2 *
            (d.dx i * d.ds i)) ^ 2) +
        ((1 - ytmStepConstant / Real.sqrt (hdim n)) *

            (d.dtau * d.dkappa)) ^ 2

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_scalar_quotient_sum_eq_neg_one
statement:

    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n)
    (hinterior : Interior w)

    d.dtau / w.tau + d.dkappa / w.kappa = -1

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_second_order_l1_bound
statement:
theorem predictor_second_order_l1_bound {n : Nat}
    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n)
    (hneigh : HSDNeighborhood ytmBetaTight w)
    (hdir : HSDStepDirection w d 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, |d.dx i * d.ds i|) + |d.dtau * d.dkappa| ≤
      hdim n * mu w / 2

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_second_order_square_sum_bound
statement:
theorem predictor_second_order_square_sum_bound {n : Nat}
    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n)
    (hneigh : HSDNeighborhood ytmBetaTight w)
    (hdir : HSDStepDirection w d 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, (d.dx i * d.ds i) ^ 2) +
      (d.dtau * d.dkappa) ^ 2 ≤ (hdim n * mu w / 2) ^ 2

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_step_guarantee_fixed

name: HSDInteriorPointLP.predictor_weighted_relative_norm_identity
statement:
theorem predictor_weighted_relative_norm_identity {n : Nat}
    (w : HSState n) (d : HSDirection n)
    (hneigh : HSDNeighborhood ytmBetaTight w)
    (hdir : HSDStepDirection w d 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin n,
        (w.x i * w.s i) *
          ((d.dx i / w.x i) ^ 2 + (d.ds i / w.s i) ^ 2)) +
      (w.tau * w.kappa) *
        ((d.dtau / w.tau) ^ 2 + (d.dkappa / w.kappa) ^ 2) =
      hdim n * mu w

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.dist_point_lattice_sq_cart
statement:
lemma dist_point_lattice_sq_cart (p : R2) (i j : ℤ) :
    dist p (isbellLatticePoint i j) ^ 2
      = (p 0 - ((i : ℝ) * isbellLatticeStep + (j : ℝ) * (isbellLatticeStep / 2))) ^ 2
        + (p 1 - (j : ℝ) * (isbellLatticeStep * Real.sqrt 3 / 2)) ^ 2

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.isbellLatticePoint_dist_sq
statement:
lemma isbellLatticePoint_dist_sq (i j i' j' : ℤ) :
    dist (isbellLatticePoint i j) (isbellLatticePoint i' j') ^ 2
      = isbellLatticeStep ^ 2 *
          (((i : ℝ) - i') ^ 2 + ((i : ℝ) - i') * ((j : ℝ) - j') + ((j : ℝ) - j') ^ 2)

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.isbellLatticePoint_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma isbellLatticePoint_one (i j : ℤ) :

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.isbellLatticePoint_zero
statement:

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.dist_between_same_color_lattice_points
statement:

    {i j i' j' : ℤ} (hne : (i, j) ≠ (i', j'))
    (hsame : ((i + 3 * j) : ZMod 7) = ((i' + 3 * j') : ZMod 7)) :

      ≥ isbellLatticeStep * Real.sqrt 7

name: HadwigerNelsonBounds.unitSquare_has_near_lattice_corner
statement:
lemma unitSquare_has_near_lattice_corner {α β : ℝ}
    (hαLower : 0 ≤ α) (hαUpper : α < 1)
    (hβLower : 0 ≤ β) (hβUpper : β < 1) :
    ∃ Δi Δj : ℤ,
      (α - (Δi : ℝ)) ^ 2 +
        (α - (Δi : ℝ)) * (β - (Δj : ℝ)) +
        (β - (Δj : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3

theorem chernoff_bound_cgf {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {ε t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h_int : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ X ω}).toReal ≤ exp (-t * ε + ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ t)

name: LeanPool.chernoff_bound_subGaussian

    {X : Ω → ℝ} {σ u : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hu : 0 < u)
    (h_sgb : ∀ t : ℝ, ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ t ≤ t^2 * σ^2 / 2)
    (h_int : ∀ t : ℝ, Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    (μ {ω | u ≤ X ω}).toReal ≤ exp (-u^2 / (2 * σ^2))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_cgf_le_of_centered_abs_le
statement:
theorem bernstein_cgf_le_of_centered_abs_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {b l : ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hcenter : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b)
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hbl : b * l < 3) :
    cgf X μ l ≤
      variance X μ * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - b * l / 3))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_cgf_sum_le
statement:
theorem bernstein_cgf_sum_le
    {ι : Type*} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset ι) {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {b v l : ℝ}
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hcenter : ∀ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ b)
    (hvar : ∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ ≤ v)
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hbl : b * l < 3) :
    cgf (∑ i ∈ s, X i) μ l ≤
      v * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - b * l / 3))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_inequality
statement:
theorem bernstein_inequality
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {b v t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hv : 0 < v) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ b)
    (hvar : ∑ i, variance (X i) μ ≤ v) :
    (μ {ω | t ≤ (∑ i, X i) ω}).toReal ≤
      exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * (v + b * t / 3)))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_inequality_finset
statement:

    {ι : Type*} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (s : Finset ι) {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} {b v t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hv : 0 < v) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    (hcenter : ∀ i ∈ s, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ b)
    (hvar : ∑ i ∈ s, variance (X i) μ ≤ v) :
    (μ {ω | t ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, X i) ω}).toReal ≤
      exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * (v + b * t / 3)))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_mgf_le_of_centered_abs_le
statement:
theorem bernstein_mgf_le_of_centered_abs_le
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} {b l : ℝ}
    (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hcenter : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ b)
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hbl : b * l < 3) :

      exp (variance X μ * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - b * l / 3)))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_one_sided_of_cgf_bound
statement:
theorem bernstein_one_sided_of_cgf_bound {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Y : Ω → ℝ} {v b C t : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 < C) (hv : 0 < v) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hcgf : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ → cgf Y μ l ≤ C * l ^ 2 * v)
    (hint : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * Y ω)) μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (μ {ω | t ≤ Y ω}).toReal ≤
      exp (-(1 / (4 * C)) * min (t ^ 2 / v) (t / b))

name: LeanPool.bernstein_one_sided_of_rational_cgf_bound
statement:
theorem bernstein_one_sided_of_rational_cgf_bound
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {Y : Ω → ℝ} {v b t : ℝ}
    (hv : 0 < v) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hcgf : ∀ l : ℝ, 0 ≤ l → b * l < 3 →
      cgf Y μ l ≤ v * l ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - b * l / 3)))
    (hint : ∀ l : ℝ, 0 ≤ l → b * l < 3 →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * Y ω)) μ) :
    (μ {ω | t ≤ Y ω}).toReal ≤
      exp (-(t ^ 2) / (2 * (v + b * t / 3)))

    (hC : 0 < C) (hv : 0 < v) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hcgf : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ → cgf Y μ l ≤ C * l ^ 2 * v)
    (hint : ∀ l : ℝ, |l| ≤ (2 * C * b)⁻¹ →
      Integrable (fun ω => exp (l * Y ω)) μ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (μ {ω | t ≤ |Y ω|}).toReal ≤

    (hX : IsSubGaussianProcess μ X σ)
    (T : Finset A) (hT : T.Nonempty) (hT_card : 2 ≤ T.card)
    (t₀ : A) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ T) (hcenter : ∀ ω, X t₀ ω = 0)
    -- Non-degeneracy: diam > 0 (otherwise the bound is trivial but requires extra work)
    (hdiam_pos : 0 < Metric.diam (T : Set A)) :

    ∃ C : ℝ, C > 0 ∧ C ≤ sqrt 2 ∧ ∀ t₀ ∈ T,

    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g ν) :

name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiterm.ofNat_toNat
statement:
lemma ofNat_toNat {n : ℕ} : ∀ t : Semiterm L ξ n, ofNat n (toNat t) = some t
  | #z => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | &x => by simp [toNat, ofNat]
  | func f v => by
      simp only [toNat, ofNat, Nat.unpair_pair]
      rw [Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.unpair_pair, Nat.natToVec_vecToNat]
      simp only [encodek, Option.bind_some, Option.map_eq_some_iff, func.injEq, heq_eq_eq,
        true_and, exists_eq_right]
      have : (fun i ↦ ofNat n (toNat (v i))) = (fun i ↦ pure (v i))

statement:
lemma beta_unbeta_recSequence_eq (f : List.Vector ℕ n → ℕ) (g : List.Vector ℕ (n + 2) → ℕ) (z :
    ℕ) (v :
    List.Vector ℕ n)
  (m : ℕ) (hm : m < z + 1) :
    Nat.beta (unbeta (recSequence f g z v)) m = m.rec (f v) (fun y IH => g (y ::ᵥ IH ::ᵥ v))

  {m : ℕ} (hm : m < z) :
    Nat.beta (unbeta (recSequence f g z v)) (m + 1) =
        g (m ::ᵥ Nat.beta (unbeta (recSequence f g z v)) m ::ᵥ v)

name: FirstOrder.Language.eventually_locDeepInterp_superset_iff
statement:
theorem eventually_locDeepInterp_superset_iff
    {Γ : Set (Σ n, Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n)}
    (hind : IsLomega1omegaIndiscernibleOnTail (L := Λ) a Γ)
    {t u : Λ[[J]].Term Empty}
    (hmem : (⟨(locJSupport Λ J t ∪ locJSupport Λ J u).card,
        locDeEqAtom Λ J (locJSupport Λ J t ∪ locJSupport Λ J u) t u Finset.subset_union_left
          Finset.subset_union_right⟩ : Σ n, Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n) ∈ Γ)
    {S : Finset J} (hS : locJSupport Λ J t ∪ locJSupport Λ J u ⊆ S) :
    ∀ᶠ d in Filter.atTop,
      (locDeepInterp Λ J a d (locJSupport Λ J t ∪ locJSupport Λ J u) t
            = locDeepInterp Λ J a d (locJSupport Λ J t ∪ locJSupport Λ J u) u ↔
          locDeepInterp Λ J a d S t = locDeepInterp Λ J a d S u)

name: FirstOrder.Language.locDeTermFin_realize
statement:
theorem locDeTermFin_realize (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) (t : Λ[[J]].Term Empty)
    (hsub : locJSupport Λ J t ⊆ S) :
    locDeepInterp Λ J a d S t
      = (locDeTermFin Λ J S t hsub).realize (fun i : Fin S.card => a (d + i))

name: FirstOrder.Language.locDeTermFin_realize_superset
statement:
theorem locDeTermFin_realize_superset (d : ℕ) (S T : Finset J) (w : Λ[[J]].Term Empty)
    (hw : locJSupport Λ J w ⊆ S) :
    (locDeTermFin Λ J S w hw).realize
        (fun i : Fin S.card => a (d + deepRank J T (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl i)))
      = locDeepInterp Λ J a d T w

name: FirstOrder.Language.locDeepInterp_eq_realize
statement:
theorem locDeepInterp_eq_realize (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) (t : Λ[[J]].Term Empty) :
    locDeepInterp Λ J a d S t =
      t.constantsToVars.realize (Sum.elim (fun j => a (d + deepRank J S j)) Empty.elim)

theorem locDeepInterp_func (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) {n : ℕ}

name: FirstOrder.Language.locDeepInterp_onTerm_subst
statement:
theorem locDeepInterp_onTerm_subst (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) {n : ℕ}
    (t : Λ.Term (Empty ⊕ Fin n)) (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) :
    locDeepInterp Λ J a d S
        (((lhomWithConstants Λ J).onTerm t).subst (Sum.elim (fun e => e.elim) ts)) =
      t.realize (Sum.elim Empty.elim fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J a d S (ts i))

name: FirstOrder.Language.locDeepInterp_snoc

theorem locDeepInterp_snoc (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) {n : ℕ}
    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) (u : Λ[[J]].Term Empty) :
    (fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J a d S
        ((Fin.snoc ts u : Fin (n + 1) → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) i))
      = Fin.snoc (fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J a d S (ts i)) (locDeepInterp Λ J a d S u)

statement:
theorem realize_locDeForm (d : ℕ) (S : Finset J) {n : ℕ}
    (φ : Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n)
    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) (hsub : ∀ i, locJSupport Λ J (ts i) ⊆ S) :
    (locDeForm Λ J S φ ts hsub).Realize Empty.elim (fun i : Fin S.card => a (d + i)) ↔

name: FirstOrder.Language.LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_decided
statement:
theorem LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_decided (ctx : LocalEMContext Λ J (M := M)) {n : ℕ}
    (φ : Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n)
    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) (S : Finset J)
    (hsub : ∀ i, locJSupport Λ J (ts i) ⊆ S)
    (hmem : (⟨S.card, locDeForm Λ J S φ ts hsub⟩ :
        Σ n, Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n) ∈ ctx.Γ) :
    (∀ᶠ d in Filter.atTop, φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J ctx.a d S (ts i)) ∨
      (∀ᶠ d in Filter.atTop, ¬ φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J ctx.a d S (ts
        i))

name: FirstOrder.Language.LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_equal_iff
statement:
theorem LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_equal_iff (ctx : LocalEMContext Λ J (M := M)) {n : ℕ}
    (t₁ t₂ : Λ.Term (Empty ⊕ Fin n))
    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) {S : Finset J}
    (hS : locJSupport Λ J (((lhomWithConstants Λ J).onTerm t₁).subst
            (Sum.elim (fun e => e.elim) ts))
          ∪ locJSupport Λ J (((lhomWithConstants Λ J).onTerm t₂).subst
            (Sum.elim (fun e => e.elim) ts)) ⊆ S) :
    @BoundedFormulaω.Realize (Λ[[J]]) ctx.Carrier ctx.structure Empty n
        ((BoundedFormulaω.equal t₁ t₂).mapLanguage (lhomWithConstants Λ J))
        Empty.elim (fun i => ctx.mkClass (t := ts i)) ↔
      LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth (Λ := Λ) (J := J) ctx (BoundedFormulaω.equal t₁ t₂)
        ts S

name: FirstOrder.Language.LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_falsum_iff

    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) (S : Finset J) :

name: FirstOrder.Language.LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_imp_iff
statement:
theorem LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth_imp_iff (ctx : LocalEMContext Λ J (M := M)) {n : ℕ}
    (φ ψ : Λ.BoundedFormulaω Empty n)
    (ts : Fin n → Λ[[J]].Term Empty) (S : Finset J)
    (hdec :
      (∀ᶠ d in Filter.atTop, φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J ctx.a d S (ts i)) ∨
        (∀ᶠ d in Filter.atTop, ¬ φ.Realize Empty.elim
          fun i => locDeepInterp Λ J ctx.a d S (ts i))) :
    LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth (Λ := Λ) (J := J) ctx (φ.imp ψ) ts S ↔
      (LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth (Λ := Λ) (J := J) ctx φ ts S →
        LocalEMContext.eventualDeepTruth (Λ := Λ) (J := J) ctx ψ ts S)

statement:
theorem locSkWitness_universal_of_mixin (s₀ : LocalStage) (J : Type) [LinearOrder J]
    {M : Type} [(localColim s₀).Structure M]
    (hsk : LocalSkolemUniversalForColim s₀ (M := M))

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormulaω.realize_existsBlock
statement:
theorem realize_existsBlock :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω α (n + k)),
      (existsBlock φ).Realize v xs ↔ ∃ ys : Fin k → M, φ.Realize v (Fin.append xs ys)
  | 0, φ => by
    change φ.Realize v xs ↔ _
    constructor
    · exact fun h => ⟨Fin.elim0, by rwa [append_fin_zero]⟩
    · rintro ⟨ys, hy⟩
      rwa [append_fin_zero] at hy
  | k + 1, φ => by
    change (existsBlock φ.ex).Realize v xs ↔ _
    rw [realize_existsBlock φ.ex]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ys, hy⟩
      rw [realize_ex] at hy
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩

  | 0, φ => by
    change φ.Realize v xs ↔ _
    constructor

      rwa [append_fin_zero]
    · intro h

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn
statement:
theorem BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn {M : Type} (S S' : L.Structure M) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω α n)
      (_ : ∀ p ∈ φ.functionsIn, ∀ x : Fin p.1 → M,
        @Structure.funMap L M S p.1 p.2 x = @Structure.funMap L M S' p.1 p.2 x)
      (_ : ∀ p ∈ φ.relationsIn, ∀ x : Fin p.1 → M,
        (@Structure.RelMap L M S p.1 p.2 x ↔ @Structure.RelMap L M S' p.1 p.2 x))
      (v : α → M) (xs : Fin n → M),
      @BoundedFormulaω.Realize L M S α n φ v xs ↔ @BoundedFormulaω.Realize L M S' α n φ v xs
  | _, .falsum, _, _, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | _, .equal t₁ t₂, hf, _, v, xs => by
    change @Term.realize L M S _ _ t₁ = @Term.realize L M S _ _ t₂
      ↔ @Term.realize L M S' _ _ t₁ = @Term.realize L M S' _ _ t₂
    rw [Term.realize_congr_functionsIn S S' t₁ (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_union_left _ hp)),
      Term.realize_congr_functionsIn S S' t₂ (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_union_right _ hp))]
  | _, .rel R ts, hf, hr, v, xs => by
    change @Structure.RelMap L M S _ R _ ↔ @Structure.RelMap L M S' _ R _
    rw [show (fun i => @Term.realize L M S _ _ (ts i))
        = (fun i => @Term.realize L M S' _ _ (ts i)) from funext fun i =>
          Term.realize_congr_functionsIn S S' (ts i)
            (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hp⟩)) _]
    exact hr ⟨_, R⟩ rfl _
  | _, .imp φ ψ, hf, hr, v, xs =>
    -- term mode: the lemma is stated through the reducible `BoundedFormulaω.Realize` alias,
    -- so `rw` cannot key on it against a goal in `BoundedFormulaInf.Realize`
    Iff.imp
      (BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn S S' φ
        (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_union_left _ hp))
        (fun p hp => hr p (Set.mem_union_left _ hp)) v xs)
      (BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn S S' ψ
        (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_union_right _ hp))
        (fun p hp => hr p (Set.mem_union_right _ hp)) v xs)
  | _, .all φ, hf, hr, v, xs =>
    forall_congr' fun x =>
      BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn S S' φ hf hr v (Fin.snoc xs x)
  | _, .iSup φs, hf, hr, v, xs =>
    exists_congr fun i => BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn S S' (φs i)
      (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hp⟩))
      (fun p hp => hr p (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hp⟩)) v xs
  | _, .iInf φs, hf, hr, v, xs =>
    forall_congr' fun i => BoundedFormulaω.realize_congr_symbolsIn S S' (φs i)
      (fun p hp => hf p (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hp⟩))
      (fun p hp => hr p (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hp⟩)) v xs

statement:
theorem MarkerHenkinConsistent.branch_choice
    {F : Finset ((L''[[J]])[[ℕ]].Sentenceω)} (h : MarkerHenkinConsistent M F)
    {K : Type} [Countable K] (branch : K → (L''[[J]])[[ℕ]].Sentenceω)

    (hbJ : ∀ k, expJConstsIn (L'' := L'') (branch k) ⊆ expJConstsIn (L'' := L'') trigger)

    (F₂ : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (R₂ : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n))
    (r₁ r₂ : L[[ℕ]].Sentenceω)

    ∃ θ : L.Sentenceω,
      θ.functionsIn ⊆ r₁.functionsIn ∩ r₂.functionsIn ∧

    (F : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (R : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n)) (r₁ r₂ : L.Sentenceω)
    (hr₁F : r₁.functionsIn ⊆ F) (hr₁R : r₁.relationsIn ⊆ R)
    (hr₂F : r₂.functionsIn ⊆ F) (hr₂R : r₂.relationsIn ⊆ R)
    (hE : Sentenceω.Entails r₁ r₂) :
    Sentenceω.Entails (r₁.restrictSymbols hr₁F hr₁R) (r₂.restrictSymbols hr₂F hr₂R)

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_restrictSymbols_expandSymbStructureBase
statement:
theorem realize_restrictSymbols_expandSymbStructureBase
    (F : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (R : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n)) {M : Type} [Nonempty M]
    [instM : (symbSublang (L := L) F R).Structure M]
    {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω Empty n) (hF : φ.functionsIn ⊆ F) (hR : φ.relationsIn ⊆ R)
    (v : Empty → M) (xs : Fin n → M) :
    @BoundedFormulaω.Realize (symbSublang (L := L) F R) M instM Empty n
        (φ.restrictSymbols hF hR) v xs
      ↔ @BoundedFormulaω.Realize L M (expandSymbStructureBase F R) Empty n φ v xs

name: FirstOrder.Language.reduct_expandSymbStructureBase
statement:
theorem reduct_expandSymbStructureBase
    (F : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (R : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n)) {M : Type} [Nonempty M]
    [instM : (symbSublang (L := L) F R).Structure M] :
    @LHom.reduct (symbSublang (L := L) F R) L (symbSublangIncl F R) M (expandSymbStructureBase F R)
      = instM

    (h : Sentenceω.Entails r₁ r₂) :
    ∃ θ : L.Sentenceω,
      θ.functionsIn ⊆ r₁.functionsIn ∩ r₂.functionsIn ∧
      θ.relationsIn ⊆ r₁.relationsIn ∩ r₂.relationsIn ∧
      Sentenceω.Entails r₁ θ ∧ Sentenceω.Entails θ r₂

name: FirstOrder.Language.entails_mapLanguage_restrictSymbols_left
statement:
theorem entails_mapLanguage_restrictSymbols_left (F : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n))
    (R : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n)) (r : L.Sentenceω) (hF : r.functionsIn ⊆ F)
    (hR : r.relationsIn ⊆ R) (θ' : (symbSublang (L := L) F R).Sentenceω)
    (hE : Sentenceω.Entails (r.restrictSymbols hF hR) θ') :

    (hE : Sentenceω.Entails θ' (r.restrictSymbols hF hR)) :

    (hR : r.relationsIn ⊆ R) (θ' : (symbSublang (L := L) F R).Sentenceω)

    (hsub : θ'.relationsIn ⊆ (r.restrictSymbols hF hR).relationsIn) :

name: FirstOrder.Language.craig_pcSeparation_relational
statement:
theorem craig_pcSeparation_relational [L.IsRelational] (ψ₁ ψ₂ : L.Sentenceω)
    (h : Sentenceω.Entails ψ₁ ψ₂.not) :
    ∃ θ₀ : (symbSublang (ψ₁.functionsIn ∩ ψ₂.functionsIn)
        (ψ₁.relationsIn ∩ ψ₂.relationsIn)).Sentenceω,
      (∀ (M : Type) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M], Sentenceω.Realize ψ₁ M →
          @Sentenceω.Realize (symbSublang (ψ₁.functionsIn ∩ ψ₂.functionsIn)
            (ψ₁.relationsIn ∩ ψ₂.relationsIn)) θ₀ M
            ((symbSublangIncl _ _).reduct M)) ∧
      (∀ (M : Type) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M], Sentenceω.Realize ψ₂ M →
          ¬ @Sentenceω.Realize (symbSublang (ψ₁.functionsIn ∩ ψ₂.functionsIn)
            (ψ₁.relationsIn ∩ ψ₂.relationsIn)) θ₀ M
            ((symbSublangIncl _ _).reduct M))

theorem relSym_inter (F₁ : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (R₁ : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n))

statement:
theorem realize_graphAxioms_iff (F : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) [Countable ↥F] :
    Sentenceω.Realize (graphAxioms F) M ↔
      ∀ p : ↥F,
        Sentenceω.Realize (graphTotality p.1.2) M ∧
          Sentenceω.Realize (graphFunctionality p.1.2) M

statement:

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_graphFunctionality
statement:
theorem realize_graphFunctionality {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n) :
    Sentenceω.Realize (graphFunctionality f) M ↔
      ∀ (ws : Fin n → M) (y z : M),
        RelMap (L := graphLanguage L) (GraphRelation.graph f) (Fin.snoc ws y) →
        RelMap (L := graphLanguage L) (GraphRelation.graph f) (Fin.snoc ws z) → y = z

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_graphTotality
statement:
theorem realize_graphTotality {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n) :
    Sentenceω.Realize (graphTotality f) M ↔
      ∀ ws : Fin n → M, ∃ y : M,
        RelMap (L := graphLanguage L) (GraphRelation.graph f) (Fin.snoc ws y)

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_graphTermLift
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_graphTermLift {k : ℕ} (u : (graphLanguage L).Term (α ⊕ Fin m))
    (v : α → M) (xs : Fin m → M) (ws : Fin k → M) :
    (graphTermLift k u).realize (Sum.elim v (Fin.append xs ws)) = u.realize (Sum.elim v xs)

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_graphWitnessVar
statement:
@[simp] theorem realize_graphWitnessVar {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k)
    (v : α → M) (xs : Fin m → M) (ws : Fin k → M) :
    (graphWitnessVar (L := L) m i).realize (Sum.elim v (Fin.append xs ws)) = ws i

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_termGraphAux
statement:
theorem realize_termGraphAux :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} (t : L.Term β) (ρ : β → (graphLanguage L).Term (α ⊕ Fin m))
      (y : (graphLanguage L).Term (α ⊕ Fin m)) (v : α → M) (xs : Fin m → M),
      (termGraphAux t ρ y).Realize v xs ↔
        (t.realize fun z => (ρ z).realize (Sum.elim v xs)) = y.realize (Sum.elim v xs)
  | _, .var z, ρ, y, v, xs => by
    simp only [termGraphAux, BoundedFormulaω.realize_equal, Term.realize]
  | m, Term.func (l := k) f ts, ρ, y, v, xs => by
    have hIH : ∀ (ws : Fin _ → M) (i),
        (termGraphAux (ts i) (fun z => graphTermLift _ (ρ z))
            (graphWitnessVar m i)).Realize v (Fin.append xs ws) ↔
          (ts i).realize (fun z => (ρ z).realize (Sum.elim v xs)) = ws i := by
      intro ws i
      rw [realize_termGraphAux (ts i)]
      simp only [realize_graphTermLift, realize_graphWitnessVar]
    have hinit : ∀ ws : Fin k → M,
        (Fin.init fun j => Term.realize (Sum.elim v (Fin.append xs ws))
          ((Fin.snoc (fun i => graphWitnessVar m i) (graphTermLift k y) :
            Fin (k + 1) → (graphLanguage L).Term (α ⊕ Fin (m + k))) j)) = ws := by
      intro ws
      funext i
      change Term.realize _
        ((Fin.snoc (fun i => graphWitnessVar m i) (graphTermLift k y) :
          Fin (k + 1) → (graphLanguage L).Term (α ⊕ Fin (m + k))) (Fin.castSucc i)) = ws i
      rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact realize_graphWitnessVar i v xs ws
    change (BoundedFormulaω.existsBlock _).Realize v xs ↔ _
    rw [BoundedFormulaω.realize_existsBlock]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ws, hw⟩
      rw [BoundedFormulaω.realize_and, BoundedFormulaω.realize_einf] at hw
      obtain ⟨hconj, hatom⟩
