name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_relationalizeFormula
statement:
theorem realize_relationalizeFormula :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω α n) (v : α → M) (xs : Fin n → M),
      (relationalizeFormula φ).Realize v xs ↔ φ.Realize v xs
  | _, .falsum, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | _, .equal t u, v, xs => realize_equalGraph t u v xs
  | _, .rel R ts, v, xs => realize_relGraph R ts v xs
  | _, .imp φ ψ, v, xs => by
    rw [relationalizeFormula_imp, BoundedFormulaω.realize_imp, BoundedFormulaω.realize_imp,
      realize_relationalizeFormula φ, realize_relationalizeFormula ψ]
  | _, .all φ, v, xs => by
    rw [relationalizeFormula_all, BoundedFormulaω.realize_all, BoundedFormulaω.realize_all]
    exact forall_congr' fun x => realize_relationalizeFormula φ v _
  | _, .iSup φs, v, xs => by
    rw [relationalizeFormula_iSup, BoundedFormulaω.realize_iSup, BoundedFormulaω.realize_iSup]
    exact exists_congr fun i => realize_relationalizeFormula (φs i) v xs
  | _, .iInf φs, v, xs => by
    rw [relationalizeFormula_iInf, BoundedFormulaω.realize_iInf, BoundedFormulaω.realize_iInf]
    exact forall_congr' fun i => realize_relationalizeFormula (φs i) v xs

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormulaω.hasQuantSigned_openBounds
statement:
theorem hasQuantSigned_openBounds (s : Bool) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω Empty n),
      hasQuantSigned s (φ.openBounds) ↔ hasQuantSigned s φ
  | _, .falsum => Iff.rfl
  | _, .equal _ _ => Iff.rfl
  | _, .rel _ _ => Iff.rfl
  | _, .imp φ ψ => by
    change hasQuantSigned (!s) (φ.openBounds) ∨ hasQuantSigned s (ψ.openBounds) ↔ _
    rw [hasQuantSigned_openBounds _ φ, hasQuantSigned_openBounds s ψ]
    exact Iff.rfl
  | _, .all φ => by
    change s = true ∨ hasQuantSigned s ((φ.openBounds).relabel insertLastBound) ↔ _
    rw [hasQuantSigned_relabel, hasQuantSigned_openBounds s φ]
    exact Iff.rfl
  | _, .iSup φs => by
    change (∃ i, hasQuantSigned s ((φs i).openBounds)) ↔ _
    exact exists_congr fun i => hasQuantSigned_openBounds s (φs i)
  | _, .iInf φs => by
    change (∃ i, hasQuantSigned s ((φs i).openBounds)) ↔ _
    exact exists_congr fun i => hasQuantSigned_openBounds s (φs i)

name: FirstOrder.Language.truthLemma
statement:
theorem truthLemma :
    (σ : L.Sentenceω) → (σ ∈ S ↔ Sentenceω.Realize σ (TermModel C S hmax))
  | .falsum => by
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (C.toConsistencyProperty.C0_no_falsum S hmax.consistent)
    · intro h; exact absurd h id
  | .imp φ ψ => by
    have ihφ := truthLemma φ
    have ihψ := truthLemma ψ
    constructor
    · -- Forward: imp φ ψ ∈ S → (Realize φ M → Realize ψ M)
      intro himp hφ_real
      -- C1: from imp φ ψ ∈ S, either φ.not ∈ S or ψ ∈ S
      rcases hmax.imp_mem himp with h | h
      · -- φ.not ∈ S means φ ∉ S. But IH backward gives φ ∈ S from Realize φ M. Contradiction.
        exact absurd (ihφ.mpr hφ_real) ((hmax.not_mem_iff φ).mp h)
      · -- ψ ∈ S, so Realize ψ M by IH forward
        exact ihψ.mp h
    · -- Backward: (Realize φ M → Realize ψ M) → imp φ ψ ∈ S
      intro hreal
      -- Decidability: imp φ ψ ∈ S or (imp φ ψ).not ∈ S
      rcases hmax.decide (BoundedFormulaω.imp φ ψ) with h | h
      · exact h
      · -- C1': from (imp φ ψ).not ∈ S, get φ ∈ S and ψ.not ∈ S
        obtain ⟨hφ_mem, hψnot⟩

name: FirstOrder.Language.realize_backTranslateFormula
statement:
theorem realize_backTranslateFormula :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (θ : (graphLanguage L).BoundedFormulaω α n) (v : α → M) (xs : Fin n → M),
      (backTranslateFormula θ).Realize v xs ↔
        @BoundedFormulaω.Realize (graphLanguage L) M (graphExpansion L M) α n θ v xs
  | _, .falsum, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | _, .equal t u, v, xs => by
    change (ungraphTerm t).realize _ = (ungraphTerm u).realize _ ↔ _
    rw [realize_ungraphTerm (graphExpansion L M) t, realize_ungraphTerm (graphExpansion L M) u]
    exact Iff.rfl
  | _, .rel (GraphRelation.base R₀) ts, v, xs => by
    change RelMap R₀ _ ↔ (graphExpansion L M).RelMap (GraphRelation.base R₀) _
    rw [graphExpansion_relMap_base]
    rw [show (fun i => @Term.realize (graphLanguage L) M (graphExpansion L M) _
        (Sum.elim v xs) (ts i)) = fun i => (ungraphTerm (ts i)).realize (Sum.elim v xs) from
      funext fun i => (realize_ungraphTerm (graphExpansion L M) (ts i) _).symm]
  | _, .rel (GraphRelation.graph f) ts, v, xs => by
    have hinit : (fun i => Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs)
        ((Fin.init fun j => ungraphTerm (ts j)) i)) =
        Fin.init (fun j => @Term.realize (graphLanguage L) M (graphExpansion L M) _
          (Sum.elim v xs) (ts j))

      (∀ (M : Type) [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M], Sentenceω.Realize ψ₂ M →
          ¬ @Sentenceω.Realize (symbSublang (ψ₁.functionsIn ∩ ψ₂.functionsIn)

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormulaω.relationsInSigned_mapLanguage
statement:
theorem relationsInSigned_mapLanguage {L' : Language.{0, 0}} (g : L →ᴸ L') (s : Bool) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω α n),
      relationsInSigned s (φ.mapLanguage g) =
        (fun p : Σ n, L.Relations n => ⟨p.1, g.onRelation p.2⟩) '' relationsInSigned s φ
  | _, .falsum => by simp [mapLanguage]
  | _, .equal _ _ => by simp [mapLanguage]
  | _, .rel R ts => by cases s <;> simp [mapLanguage]
  | _, .imp φ ψ => by
    simp only [mapLanguage, relationsInSigned_imp, Set.image_union,
      relationsInSigned_mapLanguage g _ φ, relationsInSigned_mapLanguage g s ψ]
  | _, .all φ => by
    simp only [mapLanguage, relationsInSigned_all, relationsInSigned_mapLanguage g s φ]
  | _, .iSup φs => by
    simp only [mapLanguage, relationsInSigned_iSup, Set.image_iUnion]
    exact Set.iUnion_congr fun i => relationsInSigned_mapLanguage g s (φs i)
  | _, .iInf φs => by
    simp only [mapLanguage, relationsInSigned_iInf, Set.image_iUnion]
    exact Set.iUnion_congr fun i => relationsInSigned_mapLanguage g s (φs i)

name: FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormulaω.relationsIn_eq_signed_union
statement:
theorem relationsIn_eq_signed_union :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormulaω α n),
      φ.relationsIn = φ.positiveRelationsIn ∪ φ.negativeRelationsIn
  | _, .falsum => by simp [relationsIn]
  | _, .equal _ _ => by simp [relationsIn]
  | _, .rel R ts => by simp [relationsIn]
  | _, .imp φ ψ => by
    rw [relationsIn, relationsIn_eq_signed_union φ, relationsIn_eq_signed_union ψ]
    simp only [relationsInSigned_imp, Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false]
    ac_rfl
  | _, .all φ => by rw [relationsIn, relationsIn_eq_signed_union φ]; simp
  | _, .iSup φs => by
    rw [relationsIn]
    simp only [relationsInSigned_iSup]
    rw [← Set.iUnion_union_distrib]
    exact Set.iUnion_congr fun i => relationsIn_eq_signed_union (φs i)
  | _, .iInf φs => by
    rw [relationsIn]
    simp only [relationsInSigned_iInf]
    rw [← Set.iUnion_union_distrib]
    exact Set.iUnion_congr fun i => relationsIn_eq_signed_union (φs i)

    (F₂ : Set (Σ n, L.Functions n)) (P₂ N₂ : Set (Σ n, L.Relations n))
    (r₁ r₂ : L[[ℕ]].Sentenceω)
    (hr₁ : (sentenceJConsts (L' := L) (J := ℕ) r₁).Finite)
    (hr₂ : (sentenceJConsts (L' := L) (J := ℕ) r₂).Finite)
    (hr₁sent : r₁ ∈ SentBndPol F₁ P₁ N₁) (hr₂sent : r₂.not ∈ SentBndPol F₂ P₂ N₂)
    (A₀ : Finset ℕ)
    (hsupp : sentenceJConsts (L' := L) (J := ℕ) r₁ ∪ sentenceJConsts (L' := L) (J := ℕ) r₂.not
      ⊆ (↑A₀ : Set ℕ))

      Sentenceω.Realize r₁ M ∧ ¬ Sentenceω.Realize r₂ M

      θ₀.positiveRelationsIn ⊆ σ.basePositiveRelations ∧
      θ₀.negativeRelationsIn ⊆ σ.baseNegativeRelations ∧
      Theoryω.Entails Γ₀ θ₀ ∧ Theoryω.Entails Δ₀ θ₀.not

name: aeval_sumDeriv_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
lemma aeval_sumDeriv_eq_sum_Icc
    (T : ℤ[X]) (a : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ rootMultiplicity a (T.map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))) :
    aeval a (sumDeriv T)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc m T.natDegree, aeval a ((derivative^[i]) T)

name: aeval_Fpd
statement:
lemma aeval_Fpd (T : ℤ[X]) (p m : ℕ) (a : ℂ) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (hmT : m ≤ rootMultiplicity a (T.map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))) :
    aeval a (Fpd T p)
      =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc  ((if a = 0 then (p - 1) else 0) + p * m)
                        (Fp T p).natDegree,
        aeval a ((derivative^[i]) (Fp T p))

name: aeval_Fpd_at_nonzero
statement:
lemma aeval_Fpd_at_nonzero (T : ℤ[X]) (p : ℕ) (a : ℂ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hroot : a ∈ T.aroots ℂ) : aeval a (Fpd T p) = aeval a (sumStartpDerivFp T p)

name: aeval_Fpd_at_zero
statement:
lemma aeval_Fpd_at_zero (T : ℤ[X]) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    aeval (0 : ℂ) (Fpd T p)
      = (p - 1).factorial * (aeval (0 : ℂ) T) ^ p + aeval (0 : ℂ) (sumStartpDerivFp T p)

name: factorise_sumIteratedDerivPoly
statement:
lemma factorise_sumIteratedDerivPoly {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (T : R[X]) (p : ℕ) :

name: intExpNegPoly_sum_simp
statement:
lemma intExpNegPoly_sum_simp (n p : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
  ∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i) * intExpNegPoly (Fp T p) (a i) =
    aeval 0 (Fpd T p) * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i) -
      ∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Fpd T p)

name: natDegree_Fp
statement:
lemma natDegree_Fp {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (T : R[X]) (p : ℕ) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    (Fp T p).natDegree = (p - 1) + p * T.natDegree

name: natDegree_iterate_derivative_Fp_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_iterate_derivative_Fp_le {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    (T : R[X]) (p i : ℕ) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    ((derivative^[i]) (Fp T p)).natDegree ≤ (p - 1) + p * T.natDegree - i

name: rootMultiplicity_Fp
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_Fp (T : ℤ[X]) (p : ℕ) (a : ℂ) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    rootMultiplicity a ((Fp T p).map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))
      = (if a = 0 then (p - 1) else 0) + p * rootMultiplicity a (T.map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))

name: rootMultiplicity_npow
statement:
lemma rootMultiplicity_npow (T : ℤ[X]) (a : ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    rootMultiplicity a ((T.map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))^p)
      = p * rootMultiplicity a (T.map (algebraMap ℤ ℂ))

name: Fp_bounded
statement:
lemma Fp_bounded
  (T : ℤ[X]) (a : ℂ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖aeval (t * a) (Fp T p)‖ ≤ ‖a‖ ^ (p - 1) * M ^ p

name: Fp_cexp_bounded
statement:
lemma Fp_cexp_bounded (T : ℤ[X]) (a : ℂ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖a * cexp (-(t * a)) * aeval (t * a) (Fp T p)‖ ≤ ‖a‖ ^ p * rexp ‖a‖ * M ^ p

name: intExpNegPoly_bounded
statement:
lemma intExpNegPoly_bounded
  (T : ℤ[X]) (a : ℂ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ‖intExpNegPoly (Fp T p) a‖
      ≤ ‖a‖ ^ p * rexp ‖a‖ * M ^ p

name: intExpNegPoly_eq
statement:
lemma intExpNegPoly_eq
    (n p : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (a b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hp : 0 < p)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, a i ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ i : Fin n, a i ∈ T.aroots ℂ) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i) * intExpNegPoly (Fp T p) (a i)
      =
      ((((p - 1).factorial * (aeval (0 : ℂ) T) ^ p
          + p.factorial * aeval (0 : ℂ) (Gp T p))
        * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i))
        - p.factorial * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Gp T p))

name: sum_Gp_asym_lbound
statement:
lemma sum_Gp_asym_lbound
  (n : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) (c k : ℤ) (f : ℕ → ℤ)
  (hc : c ≠ 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hT : aeval (0 : ℂ) T ≠ 0)
  (hf : ∀ᶠ p : {p : ℕ // Nat.Prime p} in Filter.atTop,
    c ^ (p : ℕ) * (∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Gp T (p : ℕ)))
      = (f (p : ℕ) : ℂ)) :
    ∀ᶠ p : {p : ℕ // Nat.Prime p} in Filter.atTop,
      ‖c ^ (p : ℕ) * ((((p : ℕ) - 1).factorial * (aeval (0 : ℂ) T) ^ (p : ℕ)
        + (p : ℕ).factorial * aeval (0 : ℂ) (Gp T (p : ℕ))) * (-(k))
            - (p : ℕ).factorial * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Gp T (p : ℕ)))‖
        ≥ ((p : ℕ) - 1).factorial

name: sum_cexp_simp
statement:
lemma sum_cexp_simp
  (n p : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (a b : Fin n → ℂ)
  (hn : 0 < n) (hp : 0 < p)
  (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, a i ≠ 0)
  (hroot : ∀ i : Fin n, a i ∈ T.aroots ℂ) :
    aeval 0 (Fpd T p) * (∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i))
      - ∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Fpd T p) =
    ((p - 1).factorial * (aeval (0 : ℂ) T) ^ p
        + p.factorial * aeval (0 : ℂ) (Gp T p))
      * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i)
      - p.factorial * ∑ i : Fin n, b i * aeval (a i) (Gp T p)

name: sum_intExpNegPoly_asym_ubound
statement:
lemma sum_intExpNegPoly_asym_ubound
  (n : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (hn : 0 < n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ (p : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ‖c ^ p * (∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i) * intExpNegPoly (Fp T p) (a i))‖
        < (p - 1).factorial

name: sum_intExpNegPoly_bound
statement:
lemma sum_intExpNegPoly_bound
  (n : ℕ) (T : ℤ[X]) (hn : 0 < n) (a b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    ∃ A B : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ‖∑ i : Fin n, b i * cexp (a i) * intExpNegPoly (Fp T p) (a i)‖
        ≤ A * B ^ p)

name: aroots_of_T'
statement:
lemma aroots_of_T'

name: RS.eq_principalPart_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem eq_principalPart_of_eventuallyEq {c : ℤ → ℂ} {s : Finset ℤ}
    (hs : ∀ k ∈ s, k < 0) (hh : AnalyticAt ℂ h z₀)
    (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] z₀] fun z => (∑ k ∈ s, c k * (z - z₀) ^ k) + h z) :
    (∀ k ∈ s, c k = laurentCoeffAt f z₀ k) ∧
      (∀ k < 0, k ∉ s → laurentCoeffAt f z₀ k = 0) ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, taylorCoeffAt h z₀ j = laurentCoeffAt f z₀ (j : ℤ)

    (hU : IsOpen U) (_hpU : p ∈ U)
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g U) (hcs : HasCompactSupport g) (hsub : tsupport g ⊆ U)

      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ i) V) ∧ (∀ i z, 0 ≤ ψ i z) ∧

    (hcoc : ∀ i j k, ∀ z ∈ W i ∩ W j ∩ W k, f i k z = f i j z + f j k z) :

theorem resAt_traceZk (hh : MeromorphicAt h 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    resAt (traceZk h k) 0 = (k : ℂ) * laurentCoeffAt h 0 (-(k : ℤ))

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_add
statement: theorem traceZk_add (hk : k ≠ 0) : traceZk (h + g) k = traceZk h k + traceZk g k

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_apply_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem traceZk_apply_of_ne_zero (hk : k ≠ 0) (_hw : w ≠ 0) :
    traceZk h k w = ∑ z ∈ (RS.setOf_pow_eq_finite hk w).toFinset, h z

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_comp_pow
statement:
theorem traceZk_comp_pow (g : ℂ → ℂ) (hk : k ≠ 0) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    traceZk (fun z => g (z ^ k)) k w = k * g w

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_const_mul
statement:
theorem traceZk_const_mul (c : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    traceZk (fun z => c * h z) k = fun w => c * traceZk h k w

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_def
statement:
theorem traceZk_def (h : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (w : ℂ) :
    traceZk h k w = ∑ᶠ z ∈ {z : ℂ | z ^ k = w}, h z

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_eq_finset_sum
statement:
theorem traceZk_eq_finset_sum (h : ℂ → ℂ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) :
    traceZk h k w = ∑ z ∈ (RS.setOf_pow_eq_finite hk w).toFinset, h z

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_fun_add
statement:
theorem traceZk_fun_add (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    traceZk (fun z => h z + g z) k = fun w => traceZk h k w + traceZk g k w

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_zero_apply
statement: theorem traceZk_zero_apply (hk : k ≠ 0) : traceZk h k 0 = h 0

name: RS.MTrace.traceZk_zpow
statement:
theorem traceZk_zpow (hk : k ≠ 0) (e : ℤ) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    traceZk (fun z => z ^ e) k w = if (k : ℤ) ∣ e then (k : ℂ) * w ^ (e / (k : ℤ)) else 0

name: RS.FormTrace.laurentCoeffAt_traceZkForm
statement:
theorem laurentCoeffAt_traceZkForm (hh : MeromorphicAt h 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    RS.laurentCoeffAt (traceZkForm h k) 0 j = RS.laurentCoeffAt h 0 ((k : ℤ) * j + ((k : ℤ) - 1))

name: RS.FormTrace.meromorphicAt_traceZkForm
statement:
theorem meromorphicAt_traceZkForm (hh : MeromorphicAt h 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) :

name: RS.FormTrace.resAt_traceZkForm
statement:
theorem resAt_traceZkForm (hh : MeromorphicAt h 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) :

name: RS.FormTrace.traceZkForm_def
statement:
theorem traceZkForm_def (h : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (w : ℂ) :
    traceZkForm h k w = RS.MTrace.traceZk (fun v => h v * ((k : ℂ) * v ^ ((k : ℤ) - 1))⁻¹) k w

name: RS.FormTrace.traceZkForm_hAdapted_eq_apply
statement:
theorem traceZkForm_hAdapted_eq_apply (hk : k ≠ 0) {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    traceZkForm (fun v => g v * (k : ℂ) * v ^ ((k : ℤ) - 1)) k w = RS.MTrace.traceZk g k w

name: RS.coeffInFun_mdifferentialSection

    {e' : OpenPartialHomeomorph Y ℂ} (he' : e' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(ℂ) ω Y) (hy : f x ∈ e'.source) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (⇑e' ∘ f ∘ ⇑e.symm) (e x)

name: RS.coeffInFun_pullbackSection
statement:
theorem coeffInFun_pullbackSection {f : X → Y} (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℂ) 𝓘(ℂ) ω f) (η : Form1 Y)
    {e : OpenPartialHomeomorph X ℂ} (he : e ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(ℂ) ω X)
    {e' : OpenPartialHomeomorph Y ℂ} (he' : e' ∈ maximalAtlas 𝓘(ℂ) ω Y)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ e.target) (hy : f (e.symm z) ∈ e'.source) :
    coeffInFun e (pullbackSection f η) z =
      deriv (⇑e' ∘ f ∘ ⇑e.symm) z * coeffIn e' η (e' (f (e.symm z)))

name: KaltonRoberts.compact_reduction_from_local
statement:
theorem compact_reduction_from_local {α : Type*} [BooleanAlgebra α]
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (f : α → ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ T : Finset α, ∃ ν : α → ℝ,
      (∀ A ∈ T, |f A - ν A| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ A ∈ T, ∀ B ∈ T, Disjoint A B → A ⊔ B ∈ T →
        ν (A ⊔ B) = ν A + ν B)) :
    ∃ μ : α → ℝ, IsFinitelyAdditiveBA μ ∧ ∀ A : α, |f A - μ A| ≤ C

name: KaltonRoberts.deficit_intersection
statement:
theorem deficit_intersection {U : Type*} [DecidableEq U]
    (f : Finset U → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditive f 1) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ S : Finset U, |f S| ≤ M)
    (A B : Finset U) (a b : ℝ)
    (hA : f A = M - a) (hB : f B = M - b) :
    f (A ∩ B) ≥ M - a - b - 2

name: KaltonRoberts.finite_boolean_algebra_bound_of_powerset
statement:
theorem finite_boolean_algebra_bound_of_powerset
    (C : ℝ)
    (hfin : ∀ (U : Type (max 0 u)) [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U]
      (f : Finset U → ℝ), IsApproxAdditive f 1 →
        ∃ a : U → ℝ, ∀ S : Finset U, |f S - additiveFunction a S| ≤ C)
    (α : Type u) [BooleanAlgebra α] [Finite α]
    (f : α → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditiveBA f 1) :
    ∃ μ : α → ℝ, IsFinitelyAdditiveBA μ ∧ ∀ A : α, |f A - μ A| ≤ C

name: KaltonRoberts.finite_reduction
statement:
theorem finite_reduction
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfin : ∀ (U : Type (max 0 u)) [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U]
      (f : Finset U → ℝ), IsApproxAdditive f 1 →
        ∃ a : U → ℝ, ∀ S : Finset U, |f S - additiveFunction a S| ≤ C)
    : ∀ (α : Type u) [BooleanAlgebra α]
        (f : α → ℝ), IsApproxAdditiveBA f 1 →
          ∃ μ : α → ℝ, IsFinitelyAdditiveBA μ ∧ ∀ A : α, |f A - μ A| ≤ C

name: KaltonRoberts.local_approximation_of_finite_boolean_algebras
statement:
theorem local_approximation_of_finite_boolean_algebras {α : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra α]
    (C : ℝ)
    (hfiniteBA : ∀ (β : Type u) [BooleanAlgebra β] [Fintype β]
      (g : β → ℝ), IsApproxAdditiveBA g 1 →
        ∃ μ : β → ℝ, IsFinitelyAdditiveBA μ ∧ ∀ B : β, |g B - μ B| ≤ C)
    (f : α → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditiveBA f 1) :
    ∀ T : Finset α, ∃ ν : α → ℝ,
      (∀ A ∈ T, |f A - ν A| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ A ∈ T, ∀ B ∈ T, Disjoint A B → A ⊔ B ∈ T →
        ν (A ⊔ B) = ν A + ν B)

name: KaltonRoberts.mixed_intersection_deficit_bound

    ℓ * E + 2 * ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) + τ * (E + 2) ≥ 0

name: KaltonRoberts.mixed_intersection_frequency_mono

    (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) (_ht : 0 ≤ t₁) (_ht12 : t₁ ≤ t₂) (_ht2 : t₂ ≤ 1)
    (ℓ : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (_hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (_hτ1 : τ ≤ 1) :
    (1 - τ) * t₁ ^ ℓ + τ * t₁ ^ (ℓ + 1) ≤
      (1 - τ) * t₂ ^ ℓ + τ * t₂ ^ (ℓ + 1)

name: KaltonRoberts.one_sided_recombination_discard

    (θ M D D' r : ℝ) (_hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hD' : 0 ≤ D')
    (hrec : (1 - θ) * M ≤ D - θ * D' + 2 * r - 1 - θ) :
    M ≤ (D + 2 * r - 1 - θ) / (1 - θ)

name: KaltonRoberts.one_sided_recombination_ineq

    M ≤ (D + 2 * r - 1 - θ) / (1 - θ) - θ / (1 - θ) * D'

name: KaltonRoberts.two_sided_recombination

    (_hθ : 0 < θ) (_hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (h_pos : (1 - θ) * M ≤ D - θ * D' + 2 * r - 1 - θ)
    (h_neg : (1 - θ) * M ≤ S - θ * S' + 2 * r - 1 - θ) :
    (1 - θ) * M ≤ (D + S) / 2 - θ * (D' + S') / 2 + 2 * r - 1 - θ

name: KaltonRoberts.WeightedCollection.mixedInter_avgDeficit_le

name: KaltonRoberts.deficit_finsetInter_le

theorem deficit_finsetInter_le (f : Finset U → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditive f 1)

    (hcard_N : (Finset.Icc 1 A).card ≤ N)

    ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A, T m ≤ q / (1 - q) + (N : ℝ) * B

name: KaltonRoberts.card_constrained_perm_subsets
statement:
theorem card_constrained_perm_subsets {n : ℕ}
    (A B : Finset (Fin n)) (hs : A.card ≤ B.card) (ht : B.card ≤ n) :
    Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) // ∀ a ∈ A, σ a ∈ B} =
    B.card.descFactorial A.card * (n - A.card).factorial

name: KaltonRoberts.card_perm_constrained

    t.descFactorial s * (n - s).factorial

    Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) //
      ∀ (i : Fin n), i.val < s → (σ i).val < t} * (t - s)

      (Fintype.card {σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) // ∀ a ∈ p.1, σ a ∈ p.2} : ℝ) / n.factorial) < 1) :

name: KaltonRoberts.good_matching_exists_of_ratio_sum_lt_one
statement:
theorem good_matching_exists_of_ratio_sum_lt_one
    (N L r c A : ℕ) (_hN : 0 < N) (hL : 0 < L) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : r < c)
    (hNL : r * N = c * L) (hA : A ≤ L)
    (hsum : (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A,
      (N.choose m : ℝ) * ↑(L.choose m) *
        ↑((c * m).choose (r * m)) / ↑((r * N).choose (r * m))) < 1) :
    ∃ (edge : Fin N → Fin r → Fin L),
      (∀ w : Fin L, ∃ v : Fin N, ∃ e : Fin r, edge v e = w) ∧
      (∀ S : Finset (Fin N), S.card ≤ A →
        (S.biUnion (fun v => Finset.univ.image (edge v))).card ≥ S.card)

name: KaltonRoberts.good_perm_indexed_of_sum_lt
statement:
theorem good_perm_indexed_of_sum_lt {ι : Type*}
    (M : ℕ) (I : Finset ι) (A B : ι → Finset (Fin M))
    (hsum : (∑ i ∈ I,
      ((B i).card.descFactorial (A i).card * (M - (A i).card).factorial : ℝ) /
        M.factorial) < 1)
    (hpairs : ∀ i ∈ I, (A i).card ≤ (B i).card ∧ (B i).card ≤ M) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin M), ∀ i ∈ I, ¬ (∀ a ∈ A i, σ a ∈ B i)

name: KaltonRoberts.good_perm_of_sum_lt
statement:
theorem good_perm_of_sum_lt (M : ℕ) (_hM : 0 < M)
    (pairs : Finset (Finset (Fin M) × Finset (Fin M)))
    (hsum : (∑ p ∈ pairs,
      (p.2.card.descFactorial p.1.card * (M - p.1.card).factorial : ℝ) / M.factorial) < 1)
    (hpairs : ∀ p ∈ pairs, p.1.card ≤ p.2.card ∧ p.2.card ≤ M) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin M), ∀ p ∈ pairs, ¬ (∀ a ∈ p.1, σ a ∈ p.2)

name: KaltonRoberts.pippenger_entropy_exponent_eq_phi
statement:
theorem pippenger_entropy_exponent_eq_phi
    (N L r c m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m < N) (hmL : m < L)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (hLθ : (L : ℝ) = θ * (N : ℝ))
    (hcθ : (c : ℝ) = (r : ℝ) / θ) :
    hEntropy (N : ℝ) (m : ℝ) + hEntropy (L : ℝ) (m : ℝ) +
        hEntropy ((c * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        hEntropy ((r * N : ℕ) : ℝ) ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = (N : ℝ) * Phi (r : ℝ) θ ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))

name: KaltonRoberts.pippenger_mid_term_le
statement:
theorem pippenger_mid_term_le
    (N L r c m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m < N) (hmL : m < L)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrc : r < c) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1)
    (hLθ : (L : ℝ) = θ * (N : ℝ))
    (hcθ : (c : ℝ) = (r : ℝ) / θ)
    (hphi : Phi (r : ℝ) θ ((m : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) ≤ -(1 : ℝ) / 1000) :
    (N.choose m : ℝ) * (L.choose m : ℝ) *
        ((c * m).choose (r * m) : ℝ) / ((r * N).choose (r * m) : ℝ)
      ≤ (((r * N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) / 1000)

name: KaltonRoberts.pippenger_small_term_raw
statement:
theorem pippenger_small_term_raw
    (N L r c m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m ≤ N) (hmL : m ≤ L)
    (hrc : r ≤ c) (hcmN : c * m ≤ r * N) :
    (N.choose m : ℝ) * (L.choose m : ℝ) *
        ((c * m).choose (r * m) : ℝ) / ((r * N).choose (r * m) : ℝ)
      ≤ ((Real.exp 1 * (N : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) *
          (Real.exp 1 * (L : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) *
          (((c * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((r * N : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ r) ^ m

name: KaltonRoberts.pippenger_term_le_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem pippenger_term_le_entropy_bound
    (N L r c m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmN : m < N) (hmL : m < L)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrc : r < c) :
    (N.choose m : ℝ) * (L.choose m : ℝ) *
        ((c * m).choose (r * m) : ℝ) / ((r * N).choose (r * m) : ℝ)
      ≤ (((r * N : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) *
        Real.exp (hEntropy (N : ℝ) (m : ℝ) + hEntropy (L : ℝ) (m : ℝ) +
          hEntropy ((c * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ) -
          hEntropy ((r * N : ℕ) : ℝ) ((r * m : ℕ) : ℝ))

theorem distToAdditive_le_C₂_from_pipeline
    [Finite U]
    -- The target function
    (f : Finset U → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditive f 1)
    -- Normalization: the infimum distance is attained
    (hnorm : ∃ a : U → ℝ, ∀ S : Finset U,
      |f S - additiveFunction a S| ≤ distToAdditive f)
    -- Mixed intersection construction
    (hmix : ∀ (g : Finset U → ℝ) (_ : IsApproxAdditive g 1) (M : ℝ)
      (_ : ∀ S, |g S| ≤ M)
      (C : WeightedCollection U) (t : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ t) (_ : t ≤ 1)
      (_ : ∀ i, C.itemFreq i ≤ t) (D : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ D)
      (_ : C.avgDeficit g M ≤ D)
      (ℓ : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (τ_mix : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ τ_mix) (_ : τ_mix ≤ 1),
      ∃ C' : WeightedCollection U,
        (∀ i, C'.itemFreq i ≤ (1 - τ_mix) * t ^ ℓ + τ_mix * t ^ (ℓ + 1)) ∧
        C'.avgDeficit g M ≤ ℓ * D + 2 * ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) + τ_mix * (D + 2))
    (hmix_sur : ∀ (g : Finset U → ℝ) (_ : IsApproxAdditive g 1) (M : ℝ)

      (_ : ∀ i, C.itemFreq i ≤ t) (S_val : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ S_val)
      (_ : C.avgSurplus g M ≤ S_val)
      (ℓ : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (τ_mix : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ τ_mix) (_ : τ_mix ≤ 1),
      ∃ C' : WeightedCollection U,
        (∀ i, C'.itemFreq i ≤ (1 - τ_mix) * t ^ ℓ + τ_mix * t ^ (ℓ + 1)) ∧
        C'.avgSurplus g M ≤ ℓ * S_val + 2 * ((ℓ : ℝ) - 1) + τ_mix * (S_val + 2))
    -- Epsilon one-sided recombination
    (hrec1_eps : ∀ (g : Finset U → ℝ) (_ : IsApproxAdditive g 1) (M : ℝ)
      (_ : ∀ S, |g S| ≤ M)
      (α_v : ℚ) (r_v : ℕ) (θ_v : ℚ)
      (_ : 0 < (θ_v : ℝ)) (_ : (θ_v : ℝ) < 1)
      (_ : StrongExpandersExist α_v r_v θ_v)
      (_ : 0 < r_v) (_ : 0 < (α_v : ℝ))
      (C : WeightedCollection U) (_ : ∀ i, C.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ))
      (D : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ D) (_ : C.avgDeficit g M ≤ D)
      (ε : ℝ) (_ : 0 < ε),
      ∃ (C' : WeightedCollection U) (D' : ℝ), 0 ≤ D' ∧
        (∀ i, C'.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ) / (θ_v : ℝ)) ∧
        C'.avgDeficit g M ≤ D' ∧
        (1 - (θ_v : ℝ)) * M ≤ D + ε - (θ_v : ℝ) * D' +
          2 * (r_v : ℝ) - 1 - (θ_v : ℝ))
    -- Epsilon two-sided recombination
    (hrec2_eps : ∀ (g : Finset U → ℝ) (_ : IsApproxAdditive g 1) (M : ℝ)
      (_ : ∀ S, |g S| ≤ M)
      (α_v : ℚ) (r_v : ℕ) (θ_v : ℚ)
      (_ : 0 < (θ_v : ℝ)) (_ : (θ_v : ℝ) < 1)
      (_ : StrongExpandersExist α_v r_v θ_v)
      (_ : 0 < r_v) (_ : 0 < (α_v : ℝ))
      (C_def C_sur : WeightedCollection U)
      (_ : ∀ i, C_def.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ))
      (_ : ∀ i, C_sur.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ))
      (D S_val : ℝ) (_ : 0 ≤ D) (_ : 0 ≤ S_val)
      (_ : C_def.avgDeficit g M ≤ D)
      (_ : C_sur.avgSurplus g M ≤ S_val)
      (ε : ℝ) (_ : 0 < ε),
      ∃ (C'_def C'_sur : WeightedCollection U) (D' S' : ℝ), 0 ≤ D' ∧ 0 ≤ S' ∧
        (∀ i, C'_def.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ) / (θ_v : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ i, C'_sur.itemFreq i ≤ (α_v : ℝ) / (θ_v : ℝ)) ∧
        C'_def.avgDeficit g M ≤ D' ∧
        C'_sur.avgSurplus g M ≤ S' ∧
        (1 - (θ_v : ℝ)) * M ≤ (D + S_val) / 2 + ε -
          (θ_v : ℝ) * ((D' + S') / 2) +
          2 * (r_v : ℝ) - 1 - (θ_v : ℝ))
    -- Expander existence
    (hexp1 : StrongExpandersExist α₁ 4 (1 / 3))
    (hexp2 : StrongExpandersExist (3009 / 10000) 4 (4 / 7))
    (hexp3 : StrongExpandersExist α₂ 4 (2 / 7))

name: KaltonRoberts.assignLabel_spec
statement:
lemma assignLabel_spec
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (v : V) (i : U) (hi : i ∈ C v) :
    edge v (assignLabel edge C threshold hexp hfreq v i hi) =
      perItemMatch edge C threshold hexp hfreq i
        ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, hi⟩⟩

name: KaltonRoberts.edgePiece_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
lemma edgePiece_pairwise_disjoint
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (v : V) (e₁ e₂ : Fin r) (he : e₁ ≠ e₂) :
    Disjoint (edgePiece edge C threshold hexp hfreq v e₁)
             (edgePiece edge C threshold hexp hfreq v e₂)

statement:
lemma edgePiece_union
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (v : V) :
    C v = Finset.univ.biUnion (fun e => edgePiece edge C threshold hexp hfreq v e)

name: KaltonRoberts.hall_matching_from_expansion
statement:
theorem hall_matching_from_expansion
    {V W : Type*} [_hV : Finite V] [_hW : Finite W] [DecidableEq W]
    {r : ℕ} (edge : V → Fin r → W)
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (A : Finset V) (hA : A.card ≤ threshold) :
    ∃ (match_fn : A → W),
      Function.Injective match_fn ∧
      ∀ x : A, match_fn x ∈ edgeNeighbors edge x.val

name: KaltonRoberts.one_sided_recombination_witness_core
statement:
theorem one_sided_recombination_witness_core
    {V W : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (edge : V → Fin r → W)
    (hcov : ∀ w : W, ∃ v : V, ∃ e : Fin r, edge v e = w)
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (f : Finset U → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditive f 1) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ S : Finset U, |f S| ≤ M)
    (C : V → Finset U)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => i ∈ C v)).card ≤ threshold)
    (D : ℝ) (_hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (havg_def : (∑ v : V, deficit f M (C v)) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ D)
    (hN : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (hL : 0 < (Fintype.card W : ℝ)) :
    ∃ (T : W → Finset U) (D' : ℝ),
      0 ≤ D' ∧
      (∀ i : U, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => i ∈ T w)).card ≤
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => i ∈ C v)).card) ∧
      (∀ i : U, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => i ∈ T w)).card ≤ threshold) ∧
      (∑ w : W, deficit f M (T w)) / (Fintype.card W : ℝ) ≤ D' ∧
      (1 - (Fintype.card W : ℝ) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) * M ≤
        D - ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) * D' +
        2 * (r : ℝ) - 1 - (Fintype.card W : ℝ) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: KaltonRoberts.perItemMatch_injective
statement:
lemma perItemMatch_injective
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (i : U) : Function.Injective (perItemMatch edge C threshold hexp hfreq i)

name: KaltonRoberts.perItemMatch_mem_neighbors
statement:
lemma perItemMatch_mem_neighbors
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (i : U) (x : ↥(sourceVertices C i)) :
    perItemMatch edge C threshold hexp hfreq i x ∈ edgeNeighbors edge x.val

name: KaltonRoberts.recombination_source_target_ineq
statement:
lemma recombination_source_target_ineq
    (edge : V → Fin r → W)
    (hcov : ∀ w : W, ∃ v : V, ∃ e : Fin r, edge v e = w)
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →
      (S.biUnion (fun v => edgeNeighbors edge v)).card ≥ S.card)
    (f : Finset U → ℝ) (hf : IsApproxAdditive f 1) (_M : ℝ)
    (C : V → Finset U)
    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold) :
    ∑ v : V, f (C v) ≤
      ∑ w : W, f (targetSet edge C threshold hexp hfreq w) +
      2 * (r : ℝ) * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (Fintype.card W : ℝ)

name: KaltonRoberts.targetSet_freq_bound
statement:
lemma targetSet_freq_bound
    (threshold : ℕ)
    (hexp : ∀ S : Finset V, S.card ≤ threshold →

    (hfreq : ∀ i : U, (sourceVertices C i).card ≤ threshold)
    (i : U) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => i ∈ targetSet edge C threshold hexp hfreq w)).card ≤ threshold

name: KaltonRoberts.targetSet_freq_source_count_bound
statement:
lemma targetSet_freq_source_count_bound
    (threshold : ℕ)

@[simp] theorem complementFrobeniusEquiv_apply (k : ℕ) (x : K) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.kasamiExponent_complement
statement:
theorem kasamiExponent_complement {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    2 ^ (2 * k) * kasamiExponent (n - k)
      = kasamiExponent k + (2 ^ n - 1) * ((2 ^ n - 2 ^ k) + 1)

theorem pow_add_card_sub_one_mul (x : K) (e c : ℕ) (he : e ≠ 0) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.pow_kasamiExponent_complement
statement:
theorem pow_kasamiExponent_complement {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hcard : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ n) (x : K) :
    x ^ (kasamiExponent (n - k) * 2 ^ (2 * k)) = x ^ kasamiExponent k

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.coefficientCount_transfer_complement
statement:
theorem coefficientCount_transfer_complement [CharP K 2]
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (hcard : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ n)
    {v₁ v₂ : K} (hv₁ : v₁ ≠ 0) (hv₂ : v₂ ≠ 0) (hne : v₁ ≠ v₂) :
    ∃ w1 w2 : K,
      w1 ≠ 0 ∧ w2 ≠ 0 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧
      coefficientTripleCount k v₁ v₂ = coefficientTripleCount (n - k) w1 w2

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.exists_normalized_parameter
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_parameter {n k : ℕ}
    (hklt : k < n) (hkn : Nat.Coprime k n) :
    ∃ k0 m : ℕ,
      (k0 = k ∨ k0 = n - k) ∧
      Odd k0 ∧ Nat.Coprime k0 n ∧
      2 ^ k0 + 1 = 3 * m ∧ Nat.Coprime m (2 ^ n - 1)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.normalize_with_count_transport
statement:
theorem normalize_with_count_transport [CharP K 2]
    {n k : ℕ} (hkpos : 1 ≤ k) (hklt : k < n) (hkn : Nat.Coprime k n)
    (hcard : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ n)
    (hhalf : 2 * (derivativeImage k K).card = Fintype.card K)
    {v₁ v₂ : K} (hv₁ : v₁ ≠ 0) (hv₂ : v₂ ≠ 0) (hne : v₁ ≠ v₂) :
    ∃ (k0 m : ℕ) (w1 w2 : K),
      (k0 = k ∨ k0 = n - k) ∧
      1 ≤ k0 ∧ k0 < n ∧
      Odd k0 ∧ Nat.Coprime k0 n ∧
      2 ^ k0 + 1 = 3 * m ∧ Nat.Coprime m (2 ^ n - 1) ∧
      2 * (derivativeImage k0 K).card = Fintype.card K ∧
      w1 ≠ 0 ∧ w2 ≠ 0 ∧ w1 ≠ w2 ∧
      coefficientTripleCount k v₁ v₂ = coefficientTripleCount k0 w1 w2

lemma sum_units_char (θ : MulChar K ℂ) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.average_of_half_size
statement:
theorem average_of_half_size [CharP K 2]
    (Delta : Finset K) (hhalf : 2 * Delta.card = Fintype.card K)
    (hK : 2 < Fintype.card K) :
    (∑ ρ ∈ slopes K, (slopeTripleCount Delta ρ : ℝ)) / ((slopes K).card : ℝ)
      = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ 2 / 8

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.card_filter_ne_two
statement:
lemma card_filter_ne_two (Delta : Finset K) {x y : K} (hx : x ∈ Delta) (hy : y ∈ Delta)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) : (Delta.filter (fun z => x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z)).card = Delta.card - 2

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.count_formula_of_half_size
statement:
theorem count_formula_of_half_size
    (Delta : Finset K) (psi : AddChar K ℂ) (hpsi : psi.IsPrimitive)
    (hhalf : 2 * Delta.card = Fintype.card K) :
    ∀ ρ : K,
      (slopeTripleCount Delta ρ : ℝ)
        = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ 2 / 8
          + (Phase.phaseTripleSum (walshCoefficient Delta psi) ρ (1 + ρ)).re /
            (Fintype.card K : ℝ)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.diag_card
statement:
lemma diag_card (Delta : Finset K) :
    ((Delta ×ˢ Delta ×ˢ Delta).filter (fun p => p.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.2.1 = p.2.2)).card
      = Delta.card

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.distinct_card
statement:
lemma distinct_card (Delta : Finset K) :
    ((Delta ×ˢ Delta ×ˢ Delta).filter
        (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2.1 ∧ p.1 ≠ p.2.2 ∧ p.2.1 ≠ p.2.2)).card
      = Delta.card * (Delta.card - 1) * (Delta.card - 2)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.mem_slopes_iff
statement: lemma mem_slopes_iff (r : K) : r ∈ slopes K ↔ r ≠ 0 ∧ r ≠ 1

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.slopeTripleCount_complex
statement:
lemma slopeTripleCount_complex (Delta : Finset K) (psi : AddChar K ℂ) (hpsi : psi.IsPrimitive)
    (ρ : K) :
    (slopeTripleCount Delta ρ : ℂ)
      = ((Delta.card : ℂ) ^ 3 + Phase.phaseTripleSum (walshCoefficient Delta psi) ρ (1 + ρ))
        / (Fintype.card K : ℂ)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.slope_filter_card
statement:
lemma slope_filter_card [CharP K 2] (hK : 2 < Fintype.card K) (x y z : K) :
    ((slopes K).filter (fun ρ => x + ρ * y + (1 + ρ) * z = 0)).card
      = (Fintype.card K - 2) * (if x = y ∧ y = z then 1 else 0)
        + (if x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z then 1 else 0)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.slopes_card
statement: lemma slopes_card (hK : 2 < Fintype.card K) : (slopes K).card = Fintype.card K - 2

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.sum_char_mul
statement:
lemma sum_char_mul (psi : AddChar K ℂ) (hpsi : psi.IsPrimitive) (t : K) :
    ∑ a : K, psi (a * t) = if t = 0 then (Fintype.card K : ℂ) else 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.sum_tripleCount
statement:
lemma sum_tripleCount [CharP K 2] (Delta : Finset K) (hK : 2 < Fintype.card K) :
    ∑ ρ ∈ slopes K, slopeTripleCount Delta ρ
      = (Fintype.card K - 2) * Delta.card
        + Delta.card * (Delta.card - 1) * (Delta.card - 2)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.sum_triple_prod
statement:
lemma sum_triple_prod (Delta : Finset K) (f g h : K → ℂ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Delta ×ˢ Delta ×ˢ Delta, f p.1 * g p.2.1 * h p.2.2
      = (∑ x ∈ Delta, f x) * (∑ y ∈ Delta, g y) * (∑ z ∈ Delta, h z)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.sum_units_eq
statement:
lemma sum_units_eq (f : K → ℂ) :
    ∑ u : Kˣ, f (u : K) = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase (0 : K), f a

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.CountAverage.walshCoefficient_zero
statement:
lemma walshCoefficient_zero (Delta : Finset K) (psi : AddChar K ℂ) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.slopeAverageFormula_of_half_size
statement:
theorem slopeAverageFormula_of_half_size [CharP K 2] {k : ℕ}
    (hhalf : 2 * (derivativeImage k K).card = Fintype.card K) (hK : 2 < Fintype.card K) :
    (∑ ρ ∈ slopes K, (slopeTripleCount k ρ : ℝ)) / ((slopes K).card : ℝ)
      = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ 2 / 8

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.walshTripleCountFormula_of_half_size
statement:
theorem walshTripleCountFormula_of_half_size {k : ℕ}
    (hhalf : 2 * (derivativeImage k K).card = Fintype.card K) :
    ∀ ρ : K, AdmissibleSlope ρ →
      (slopeTripleCount k ρ : ℝ) = (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ 2 / 8
        + (Phase.phaseTripleSum (walshCoefficient k (primitiveAddChar K)) ρ (1 + ρ)).re /
            (Fintype.card K : ℝ)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.some_eq_some
statement:
lemma some_eq_some {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : K} (h₁ : (fer K).toAffine.Nonsingular x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : (fer K).toAffine.Nonsingular x₂ y₂) (hx : x₁ = x₂) (hy : y₁ = y₂) :
    Affine.Point.some _ _ h₁ = Affine.Point.some _ _ h₂

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.some_inj
KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.three_torsion_some_iff
statement:
lemma three_torsion_some_iff {x y : K} (h : (fer K).toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    (3 : ℕ) • (Affine.Point.some _ _ h) = 0 ↔ x ^ 4 = x

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hess_addY_aux
statement:
theorem hess_addY_aux (h1 : w1 ^ 3 + t1 ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : w2 ^ 3 + t2 ^ 3 = 1) :
    (w1 * (w2 + t2) + w2 * (w1 + t1))
          * (hessD w1 t1 w2 t2 * (w1 + t1) + (hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 + hessY w1 t1 w2 t2))
        + w1 * ((w1 + t1) + (w2 + t2)) * (hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 + hessY w1 t1 w2 t2)
        + ((w1 + t1) + (w2 + t2)) * (w1 + t1) * (hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 + hessY w1 t1 w2 t2)
      = hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 * ((w1 + t1) + (w2 + t2)) * (w1 + t1)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hess_cubic
statement:
theorem hess_cubic (h1 : w1 ^ 3 + t1 ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : w2 ^ 3 + t2 ^ 3 = 1) :
    hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 ^ 3 + hessY w1 t1 w2 t2 ^ 3 = hessD w1 t1 w2 t2 ^ 3

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.add_pt
statement:
theorem add_pt (h1 : w1 ^ 3 + t1 ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : w2 ^ 3 + t2 ^ 3 = 1)
    (hD : hessD w1 t1 w2 t2 ≠ 0) :
    pt w1 t1 h1 + pt w2 t2 h2 =
      pt (hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 / hessD w1 t1 w2 t2) (hessY w1 t1 w2 t2 / hessD w1 t1 w2 t2)
        (hess_fermat h1 h2 hD)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.add_pt_x_eq_zero
statement:
theorem add_pt_x_eq_zero (h1 : w1 ^ 3 + t1 ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : w2 ^ 3 + t2 ^ 3 = 1)
    (hdd : w1 + t1 ≠ w2 + t2) (hD : hessD w1 t1 w2 t2 = 0)
    (hS : hessX w1 t1 w2 t2 + hessY w1 t1 w2 t2 ≠ 0) :
    (fer K).toAffine.addX ((w1 + t1)⁻¹) ((w2 + t2)⁻¹)
      ((fer K).toAffine.slope ((w1 + t1)⁻¹) ((w2 + t2)⁻¹) (w1 * (w1 + t1)⁻¹)
        (w2 * (w2 + t2)⁻¹)) = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.chart_nonsingular
statement:
lemma chart_nonsingular {w t : K} (h : w ^ 3 + t ^ 3 = 1) :
    (fer K).toAffine.Nonsingular ((w + t)⁻¹) (w * (w + t)⁻¹)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.den_ne_zero
statement: lemma den_ne_zero {w t : K} (h : w ^ 3 + t ^ 3 = 1) : w + t ≠ 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hessD_eq_zero_of_den_eq

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hessS_ne_zero

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hess_fermat
statement:
lemma hess_fermat (h1 : w1 ^ 3 + t1 ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : w2 ^ 3 + t2 ^ 3 = 1)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.neg_pt

statement: lemma sum_den_ne_zero (hdd : w1 + t1 ≠ w2 + t2) : (w1 + t1) + (w2 + t2) ≠ 0

statement:

statement:
lemma eq_neg_of_hessD_eq_zero {W T A B : K} (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : A ^ 3 + B ^ 3 = 1)
    (hT : T ≠ 0) (hD : hessD W T A B = 0) (hAT : A = T) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.exists_twisted_root_equation
statement:
theorem exists_twisted_root_equation (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (hW : W ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (hkn : Nat.gcd k n = 1)
    (hB3 : ∃ (c : K) (hc : c ^ 3 = 1),
      pt (W ^ 2 ^ n) (T ^ 2 ^ n) (frob_fermat h n) = pt W T h + ptInf c hc)
    (hB5 : (3 : ℕ) • phi k W T h ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (p q : K) (hpq : p ^ 3 + q ^ 3 = 1),
      phi k W T h = pt p q hpq ∧ p ≠ 0 ∧ q ≠ 0 ∧
        W ^ (2 ^ k + 1) + p * T ^ (2 ^ k + 1) = q

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.frob_fermat
statement:
lemma frob_fermat {W T : K} (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (W ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 3 + (T ^ 2 ^ k) ^ 3 = 1

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hessCoords_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hessCoords_ne_zero (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (hW : W ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (hkn : Nat.gcd k n = 1)
    (hB3 : ∃ (c : K) (hc : c ^ 3 = 1),
      pt (W ^ 2 ^ n) (T ^ 2 ^ n) (frob_fermat h n) = pt W T h + ptInf c hc)
    (hB5 : (3 : ℕ) • phi k W T h ≠ 0) :
    hessX W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) ≠ 0 ∧ hessY W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) ≠ 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hessDenom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hessDenom_ne_zero (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (hW : W ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (hkn : Nat.gcd k n = 1)
    (hB3 : ∃ (c : K) (hc : c ^ 3 = 1),
      pt (W ^ 2 ^ n) (T ^ 2 ^ n) (frob_fermat h n) = pt W T h + ptInf c hc)
    (hB5 : (3 : ℕ) • phi k W T h ≠ 0) :
    hessD W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) ≠ 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hessNum_ne_zero_of_hessD_eq_zero
statement:

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hess_key
statement: lemma hess_key (hD : hessD W T A B = 0) : hessX W T A B * A = hessY W T A B * T

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.hess_weighted_sum_eq_hessD
statement:
theorem hess_weighted_sum_eq_hessD (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) :
    W ^ (2 ^ k + 1) * hessY W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k)
      + hessX W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) * T ^ (2 ^ k + 1)
      = hessD W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.neg_add_t3
statement:
lemma neg_add_t3 {x y d : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (h1 : (x / d) ^ 3 + (y / d) ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : (x / y) ^ 3 + (d / y) ^ 3 = 1) :
    -(pt (x / d) (y / d) h1) + t3 K = pt (x / y) (d / y) h2

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.not_hess_all_eq_zero
statement:
theorem not_hess_all_eq_zero (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (hW : W ≠ 0) (hT : T ≠ 0)
    (hkn : Nat.gcd k n = 1)
    (hX : hessX W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) = 0)
    (hY : hessY W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) = 0)
    (hD : hessD W T (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) = 0)
    (hn : ∃ c : K, c ^ 3 = 1 ∧ W ^ 2 ^ n = c * W ∧ T ^ 2 ^ n = c ^ 2 * T) :
    False

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.three_torsion_add_of_hessD_eq_zero
statement:
theorem three_torsion_add_of_hessD_eq_zero {W T A B : K}
    (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1) (h2 : A ^ 3 + B ^ 3 = 1)
    (hT : T ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hD : hessD W T A B = 0)
    (hN : ¬(hessX W T A B = 0 ∧ hessY W T A B = 0)) :
    (3 : ℕ) • (pt W T h + pt A B h2) = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.three_torsion_phi
statement:
lemma three_torsion_phi {k : ℕ} {W T : K} (h : W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1)
    (hsum : (3 : ℕ) • (pt W T h + pt (W ^ 2 ^ k) (T ^ 2 ^ k) (frob_fermat h k)) = 0) :
    (3 : ℕ) • phi k W T h = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.three_torsion_t3
statement: lemma three_torsion_t3 : (3 : ℕ) • t3 K = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.FermatCubic.explicit_quotient_coordinates
statement:
theorem explicit_quotient_coordinates
    {K : Type*}
    [Field K] [CharP K 2]
    {x y W : K}
    (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hxy : x ^ 3 + y ^ 3 = 1)
    (hW :
      W ^ 3 = (x + 1) / (x + y)) :
    let T : K := quotientT x y W
    T ^ 3 = (y + 1) / (x + y) ∧
    W ^ 3 + T ^ 3 = 1 ∧
    hessD W T (W ^ 2) (T ^ 2) ≠ 0 ∧
    hessX W T (W ^ 2) (T ^ 2) /
        hessD W T (W ^ 2) (T ^ 2) = x ∧
    hessY W T (W ^ 2) (T ^ 2) /
        hessD W T (W ^ 2) (T ^ 2) = y

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.exists_factor_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_factor_coefficients
    {r m : ℕ}
    (he : 2 ^ (2 * r + 1) + 1 = 3 * m) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ,
      a + 2 * b = 1 ∧
      a - b = (-2 : ℤ) ^ r ∧
      a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2 = (m : ℤ)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.gMap_add_map
statement:
lemma gMap_add_map
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (pi : G →+ G) (a b : ℤ) (x : G) :
    gMap pi a b x + pi (gMap pi a b x) = gMap pi a b (x + pi x)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.gMap_bijective
statement:
theorem gMap_bijective
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (pi : G →+ G)
    {m : ℕ} {N a b : ℤ}
    (hpi2 : ∀ x : G, pi (pi x) = (-2 : ℤ) • x)
    (hnorm : a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2 = (m : ℤ))
    (hann : ∀ x : G, N • x = 0)
    (hcop : IsCoprime (m : ℤ) N) :
    Function.Bijective (gMap pi a b)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.gMap_factor
statement:
theorem gMap_factor
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (pi : G →+ G)
    {r : ℕ} {a b : ℤ}
    (hpi2 : ∀ x : G, pi (pi x) = (-2 : ℤ) • x)
    (hab1 : a + 2 * b = 1)
    (hab2 : a - b = (-2 : ℤ) ^ r) :
    ∀ x : G, x + piIter pi (2 * r + 1) x
      = gMap pi a b x + pi (gMap pi a b x)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.gMap_zsmul
statement:
lemma gMap_zsmul
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (pi : G →+ G) (a b c : ℤ) (x : G) :
    gMap pi a b (c • x) = c • gMap pi a b x

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.neg_two_pow_eq_one_add_three_mul
statement:
lemma neg_two_pow_eq_one_add_three_mul (r : ℕ) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Isogeny.piIter_even
statement:
theorem piIter_even

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.dvd_three_of_dvd_two_pow_add_one_two_pow_sub_one

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.dickson_bijective
KasamiCyclicAdditive.dickson_eval_eq_pow_add_inv_pow
statement:
theorem dickson_eval_eq_pow_add_inv_pow (K : Type*) [Field K] (x : K)
    {u : AlgebraicClosure K} (hu0 : u ≠ 0)
    (hux : u + u⁻¹ = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x) (m : ℕ) :
    algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) ((dickson 1 1 m).eval x) = u ^ m + (u⁻¹) ^ m

theorem pow_card_sq_sub_one_eq_one (K : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype K] (x : K)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.sum_dickson_eq_cubic
statement:
theorem sum_dickson_eq_cubic {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {e h : ℕ} (he : e = 3 * h)
    (hh : Nat.Coprime h (Fintype.card K ^ 2 - 1)) (f : K → M) :
    ∑ x : K, f ((dickson 1 1 e).eval x) = ∑ x : K, f ((dickson 1 1 3).eval x)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.sum_dickson_kasami_eq_three
statement:
theorem sum_dickson_kasami_eq_three
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]

    {n k : ℕ} (hcard : Fintype.card K = 2 ^ n)
    (hk : Odd k) (hkn : Nat.Coprime k n) (f : K → M) :
    ∑ x : K, f ((dickson 1 1 (2 ^ k + 1)).eval x)
      = ∑ x : K, f ((dickson 1 1 3).eval x)

theorem frobSum_sq_add_self (k : ℕ) (s : K) :

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.frobSum_succ

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.powm_powD

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.sum_psi_mul_powD
statement:
lemma sum_psi_mul_powD {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) (C : K) :
    ∑ y : K, ψ (C * y ^ D) = if C = 0 then (Fintype.card K : ℂ) else 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.S_eq_zero_of_not_cube
statement:
lemma S_eq_zero_of_not_cube {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m e : ℕ} {S : K → ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (he : e = 3 * m) (hS : WalshCharacterFormula ψ e S) (a : Kˣ) (ha : ¬ ∃ b : Kˣ, b ^ 3 = a) :
    S ((a : K)) = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.card_cubeRoots_units
statement: lemma card_cubeRoots_units (A : Kˣ) : #{b : Kˣ | b ^ 3 = A ^ 3} = mu3Card K

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.card_mu3Units
statement: lemma card_mu3Units : (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Kˣ => u ^ 3 = 1)).card = mu3Card K

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.eight_phaseTripleSum
statement:
lemma eight_phaseTripleSum {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D e : ℕ} {S : K → ℂ} {A B : K}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) (he : e = 3 * m) (hS : WalshCharacterFormula ψ e S)
    (hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    8 * phaseTripleSum S (A ^ 3) (B ^ 3) * (mu3Card K : ℂ)
      = ∑ z : Kˣ, phiHat ψ D (z : K) * phiHat ψ D (A * z) * phiHat ψ D (B * z)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.fourier_triple
statement:
lemma fourier_triple {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {D : ℕ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (A B : K) :
    ∑ z : K, phiHat ψ D z * phiHat ψ D (A * z) * phiHat ψ D (B * z)
      = (Fintype.card K : ℂ) * ∑ x : K, ∑ y : K,
          phi ψ D x * phi ψ D y * phi ψ D (A * x + B * y)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.phase_to_root_count
statement:
theorem phase_to_root_count {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D e : ℕ} {S : K → ℂ} {A B : K}
    (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) (he : e = 3 * m) (hS : WalshCharacterFormula ψ e S)
    (hA : A ≠ 0) (hAB : A ^ 3 + B ^ 3 = 1) (hA3 : A ^ 3 ≠ 1) :
    phaseTripleSum S (A ^ 3) (B ^ 3)
      = (Fintype.card K : ℂ) ^ 2 / 8 *
        ((∑ u ∈ cubeRootsOne K, ∑ v ∈ cubeRootsOne K, (rootCount D A B u v : ℂ))
          - (mu3Card K : ℂ) ^ 2)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.phiHat_zero
statement:
lemma phiHat_zero {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D : ℕ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) :
    phiHat ψ D 0 = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.ratio_eq
statement:
lemma ratio_eq {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (m : ℕ) (χ : MulChar K ℂ) :
    gaussSum (χ ^ (3 * m)) ψ / gaussSum (χ ^ 3) ψ
      = gaussSum ((χ ^ 3) ^ m) ψ * gaussSum ((χ ^ 3)⁻¹) ψ / (Fintype.card K : ℂ)
        + (if χ ^ 3 = 1 then 1 - 1 / (Fintype.card K : ℂ) else 0)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.sum_gaussSum_prod
statement:
lemma sum_gaussSum_prod {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m : ℕ} (a : Kˣ) :
    ∑ χ : MulChar K ℂ, gaussSum ((χ ^ 3) ^ m) ψ * gaussSum ((χ ^ 3)⁻¹) ψ * χ ((a : K))
      = (Fintype.card Kˣ : ℂ) * ∑ x : Kˣ,
          ∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Kˣ => y ^ 3 = a * x ^ (3 * m)),
            ψ ((x : K) + (y : K))

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.sum_mu3Units
statement:
lemma sum_mu3Units {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : K → M) :
    ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Kˣ => u ^ 3 = 1), f ((u : K))
      = ∑ u ∈ cubeRootsOne K, f u

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.sum_phi_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_phi_eq_zero {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D : ℕ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) :
    ∑ t : K, phi ψ D t = 0

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.symmetrization
statement:
lemma symmetrization {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) (A B : K) :
    ∑ x : K, ∑ y : K, phi ψ D x * phi ψ D y * phi ψ D (A * x + B * y)
      = (mu3Card K : ℂ) * ∑ u ∈ cubeRootsOne K, ∑ v ∈ cubeRootsOne K, weilSum ψ D A B u v

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.two_S_cube
statement:
lemma two_S_cube {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D e : ℕ} {S : K → ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0) (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) (he : e = 3 * m)
    (hS : WalshCharacterFormula ψ e S) (A : Kˣ) :
    2 * S ((A : K) ^ 3) = phiHat ψ D (A : K)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.walshCoefficient_closed_form
statement:
lemma walshCoefficient_closed_form {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m e : ℕ} {S : K → ℂ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive)
    (he : e = 3 * m) (hS : WalshCharacterFormula ψ e S) (a : Kˣ) :
    2 * S (a : K) = (#{b : Kˣ | b ^ 3 = a} : ℂ)
      + ∑ x : Kˣ, ∑ y ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Kˣ => y ^ 3 = a * x ^ (3 * m)),
          ψ ((x : K) + (y : K))

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.Phase.weilSum_eq
statement:
lemma weilSum_eq {ψ : AddChar K ℂ} {m D : ℕ} (hψ : ψ.IsPrimitive) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hmD : m * D ≡ 1 [MOD Fintype.card Kˣ]) {A B : K} (hA3 : A ^ 3 ≠ 1)
    {u v : K} (hu : u ∈ cubeRootsOne K) (hv : v ∈ cubeRootsOne K) :
    weilSum ψ D A B u v = (Fintype.card K : ℂ) * ((rootCount D A B u v : ℂ) - 1)

name: KasamiCyclicAdditive.forcing_of_average_and_nonneg

theorem forcing_of_average_and_nonneg {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)

    (hN : ∀ i ∈ s, N i = c + Z i / Q)
    (hAV : (∑ i ∈ s, N i) / (s.card : ℝ) = c)

    ∀ i ∈ s, N i = c ∧ Z i = 0

    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : Ring R) (I : TwoSidedIdeal R),
      (∀ x ∈ I, IsNilpotent x) ∧
        ∃ W : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R,
          W ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.matrix (Fin 2) I ∧ ¬ IsNilpotent W

name: Komlos.sum_split
statement:
lemma sum_split {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] (v : E) (P : E →₀ ℝ) (g : E × ℝ → ℝ → N)
    (h0 : ∀ y, g y 0 = 0) (hadd : ∀ y r s, g y (r + s) = g y r + g y s) :
    (split v P).sum g
      = (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (tr (-v) P ⊔ tr v P)).sum fun x r ↦ g (x, 0) r)
        + ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • (tr (-v) P ⊓ tr v P)).sum fun x r ↦ g (x, 1) r

lemma mem_P_n_iff_exists_index (n : ℕ) (p_val : ℕ) :

name: KrafftSieve.p_dvd_q

name: KrafftSieve.p_mem_P_n

statement: lemma p_prime (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (w n)) : (p n i).Prime

name: KrafftSieve.q_ge_q10_very_large
statement: lemma q_ge_q10_very_large (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 10) : q n ≥ 10^20

name: KrafftSieve.q_mono
statement: lemma q_mono (n : ℕ) : q n ∣ q (n + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.additive_sieve_equivalence
statement:
lemma additive_sieve_equivalence (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ evalInterval n) :
    c n x = 0 ↔ Nat.Prime (6 * x - 1) ∧ Nat.Prime (6 * x + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.interval_projection_bound
statement:
lemma interval_projection_bound (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ evalInterval n) :
    6 * x + 1 < (6 * n + 5) ^ 2

name: KrafftSieve.krafft_algebraic_equivalence
statement:
lemma krafft_algebraic_equivalence (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h_ge_5 : p ≥ 5) (x : ℤ) :
    let r := (p + 1) / 6
    (x : ZMod p) = r ∨ (x : ZMod p) = -r ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ (6 * x - 1) ∨ (p : ℤ) ∣ (6 * x + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.krafft_sieve_guarantee
statement:
theorem krafft_sieve_guarantee (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) (h_admit : KrafftSufficiency n) :
    ∃ x ∈ evalInterval n, Nat.Prime (6 * x - 1) ∧ Nat.Prime (6 * x + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.non_negative_hits
statement:
lemma non_negative_hits (n : ℕ) (x : ZMod (q n)) :
    c n x ≥ 0 ∧ (c n x < 1 → c n x = 0)

name: KrafftSieve.not_dvd_of_survives
statement:
lemma not_dvd_of_survives (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ) (h_survives : f n (krafftResidue n) x = 1) (p_val : ℕ)
    (hp : p_val ∈ primeWindow n) : ¬(p_val : ℤ) ∣ (6 * x - 1) ∧ ¬(p_val : ℤ) ∣ (6 * x + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.prime_of_no_prime_factors_lt
statement:
lemma prime_of_no_prime_factors_lt {k m : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (h_sq : k < m ^ 2)
    (h_no_factors : ∀ p, p.Prime → p < m → ¬ p ∣ k) : k.Prime

name: KrafftSieve.primes_in_range_eq_P_n
statement:
lemma primes_in_range_eq_P_n (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (h_ge_5 : 5 ≤ p) (h_lt : p < 6 * n + 5) :
    p ∈ primeWindow n

name: KrafftSieve.sieve_equivalence
statement:
lemma sieve_equivalence (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ evalInterval n) :
    f n (krafftResidue n) x = 1 ↔ Nat.Prime (6 * x - 1) ∧ Nat.Prime (6 * x + 1)

name: KrafftSieve.survives_iff
statement:
theorem survives_iff (n : ℕ) (x : ZMod (q n)) :
    f n (krafftResidue n) x = 1 ↔ ∀ i : Fin (w n),
       (x.cast : ZMod (p n i)) ≠ krafftResidue n i ∧
         (x.cast : ZMod (p n i)) ≠ -krafftResidue n i

name: KrafftSieve.weighted_existence_principle
statement:
theorem weighted_existence_principle (n : ℕ) (W : ZMod (q n) → ℝ) (hW : ∀ x, W x ≥ 0)
    (h_ineq : sum2 n W < sum1 n W) :
    ∃ x ∈ evalInterval n, W (x : ZMod (q n)) > 0 ∧ c n (x : ZMod (q n)) = 0

name: KrafftSieve.P_multi_add
statement:
lemma P_multi_add (n : ℕ) (u v : Idx n → ℝ) (x : ZMod (q n)) :
    pMulti n (u + v) x = pMulti n u x + pMulti n v x

name: KrafftSieve.Q_1_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma Q_1_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (lambda : Idx n → ℝ) :
    q1 n lambda = 0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ evalInterval n, pMulti n lambda x = 0

name: KrafftSieve.Q_1_nonneg
statement: lemma Q_1_nonneg (n : ℕ) (lambda : Idx n → ℝ) : q1 n lambda ≥ 0

name: KrafftSieve.Q_1_pos_on_sphere_perp
statement:
lemma Q_1_pos_on_sphere_perp (n : ℕ) (lambda : Idx n → ℝ) (h : lambda ∈ spherePerp n) :
    q1 n lambda > 0

name: KrafftSieve.Q_2_add_kernel
statement:
lemma Q_2_add_kernel (n : ℕ) (u v : Idx n → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ kernelQ1 n) :
    q2 n (u + v) = q2 n v

name: KrafftSieve.Ratio_add_kernel
statement:
lemma Ratio_add_kernel (n : ℕ) (u v : Idx n → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ kernelQ1 n) :
    Ratio n (u + v) = Ratio n v

name: KrafftSieve.Ratio_scale
statement:
lemma Ratio_scale (n : ℕ) (lambda : Idx n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Ratio n (c • lambda) = Ratio n lambda

name: KrafftSieve.W_truly_multi_nonneg
statement:
lemma W_truly_multi_nonneg (n : ℕ) (lambda : Finset (Fin (w n)) → ℝ) (x : ZMod (q n)) :
    wTrulyMulti n lambda x ≥ 0

name: KrafftSieve.W_truly_multi_support
statement:
lemma W_truly_multi_support (n : ℕ) (lambda : Finset (Fin (w n)) → ℝ) (x : ZMod (q n))
    (hx : x.val ∉ evalInterval n) :
  wTrulyMulti n lambda x = 0

name: KrafftSieve.attainable_ratios_compact
statement: lemma attainable_ratios_compact (n : ℕ) : IsCompact (attainableRatios n)

name: KrafftSieve.attainable_ratios_eq_image_sphere_perp
statement:
lemma attainable_ratios_eq_image_sphere_perp (n : ℕ) :
    attainableRatios n = (spherePerp n).image (Ratio n)

name: KrafftSieve.decomposition
statement:
lemma decomposition (n : ℕ) (x : Idx n → ℝ) :
  ∃ u ∈ kernelQ1 n, ∃ v ∈ kernelQ1Perp n, x = u + v

name: KrafftSieve.exists_sphere_perp_ratio_eq
statement:
lemma exists_sphere_perp_ratio_eq (n : ℕ) (lambda : Idx n → ℝ) (hQ1 : q1 n lambda > 0) :
    ∃ v ∈ spherePerp n, Ratio n lambda = Ratio n v

name: KrafftSieve.sphere_perp_compact
statement: lemma sphere_perp_compact (n : ℕ) : IsCompact (spherePerp n)

name: KrafftSieve.sq_le_dot_product
statement:
lemma sq_le_dot_product (n : ℕ) (v : Idx n → ℝ) (i : Idx n) :
    (v i)^2 ≤ dotProduct n v v

name: KrafftSieve.dirac_comb_nonzero
statement:
lemma dirac_comb_nonzero (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (w n)) (k : Fin (p n i)) :
    gHat n i (((k : ℕ) * (q n / p n i) : ℕ) : ZMod (q n)) =
    ((2 : ℝ) / (p n i : ℝ) * Real.cos
      (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (krafftResidue n i : ℝ) / (p n i : ℝ)) : ℂ)

name: KrafftSieve.exact_krafft_cosine
statement:
lemma exact_krafft_cosine (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (w n)) :
    Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * 3 * (krafftResidue n i : ℝ) / (p n i : ℝ)) =
      -Real.cos (Real.pi / (p n i : ℝ))

name: KrafftSieve.plancherel_theorem_custom
statement:
lemma plancherel_theorem_custom (n : ℕ) (f g : ZMod (q n) → ℂ) :
    ∑ x : ZMod (q n), f x * starRingEnd ℂ (g x) = (q n : ℂ) * ∑ h : ZMod (q n),
      (1 / (q n : ℂ) * ∑ x, f x *
        Complex.exp (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (h.val * x.val : ℕ) / (q n : ℂ))) *
        starRingEnd ℂ (1 / (q n : ℂ) * ∑ x, g x *
        Complex.exp (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (h.val * x.val : ℕ) / (q n : ℂ)))

name: KrafftSieve.resonance_lt_mainTerm
statement:
lemma resonance_lt_mainTerm (n : ℕ) (hn : primeWindow n ≠ ∅) :
    resonanceCapacity n < mainTerm n

name: KrafftSieve.f_hat_conj_symm
statement:
lemma f_hat_conj_symm (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) (h : ZMod (q n)) :
    fHat n r (-h) = starRingEnd ℂ (fHat n r h)

name: KrafftSieve.f_hat_normSq_expansion
statement:
lemma f_hat_normSq_expansion (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) (h : ZMod (q n)) :
    Complex.normSq (fHat n r h) =
    (1 / (q n : ℂ)^2) * ∑ x : ZMod (q n), ∑ y : ZMod (q n), (f n r x : ℂ) * (f n r y : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * h.val * (y - x).val / (q n : ℂ))

name: KrafftSieve.f_hat_zero_eq_mu
statement:
theorem f_hat_zero_eq_mu (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) :
    fHat n r 0 = μ n r

name: KrafftSieve.harmonic_variance_lower_bound
statement:
lemma harmonic_variance_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) (h : ZMod (q n))
    (h_ne_zero : h ≠ 0) : sigmaSq n r ≥ 2 * Complex.normSq (fHat n r h)

name: KrafftSieve.orthogonality_x
statement:
lemma orthogonality_x (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod (q n)) :
    ∑ x : ZMod (q n), Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * k.val * x.val / (q n : ℂ)) =
      if k = 0 then (q n : ℂ) else 0

name: KrafftSieve.parseval_identity
statement:
theorem parseval_identity (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) :
    sigmaSq n r = ∑ h : ZMod (q n), if h = 0 then 0 else Complex.normSq (fHat n r h)

name: KrafftSieve.parseval_standard
statement:
lemma parseval_standard (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) :
    ∑ h : ZMod (q n), Complex.normSq (fHat n r h) = (1 / (q n : ℝ)) *
      ∑ x : ZMod (q n), (f n r x)^2

name: KrafftSieve.q_odd
statement: lemma q_odd (n : ℕ) : Odd (q n)

name: KrafftSieve.sum_exp_orthogonality
statement:
lemma sum_exp_orthogonality (n : ℕ) (k : ZMod (q n)) :
    ∑ h : ZMod (q n), Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * h.val * k.val / (q n : ℂ)) =
      if k = 0 then (q n : ℂ) else 0

name: KrafftSieve.sum_orthogonality_application
statement:
lemma sum_orthogonality_application (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) :
    ∑ x : ZMod (q n), ∑ y : ZMod (q n), (f n r x : ℂ) * (f n r y : ℂ) *
      ∑ h : ZMod (q n), Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * h.val * (y - x).val / (q n : ℂ)) =
    (q n : ℂ) * ∑ x : ZMod (q n), (f n r x : ℂ)^2

name: KrafftSieve.variance_expansion
statement:
lemma variance_expansion (n : ℕ) (r : Fin (w n) → ℕ) :
    sigmaSq n r = (1 / (q n : ℝ)) * ∑ x : ZMod (q n), (f n r x)^2 - (μ n r)^2

name: weightedKuramotoV_symm_cancel
statement:
lemma weightedKuramotoV_symm_cancel
    (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin N, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ * weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ =
    -(∑ i : Fin N, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ *
        deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i))

name: weighted_gradient_identity
statement:
lemma weighted_gradient_identity
    (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i : Fin N) :
    weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ =
      -(deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i))

name: weighted_lyapunov_descent
statement:
theorem weighted_lyapunov_descent
    (K : ℝ) (_hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin N, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ *
        deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i) ≤ 0

name: hebbian_joint_lyapunov_descent
statement:
theorem hebbian_joint_lyapunov_descent
    (K lam : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin N, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ *
        deriv (fun x => hebbianL K lam N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i))
      + (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, hebbianWeightF K lam N W θ i j *
        deriv (fun x => hebbianL K lam N (hebbianUpdateWeight W i j x) θ) (W i j)) ≤ 0

name: hebbian_phase_gradient_identity
statement:
theorem hebbian_phase_gradient_identity
    (K lam : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i : Fin N) :
    weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ =
      -(deriv (fun x => hebbianL K lam N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i))

name: hebbian_weight_gradient_identity
statement:
theorem hebbian_weight_gradient_identity
    (K lam : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i j : Fin N) :
    hebbianWeightF K lam N W θ i j =
      -(deriv (fun x => hebbianL K lam N (hebbianUpdateWeight W i j x) θ) (W i j))

name: hebbianL_convex_weight_entry
statement:
lemma hebbianL_convex_weight_entry
    (K lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i j : Fin N) :
    0 < deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => hebbianL K lam N (hebbianUpdateWeight W i j y) θ) x)
              (W i j)

name: hebbianL_zero_lam_eq_weighted
statement:
lemma hebbianL_zero_lam_eq_weighted
    (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (_hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    hebbianL K 0 N W θ = weightedKuramotoV K N W θ

name: kuramoto_gradient_identity
statement:
theorem kuramoto_gradient_identity
    (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hK : 0 < K)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i : Fin N) :
    kuramotoF K N i θ = -(deriv (fun x => kuramotoV K N (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i))

name: kuramoto_coupling_contraction
statement:
theorem kuramoto_coupling_contraction
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i j : Fin N)
    (hWpos : 0 < W i j)
    (hgap : 0 < θ i - θ j) (hpi : θ i - θ j < Real.pi) :
    K * W i j * Real.sin (θ j - θ i) - K * W j i * Real.sin (θ i - θ j) < 0

name: kuramoto_pairwise_contraction
statement:
theorem kuramoto_pairwise_contraction
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (θ : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hgap : 0 < θ 0 - θ 1) (hpi : θ 0 - θ 1 < Real.pi) :
    kuramotoF K 2 0 θ < kuramotoF K 2 1 θ

name: kuramoto_relative_velocity
statement:
lemma kuramoto_relative_velocity
    (K : ℝ) (θ : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    kuramotoF K 2 0 θ - kuramotoF K 2 1 θ = -K * Real.sin (θ 0 - θ 1)

name: kuramotoR_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem kuramotoR_norm_le_one (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ‖kuramotoR N θ‖ ≤ 1

name: allToAll_convergence_to_synchrony
statement:
theorem allToAll_convergence_to_synchrony
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hWdiag : ∀ i, W i i = 0)
    (hWoff : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → W i j = 1)
    (θ : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (hsol : ∀ t, HasDerivAt θ (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ t)) t)
    (hsemi : ∀ a b : Fin N, |θ 0 a - θ 0 b| < Real.pi) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ‖kuramotoR N (θ t)‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

name: extremal_gap_derivative_nonpos
statement:
theorem extremal_gap_derivative_nonpos
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (hWnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j)
    (hWeq : ∀ i j k, W i k = W j k)
    (θ : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (hsol : ∀ t, HasDerivAt θ (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ t)) t)
    (t : ℝ) (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hWij : 0 < W i j)
    (hmax : ∀ k, θ t k ≤ θ t i)
    (hmin : ∀ k, θ t j ≤ θ t k)
    (hgap : θ t i - θ t j < Real.pi) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => θ s i - θ s j)
      (weightedKuramotoF K N W i (θ t) - weightedKuramotoF K N W j (θ t)) t ∧
    weightedKuramotoF K N W i (θ t) - weightedKuramotoF K N W j (θ t) ≤ 0

name: kuramotoR_norm_eq_one_at_synchrony
statement:
theorem kuramotoR_norm_eq_one_at_synchrony
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (θ : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hsync : ∀ i j : Fin N, θ i = θ j) :
    ‖kuramotoR N θ‖ = 1

name: kuramotoVectorField_contDiff
statement:
theorem kuramotoVectorField_contDiff (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (kuramotoVectorField K N W)

name: kuramotoVectorField_locallyLipschitz
statement:
theorem kuramotoVectorField_locallyLipschitz (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∀ θ₀ : Fin N → ℝ, ∃ (ε : ℝ) (_ : 0 < ε) (L : NNReal),
      LipschitzOnWith L (kuramotoVectorField K N W) (Metric.ball θ₀ ε)

name: kuramoto_ode_exists
statement:
theorem kuramoto_ode_exists (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ)
    (θ₀ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∃ (θ : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ),
      θ 0 = θ₀ ∧
      ∃ (ε : ℝ) (_ : 0 < ε),
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt θ (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ t)) t

name: kuramoto_ode_unique
statement:
theorem kuramoto_ode_unique (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ)
    (θ θ' : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ) {T : ℝ} (_hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hinit : θ 0 = θ' 0)
    (hf : ContinuousOn θ (Set.Icc 0 T))
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt θ
      (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ t)) (Set.Ici t) t)
    (hg : ContinuousOn θ' (Set.Icc 0 T))
    (hg' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt θ'
      (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ' t)) (Set.Ici t) t)
    (hLip : ∃ (M : NNReal), LipschitzWith M (kuramotoVectorField K N W)) :
    Set.EqOn θ θ' (Set.Icc 0 T)

name: lyapunov_derivative_eq
statement:
theorem lyapunov_derivative_eq
    (K : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ *
      deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i) =
    -(∑ i, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ ^ 2)

name: lyapunov_derivative_nonpos
statement:
theorem lyapunov_derivative_nonpos
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ *
      deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update θ i x)) (θ i) ≤ 0

name: lyapunov_nonincreasing_along_trajectory
statement:
theorem lyapunov_nonincreasing_along_trajectory
    (K : ℝ) (_hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (_hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (θ : ℝ → Fin N → ℝ)
    (hsol : ∀ t, HasDerivAt θ (kuramotoVectorField K N W (θ t)) t) :
    ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => weightedKuramotoV K N W (θ s))
      (∑ i, weightedKuramotoF K N W i (θ t) *
        deriv (fun x => weightedKuramotoV K N W (Function.update (θ t) i x)) ((θ t) i)) t

name: semicircle_extremal_contraction
statement:
theorem semicircle_extremal_contraction
    (K : ℝ) (_hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ) (_hN : 0 < N)
    (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (_hW : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i)
    (hWnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i j : Fin N) (_hij : i ≠ j)
    (_hWij : 0 < W i j)
    (hWeq : ∀ k, W i k = W j k)
    (hmax : ∀ k, θ k ≤ θ i)
    (hmin : ∀ k, θ j ≤ θ k)
    (hgap : θ i - θ j < Real.pi) :
    weightedKuramotoF K N W i θ - weightedKuramotoF K N W j θ ≤ 0

name: sin_nonneg_of_phase_between
statement:
lemma sin_nonneg_of_phase_between
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) (i j k : Fin N)
    (hmax : θ k ≤ θ i) (hmin : θ j ≤ θ k)
    (hgap : θ i - θ j < Real.pi) :
    0 ≤ Real.sin (θ k - θ j) ∧ 0 ≤ Real.sin (θ i - θ k)

name: weightedKuramotoV_bounded_below
statement:
theorem weightedKuramotoV_bounded_below
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (N : ℕ)
    (W : Fin N → Fin N → ℝ) (hWnn : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ W i j) (hWle : ∀ i j, W i j ≤ 1)
    (θ : Fin N → ℝ) :
    -(K / 2) * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ weightedKuramotoV K N W θ

name: CategoryTheory.hom_cospan_pullback_lift_fst
statement:
lemma hom_cospan_pullback_lift_fst {W : Type v} {A B X Y : C}
    (l : A ⟶ B) (r : X ⟶ Y) (φ : W ⟶ (B ⟶ Y)) (ψ : W ⟶ (A ⟶ X))
    (comm : φ ≫ (homSquareRight l r) = ψ ≫ (homSquareBot l r) := by aesop_cat) :
    homCospanPullbackLift l r φ ψ comm ≫ homCospanPullbackFst l r = φ

    homCospanPullbackLift l r φ ψ comm ≫ homCospanPullbackSnd l r = ψ

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_is_unique_set
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_is_unique_set : {X Y : Type u} → (f : X ⟶ Y) → (im : Type u) →
    (left : X ⟶ im) → (p : MorphismProperty.epimorphisms _ left) → (right : im ⟶ Y) →
    (q : MorphismProperty.monomorphisms _ right) → (fact : left ≫ right = f) →
    (i : imageSet f ≅ im) → (leftMapSet f ≫ i.hom = left) →
    (_ : i.hom ≫ right = rightMapSet f) →
    i = (factorizationIsoSet f im left p right q fact).fst

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_set_hom'
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_set_hom' {X Y : Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (im : Type u)
    (left : X ⟶ im) (_ : MorphismProperty.epimorphisms _ left) (right : im ⟶ Y)
    (q : MorphismProperty.monomorphisms _ right) (fact : left ≫ right = f) (y : imageSet f) :
    ∃! y' : im, right y' = (rightMapSet f) y

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_set_hom_comm_left
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_set_hom_comm_left : {X Y : Type u} → (f : X ⟶ Y) → (im : Type u) →
    (left : X ⟶ im) → (p : MorphismProperty.epimorphisms _ left) → (right : im ⟶ Y) →
    (q : MorphismProperty.monomorphisms _ right) → (fact : left ≫ right = f) →
    leftMapSet f ≫ factorizationIsoSetHom f im left p right q fact = left

name: CategoryTheory.factorization_iso_set_hom_comm_right
statement:
lemma factorization_iso_set_hom_comm_right : {X Y : Type u} → (f : X ⟶ Y) → (im : Type u) →

statement:
public
theorem HolomorphicCousin.exists_smoothPartitionOfUnity_eq_one_near_closed {ι E H M : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace H]
    (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [IsManifold I ∞ M]
    [T2Space M] [SigmaCompactSpace M] (U : ι → Set M) (hUo : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hUc : Set.univ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) (i₀ : ι) {K : Set M} (hK : IsClosed K) (hKU : K ⊆ U i₀) :
    ∃ V : Set M,
      IsOpen V ∧
        K ⊆ V ∧
          V ⊆ U i₀ ∧
            ∃ ρ : SmoothPartitionOfUnity ι I M Set.univ,
              ρ.IsSubordinate U ∧
                (∀ x ∈ V, ρ i₀ x = 1) ∧
                  (∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → ∀ x ∈ V, ρ i x = 0) ∧
                    ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → Disjoint (tsupport (ρ i)) V
