        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) b c) :
    quotientRawPathValue G H (p.cons e) =
      quotientSymmEdgeLabel G H e * quotientRawPathValue G H p

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.quotientRawPathValue_nil
statement:
theorem quotientRawPathValue_nil {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (a : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) :
    quotientRawPathValue G H
      (@Quiver.Path.nil (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
    (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) a) = 1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.quotientRawPathValue_tree
GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.quotientSymmEdgeLabel_tree
statement:
theorem quotientSymmEdgeLabel_tree {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) a b)
    (he : e ∈ rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H a b) :
    quotientSymmEdgeLabel G H e = 1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.quotientTreePathHom_eq_rawTreePathAtRoot
statement:
theorem quotientTreePathHom_eq_rawTreePathAtRoot {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (a : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) :
    quotientTreePathHom G H a =
      @freeGroupoidPathHom (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H) a
        (rawTreePathMap G H (rawTreePathAtRoot G H a))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.quotientTreePathValue_one
statement:
theorem quotientTreePathValue_one {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (a : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) :
    quotientPathValue G H (quotientTreePathHom G H a) = 1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf_source
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf_source {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G} (e : a ⟶ b) :
    rawBassSerreEdgeDataSource G (rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf G e) = a

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf_target
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf_target {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G} (e : a ⟶ b) :
    rawBassSerreEdgeDataTarget G (rawBassSerreEdgeDataOf G e) = b

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreEdgeData_source_action
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreEdgeData_source_action {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (a : FreeProduct G) (e : rawBassSerreEdgeData G) :
    rawBassSerreEdgeDataSource G (a • e) = a • rawBassSerreEdgeDataSource G e

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreEdgeData_target_action
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreEdgeData_target_action {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (a : FreeProduct G) (e : rawBassSerreEdgeData G) :
    rawBassSerreEdgeDataTarget G (a • e) = a • rawBassSerreEdgeDataTarget G e

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreFactor_path
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreFactor_path {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (i : ι) (c : FactorCoset G i) :
    Nonempty (@Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreVertex G)) _
      (RawBassSerreVertex.central 1) (RawBassSerreVertex.factor i c))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeSource_mk
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeSource_mk {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (e : rawBassSerreEdgeData G) :
    rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeSource G H (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMk G H e) =
      actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreEdgeDataSource G e)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeTarget_mk
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeTarget_mk {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (e : rawBassSerreEdgeData G) :
    rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeTarget G H (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMk G H e) =
      actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreEdgeDataTarget G e)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver_rootedConnected
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver_rootedConnected {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G)) :
    Quiver.RootedConnected
      (show Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) from
        actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) (RawBassSerreVertex.central 1))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreOrbitTree_root_eq
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreOrbitTree_root_eq {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G)) :
    (Quiver.root (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H) : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) =
      rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerreWord_path
statement:
theorem rawBassSerreWord_path {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (g : FreeProduct G) :
    Nonempty (@Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreVertex G)) _
      (RawBassSerreVertex.central 1) (RawBassSerreVertex.central g))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerre_central_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem rawBassSerre_central_fixed_iff {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (g h : FreeProduct G) :
    h • RawBassSerreVertex.central g = RawBassSerreVertex.central g ↔ h = 1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerre_factor_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem rawBassSerre_factor_fixed_iff {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G)) (i : ι)
    (g : FreeProduct G) (h : H) :
    h.1 • RawBassSerreVertex.factor i (factorCosetMk G i g) =
        RawBassSerreVertex.factor i (factorCosetMk G i g) ↔
      (h : FreeProduct G) ∈ intersectionFactor H i g

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawBassSerre_rootedConnected
statement:
theorem rawBassSerre_rootedConnected {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] :
    Quiver.RootedConnected
      (show Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreVertex G) from
        RawBassSerreVertex.central 1)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawOrbitAlign_spec
statement:
theorem rawOrbitAlign_spec {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {x y : RawBassSerreVertex G}
    (h : actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) x =
      actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) y) :
    (rawOrbitAlign G H h).1 • x = y

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeInclusion_mapPath_asRaw_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawTreeInclusion_mapPath_asRaw_cons {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b c : WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
      (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)) a b)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
      (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)) b c) :
    rawTreeInclusionMapPathAsRaw G H (p.cons e) =
      (rawTreeInclusionMapPathAsRaw G H p).cons
        ((rawTreeInclusion G H).map e)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeInclusion_mapPath_asRaw_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawTreeInclusion_mapPath_asRaw_nil {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a : WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)} :
    rawTreeInclusionMapPathAsRaw G H
      (Quiver.Path.nil : @Quiver.Path (WideSubquiver.toType
        (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
        (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
        (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)) a a) =
      (Quiver.Path.nil : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify
        (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H))
        (show RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H from a)
        (show RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H from a))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreePathAtRoot_cons
statement:
theorem rawTreePathAtRoot_cons {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b c : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
      (rawTreeQuiver G H) a b)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
      (rawTreeQuiver G H) b c) :
    rawTreePathMap G H
        (@Quiver.Path.cons (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawTreeQuiver G H) _ _ _ p e) =
      (@Quiver.Path.cons (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) _ _ _
        (rawTreePathMap G H p)
        (show @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
          (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
            (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) _ _ from e.1))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreePathAtRoot_eq_rawTreePath
statement:
theorem rawTreePathAtRoot_eq_rawTreePath {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (a : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) :
    rawTreePathAtRoot G H a = rawTreePath G H a

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreePathMap_cons_raw
statement:
theorem rawTreePathMap_cons_raw {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b c : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
      (rawTreeQuiver G H) a b)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
      (rawTreeQuiver G H) b c) :
    rawTreePathMap G H
        (@Quiver.Path.cons (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawTreeQuiver G H) _ _ _ p e) =
      (@Quiver.Path.cons (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) _ _ _
        (rawTreePathMap G H p)
        (show @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
          (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
            (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) _ _ from e.1))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeQuiverRoot_eq
statement:
theorem rawTreeQuiverRoot_eq {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G)) :
    rawTreeQuiverRoot G H = rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeRepresentative_of_tree_edge
statement:
theorem rawTreeRepresentative_of_tree_edge {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H} (e : a ⟶ b)
    (he : Quiver.Hom.toPos e ∈ rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H a b) :
    rawTreeRepresentative G H b = quotientEdgeAlignedTarget G H e

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeRepresentative_of_tree_edge_neg
statement:
theorem rawTreeRepresentative_of_tree_edge_neg {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H} (e : a ⟶ b)
    (he : Quiver.Hom.toNeg e ∈ rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H b a) :
    rawTreeRepresentative G H a =
      (quotientEdgeDirectTargetAlign G H e).1 •
        rawBassSerreEdgeDataSource G (quotientEdgeRawData G H e)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeRepresentative_orbit
statement:
theorem rawTreeRepresentative_orbit {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (b : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) :
    actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawTreeRepresentative G H b) = b

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeRootPath_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawTreeRootPath_cons {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {b c : WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H) (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G
      H)) (@Quiver.root (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)
        (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
        (rawBassSerreOrbitTreeArborescence G H)) b)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (WideSubquiver.toType
      (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
      (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)) b c) :
    rawTreeRootPath G H (p.cons e) =
      (rawTreeRootPath G H p).cons (rawTreeEdgeMap G H e)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rawTreeRootPath_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawTreeRootPath_nil {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G)) :
    rawTreeRootPath G H (Quiver.Path.nil :
      @Quiver.Path (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H) (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
        (@Quiver.root (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)
        (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
        (rawBassSerreOrbitTreeArborescence G H))
        (@Quiver.root (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H)
        (WideSubquiver.quiver (rawBassSerreOrbitTree G H))
        (rawBassSerreOrbitTreeArborescence G H))) =
      (Quiver.Path.nil : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify
        (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
        (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
          (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H))
        (rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H) (rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightAppendCanonical_of_lastIdx_eq
statement:
theorem rightAppendCanonical_of_lastIdx_eq {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (hwi : wordLastIdx w = some i) :
    rightAppendCanonical i (rightTailCanonical i w) (rightHead i w)
        (rightHead_ne_one_of_lastIdx_eq i w hwi) = w

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightAppend_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightAppend_prod {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (a : G i) (ha : a ≠ 1)
    (hw : wordLastIdx w ≠ some i) :
    (rightAppend i w a ha hw).prod =
      w.prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of a

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightAppend_rightHead
statement:
theorem rightAppend_rightHead {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (a : G i) (ha : a ≠ 1)
    (hw : wordLastIdx w ≠ some i) :
    rightHead i (rightAppend i w a ha hw) = a

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightAppend_rightTail
statement:
theorem rightAppend_rightTail {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (a : G i) (ha : a ≠ 1)
    (hw : wordLastIdx w ≠ some i) :
    rightTail i (rightAppend i w a ha hw) = w

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightCosetMk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rightCosetMk_eq_iff {P : Type w} [Group P] (K : Subgroup P) (a b : P) :
    rightCosetMk K a = rightCosetMk K b ↔ ∃ k : K, a * k = b

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightCosetMk_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightCosetMk_smul {P : Type w} [Group P] (K : Subgroup P) (g a : P) :
    g • rightCosetMk K a = rightCosetMk K (g * a)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightCoset_stabilizer_iff
statement:
theorem rightCoset_stabilizer_iff {P : Type w} [Group P] (K : Subgroup P)
    (g a : P) : g • rightCosetMk K a = rightCosetMk K a ↔
      a⁻¹ * g * a ∈ K

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightHead_ne_one_of_lastIdx_eq
statement:
theorem rightHead_ne_one_of_lastIdx_eq {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (hwi : wordLastIdx w = some i) : rightHead i w ≠ 1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightTail_eq_of_prod_eq_mul_factor
statement:
theorem rightTail_eq_of_prod_eq_mul_factor {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w w' : RightFactorWord (G := G) i) (a a' : G i)
    (h : w.1.prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of a =
      w'.1.prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of a') : w.1 = w'.1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightTail_equiv_mul_factor
statement:
theorem rightTail_equiv_mul_factor {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : RightFactorWord (G := G) i) (a : G i) :
    rightTail i (Word.equiv (w.1.prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of a)) = w.1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightTail_lastIdx_ne
statement:
theorem rightTail_lastIdx_ne {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)] (i : ι) (w : Word G) :
    wordLastIdx (rightTail i w) ≠ some i

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.rightTail_of_lastIdx_ne
statement:
theorem rightTail_of_lastIdx_ne {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) (hw : wordLastIdx w ≠ some i) :
    rightTail i w = w

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.right_syllable_decomposition
statement:
theorem right_syllable_decomposition {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : Word G) :
    w.prod = (rightTail i w).prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of (rightHead i w)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.treeKuroshProductToH_free
statement:
@[simp]
theorem treeKuroshProductToH_free {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (x : KuroshFreePart G H) :
    treeKuroshProductToH G H (treeKuroshFreeInclusion G H x) =
      kuroshFreePartHom G H x

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.treeKuroshProductToH_vertex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem treeKuroshProductToH_vertex {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    (a : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H) (x : treeVertexStabilizer G H a) :
    treeKuroshProductToH G H (treeKuroshVertexInclusion G H a x) = x

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.wordInv_cons_rightAppend
statement:
theorem wordInv_cons_rightAppend {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (a : G i) (w : Word G) (hw : w.fstIdx ≠ some i) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    rightAppend i (⟨wordInv w, by simpa [wordLastIdx] using hw⟩ : RightFactorWord (G := G) i)
        a⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr ha) (by simpa [wordLastIdx] using hw) =
      wordInv (Word.cons a w hw ha)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.wordInv_prod
statement:
theorem wordInv_prod {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)] (w : Word G) :
    (wordInv w).prod = w.prod⁻¹

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.wordInv_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordInv_toList {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)] (w : Word G) :
    (wordInv w).toList = w.toList.reverse.map (fun x : Σ i, G i => ⟨x.1, x.2⁻¹⟩)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.wordInv_wordInv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem wordInv_wordInv {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)] (w : Word G) :
    wordInv (wordInv w) = w

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.wordLastIdx_ne_iff
statement:
theorem wordLastIdx_ne_iff {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (w : Word G) (i : ι) :
    wordLastIdx w ≠ some i ↔
      ∀ l ∈ w.toList.getLast?, i ≠ l.1

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.word_equiv_mul_rightAppend
statement:
theorem word_equiv_mul_rightAppend {G : ι → Type u} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (i : ι) (w : RightFactorWord (G := G) i) (a : G i) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    Word.equiv (w.1.prod * Monoid.CoprodI.of a) =
      rightAppend i w.1 a ha w.2

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.actionOrbitAlign_spec
statement:
theorem Internal.actionOrbitAlign_spec {A X : Type w} [Group A]
    [MulAction A X] {x y : X}
    (h : actionOrbitMk A X x = actionOrbitMk A X y) :
    Internal.actionOrbitAlign h • x = y

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassAllEdge_target_injective
GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassEdgeCodeOf_ofCode
statement:
theorem Internal.bassEdgeCodeOf_ofCode {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (c : Internal.bassEdgeCode G) :
    Internal.bassEdgeCodeOf G (Internal.bassEdgeOfCode G c) = c

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassEdgeCodeTarget_injective

theorem Internal.bassHeight_symm_edge {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassPathHom_cons
statement:
theorem Internal.bassPathHom_cons {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {x y z : BassSerreVertex G}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x y)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) y z) :
    Internal.bassPathHom G (p.cons e) =
      Internal.bassPathHom G p ≫
        (match e with
        | Sum.inl f => (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (BassSerreVertex G)).map f
        | Sum.inr f => Groupoid.inv ((Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (BassSerreVertex G)).map f))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassPathHom_eq_quotient_map
statement:
theorem Internal.bassPathHom_eq_quotient_map {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {x y : BassSerreVertex G}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x y) :
    Internal.bassPathHom G p =
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor
        (@Quiver.FreeGroupoid.redStep (BassSerreVertex G)
          (bassSerreQuiver G))).map p

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassPathHom_eq_tree
statement:
theorem Internal.bassPathHom_eq_tree {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {x : BassSerreVertex G} (p :
      @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
        (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G))
        (BassSerreVertex.central Word.empty) x) :
    Internal.bassPathHom G p =
      Internal.bassPathHom G (Internal.bassTreePathMap G (Internal.bassTreePath G x))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassPathHom_nil
statement:
theorem Internal.bassPathHom_nil {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

          (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x x) = 𝟙 _

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassQuotientMap_cons
statement:
theorem Internal.bassQuotientMap_cons {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {x y z : BassSerreVertex G}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x y)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) y z) :
    (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor
        (@Quiver.FreeGroupoid.redStep (BassSerreVertex G)
          (bassSerreQuiver G))).map
        (@Quiver.Path.cons (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
          (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x y z p e) =
      (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor
        (@Quiver.FreeGroupoid.redStep (BassSerreVertex G)
          (bassSerreQuiver G))).map p ≫
        (match e with
        | Sum.inl f => (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (BassSerreVertex G)).map f
        | Sum.inr f => Groupoid.inv ((Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (BassSerreVertex G)).map f))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassRootOrArrow
statement:
theorem Internal.bassRootOrArrow {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (b : BassSerreVertex G) :

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassSymmPath_of_length_eq
statement:
theorem Internal.bassSymmPath_of_length_eq {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {b : BassSerreVertex G}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G))
      (BassSerreVertex.central Word.empty) b)
    (hp : @Quiver.Path.length (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
      (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) _ _ p =
        Internal.bassSymmHeight G b) :
    ∃ q : @Quiver.Path (BassSerreVertex G) (bassSerreQuiver G)
      (BassSerreVertex.central Word.empty) b,
      (Internal.bassToSymm G).mapPath q = p

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassToRawFunctor_map_of
statement:
theorem Internal.bassToRawFunctor_map_of {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {a b : BassSerreVertex G}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (BassSerreVertex G) (bassSerreQuiver G) a b) :
    Quiver.homOfEq
        ((Internal.bassToRawFunctor G).map
          ((Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (BassSerreVertex G)).map e))
        (Prefunctor.congr_obj
          (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.lift_spec (Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor G)) a)
        (Prefunctor.congr_obj
          (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.lift_spec (Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor G)) b) =
      (Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor G).map e

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor_map_centralFactor
statement:
theorem Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor_map_centralFactor {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (g : FreeProduct G) (i : ι)
    (hw : wordLastIdx (Word.equiv g) ≠ some i) :
    (Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor G).map
        (BassSerreEdge.centralFactor (Word.equiv g) i hw) =
      (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (RawBassSerreVertex G)).map
        (RawBassSerreEdge.centralFactor (Word.equiv g).prod i)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor_map_factorCentral
statement:
theorem Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor_map_factorCentral {ι : Type v}
    (G : ι → Type u) [∀ i, Group (G i)] (i : ι)
    (w : RightFactorWord (G := G) i) (a : G i) (ha : a ≠ 1)
    (hv : RawBassSerreVertex.factor i
        (factorCosetMk G i (rightAppendCanonical i w a ha).prod) =
      Internal.bassToRawVertex G (BassSerreVertex.factor i w)) :
    (Internal.bassToRawPrefunctor G).map
        (BassSerreEdge.factorCentral i w a ha) =
      Groupoid.inv (Quiver.homOfEq
        ((Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (RawBassSerreVertex G)).map
          (RawBassSerreEdge.centralFactor
            (rightAppendCanonical i w a ha).prod i)) rfl
        (congrArg (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (RawBassSerreVertex G)).obj hv))

GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassToSymm_mapPath_length
statement:
theorem Internal.bassToSymm_mapPath_length {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassTreePathHom_edge_neg
statement:
theorem Internal.bassTreePathHom_edge_neg {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassTreePathMap_cons
statement:
theorem Internal.bassTreePathMap_cons {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {x y z : BassSerreVertex G}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (BassSerreVertex G) (Internal.bassTreeQuiver G) x y)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (BassSerreVertex G) (Internal.bassTreeQuiver G) y z) :
    Internal.bassTreePathMap G (@Quiver.Path.cons (BassSerreVertex G)
      (Internal.bassTreeQuiver G) x y z p e) =
      @Quiver.Path.cons (Quiver.Symmetrify (BassSerreVertex G))
        (Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (BassSerreVertex G)) x y z

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bassTreePathMap_edge_pos
statement:
theorem Internal.bassTreePathMap_edge_pos {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

      (Internal.bassTreePathMap G (Internal.bassTreePath G x)).cons

GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bass_edge_mem_geodesicTree

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.bass_factorCoset_append
statement:
theorem Internal.bass_factorCoset_append {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.conjugate_mem_stabilizer
statement:
theorem Internal.conjugate_mem_stabilizer {A X : Type w} [Group A]
    [MulAction A X] (x : X) (s k : A) (hk : k • x = x) :
    s * k * s⁻¹ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer A (s • x)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.factorCentralInjective
statement:
theorem Internal.factorCentralInjective {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] {i i' : ι}
    {w : RightFactorWord (G := G) i} {w' : RightFactorWord (G := G) i'}
    {a : G i} {a' : G i'} (ha : a ≠ 1) (ha' : a' ≠ 1)
    (h : rightAppendCanonical i w a ha =
      rightAppendCanonical i' w' a' ha') :
    i = i' ∧ HEq w w' ∧ HEq a a'

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.freeGroupoid_isConnected_of_basedPaths
statement:

    [q : Quiver.{v} V] (r : V)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.functor_map_homOfEq
statement:
theorem Internal.functor_map_homOfEq {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {X Y X' Y' : C} (F : C ⥤ D) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') :
    F.map (Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY) =
      Quiver.homOfEq (F.map f) (congrArg F.obj hX) (congrArg F.obj hY)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.functor_map_injective_of_eq_id
statement:
theorem Internal.functor_map_injective_of_eq_id {C : Type u} [Category C]
    (F : C ⥤ C) (hF : F = CategoryTheory.Functor.id C) (x : C) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : End x => F.map f)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.groupoid_inv_homOfEq
statement:
theorem Internal.groupoid_inv_homOfEq {C : Type*} [Groupoid C]
    {X Y X' Y' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') :
    Groupoid.inv (Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY) =
      Quiver.homOfEq (Groupoid.inv f) hY hX

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.groupoid_inv_inv
statement:
theorem Internal.groupoid_inv_inv {C : Type*} [Groupoid C]
    {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Groupoid.inv (Groupoid.inv f) = f

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.groupoid_inv_inv_homOfEq
statement:
theorem Internal.groupoid_inv_inv_homOfEq {C : Type*} [Groupoid C]
    {X Y X' Y' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') :
    Groupoid.inv (Groupoid.inv (Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY)) =
      Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.homOfEq_eq_of_heq
statement:
theorem Internal.homOfEq_eq_of_heq {C : Type*} [Quiver C]
    {X Y X' Y' : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : X' ⟶ Y'}
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (hfg : HEq f g) :

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.homOfEq_transport
statement:
theorem Internal.homOfEq_transport {C : Type*} [Quiver C]
    {X Y X' Y' X'' Y'' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X' ⟶ Y')
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (kX : X' = X'') (kY : Y' = Y'')
    (h : Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY = g) :
    Quiver.homOfEq f (hX.trans kX) (hY.trans kY) =
      Quiver.homOfEq g kX kY

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.homOfEq_transport'
statement:
theorem Internal.homOfEq_transport' {C : Type*} [Quiver C]
    {X Y X' Y' X'' Y'' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X' ⟶ Y')
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (kX : X' = X'') (kY : Y' = Y'')
    (lX : X = X'') (lY : Y = Y'')
    (h : Quiver.homOfEq f hX hY = g) :
    Quiver.homOfEq f lX lY = Quiver.homOfEq g kX kY

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.negativeStepVertex_endpoint
statement:
theorem Internal.negativeStepVertex_endpoint {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreQuiver G) a b)
    (u : H)
    (hu : u.1 • rawTreeRepresentative G H
      (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) b) = b) :
    a = (u * Internal.negativeStepVertex G H e u hu *
      quotientEdgeLabel G H
        (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e)).1 •
      rawTreeRepresentative G H
        (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) a)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.negative_step
statement:
theorem Internal.negative_step {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreQuiver G) a b)
    (u : H)
    (hu : u.1 • rawTreeRepresentative G H
      (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) b) = b) :
    ∃ v : treeVertexStabilizer G H
        (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) b),
      Internal.rawEdgeOrbitAlign G H e =
          u * v * ((quotientEdgeLabel G H
            (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e)) *
            quotientEdgeCoherentSourceAlign G H
              (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e)) ∧
        a = (u * v * quotientEdgeLabel G H
          (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e)).1 •
          rawTreeRepresentative G H
            (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) a)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.positiveStepVertex_endpoint
statement:
theorem Internal.positiveStepVertex_endpoint {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreQuiver G) a b)
    (u : H)
    (hu : u.1 • rawTreeRepresentative G H
      (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) a) = a) :
    b = (u * Internal.positiveStepVertex G H e u hu *
      (quotientEdgeLabel G H
        (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e))⁻¹).1 •
      rawTreeRepresentative G H
        (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) b)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.positive_step
statement:
theorem Internal.positive_step {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreVertex G}
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (RawBassSerreVertex G) (rawBassSerreQuiver G) a b)
    (u : H)
    (hu : u.1 • rawTreeRepresentative G H
      (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) a) = a) :
    ∃ v : treeVertexStabilizer G H
        (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) a),
      Internal.rawEdgeOrbitAlign G H e =
          u * v * quotientEdgeCoherentSourceAlign G H
            (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e) ∧
        b = (u * v * (quotientEdgeLabel G H
          (rawBassSerreOrbitEdgeMap G H e))⁻¹).1 •
          rawTreeRepresentative G H
            (actionOrbitMk H (RawBassSerreVertex G) b)

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.rawBassRawFunctor_eq_id

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.rawCanonicalVertex_bassToRawVertex
GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.Internal.rawCanonicalVertex_factorCosetMk
statement:
theorem Internal.rawCanonicalVertex_factorCosetMk {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (i : ι) (g : FreeProduct G) :

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.coverFreeGroupoidPathHom_cons
statement:
theorem coverFreeGroupoidPathHom_cons {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b c : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) a b)
    (e : @Quiver.Hom (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H)) b c) :
    coverFreeGroupoidPathHom G H (p.cons e) =
      coverFreeGroupoidPathHom G H p ≫
        (match e with
        | Sum.inl f =>
            (Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)).map f
        | Sum.inr f =>
            Groupoid.inv
              ((Quiver.FreeGroupoid.of (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)).map f))

        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H) a) :

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.coverPathValueOpp_neg
statement:
theorem coverPathValueOpp_neg {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))
    {a b : RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H}
    (p : @Quiver.Path (Quiver.Symmetrify (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H))
      (@Quiver.symmetrifyQuiver (RawBassSerreOrbitVertex G H)
        (rawBassSerreOrbitQuiver.inst G H))
      (rawBassSerreOrbitRoot G H) b)
    (e : a ⟶ b) :
    coverPathValueOpp G H (p.cons (Quiver.Hom.toNeg e)) =
      MulOpposite.op
          (coverEdgeLetter G H (coverBaseEdge G H e)) *
        coverPathValueOpp G H p

statement:
theorem coverPathValue_formula {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)
    [∀ i, Group (G i)] (H : Subgroup (FreeProduct G))

name: GraphCoveringTheory.Kurosh.coverPathValue_neg
statement:
theorem coverPathValue_neg {ι : Type v} (G : ι → Type u)

name: PerUnitMerge.arith_prog_sum_le
statement:
lemma arith_prog_sum_le
    (n d : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hd_pos : 0 < d) (hd_le : d ≤ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b + j * d)) ≤
    1 / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b)) + (1 + Real.log ↑n) / (2 * ↑d)

      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ))) ≤

name: PerUnitMerge.b_bounds
statement:
lemma b_bounds
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d]
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (k_val : ℕ) (hk_nd : ¬(d ∣ k_val))
    (u : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    let b := ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d))
    1 ≤ b ∧ b < d

name: PerUnitMerge.b_ne_zero
statement:
lemma b_ne_zero
    (d : ℕ)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (k_val : ℕ) (hk_nd : ¬(d ∣ k_val))
    (u : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d)) ≠ 0

name: PerUnitMerge.bijection_sum_eq
statement:
lemma bijection_sum_eq
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d]
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (k_val : ℕ) (hk_nd : ¬(d ∣ k_val)) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      let b := ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d))
      1 / min (b : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) - b)) =
    (∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      1 / min ((k_val * (u : ZMod d).val % d : ℕ) : ℝ)
              ((d : ℝ) - (k_val * (u : ZMod d).val % d : ℕ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.complement_div_d_dvd

    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) (hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    d ∣ (n - v - (d - b))

name: PerUnitMerge.complement_eq_arith_prog

    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) (hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    n - v = (d - b) + ((n - v - (d - b)) / d) * d

name: PerUnitMerge.complement_eq_arith_prog_real
statement:
lemma complement_eq_arith_prog_real
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) (hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    (n : ℝ) - v = (d : ℝ) - b + ((n - v - (d - b)) / d : ℕ) * d

name: PerUnitMerge.complement_j_in_range
statement:
lemma complement_j_in_range
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_pos : 0 < d) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) (hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    (n - v - (d - b)) / d < n / (2 * d) + 1

name: PerUnitMerge.complement_map_injective
statement:
lemma complement_map_injective
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    ∀ v₁ v₂ : ℕ,
      v₁ < n → v₁ % d = b → n < 2 * v₁ →
      v₂ < n → v₂ % d = b → n < 2 * v₂ →
      (n - v₁ - (d - b)) / d = (n - v₂ - (d - b)) / d →
      v₁ = v₂

name: PerUnitMerge.cond_sum_eq_residue_class_sum
statement:
lemma cond_sum_eq_residue_class_sum
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (mq : ℕ)
    (k : ZMod n) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (u : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    let b := ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((ZMod.val k * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d))
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) =
    ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0

name: PerUnitMerge.d_sub_b_le_n_sub_v
statement:
lemma d_sub_b_le_n_sub_v
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) (_hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    d - b ≤ n - v

name: PerUnitMerge.divisibility_iff_residue_class
statement:
lemma divisibility_iff_residue_class
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero d]
    (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (k : ZMod n) (_hk : k ≠ 0)
    (u : (ZMod d)ˣ)
    (l : ZMod n) :
    let b := ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((ZMod.val k * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d))
    ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q)) ↔
    (ZMod.val l % d = b)

name: PerUnitMerge.dvd_iff_zmod_eq_zero
statement:
lemma dvd_iff_zmod_eq_zero
    (d : ℕ) (k_val u_val l_val : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑k_val * ↑u_val + ↑l_val * q)) ↔
    ((k_val : ZMod d) * (u_val : ZMod d) + (l_val : ZMod d) * (q : ZMod d) = 0)

name: PerUnitMerge.dvd_of_dvd_mul_unit_val
statement:
lemma dvd_of_dvd_mul_unit_val
    (d : ℕ)
    (k_val : ℕ) (u : (ZMod d)ˣ)
    (h : d ∣ k_val * (u : ZMod d).val) :
    d ∣ k_val

name: PerUnitMerge.eq_of_dvd_div_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_dvd_div_eq (a b d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (ha : d ∣ a) (hb : d ∣ b)
    (h : a / d = b / d) : a = b

name: PerUnitMerge.fourier_mass_residue_class_bound
statement:
lemma fourier_mass_residue_class_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) ≤
    1 / min (b : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) - b) + (1 + Real.log ↑n) / ↑d

name: PerUnitMerge.half_reciprocal_sum_le_min_reciprocal
statement:
lemma half_reciprocal_sum_le_min_reciprocal
    (b d : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    1 / (2 * (b : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b)) ≤
    1 / min (b : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) - b)

name: PerUnitMerge.harmonic_range_le_one_plus_log
statement:
lemma harmonic_range_le_one_plus_log (M n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hM : M ≤ n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 + Real.log ↑n

name: PerUnitMerge.harmonic_sum_over_Icc_le_log_div
statement:
lemma harmonic_sum_over_Icc_le_log_div
    (n d : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hd_pos : 0 < d) (_hd_le : d ≤ n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n / (2 * d)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ))) ≤
    (1 + Real.log ↑n) / (2 * ↑d)

name: PerUnitMerge.high_range_bound
statement:
lemma high_range_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) ≤
    1 / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b)) + (1 + Real.log ↑n) / (2 * ↑d)

name: PerUnitMerge.high_range_pointwise_bound
statement:
lemma high_range_pointwise_bound
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (d : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b)
    (l : ZMod n) (hl_mod : ZMod.val l % d = b) (hl_high : ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)) :
    ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ ≤
      1 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val l))

name: PerUnitMerge.high_range_reindex_bound
statement:
lemma high_range_reindex_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n))
      then (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val l))
      else 0) ≤
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b + j * d))

name: PerUnitMerge.image_subset_range
statement:
lemma image_subset_range
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (_hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : ZMod n =>
        ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n))).image
      (fun l : ZMod n => (n - ZMod.val l - (d - b)) / d) ⊆
    Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1)

name: PerUnitMerge.inner_sum_bound_at_residue
statement:
lemma inner_sum_bound_at_residue
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (_hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (_hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (k : ZMod n) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hk_nd : ¬((d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k))
    (u : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    let b := ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((ZMod.val k * (u : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d))
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) ≤
    1 / min (b : ℝ) ((d : ℝ) - b)
    + (1 + Real.log ↑n) / ↑d

name: PerUnitMerge.log_two_n_plus_one_le_one_plus_log
statement:
theorem log_two_n_plus_one_le_one_plus_log (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Real.log (2 * ↑n + 1) ≤ 1 + Real.log ↑n

name: PerUnitMerge.low_range_bound
statement:
lemma low_range_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) ≤
    1 / (2 * (b : ℝ)) + (1 + Real.log ↑n) / (2 * ↑d)

name: PerUnitMerge.low_range_le_sum_over_j
statement:
lemma low_range_le_sum_over_j (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else 0) ≤
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.min_eq_val_of_two_mul_le
statement:
lemma min_eq_val_of_two_mul_le (n : ℕ) (l : ZMod n)
    (h2 : 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n) :
    (min (ZMod.val l : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val l)) = (ZMod.val l : ℝ)

name: PerUnitMerge.n_modEq_d_of_dvd
statement:
lemma n_modEq_d_of_dvd
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) :
    n ≡ d [MOD d]

name: PerUnitMerge.n_sub_v_eq
statement:
lemma n_sub_v_eq
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b)
    (hquot : v / d < n / d) :
    n - v = d * (n / d - v / d - 1) + (d - b)

name: PerUnitMerge.n_sub_v_le_half_n
statement:
lemma n_sub_v_le_half_n
    (n : ℕ) (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    n - v ≤ n / 2

name: PerUnitMerge.n_sub_v_mod_eq_d_sub_b
statement:
lemma n_sub_v_mod_eq_d_sub_b
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) :
    (n - v) % d = d - b

name: PerUnitMerge.nat_sub_mul_add
statement:
lemma nat_sub_mul_add (A B d b : ℕ) (hBA : B < A) (hbd : b < d) :
    d * A - (d * B + b) = d * (A - B - 1) + (d - b)

name: PerUnitMerge.neg_inv_eq_inv_neg
statement:
lemma neg_inv_eq_inv_neg (d : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (hq : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1) :
    -(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ = (-(q : ZMod d))⁻¹

name: PerUnitMerge.neg_inv_isUnit
statement:
lemma neg_inv_isUnit
    (d : ℕ)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1) :
    IsUnit (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹)

name: PerUnitMerge.neg_q_unit_exists
statement:
lemma neg_q_unit_exists
    (d : ℕ)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1) :
    ∃ w : (ZMod d)ˣ, (w : ZMod d) = -(q : ZMod d)

name: PerUnitMerge.nonzero_of_val_mod_eq_pos
statement:
lemma nonzero_of_val_mod_eq_pos (n d : ℕ)
    (l : ZMod n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (_hb_lt : b < d)
    (hmod : ZMod.val l % d = b) : l ≠ 0

name: PerUnitMerge.pointwise_bound_in_low_range
statement:
lemma pointwise_bound_in_low_range (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq_lo : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq_hi : mq < n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d)
    (l : ZMod n) (hmod : ZMod.val l % d = b) (hlow : 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n) :
    ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ ≤
      1 / (2 * (ZMod.val l : ℝ))

name: PerUnitMerge.q_isUnit_of_gcd
statement:
lemma q_isUnit_of_gcd (d : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (hq : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1) :
    IsUnit (q : ZMod d)

name: PerUnitMerge.quot_lt
statement:
lemma quot_lt
    (n d : ℕ) (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (_hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < n) (hv_mod : v % d = b) :
    v / d < n / d

name: PerUnitMerge.quotient_injOn
statement:
lemma quotient_injOn (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    Set.InjOn (fun l : ZMod n => (ZMod.val l - b) / d)
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun l : ZMod n => ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)))

name: PerUnitMerge.quotient_mem_range
statement:
lemma quotient_mem_range (n d : ℕ) (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (_hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (_hb_lt : b < d)
    (l : ZMod n) (hl : ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n) :
    (ZMod.val l - b) / d ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1)

name: PerUnitMerge.reindex_filtered_sum
statement:
lemma reindex_filtered_sum
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun l : ZMod n =>
        ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val l))) =
    ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : ZMod n =>
        ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n))).image
      (fun l : ZMod n => (n - ZMod.val l - (d - b)) / d),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b + j * d))

name: PerUnitMerge.reindex_map_injOn
statement:
lemma reindex_map_injOn
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    Set.InjOn (fun l : ZMod n => (n - ZMod.val l - (d - b)) / d)
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : ZMod n =>
        ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ ¬(2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)) : Set (ZMod n))

name: PerUnitMerge.residue_iff_zmod_eq
statement:
lemma residue_iff_zmod_eq
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (k_val u_val l_val : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    (l_val % d = ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * u_val : ℕ) : ZMod d))) ↔
    ((l_val : ZMod d) = -(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * u_val : ℕ) : ZMod d))

name: PerUnitMerge.rhs_term_nonneg
statement:
lemma rhs_term_nonneg (b d : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (j : ℕ) :
    (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.split_sum_low_high
PerUnitMerge.sub_d_sub_b_le_sub_v
statement:
lemma sub_d_sub_b_le_sub_v
    (n d : ℕ) (_hd_pos : 0 < d) (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (_hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (_hb_lt : b < d)
    (v : ℕ) (_hv_lt : v < n) (_hv_mod : v % d = b) (_hv_big : n < 2 * v) :
    n - v - (d - b) ≤ n - v

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_Icc_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma sum_Icc_eq_sum_range (J : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 J, (1 : ℝ) / (j : ℝ) =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_factor_Icc
statement:
lemma sum_factor_Icc (n d : ℕ) (hd_pos : 0 < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n / (2 * d)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ))) =
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n / (2 * d)), (1 : ℝ) / (j : ℝ)) / (2 * (d : ℝ))

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_range_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_range_eq_sum_Icc (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) = ∑ u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (↑u)⁻¹

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_range_le_sum_Icc
statement:
lemma sum_range_le_sum_Icc (n d : ℕ) (hd_pos : 0 < d)
    (b : ℕ) (_hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b + ((j : ℝ) + 1) * d)) ≤
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n / (2 * d)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_range_split
statement:
lemma sum_range_split (J : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), f j = f 0 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 J, f j

name: PerUnitMerge.sum_val_reciprocal_le_sum_range
statement:
lemma sum_val_reciprocal_le_sum_range (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n)
      then (1 : ℝ) / (2 * (ZMod.val l : ℝ))
      else 0) ≤
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d) + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.summand_bound
statement:
lemma summand_bound (d : ℕ) (hd_pos : 0 < d) (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + (j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ))) ≤
    (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((j : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.summand_eq
statement:
lemma summand_eq (n d : ℕ)
    (b : ℕ) (_hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (_hb_lt : b < d)
    (l : ZMod n) (hl : ZMod.val l % d = b ∧ 2 * ZMod.val l ≤ n) :
    (1 : ℝ) / (2 * (ZMod.val l : ℝ)) =
    (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((b : ℝ) + ((ZMod.val l - b) / d : ℕ) * (d : ℝ)))

name: PerUnitMerge.summand_val_eq_after_bijection
statement:
lemma summand_val_eq_after_bijection
    (d : ℕ) [NeZero d]
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (k_val : ℕ) (_hk_nd : ¬(d ∣ k_val))
    (w : (ZMod d)ˣ) (hw : (w : ZMod d) = -(q : ZMod d))
    (v : (ZMod d)ˣ) :
    ZMod.val (-(q : ZMod d)⁻¹ * ((k_val * (↑(w * v) : ZMod d).val : ℕ) : ZMod d)) =
    k_val * (↑v : ZMod d).val % d

name: PerUnitMerge.tail_sum_le
statement:
lemma tail_sum_le (n d : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hd_pos : 0 < d) (hd_le : d ≤ n)
    (b : ℕ) (hb_pos : 1 ≤ b) (hb_lt : b < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n / (2 * d)),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ((d : ℝ) - b + ((j : ℝ) + 1) * d)) ≤
    (1 + Real.log ↑n) / (2 * ↑d)

name: PerUnitMerge.tail_sum_le_log_div
statement:
lemma tail_sum_le_log_div

lemma average_S_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)

    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq : mq = (2 * q - 1).toNat) :
    ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
        if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
        else 0) ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) * (6 * (1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d)

name: crt_exponent_eq
statement:
lemma crt_exponent_eq {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} [hn₁ : NeZero n₁] [hn₂ : NeZero n₂]
    (h : Nat.Coprime n₁ n₂) (j : ℤ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑j / ↑(n₁ * n₂) =
      (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑((j : ZMod n₁) * (↑n₂ : ZMod n₁)⁻¹).val / ↑n₁ +
       2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑((j : ZMod n₂) * (↑n₁ : ZMod n₂)⁻¹).val / ↑n₂) +
      ↑m * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)

name: crt_proj_fst
statement:
lemma crt_proj_fst {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} [_hn₁ : NeZero n₁] [_hn₂ : NeZero n₂]
    (h : Nat.Coprime n₁ n₂) (a₁ : (ZMod n₁)ˣ) (a₂ : (ZMod n₂)ˣ) (t : ℤ) :
    let e := (Units.mapEquiv (ZMod.chineseRemainder h).toMulEquiv).toEquiv.trans
      MulEquiv.prodUnits.toEquiv
    (ZMod.chineseRemainder h ((e.symm (a₁, a₂)).val * (t : ZMod (n₁ * n₂)))).1 =
      a₁.val * (t : ZMod n₁)

    (ZMod.chineseRemainder h ((e.symm (a₁, a₂)).val * (t : ZMod (n₁ * n₂)))).2 =
      a₂.val * (t : ZMod n₂)

name: double_sum_bad_set_construction
statement:
lemma double_sum_bad_set_construction
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2) :
    let P := largestPrimeFactor n
    let d := P ^ n.factorization P
    let R := ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊
    ∃ B : Finset ℕ, B.card ≤ d / R ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ¬ ((P : ℤ) ∣ p) →
        1 ≤ p →
        (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2 →
        (p % (d : ℕ)).toNat ∉ B →
        (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
          if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧
             ((largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℤ)) ∣
               (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) k‖ *
               ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l‖
          else (0 : ℝ)) ≤
          7 * R * (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (P : ℝ)

name: double_sum_split_k0_kneq0
statement:
lemma double_sum_split_k0_kneq0
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (mp mq : ℕ)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧ ((d : ℤ)) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) k‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ)) =
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if l ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) (0 : ZMod n)‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ)) +
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) k‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ))

           ((largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℤ)) ∣

name: error_bound_with_bad_set
statement:
lemma error_bound_with_bad_set (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (_hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (_hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hP : (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ)
    (h_small : (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ < η ^ 2 / 100)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1) :
    ∃ B : Finset ℕ, B.card ≤
      largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ¬ ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) ∣ p) →
        (p, q) ∈ truncatedObtuseRegion n η →
        (p % (largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℕ)).toNat ∉ B →
        |(countingFunctionS n p q : ℝ) -
          (2 * ↑p - 1) * (2 * ↑q - 1) * (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2| <
        η ^ 2 / 10 * (Nat.totient n : ℝ)

      ((2 * p - 1).toNat : ℂ) * ((2 * q - 1).toNat : ℂ) *

name: error_split_bound
statement:
lemma error_split_bound
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2) :
    ∃ B : Finset ℕ, B.card ≤
      largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ¬ ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) ∣ p) →
        1 ≤ p →
        (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2 →
        (p % (largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℕ)).toNat ∉ B →
        |(countingFunctionS n p q : ℝ) -
          ((2 * p - 1).toNat : ℝ) * ((2 * q - 1).toNat : ℝ) *
          (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2| ≤
        (Nat.totient n : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 /
          ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) - 1) +
        7 * ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ * (Nat.totient n : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ)

name: exceptional_set_construction_single_n
statement:
lemma exceptional_set_construction_single_n (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hP : (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ)
    (h_small : (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ < η ^ 2 / 100) :
    ∃ (E : Set (ℤ × ℤ)),
      E ⊆ truncatedObtuseRegion n η ∧
      E.Finite ∧
      (E.ncard : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ + 1 / Real.log n) ∧
      ∀ pq ∈ truncatedObtuseRegion n η,
        Int.gcd pq.2 (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1 →
        pq ∉ E →
        (η ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) * (Nat.totient n : ℝ) ≤
          (countingFunctionS n pq.1 pq.2 : ℝ)

name: factor_weight_from_double_sum
statement:
lemma factor_weight_from_double_sum
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (k : ZMod n) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
        else 0)) =
    (∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
        else 0)) /
    (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))

name: fiber_bwd_fwd
statement:
lemma fiber_bwd_fwd
    (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (α v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < α)
    [NeZero (p ^ α)]
    (s : ℕ) (_hs_lt : s < p ^ (α - v)) (hs_cop : Nat.Coprime s p)
    (u : (ZMod (p ^ α))ˣ)
    (hu : (u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % p ^ (α - v) = s) :
    let idx := ((u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val - s) / p ^ (α - v)
    let a := s + idx * p ^ (α - v)
    let hcop := fiber_element_coprime p hp α v hv_lt s hs_cop idx
    ZMod.unitOfCoprime a hcop = u

lemma fiber_grouping_step
    (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (α : ℕ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)

name: fourier_markov_bad_set
statement:
lemma fourier_markov_bad_set
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2) :
    ∃ B : Finset ℕ, B.card ≤
      largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ¬ ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) ∣ p) →
        1 ≤ p →
        (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2 →
        (p % (largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℕ)).toNat ∉ B →
        |(countingFunctionS n p q : ℝ) -
          (2 * ↑p - 1) * (2 * ↑q - 1) * (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2| ≤
        9 * ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ * (Nat.totient n : ℝ) *
          (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ)

    ∃ B : Finset ℕ, B.card ≤
      largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊ ∧
      ∀ p : ℤ, ¬ ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) ∣ p) →
        (p, q) ∈ truncatedObtuseRegion n η →
        (p % (largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℕ)).toNat ∉ B →

name: good_p_double_sum_bound
statement:
lemma good_p_double_sum_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n))
    (p q : ℤ)
    (hp_pos : 1 ≤ p) (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hp_coprime : ¬ ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) ∣ p))
    (u_val : ℕ)
    (hu_congr : (p : ZMod d) = (u_val : ZMod d)) :
    let P := largestPrimeFactor n
    let R := ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊
    let mp := (2 * p - 1).toNat
    let mq := (2 * q - 1).toNat
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑u_val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
           (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
      else 0) ≤ 6 * ↑R * (1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d →
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧
         ((d : ℤ)) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) k‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ)) ≤
      7 * ↑R * (1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / (P : ℝ)

name: k_nonzero_contribution_bound
statement:
lemma k_nonzero_contribution_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (_hd : d = largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n))
    (p q : ℤ) (hp_pos : 1 ≤ p) (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (u_val : ℕ)
    (hu_congr : (p : ZMod d) = (u_val : ZMod d)) :
    let mp := (2 * p - 1).toNat
    let mq := (2 * q - 1).toNat
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) k‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ)) ≤
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑u_val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
           (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
      else 0)

name: k_sum_split_by_d_divisibility
statement:
lemma k_sum_split_by_d_divisibility
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    ∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
        else 0) =
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ ¬((d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k)),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0)) +
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0))

name: k_zero_contribution_bound
statement:
lemma k_zero_contribution_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n))
    (p q : ℤ) (hp_pos : 1 ≤ p) (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1) :
    let mp := (2 * p - 1).toNat
    let mq := (2 * q - 1).toNat
    (∑ l : ZMod n,
      if l ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
      then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) (0 : ZMod n)‖ *
           ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
      else (0 : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 + Real.log ↑n) / ↑d

lemma kval_mul_unit_mod_eq_pv_mul

               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))

    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) * ((1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d)

lemma nonmultiple_d_weighted_bound
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n))
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq : mq = (2 * q - 1).toNat) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ ¬((d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k)),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0)) ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) * (5 * (1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d)

statement:
lemma nonzero_sum_eq_EP0_plus_EPalpha
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p q : ℤ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2) :
    (∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ l : ZMod n,
      if ¬(k = 0 ∧ l = 0)

           normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l *
           ramanujanSum n (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)

    errorTermEP0 n p q + errorTermEPalpha n p q

              (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k_val * (u : ZMod d).val % d : ℕ))) ≤

name: orbit_fiber_sum_eq

lemma orbit_fiber_sum_eq

    [NeZero (p ^ (α - v))] :

              (((d : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k_val * (u : ZMod d).val % d : ℕ))) =
    (∑ t : (ZMod (p ^ (α - v)))ˣ,
      1 / min (((t : ZMod (p ^ (α - v))).val : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: ramanujanSum_absorb_inv
statement:
lemma ramanujanSum_absorb_inv {n m : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hc : Nat.Coprime m n) (s : ZMod n) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod n)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar (a.val * ((m : ZMod n)⁻¹ * s)) =

name: ramanujanSum_crt_decomp
statement:
lemma ramanujanSum_crt_decomp {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} [hn₁ : NeZero n₁] [hn₂ : NeZero n₂]
    (h : Nat.Coprime n₁ n₂) (t : ℤ) :
    ∑ a : (ZMod (n₁ * n₂))ˣ,
      @ZMod.stdAddChar (n₁ * n₂) ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero hn₁.ne hn₂.ne⟩
        (a.val * (t : ZMod (n₁ * n₂))) =
    ∑ ab : (ZMod n₁)ˣ × (ZMod n₂)ˣ,
      ZMod.stdAddChar (ab.1.val * ((n₂ : ZMod n₁)⁻¹ * (t : ZMod n₁))) *
      ZMod.stdAddChar (ab.2.val * ((n₁ : ZMod n₂)⁻¹ * (t : ZMod n₂)))

name: ramanujanSum_multiplicative
statement:
theorem ramanujanSum_multiplicative {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} [hn₁ : NeZero n₁] [hn₂ : NeZero n₂]
    (h : Nat.Coprime n₁ n₂) (t : ℤ) :
    @ramanujanSum (n₁ * n₂) ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero hn₁.ne hn₂.ne⟩ t =
    ramanujanSum n₁ t * ramanujanSum n₂ t

name: ramanujanSum_prime_pow_decomp
statement:
lemma ramanujanSum_prime_pow_decomp {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (t : ℤ) :
    @ramanujanSum (p ^ k) ⟨pow_ne_zero k hp.out.ne_zero⟩ t =
    (∑ a : ZMod (p ^ k), ZMod.stdAddChar (a * (t : ZMod (p ^ k)))) -
    (∑ b : ZMod (p ^ (k - 1)), ZMod.stdAddChar (b * (t : ZMod (p ^ (k - 1)))))

name: ratio_bound_from_three_lemmas
statement:
lemma ratio_bound_from_three_lemmas (c C : ℝ) (N₁ N₂ : ℕ) (η θ : ℝ)
    (hc_pos : 0 < c) (hC_pos : 0 < C)
    (h_lower : ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n → c * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ((truncatedObtuseRegion n η).ncard : ℝ))
    (h_upper : ∀ n : ℕ, N₂ ≤ n → (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ →
      ((badPairsSet n η).ncard : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ + 1 / Real.log n))
    (_hη_pos : 0 < η) (_hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n →
        (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ →

name: re_complex_lhs_eq_real_lhs

    (countingFunctionS n p q : ℝ) -

name: rectangle_coprime_ncard_lower_bound
statement:
lemma rectangle_coprime_ncard_lower_bound (η : ℝ) (hη_pos : 0 < η) (hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (N₁ : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n →
      c * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        ({pq : ℤ × ℤ |
          (⌈η * (n : ℝ)⌉ : ℤ) ≤ pq.1 ∧ pq.1 ≤ (⌊(n : ℝ) / 6⌋ : ℤ) ∧
          (⌈η * (n : ℝ)⌉ : ℤ) ≤ pq.2 ∧ pq.2 ≤ (⌊(n : ℝ) / 6⌋ : ℤ) ∧

name: rectangle_coprime_subset_target
statement:
lemma rectangle_coprime_subset_target (n : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :

name: reindex_multiples_of_d
statement:
lemma reindex_multiples_of_d (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (hd_pos : 0 < d) :
    let N := n / d
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k)) =
    (1 / (d : ℝ)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N - 1),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (j : ℝ) ((N : ℝ) - j))

name: residueBadPairs_ncard_bound
statement:
lemma residueBadPairs_ncard_bound (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hP : (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ)
    (h_small : (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ < η ^ 2 / 100) :
    ((residueBadPairs n η).ncard : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / Real.log n

name: residueBadPairs_ncard_from_fibers
statement:
lemma residueBadPairs_ncard_from_fibers (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (_hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (_hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (_hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (_hP : (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≥ (n : ℝ) ^ θ)
    (_h_small : (1 + Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3 / (n : ℝ) ^ θ < η ^ 2 / 100)
    (hfiber : ∀ q : ℤ, {p : ℤ | (p, q) ∈ residueBadPairs n η}.ncard ≤
      (largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊) *
      (n / (2 * largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n)) + 1)) :
    (residueBadPairs n η).ncard ≤
      n / 2 *
      ((largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) /
        ⌈Real.log (n : ℝ)⌉₊) *
      (n / (2 * largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n)) + 1))

name: residueBadPairs_ncard_le
statement:
lemma residueBadPairs_ncard_le (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (hη_lt : η < 1 / 6) (hθ_pos : 0 < θ) (hθ_lt : θ < 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)

name: residueBadPairs_ncard_le_nat
statement:
lemma residueBadPairs_ncard_le_nat (η : ℝ) (θ : ℝ)

name: restricted_fourier_mass_le
statement:
lemma restricted_fourier_mass_le
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)

name: simplify_u_sum_when_d_dvd_k
statement:
lemma simplify_u_sum_when_d_dvd_k
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ) (k : ZMod n)
    (hdk : (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k)
    (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1) :
    (∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
        else 0)) =
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) *
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ ↑(ZMod.val l))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
        else 0)

name: snd_lt_half_of_mem_truncatedObtuseRegion'
statement:
lemma snd_lt_half_of_mem_truncatedObtuseRegion' (n : ℕ) (η : ℝ)

name: split_nonzero_by_divisibility
statement:
lemma split_nonzero_by_divisibility
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0), ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
        else 0) =
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ ¬((d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k)),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0)) +
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0))

name: summand_eq_EP0_plus_EPalpha
statement:
lemma summand_eq_EP0_plus_EPalpha
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p q : ℤ) (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (_hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (_hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (k l : ZMod n) :
    (if ¬(k = 0 ∧ l = 0)
     then normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) k *
          normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l *
          ramanujanSum n (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
     else 0 : ℂ) =
    (let P := largestPrimeFactor n
     let alpha := n.factorization P
     let P0 := P ^ (alpha - 1)
     let d := P ^ alpha
     let fp := intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat
     let fq := intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat
     (if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧
         (P0 : ℤ) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q) ∧
         ¬((d : ℤ) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q))
      then normalizedDFT n fp k * normalizedDFT n fq l *
           ramanujanSum n (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      else 0) +
     (if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧
         (d : ℤ) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      then normalizedDFT n fp k * normalizedDFT n fq l *
           ramanujanSum n (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      else 0))

name: summand_eq_via_bwd
statement:
lemma summand_eq_via_bwd (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (_hd_pos : 0 < d)
    (k : ZMod n) (hk : k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k)) :
    let N := n / d
    let j := ZMod.val k / d
    (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k)) =
    (1 / (d : ℝ)) * ((1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (j : ℝ) ((N : ℝ) - j)))

name: summand_le
statement:
lemma summand_le (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p q : ℤ) (hp_pos : 1 ≤ p) (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (u_val : ℕ) (hu_congr : (p : ZMod d) = (u_val : ZMod d))
    (k l : ZMod n) :
    let mp := (2 * p - 1).toNat
    let mq := (2 * q - 1).toNat
    (if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
     then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mp) k‖ *
          ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
     else (0 : ℝ)) ≤
    (if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑u_val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
     then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
          (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
     else 0)

name: summand_norm_bound
statement:
lemma summand_norm_bound
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p q : ℤ)
    (k l : ZMod n) :
    ‖(if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧
         (↑(largestPrimeFactor n ^ (n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) - 1)) : ℤ) ∣
           (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q) ∧
         ¬((↑(largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n)) : ℤ) ∣
           (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
       then normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) k *
            normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l *
            ramanujanSum n (↑(ZMod.val k) * p + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q)
       else 0 : ℂ)‖ ≤
    (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / ((largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) - 1) *
    (‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) k‖ *
     ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l‖)

name: summand_norm_le
statement:
lemma summand_norm_le (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (p q : ℤ)
    (k l : ZMod n) :
    let P := largestPrimeFactor n
    let alpha := n.factorization P
    let d := P ^ alpha
    let fp := intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat
    let fq := intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat
    ‖(if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧ (d : ℤ) ∣ (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      then normalizedDFT n fp k * normalizedDFT n fq l *
           ramanujanSum n (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
      else 0)‖ ≤
    (Nat.totient n : ℝ) *
    (if (k, l) ≠ (0, 0) ∧ ((largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n) : ℤ)) ∣
         (ZMod.val k * p + ZMod.val l * q)
     then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) k‖ *
          ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) l‖
     else 0)

name: summand_norm_le_aux
statement:
lemma summand_norm_le_aux (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_p _q : ℤ) (k l : ZMod n)
    (fp fq : ZMod n → ℂ) (t : ℤ)
    (cond : Prop) [Decidable cond] :
    ‖(if cond then normalizedDFT n fp k * normalizedDFT n fq l * ramanujanSum n t
      else 0)‖ ≤
    (Nat.totient n : ℝ) *
    (if cond then ‖normalizedDFT n fp k‖ * ‖normalizedDFT n fq l‖ else 0)

name: summand_reindex
statement:
lemma summand_reindex (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (m : ℕ) (hm2 : m < n) (k : ZMod n) :
    ∑ j : ZMod n, (if j ∈ intervalSet n m then ZMod.stdAddChar (-(j * k)) else 0) =
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.range m, ZMod.stdAddChar (-((t + 1 : ZMod n) * k))

name: summand_rewrite
statement:
lemma summand_rewrite
    (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (α : ℕ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (k_val : ℕ) (hk_nd : ¬((p ^ α : ℕ) ∣ k_val)) (hk_dvd_p : p ∣ k_val)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_pos : 1 ≤ v) (hv_lt : v < α)
    (hv_val : p ^ v ∣ k_val) (hv_max : ¬(p ^ (v + 1) ∣ k_val))
    [NeZero (p ^ α)] [NeZero (p ^ (α - v))] :
    (∑ u : (ZMod (p ^ α))ˣ,
      1 / min ((k_val * (u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % (p ^ α) : ℕ) : ℝ)
              (((p ^ α : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k_val * (u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % (p ^ α) : ℕ))) =
    (∑ u : (ZMod (p ^ α))ˣ,
      1 / (((p ^ v : ℕ) : ℝ) * min (((k_val / p ^ v) * ((u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % p ^ (α - v)) % p ^
        (α - v) : ℕ) : ℝ)
              (((p ^ (α - v) : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((k_val / p ^ v) * ((u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % p ^ (α -
                v)) % p ^ (α - v) : ℕ))))

name: symmetric_harmonic_sum_le_log
statement:
lemma symmetric_harmonic_sum_le_log (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1),

name: symmetric_sum_even
statement:
lemma symmetric_sum_even (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (2 * N - 1),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (t : ℝ) ((2 * N : ℝ) - t)) =
    (∑ u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N - 1), (u : ℝ)⁻¹) + 1 / (2 * N)

name: symmetric_sum_le_one_plus_log
statement:
lemma symmetric_sum_le_one_plus_log (n d : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n) (_hd_pos : 0 < d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n / d - 1),
      (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (j : ℝ) ((↑(n / d) : ℝ) - j)) ≤ 1 + Real.log n

name: symmetric_sum_odd
statement:
lemma symmetric_sum_odd (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

    ∑ u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (u : ℝ)⁻¹

name: telescoping_log_sum
