name: triple_sum_bound_via_factoring
statement:
lemma triple_sum_bound_via_factoring
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hd : d = largestPrimeFactor n ^ n.factorization (largestPrimeFactor n))
    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (_hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (_hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (mq : ℕ) (_hmq : mq = (2 * q - 1).toNat)
    (hmq1 : 1 ≤ mq) (hmq2 : mq < n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0)) ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) * ((1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d)

name: triple_sum_eq_card_times_product
statement:
lemma triple_sum_eq_card_times_product
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (_hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ)
    (hq_coprime_d : Int.gcd q (d : ℤ) = 1)
    (_hd_dvd : d ∣ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
      ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
        (∑ l : ZMod n,
          if ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
          then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
               (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
          else 0)) ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) *
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if ((d : ℤ) ∣ ↑(ZMod.val l))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖
        else 0) *
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k : ZMod n => k ≠ 0 ∧ (d : ℕ) ∣ ZMod.val k),
        (1 : ℝ) / (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k)))

name: unitProjection_filter_iff
statement:
lemma unitProjection_filter_iff
    (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (α : ℕ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (v : ℕ) (hv_lt : v < α)
    [NeZero (p ^ (α - v))]
    (u : (ZMod (p ^ α))ˣ) (t : (ZMod (p ^ (α - v)))ˣ) :
    ZMod.unitOfCoprime
      ((u : ZMod (p ^ α)).val % p ^ (α - v))
      (unit_mod_coprime_pow p hp α hα v hv_lt u) = t ↔

name: weighted_orbit_total
statement:
lemma weighted_orbit_total
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hn : 2 ≤ n)

    (q : ℤ) (hq_coprime : Int.gcd q (largestPrimeFactor n : ℤ) = 1)
    (hq_pos : 1 ≤ q) (hq_bound : (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2)
    (mq : ℕ) (hmq : mq = (2 * q - 1).toNat) :
    ∑ k : ZMod n, ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if k ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val k) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val + ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val k : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val k))
        else 0) ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card (ZMod d)ˣ) * (6 * (1 + Real.log ↑n) ^ 2 / ↑d)

name: zero_term_vanishes
statement:
lemma zero_term_vanishes
    (n d : ℕ) [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (mq : ℕ) (q : ℤ) :
    ∑ u : (ZMod d)ˣ,
      (∑ l : ZMod n,
        if (0 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 ∧ ((d : ℤ) ∣ (↑(ZMod.val (0 : ZMod n)) * ↑(u : ZMod d).val +
          ↑(ZMod.val l) * q))
        then ‖normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n mq) l‖ /
             (2 * min (ZMod.val (0 : ZMod n) : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) - ZMod.val (0 : ZMod n)))
        else 0) = 0

name: zero_zero_term_eq_main
statement:
lemma zero_zero_term_eq_main
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p q : ℤ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / 2) :
    normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * p - 1).toNat) 0 *
    normalizedDFT n (intervalIndicator n (2 * q - 1).toNat) 0 *
    ramanujanSum n (↑(ZMod.val (0 : ZMod n)) * p + ↑(ZMod.val (0 : ZMod n)) * q) =
    ((2 * p - 1).toNat : ℂ) * ((2 * q - 1).toNat : ℂ) *
      (Nat.totient n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ 2

statement:
lemma bounds_of_continuousOn_unitCircle_closedUnitDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : ℂ → E} {k : ℂ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (closedBall 0 1)) (hk : ContinuousOn k (sphere 0 1)) :
    ‖k (exp (t * I)) • f (r * exp (t * I))‖ ≤
    sSup ((fun ζ ↦ |k ζ|) '' sphere 0 1) * sSup ((fun w ↦ ‖f w‖) '' closedBall 0 1)

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.cauchy_circleIntegral_formula_on_scaled_unitDisc
statement:
lemma cauchy_circleIntegral_formula_on_scaled_unitDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : AnalyticOn ℂ f (ball 0 1)) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 1) :
    f (r * z) = (1 / (2 * π * I)) • ∮ (ζ : ℂ) in C(0, 1), (1 / (ζ - z)) • f (r * ζ)

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.cauchy_goursat_integral_scaled_unitDisc
statement:
lemma cauchy_goursat_integral_scaled_unitDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : AnalyticOn ℂ f (ball 0 1)) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 1) :
    f (r * z) = (1 / (2 * π)) • ∫ t in 0..2 * π,
              (exp (t * I) / (exp (t * I) - z)) • f (r * exp (t * I)) +
              (star z / (star (exp (t * I)) - star z)) • f (r * exp (t * I))

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.cauchy_integral_formula_on_scaled_unitDisc

lemma cauchy_integral_formula_on_scaled_unitDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.poisson_formula_of_analyticOn_scaled_unitDisc
statement:
theorem poisson_formula_of_analyticOn_scaled_unitDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hf : AnalyticOn ℂ f (ball 0 1))
    (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 1) :
    f (r * z) = (1 / (2 * π)) • ∫ t in 0..2 * π,
      ((1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) / ‖exp (t * I) - z‖ ^ 2) • f (r * exp (t * I))

theorem poisson_integral_of_analyticOn_unitDisc_continuousOn_closedUnitDisc_re_kernel

lemma bounds_of_continuousOn_circle_closedDisc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

    ‖k (R * exp (t * I)) • f (r * R * exp (t * I))‖ ≤

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.cauchy_circleIntegral_formula_scaled_disc
statement:
lemma cauchy_circleIntegral_formula_scaled_disc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ} {r R : ℝ}
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 R)) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 R) :
    f (r * z) = (1 / (2 * π * I)) • ∮ (ζ : ℂ) in C(0, R), (1 / (ζ - z)) • f (r * ζ)

name: LeanPool.LeanComplexAnalysis.cauchy_goursat_integral_scaled_disc
statement:
lemma cauchy_goursat_integral_scaled_disc {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball 0 R)) (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) (hz : z ∈ ball 0 R) :
    f (r * z) = (1 / (2 * π)) • ∫ t in 0..2 * π,
              (R * exp (t * I) / (R * exp (t * I) - z)) • f (r * R * exp (t * I)) +
              (star z / (R * star (exp (t * I)) - star z)) • f (r * R* exp (t * I))

  {S}

  {w : ℕ → S}
  (G₁ : RunDAG M₁ w) (G₂ : RunDAG M₂ w)
  (delta_eq_1 : ∀ (q : Iic φ₁) i,
      M.δ (q.embedLe leφ₁) (w i) = (M₁.δ q (w i)).mapSubtypeImp (fun _ q => q.trans leφ₁))
  (delta_eq_2 : ∀ (q : Iic φ₂) i,
      M.δ (q.embedLe leφ₂) (w i) = (M₂.δ q (w i)).mapSubtypeImp (fun _ q => q.trans leφ₂))
  (delta_root : ∀ Y₁ Y₂, (M₁.δ M₁.q₀ (w 0)).Sat Y₁ → (M₂.δ M₂.q₀ (w 0)).Sat Y₂
      → (M.δ M.q₀ (w 0)).Sat (((Subtype.embedLe leφ₁) '' Y₁) ∪ ((Subtype.embedLe leφ₂) '' Y₂))) :
    ∀ v ∈ (dag leφ₁ leφ₂ M₁.q₀ M₂.q₀ M.q₀ G₁.toDAG G₂.toDAG).V,
      let (q, i) := v
      ∃ Y, PositiveBool.Sat Y (M.δ q (w i)) ∧
        {(q, i)} ×ˢ Y ⊆ (dag leφ₁ leφ₂ M₁.q₀ M₂.q₀ M.q₀ G₁.toDAG G₂.toDAG).E

name: LeanPolyABC.Polynomial.flt_catalan
statement:
theorem flt_catalan
    {p q r : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hineq : q * r + r * p + p * q ≤ p * q * r)
    (chp : ¬ringChar k ∣ p) (chq : ¬ringChar k ∣ q) (chr : ¬ringChar k ∣ r)
    {a b c : k[X]} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b)
    {u v w : k} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (heq : C u * a ^ p + C v * b ^ q + C w * c ^ r = 0) :
    a.natDegree = 0 ∧ b.natDegree = 0 ∧ c.natDegree = 0

    (chp : ¬ringChar k ∣ p) (chq : ¬ringChar k ∣ q) (chr : ¬ringChar k ∣ r)
    {a b c : k[X]} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hab : IsCoprime a b)
    {u v w : k} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (heq : C u * a ^ p + C v * b ^ q + C w * c ^ r = 0) :

name: LeanPolyABC.calcstep
statement:
theorem calcstep {n N m M : k[X]} (nz_M : M ≠ 0) (nz_N : N ≠ 0)
    (eqn :
      (algebraMap _ (RatFunc k)) n ^ 2 / (algebraMap _ (RatFunc k)) N ^ 2 =
        (algebraMap _ (RatFunc k)) m ^ 3 / (algebraMap _ (RatFunc k)) M ^ 3 + 1) :
    n ^ 2 * M ^ 3 = (m ^ 3 + M ^ 3) * N ^ 2

name: LeanPolyABC.calcstep2
statement:
theorem calcstep2 {m M n N : k[X]} (nz_M : M ≠ 0) (nz_N : N ≠ 0) (cp_mM : IsCoprime m M)
    (cp_nN : IsCoprime n N) (_nz_m : m ≠ 0) (_nz_n : n ≠ 0)
    (flat_eqn : n ^ 2 * M ^ 3 = (m ^ 3 + M ^ 3) * N ^ 2) :
    ∃ (w : k[X]) (u v : k[X]ˣ),
      w ≠ 0 ∧
        ↑u * w ^ 2 = M ∧
          ↑v * w ^ 3 = N ∧
            IsCoprime m w ∧ (↑u) ^ 3 * n ^ 2 = (↑v) ^ 2 * m ^ 3 + (↑v) ^ 2 * (↑u) ^ 3 * w ^ 6

name: QuantumAlg.teleportation_correct
statement:
theorem teleportation_correct (α β : ℂ) :
    teleportBellMeasure.applyVec
        (StateVector.tensor (teleportInput α β) (bell : StateVector 2))
      = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        (StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1) (ket0 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate false false).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1) (ket1 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate false true).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket1 : StateVector 1) (ket0 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate true false).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket1 : StateVector 1) (ket1 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate true true).applyVec (teleportInput α β)))
    ∧ ∀ a b : Bool,
        (teleportCorrection a b).applyVec
            ((teleportBranchGate a b).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
          = teleportInput α β

        (StateVector.tensor

          ((teleportBranchGate false false).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1) (ket1 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate false true).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor
          (StateVector.tensor (ket1 : StateVector 1) (ket0 : StateVector 1))
          ((teleportBranchGate true false).applyVec (teleportInput α β))
        + StateVector.tensor

name: QuantumAlg.teleportation_premeasurement_basis

    teleportBellMeasure.applyVec
        (StateVector.tensor (teleportInput α β) (bell : StateVector 2))
      = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
        ((α • teleKet3 0) + (β • teleKet3 1)
          + (β • teleKet3 2) + (α • teleKet3 3)
          + (α • teleKet3 4) - (β • teleKet3 5)
          - (β • teleKet3 6) + (α • teleKet3 7))

name: QuantumAlg.TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main

theorem TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main (U : Gate n) (u : PureState n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hu : U.applyVec (u : StateVector n) =
      Complex.exp ((θ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • (u : StateVector n))
    (φ θ₀ φ₀ : ℝ) (ps : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (ψ : StateVector 1) :
    (qppYZZYZ U φ θ₀ φ₀ ps).applyVec
        (StateVector.tensor ψ (u : StateVector n))
      = StateVector.tensor
          ((Complex.exp ((θ / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I)) ^ ps.length
            • (qspYZZYZ φ θ₀ φ₀ ps θ).applyVec ψ)
          (u : StateVector n)

name: QuantumAlg.TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main_eigenstate_reduction
statement:
theorem TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main_eigenstate_reduction
    (U : Gate n) (u : PureState n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hu : U.applyVec (u : StateVector n) =
      Complex.exp ((θ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • (u : StateVector n)) (ψ : PureState 1) :
    (Gate.controlled U).applyVec
        (StateVector.tensor (ψ : StateVector 1) (u : StateVector n))
      = StateVector.tensor
          (Complex.exp ((θ / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I) •
            (rotZStd θ).applyVec (ψ : StateVector 1))
          (u : StateVector n)

name: QuantumAlg.TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main_realizes_target
statement:
theorem TransformationOnControlledUnitary.main_realizes_target
    (U : Gate n) (u : PureState n) (θ : ℝ)
    (hu : U.applyVec (u : StateVector n) =
      Complex.exp ((θ : ℝ) * Complex.I) • (u : StateVector n))
    (L : ℕ) (A B : Polynomial ℂ) (h : IsYZPair L A B) :
    ∃ (φ θ₀ φ₀ : ℝ) (ps : List (ℝ × ℝ)), ps.length = L ∧ ∀ ψ : PureState 1,
      (qppYZZYZ U φ θ₀ φ₀ ps).applyVec
          (StateVector.tensor (ψ : StateVector 1) (u : StateVector n))
        = StateVector.tensor
            ((Complex.exp ((θ / 2 : ℝ) * Complex.I)) ^ L
              • HilbertOperator.applyVec (qspMatYZ L A B θ) (ψ : StateVector 1))
            (u : StateVector n)

statement:

name: QuantumAlg.HadamardTest.main
statement:
theorem HadamardTest.main {U : Gate n} (psi : PureState n) :
    probQubit0 ((hadamardTest U).apply (ket0.tensor psi)) 0
      = (1 + (inner ℂ psi (U.apply psi)).re) / 2

name: QuantumAlg.hadamardTest_applyVec_ket0_tensor
statement:
theorem hadamardTest_applyVec_ket0_tensor (U : Gate n) (psi : PureState n) :
    HilbertOperator.applyVec (hadamardTest U : HilbertOperator (1 + n))
        (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1) (psi : StateVector n))
      =
        (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
          (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1)
              (psi + U.apply psi : StateVector n)
            + StateVector.tensor (ket1 : StateVector 1)
              (psi - U.apply psi : StateVector n))

name: QuantumAlg.hadamardTest_apply_ket0_tensor
statement:
theorem hadamardTest_apply_ket0_tensor (U : Gate n) (psi : PureState n) :
    ((hadamardTest U).apply (ket0.tensor psi) : StateVector (1 + n))
      =
        (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ •
          (StateVector.tensor (ket0 : StateVector 1)
              (psi + U.apply psi : StateVector n)
            + StateVector.tensor (ket1 : StateVector 1)
              (psi - U.apply psi : StateVector n))

name: QuantumAlg.hadamardTest_probQubit0_one

      = (1 - (inner ℂ psi (U.apply psi)).re) / 2

name: QuantumAlg.LinearCombinationOfUnitaries.main
statement:
theorem LinearCombinationOfUnitaries.main (V : Gate a) (U : Fin (2 ^ a) → Gate n)
    (alpha : Fin (2 ^ a) → ℝ) (halpha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ alpha i) (hlam : 0 < lcuNorm alpha)
    (hV : ∀ i, V i 0 = ((Real.sqrt (alpha i / lcuNorm alpha) : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (s t : Fin (2 ^ n)) :
    lcuWalk V U (prodEquiv (0, s)) (prodEquiv (0, t))
      = ((lcuNorm alpha : ℂ))⁻¹ * ∑ i, ((alpha i : ℝ) : ℂ) * U i s t

name: QuantumAlg.lcuWalk_eq_sum
statement:
theorem lcuWalk_eq_sum (V : Gate a) (U : Fin (2 ^ a) → Gate n) :
    lcuWalk V U
      = ∑ i, HilbertOperator.tensor
          ((V.conjTranspose : HilbertOperator a) * lcuProj i * (V : HilbertOperator a))
          (U i : HilbertOperator n)

name: QuantumAlg.trig_parameter_shift
statement:
theorem trig_parameter_shift (a b c θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => a + b * Real.cos t + c * Real.sin t) θ
      = ((a + b * Real.cos (θ + Real.pi / 2) + c * Real.sin (θ + Real.pi / 2))
          - (a + b * Real.cos (θ - Real.pi / 2) + c * Real.sin (θ - Real.pi / 2))) / 2

name: QuantumAlg.ParamShiftModel.parameter_shift

name: QuantumAlg.expConcentratedProb_of_mean_le
statement:
theorem expConcentratedProb_of_mean_le {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Ω n)]
    (μ : (n : ℕ) → Measure (Ω n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (X : (n : ℕ) → Ω n → ℝ) (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (X n) 2 (μ n))

        ∧ (densityOf (φ i)).PosSemidef)
    ∧ ∀ i j, (densityOf (φ i) * densityOf (φ j)).trace
        = ((((r : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ : ℂ)) ^ 2
          * (((1 + r : ℕ) : ℂ) + 2 * (∑ k, starRingEnd ℂ (φ i k) * φ j k).re)

name: QuantumAlg.fourier_representation
statement:
theorem fourier_representation (W : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (lam : Fin d → ℝ) (ψ : Fin d → ℂ) (x x' : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (Complex.normSq
      (∑ m, (starRingEnd ℂ) (featState W lam ψ N x' m) * featState W lam ψ N x m) : ℂ)
      = ∑ ω ∈ (kernelES W lam ψ).freqs,
          (kernelES W lam ψ).coeff ω
            * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (freqDot ω (Fin.append x x') : ℂ))

    (hmain_bound :

        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0)))
    (hrhs_bound :

        ‖weakRadialRhsCoeff phi x‖ ≤ Crhs) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0,

theorem ballIntegralRadiusDerivativeFormula_of_dominated_approx
    {n : ℕ}
    {f : Domain n → ℝ} {R0 : ℝ}
    {c : ℝ → ℝ} {cSeq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    {boundLeft : Domain n → ℝ} {boundRight : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hleft_meas : ∀ N : ℕ,
      AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun x : Domain n => cSeq N ‖x‖ * f x)
        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0)))
    (hleft_bound_int :
      Integrable boundLeft (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0)))
    (hleft_bound : ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0),
        ‖cSeq N ‖x‖ * f x‖ ≤ boundLeft x)
    (hleft_lim :
      ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => cSeq N ‖x‖ * f x) Filter.atTop
          (𝓝 (c ‖x‖ * f x)))
    (hright_meas : ∀ N : ℕ,
      AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun rho : ℝ =>
          cSeq N rho *
            deriv (fun r : ℝ => ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho)
        (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0)))
    (hright_bound_int :
      Integrable boundRight (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0)))
    (hright_bound : ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∀ᵐ rho ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0),
        ‖cSeq N rho *
          deriv (fun r : ℝ => ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho‖
          ≤ boundRight rho)
    (hright_lim :
      ∀ᵐ rho ∂volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0),
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun N : ℕ =>
            cSeq N rho *
              deriv (fun r : ℝ => ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho)
          Filter.atTop
          (𝓝 (c rho *
            deriv (fun r : ℝ => ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho)))
    (hformula : ∀ N : ℕ,
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0, cSeq N ‖x‖ * f x)
        =
      (∫ rho in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0,
        cSeq N rho *
          deriv (fun r : ℝ => ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho)) :
    (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) R0, c ‖x‖ * f x)
      =
    (∫ rho in Ioo (0 : ℝ) R0,
      c rho * deriv (fun r : ℝ =>
        ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : Domain n) r, f x) rho)

    (hzero : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0 : ComplexEuclidean 1),
      (∀ i, f i x = 0) → g x = 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∃ h : Fin s → ComplexEuclidean 1 → ℂ,
        (∀ i, AnalyticAt ℂ (h i) 0) ∧
        (fun x ↦ g x ^ N) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
          fun x ↦ ∑ i, h i x * f i x

name: Lean4LPD.entryFactor_le
statement:
theorem entryFactor_le {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    {nu : ℕ} (hnu : 1 ≤ nu) (hb : betaOf kh1 c a ≤ 1 / 2) :
    entryFactor kh1 c a nu ≤ epsJump kh1 c a nu nu * (1 + 2 * betaOf kh1 c a)

name: Lean4LPD.entryFactor_le_geom
statement:
theorem entryFactor_le_geom {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    {nu : ℕ} (hnu : 1 ≤ nu) (hb1 : betaOf kh1 c a < 1) :
    entryFactor kh1 c a nu ≤ epsJump kh1 c a nu nu / (1 - betaOf kh1 c a)

name: Lean4LPD.epsJump_nonneg
statement:
lemma epsJump_nonneg {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (j nu : ℕ)
    (h : 1 ≤ nu + j) : 0 ≤ epsJump kh1 c a j nu

name: Lean4LPD.epsJump_ratio
statement:
theorem epsJump_ratio {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    {j nu : ℕ} (hnu : 1 ≤ nu) (hj : nu ≤ j) :
    epsJump kh1 c a (j + 1) nu ≤ betaOf kh1 c a * epsJump kh1 c a j nu

name: Lean4LPD.diagFactor_le
statement: theorem diagFactor_le (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) : diagFactor j ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (j - 1)

theorem sum_range_choose (m : ℕ) :

name: Lean4LPD.sum_range_choose_real
statement:
theorem sum_range_choose_real (m g : ℕ) :

name: Lean4LPD.MultiLadder.le_majorant
statement:
theorem le_majorant (L : MultiLadder eps E M) (heps : ∀ j m, 0 ≤ eps j m) :
    ∀ T : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → L.N m T ≤ majorant eps E M m T

name: Lean4LPD.MultiLadder.majorant_mono
statement:
lemma majorant_mono (heps : ∀ j m, 0 ≤ eps j m) (hE : ∀ m, 0 ≤ E m) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (m T : ℕ) :
    majorant eps E M m T ≤ majorant eps E M m (T + 1)

name: Lean4LPD.MultiLadder.sum_chain_shift
statement:
lemma sum_chain_shift (m T : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (T + 1), (T.choose k : ℝ) * chain eps E (k + 1) m
      = E m + ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, eps j m
          * ∑ k ∈ range (T + 1), (T.choose k : ℝ) * chain eps E k (m - j)

name: Lean4LPD.MultiLadder.sum_chain_succ
statement:
lemma sum_chain_succ (m T : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (T + 2), ((T + 1).choose k : ℝ) * chain eps E k m
      = (∑ k ∈ range (T + 1), (T.choose k : ℝ) * chain eps E k m)
        + ∑ k ∈ range (T + 1), (T.choose k : ℝ) * chain eps E (k + 1) m

name: Lean4LPD.chain_diag
statement:
lemma chain_diag :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → chain eps E m m = E 1 * ∏ i ∈ Ico 2 (m + 1), eps 1 i

name: Lean4LPD.chain_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: lemma chain_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ k m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m < k → chain eps E k m = 0

lemma chain_nonneg (heps : ∀ j m, 0 ≤ eps j m) (hE : ∀ m, 0 ≤ E m) :

name: Lean4LPD.chain_one
statement: @[simp] lemma chain_one (eps : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : chain eps E 1 m = E m

name: Lean4LPD.chain_succ_succ
statement:
lemma chain_succ_succ (eps : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (k m : ℕ) :
    chain eps E (k + 2) m = ∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, eps j m * chain eps E (k + 1) (m - j)

name: Lean4LPD.chain_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma chain_zero (eps : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : chain eps E 0 m = 0

name: Lean4LPD.Ladder.cumulation
statement:
theorem cumulation (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ∀ m g : ℕ, L.N m g ≤ (g.choose m : ℝ) * a ^ m * M

name: Lean4LPD.Ladder.step_iterate
statement:
lemma step_iterate {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∀ g : ℕ, L.N m g ≤ a * ∑ l ∈ range g, L.N (m - 1) l

name: Lean4LPD.WeightedLadder.cumulation
statement:
theorem cumulation (hc : ∀ j, 0 ≤ c j) :
    ∀ m g : ℕ, L.N m g ≤ (g.choose m : ℝ) * (∏ j ∈ Icc 1 m, c j) * M

name: Lean4LPD.WeightedLadder.step_iterate
statement:
lemma step_iterate {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∀ g : ℕ, L.N m g ≤ c m * ∑ l ∈ range g, L.N (m - 1) l

name: Lean4LPD.layer_cumulation
statement:
theorem layer_cumulation {M a : ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j)
    (L : WeightedLadder (fun m => w (m + 1) * a) M) (m g : ℕ) :
    L.N m g ≤ (g.choose m : ℝ) * a ^ m * (∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (m + 1), w j) * M

name: Lean4LPD.satLadder_cumulation_eq
statement:
lemma satLadder_cumulation_eq {c : ℕ → ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hc : ∀ j, 0 ≤ c j) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (m g : ℕ) :
    (satLadder hc hM).N m g = (g.choose m : ℝ) * (∏ j ∈ Icc 1 m, c j) * M

name: Lean4LPD.weighted_prod_eq
statement:
lemma weighted_prod_eq (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, (∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, w (j + 1) * a) = a ^ m * ∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (m + 1), w j

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauli_rotation_branch
statement:
theorem pauli_rotation_branch (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (s : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ) :
    rot (toMatrix G) θ * toMatrix s * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)
      = if sympForm G s = 0 then toMatrix s
        else (Real.cos θ : ℂ) • toMatrix s + (Complex.I * Real.sin θ) • toMatrix (G * s)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute
statement:
theorem pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G s = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    rot (toMatrix G) θ * toMatrix s * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)
      = (Real.cos θ : ℂ) • toMatrix s + (Complex.I * Real.sin θ) • toMatrix (G * s)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute_bounds
statement:
theorem pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute_bounds (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G s = 1)
    (hk : weight G ≤ kh) (θ : ℝ) :
    rot (toMatrix G) θ * toMatrix s * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)
        = (Real.cos θ : ℂ) • toMatrix s + (Complex.I * Real.sin θ) • toMatrix (G * s)
      ∧ weight s - (kh - 1) ≤ weight (G * s)
      ∧ weight (G * s) ≤ weight s + (kh - 1)
      ∧ ∀ c : ℂ, toMatrix (G * s) ≠ c • toMatrix s

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute_hermitian
statement:
theorem pauli_rotation_branch_anticommute_hermitian (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G)
    (h : sympForm G s = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    rot (toMatrix G) θ * toMatrix s * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)
      = (Real.cos θ : ℂ) • toMatrix s
        + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) • toMatrix (phaseMul 1 (G * s))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeff_conj
statement:
theorem coeff_conj (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ)
    (p : PauliIndex n) :
    coeff (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)) p
      = if sympForm G (herm p) = 0 then coeff O p
        else (Real.cos θ : ℂ) * coeff O p
          - (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * (partnerSign G p * coeff O (partner G p))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.conj_partnerSign
statement:
lemma conj_partnerSign (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G (herm p) = 1) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (partnerSign G p) = partnerSign G p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_conj_le
statement:
theorem highNorm_conj_le (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ)
    (T : Finset (PauliIndex n))
    (hT : ∀ q : PauliIndex n, w < wt q → sympForm G (herm q) = 1 → partner G q ∈ T) :
    highNorm w (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ))
      ≤ highNorm w O + |Real.sin θ| * ‖restr T (coeffVec O)‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_conj_le_highNorm
statement:
theorem highNorm_conj_le_highNorm (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (hk : weight G ≤ kh)
    (hw : w' + (kh - 1) ≤ w) (θ : ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm w (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ))
      ≤ highNorm w O + |Real.sin θ| * highNorm w' O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_conj_le_pauliNorm
statement:
theorem highNorm_conj_le_pauliNorm (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm w (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ))
      ≤ highNorm w O + |Real.sin θ| * pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_restr_le
statement:
theorem highNorm_restr_le (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    ‖restr (highSet n w) (restr S y)‖ ≤ ‖restr (highSet n w) y‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.ladderN_init
Lean4LPD.PauliString.ladderN_nonneg
statement:
lemma ladderN_nonneg (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ)
    (ko kh m g : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ladderN Gs θ O ko kh m g

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.local_flow_k_local
statement:
theorem local_flow_k_local {ko m : ℕ} (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (hk : weight G ≤ kh) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (θ : ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ))
      ≤ highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O
        + |Real.sin θ| * highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - 1)) O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.norm_partnerSign
statement:
lemma norm_partnerSign (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G (herm p) = 1) :
    ‖partnerSign G p‖ = 1

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.norm_restr_high_rotAct_low
statement:
lemma norm_restr_high_rotAct_low (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) (T : Finset (PauliIndex n))
    (hT : ∀ q : PauliIndex n, w < wt q → sympForm G (herm q) = 1 → partner G q ∈ T) :
    ‖restr (highSet n w) (rotAct G θ (restr (highSet n w)ᶜ y))‖
      ≤ |Real.sin θ| * ‖restr T y‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.norm_rotAct
statement:
theorem norm_rotAct (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    ‖rotAct G θ y‖ = ‖y‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.partnerSign_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
lemma partnerSign_eq_one_or_neg_one (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G (herm p) = 1) :
    partnerSign G p = 1 ∨ partnerSign G p = -1

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.partnerSign_mul_self
statement:
lemma partnerSign_mul_self (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G (herm p) = 1) :
    partnerSign G p * partnerSign G p = 1

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.partnerSign_partner
statement:
lemma partnerSign_partner (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (h : sympForm G (herm p) = 1) :
    partnerSign G (partner G p) = -partnerSign G p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.partner_injective
statement: lemma partner_injective (G : PauliString n) : Function.Injective (partner G)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.partner_partner
statement:
@[simp] lemma partner_partner (G : PauliString n) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    partner G (partner G p) = p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_conj
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_conj (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (rot (toMatrix G) θ * O * rot (toMatrix G) (-θ)) = pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_traj
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_traj {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n} (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) : pauliNorm (traj Gs θ O g) = pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rotAct_add
statement:
lemma rotAct_add (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ) (y z : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    rotAct G θ (y + z) = rotAct G θ y + rotAct G θ z

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rotAct_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rotAct_apply (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n))
    (p : PauliIndex n) :
    (rotAct G θ y).ofLp p
      = if sympForm G (herm p) = 0 then y.ofLp p
        else (Real.cos θ : ℂ) * y.ofLp p
          - (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * (partnerSign G p * y.ofLp (partner G p))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rungWeight_add_two
statement:
lemma rungWeight_add_two (ko kh m : ℕ) :
    rungWeight ko kh (m + 2) = rungWeight ko kh (m + 1) + (kh - 1)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sympForm_herm_partner
statement:
@[simp] lemma sympForm_herm_partner (G : PauliString n) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    sympForm G (herm (partner G p)) = sympForm G (herm p)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.toMatrix_partner
statement:
lemma toMatrix_partner (G : PauliString n) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    toMatrix (phaseMul 1 (G * herm p))
      = partnerSign G p • toMatrix (herm (partner G p))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.traj_succ
statement:
lemma traj_succ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) :
    traj Gs θ O (g + 1)
      = rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (θ g) * traj Gs θ O g * rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (-(θ g))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.traj_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma traj_zero (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) : traj Gs θ O 0 = O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.wt_partner
statement:
lemma wt_partner (G : PauliString n) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    wt (partner G p) = weight (G * herm p)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeffVec_truncOp
statement:
theorem coeffVec_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    coeffVec (truncOp S O) = restr S (coeffVec O)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeff_truncOp
statement:
theorem coeff_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ)
    (q : PauliIndex n) :
    coeff (truncOp S O) q = if q ∈ S then coeff O q else 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_conj_trajTrunc_le
statement:
theorem highNorm_conj_trajTrunc_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n} {θ : ℕ → ℝ}
    {S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)} {O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (hk : ∀ g, weight (Gs g) ≤ kh) (m g : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m)
        (rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (θ g) * trajTrunc Gs θ S O g * rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (-(θ g)))
      ≤ ladderNTrunc Gs θ S O ko kh m g
        + |Real.sin (θ g)| * ladderNTrunc Gs θ S O ko kh (m - 1) g

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_trajTrunc_succ
statement:
theorem highNorm_trajTrunc_succ (wstar : ℕ) (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) :
    highNorm wstar (trajTrunc Gs θ (fun _ => (highSet n wstar)ᶜ) O (g + 1)) = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_truncOp_compl
statement:
theorem highNorm_truncOp_compl (w : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm w (truncOp (highSet n w)ᶜ O) = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_truncOp_le
statement:
theorem highNorm_truncOp_le (w : ℕ) (S : Finset (PauliIndex n))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.ladderNTrunc_init
Lean4LPD.PauliString.ladderNTrunc_nonneg
statement:
lemma ladderNTrunc_nonneg (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)

Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_trajTrunc_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_trajTrunc_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n} (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_truncOp_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_truncOp_le (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sum_coeff_smul_toMatrix_herm
statement:
theorem sum_coeff_smul_toMatrix_herm (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trajTrunc_succ
statement:
lemma trajTrunc_succ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n))
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) :
    trajTrunc Gs θ S O (g + 1)
      = truncOp (S g)
          (rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (θ g) * trajTrunc Gs θ S O g
            * rot (toMatrix (Gs g)) (-(θ g)))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trajTrunc_univ
statement:
theorem trajTrunc_univ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trajTrunc_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma trajTrunc_zero (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)

theorem coeffVec_sub (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeffVec_sub_truncOp
statement:
theorem coeffVec_sub_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n))

statement:
theorem coeff_ext {A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ}

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeff_sub
statement:
theorem coeff_sub (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (p : PauliIndex n) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_sub_truncOp
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_sub_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_sub_truncOp_compl
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_sub_truncOp_compl (S : Finset (PauliIndex n))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_sub_truncOp_highSet_compl
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_sub_truncOp_highSet_compl (w : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (O - truncOp (highSet n w)ᶜ O) = highNorm w O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_truncOp
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (truncOp S O) = ‖restr S (coeffVec O)‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_truncOp_highSet
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_truncOp_highSet (w : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (truncOp (highSet n w) O) = highNorm w O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sub_truncOp
statement:
theorem sub_truncOp (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sub_truncOp_compl
statement:
theorem sub_truncOp_compl (S : Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.discardedStep_eq_boundary_sub
statement:
theorem discardedStep_eq_boundary_sub (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d =
      rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (θ (period - 1)) *
        trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d * period + (period - 1)) *
        rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (-(θ (period - 1))) -
      trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O ((d + 1) * period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.discardedStep_eq_truncOp
statement:
theorem discardedStep_eq_truncOp (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) :
    discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d = truncOp (highSet n wstar)
      (traj Gs θ (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O d) period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_trotterStepTraj_succ
statement:
theorem highNorm_trotterStepTraj_succ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) :
    highNorm wstar (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d + 1)) = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_discardedStep
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_discardedStep (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d) =
      highNorm wstar (traj Gs θ (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O d) period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_discardedStep_eq_boundary_highNorm
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_discardedStep_eq_boundary_highNorm (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d) = highNorm wstar
      (rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (θ (period - 1)) *
        trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d * period + (period - 1)) *
        rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (-(θ (period - 1))))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_discardedStep_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_discardedStep_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n} {θ : ℕ → ℝ}
    {period wstar ko kh m : ℕ} {O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (hk : ∀ g, weight (Gs g) ≤ kh)
    (hp : 0 < period) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hcut : wstar = rungWeight ko kh m) (d : ℕ) :
    let g := d * period + (period - 1)
    pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d) ≤
      ladderNTrunc (fun j => Gs (j % period)) (fun j => θ (j % period))
          (trotterSchedule period wstar) O ko kh m g +
        |Real.sin (θ (period - 1))| *
          ladderNTrunc (fun j => Gs (j % period)) (fun j => θ (j % period))
            (trotterSchedule period wstar) O ko kh (m - 1) g

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterBlock_eq_boundary_pre
statement:
theorem trotterBlock_eq_boundary_pre (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    traj Gs θ (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O d) period =
      rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (θ (period - 1)) *
        trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d * period + (period - 1)) *
        rot (toMatrix (Gs (period - 1))) (-(θ (period - 1)))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterSchedule_boundary
statement:
theorem trotterSchedule_boundary (period wstar d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    trotterSchedule (n := n) period wstar (d * period + (period - 1)) =

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterSchedule_interior
statement:
theorem trotterSchedule_interior (period wstar d i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < period) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterStepTraj_succ
statement:
theorem trotterStepTraj_succ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) :
    trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d + 1) =
      truncOp (highSet n wstar)ᶜ
        (traj Gs θ (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O d) period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterStepTraj_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem trotterStepTraj_zero (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O 0 = O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterTraj_at_boundary
statement:
theorem trotterTraj_at_boundary (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterTraj_next_boundary
statement:
theorem trotterTraj_next_boundary (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O ((d + 1) * period) =
      truncOp (highSet n wstar)ᶜ
        (traj Gs θ (trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d * period)) period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterTraj_succ
statement:
theorem trotterTraj_succ (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) :
    trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (g + 1) =
      truncOp (trotterSchedule period wstar g)
        (rot (toMatrix (Gs (g % period))) (θ (g % period)) *
          trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O g *
          rot (toMatrix (Gs (g % period))) (-(θ (g % period))))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterTraj_within_step
statement:
theorem trotterTraj_within_step (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)

    trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (d * period + i) =

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterTraj_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem trotterTraj_zero (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)

name: Lean4LPD.DiscardWitness.discardedStep_pauliNorm_pos

statement:

    (hL : IsLayer kh (L.map Prod.fst)) (w j : ℕ) :
    ‖layerInflowMatrix L w j‖
      ≤ ((w + j * (kh - 1)).choose j : ℝ) * layerSigma L ^ j

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.norm_restr_layerAct_le_sum_inflow
statement:
theorem norm_restr_layerAct_le_sum_inflow (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (hL : ∀ g ∈ L, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) (w : ℕ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    ‖restr (highSet n w) (layerAct L y)‖ ≤ ‖restr (highSet n w) y‖
      + ∑ j ∈ range (L.length + 1), ‖Lean4LPD.clm (layerInflowMatrix L w j) y‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.norm_stayAct_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_stayAct_apply_le (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    ‖(stayAct G θ y).ofLp p‖ ≤ ‖y.ofLp p‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.restr_layerAct_low_eq_sum_inflow
statement:
theorem restr_layerAct_low_eq_sum_inflow (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ)) (w : ℕ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    restr (highSet n w) (layerAct L (restr (highSet n w)ᶜ y))
      = ∑ j ∈ range (L.length + 1), Lean4LPD.clm (layerInflowMatrix L w j) y

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.restr_sum
statement:
theorem restr_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (R : Finset (PauliIndex n))
    (f : ι → EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    restr R (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, restr R (f i)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rotAct_eq_stay_add_jump
statement:
theorem rotAct_eq_stay_add_jump (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    rotAct G θ y = stayAct G θ y + jumpAct G θ y

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.row_sum_norm_layerInflowMatrix_le
statement:
theorem row_sum_norm_layerInflowMatrix_le (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ)) {kh : ℕ}
    (hL : IsLayer kh (L.map Prod.fst)) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hsin : ∀ g ∈ L, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ σ) (w j : ℕ) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    ∑ q, ‖layerInflowMatrix L w j p q‖
      ≤ ((w + j * (kh - 1)).choose j : ℝ) * σ ^ j

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.row_sum_norm_layerJumpMatrix_le
statement:
theorem row_sum_norm_layerJumpMatrix_le (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (hcomm : ∀ g ∈ L, ∀ h ∈ L, sympForm g.1 h.1 = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hsin : ∀ g ∈ L, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ σ)
    (j : ℕ) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    ∑ q, ‖layerJumpMatrix L j p q‖
      ≤ ((layerAntiCount (L.map Prod.fst) p).choose j : ℝ) * σ ^ j

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.stayAct_add
statement:
theorem stayAct_add (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y z : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    stayAct G θ (y + z) = stayAct G θ y + stayAct G θ z

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.stayAct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem stayAct_apply (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    (stayAct G θ y).ofLp p =
      if sympForm G (herm p) = 0 then y.ofLp p else (Real.cos θ : ℂ) * y.ofLp p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.stayAct_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem stayAct_apply_eq_zero (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) (p : PauliIndex n) (hy : y.ofLp p = 0) :
    (stayAct G θ y).ofLp p = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.stayAct_sum
statement:
theorem stayAct_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (f : ι → EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    stayAct G θ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, stayAct G θ (f i)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.stayAct_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem stayAct_zero (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ) : stayAct G θ 0 = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sum_norm_jumpAct_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_jumpAct_le (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    ∑ p, ‖(jumpAct G θ y).ofLp p‖ ≤ |Real.sin θ| * ∑ p, ‖y.ofLp p‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sum_norm_stayAct_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_stayAct_le (G : PauliString n) (θ : ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (PauliIndex n)) :
    ∑ p, ‖(stayAct G θ y).ofLp p‖ ≤ ∑ p, ‖y.ofLp p‖

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.sympForm_herm_partner_of_commute
statement:
theorem sympForm_herm_partner_of_commute (G H : PauliString n)
    (hGH : sympForm G H = 0) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    sympForm G (herm (partner H p)) = sympForm G (herm p)

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.actual_discard_exceeds_gamma_bound
statement:
theorem actual_discard_exceeds_gamma_bound {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθπ : 2 * θ < Real.pi) :
    ∃ p : PauliIndex 8, coeff (pf2Discard θ) p ≠ 0 ∧ (1 * 2 ^ 2 : ℕ) < wt p

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.herm_P6_sign
statement: theorem herm_P6_sign : herm (cls P₆) = phaseMul 2 P₆

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.herm_input
statement: theorem herm_input : herm (cls (Z (3 : Fin 8))) = Z 3

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.input_coeffVec
statement:
theorem input_coeffVec : coeffVec (toMatrix (Z (3 : Fin 8))) =
    WithLp.toLp 2 (Pi.single (cls (Z (3 : Fin 8))) (1 : ℂ))

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.input_local
statement: theorem input_local : ∀ p : PauliIndex 8, 1 < wt p → coeff (toMatrix (Z 3)) p = 0

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2Discard_coeff
statement:
theorem pf2Discard_coeff (θ : ℝ) :
    coeff (pf2Discard θ) (cls P₆) = coeff (pf2Output θ) (cls P₆)

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2Output_eq_four_layers
statement:
theorem pf2Output_eq_four_layers (θ : ℝ) :
    pf2Output θ = layerConj (L₁.map fun G => (G, θ))
      (layerConj (L₂.map fun G => (G, θ))
        (layerConj (L₂.map fun G => (G, θ))
          (layerConj (L₁.map fun G => (G, θ)) (toMatrix (Z 3)))))

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2Rotations_hermitian
statement: theorem pf2Rotations_hermitian (θ : ℝ) : ∀ g ∈ pf2Rotations θ, IsSelfAdjoint g.1

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pf2_coeff_ne_zero {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθπ : 2 * θ < Real.pi) :
    coeff (pf2Output θ) (cls P₆) ≠ 0

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2_coeff_polynomial
statement:
theorem pf2_coeff_polynomial (θ : ℝ) :
    coeff (pf2Output θ) (cls P₆) =
      -4 * (Real.cos θ : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Real.sin θ : ℂ) ^ 5

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2_coeff_sines
statement:
theorem pf2_coeff_sines (θ : ℝ) :
    coeff (pf2Output θ) (cls P₆) =
      -(Real.sin θ : ℂ) ^ 3 * (Real.sin (2 * θ) : ℂ) ^ 2

name: Lean4LPD.LayerCounterexample.pf2_named_P6_component
statement:
theorem pf2_named_P6_component (θ : ℝ) :
    coeff (pf2Output θ) (cls P₆) • toMatrix (herm (cls P₆)) =
      ((Real.sin θ : ℂ) ^ 3 * (Real.sin (2 * θ) : ℂ) ^ 2) • toMatrix P₆

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.highNorm_layerConj_le_multi
statement:
theorem highNorm_layerConj_le_multi (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ)) {ko kh m : ℕ}
    (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hL : IsLayer kh (L.map Prod.fst))
    (hherm : ∀ g ∈ L, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsin : ∀ g ∈ L, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ a) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hb : betaOf (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a < 1)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (layerConj L O) ≤
      highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) O +
        (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
          highNorm (rungWeight ko kh (m - j)) O) +
        entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a m * pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerN_eq_highNorm
statement:
theorem layerN_eq_highNorm (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (ko kh m T : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    layerN Ls S O ko kh m T = highNorm (rungWeight ko kh m) (layerTraj Ls S O T)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerN_init
statement:
theorem layerN_init (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) {O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ} {ko kh : ℕ}
    (hloc : ∀ p : PauliIndex n, ko < wt p → coeff O p = 0) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    layerN Ls S O ko kh m 0 = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerN_le_majorant
statement:
theorem layerN_le_majorant (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) {ko kh : ℕ}
    (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hL : ∀ T, IsLayer kh ((Ls T).map Prod.fst))
    (hherm : ∀ T, ∀ g ∈ Ls T, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsin : ∀ T, ∀ g ∈ Ls T, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ a)
    (hb : betaOf (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a < 1)
    (hloc : ∀ p : PauliIndex n, ko < wt p → coeff O p = 0) (T m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    layerN Ls S O ko kh m T ≤ MultiLadder.majorant
      (epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a)
      (entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a) (pauliNorm O) m T

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerN_nonneg
statement:
theorem layerN_nonneg (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (ko kh m T : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ layerN Ls S O ko kh m T

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerN_step
statement:
theorem layerN_step (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) {ko kh : ℕ}
    (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hL : ∀ T, IsLayer kh ((Ls T).map Prod.fst))
    (hherm : ∀ T, ∀ g ∈ Ls T, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hsin : ∀ T, ∀ g ∈ Ls T, |Real.sin g.2| ≤ a)
    (hb : betaOf (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a < 1)
    (m T : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    layerN Ls S O ko kh m (T + 1) ≤ layerN Ls S O ko kh m T +
      (∑ j ∈ Ico 1 m, epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m *
        layerN Ls S O ko kh (m - j) T) +
      entryFactor (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a m * pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerTraj_succ
statement:
theorem layerTraj_succ (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (T : ℕ) :
    layerTraj Ls S O (T + 1) = truncOp (S T) (layerConj (Ls T) (layerTraj Ls S O T))

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layerTraj_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem layerTraj_zero (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n)) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    layerTraj Ls S O 0 = O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.layer_factor_eq_epsJump
statement:
theorem layer_factor_eq_epsJump {ko kh m : ℕ} (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (a : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    ((((rungWeight ko kh m + j * (kh - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) ^ j / (Nat.factorial j : ℝ)) =
      epsJump (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) a j m

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_layerConj
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_layerConj (L : List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (hL : ∀ g ∈ L, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (layerConj L O) = pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_layerTraj_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_layerTraj_le (Ls : ℕ → List (PauliString n × ℝ))
    (hL : ∀ T, ∀ g ∈ Ls T, IsSelfAdjoint g.1) (S : ℕ → Finset (PauliIndex n))
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (T : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (layerTraj Ls S O T) ≤ pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rungWeight_add_jump
statement:
theorem rungWeight_add_jump (ko kh m j : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    rungWeight ko kh m + j * (kh - 1) = rungWeight ko kh (m + j)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rungWeight_cast_eq_rungW
statement:
theorem rungWeight_cast_eq_rungW {ko kh m : ℕ} (hkh : 2 ≤ kh) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (rungWeight ko kh m : ℝ) = rungW (kh - 1 : ℕ) ((ko : ℝ) / (kh - 1 : ℕ)) m

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rungWeight_sub_jump
statement:
theorem rungWeight_sub_jump (ko kh m j : ℕ) (hj : j < m) :
    rungWeight ko kh (m - j) + j * (kh - 1) = rungWeight ko kh m

name: Lean4LPD.entryFactor_nonneg_all
statement:
theorem entryFactor_nonneg_all {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ entryFactor kh1 c a m

name: Lean4LPD.epsJump_nonneg_all
statement:
theorem epsJump_nonneg_all {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (j m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ epsJump kh1 c a j m

name: Lean4LPD.sum_Ico_epsJump_le_entryFactor
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_epsJump_le_entryFactor {kh1 c a : ℝ}
    (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hb : betaOf kh1 c a < 1) (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Ico m K, epsJump kh1 c a j m) ≤ entryFactor kh1 c a m

name: Lean4LPD.summable_epsJump_tail
statement:
theorem summable_epsJump_tail {kh1 c a : ℝ} (hkh : 0 < kh1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hb : betaOf kh1 c a < 1) :
    Summable (fun i : ℕ => epsJump kh1 c a (m + i) m)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.bitsMatrixEquiv_star
statement:
theorem bitsMatrixEquiv_star (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    bitsMatrixEquiv n (star A) = star (bitsMatrixEquiv n A)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.cls_tensorRepresentative
statement:
@[simp] theorem cls_tensorRepresentative {n : ℕ} (p : PauliIndex n) :
    cls (tensorRepresentative p) = p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.isSelfAdjoint_tensorPauli
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_tensorPauli {n : ℕ} (p : PauliIndex n) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (tensorPauli n p.1 p.2)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.isSelfAdjoint_tensorRepresentative
statement:
theorem isSelfAdjoint_tensorRepresentative {n : ℕ} (p : PauliIndex n) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (tensorRepresentative p)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.qubitXZ_eq_phase_qubitPauli
statement:
theorem qubitXZ_eq_phase_qubitPauli (x z : ZMod 2) :
    qubitXZ x z = iPow (-((x * z).val : ZMod 4)) • qubitPauli x z

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.tensorPauli_succ_apply
statement:
theorem tensorPauli_succ_apply {n : ℕ} (x z a b : Bits (n + 1)) :
    tensorPauli (n + 1) x z a b =
      qubitPauli (x 0) (z 0) (a 0) (b 0) *
        tensorPauli n (Fin.tail x) (Fin.tail z) (Fin.tail a) (Fin.tail b)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.toMatrix_eq_phase_tensor
statement:
theorem toMatrix_eq_phase_tensor : ∀ {n : ℕ} (s : PauliString n),
    toMatrix s = iPow (s.phase - yPhase s.x s.z) • tensorPauli n s.x s.z

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.toMatrix_split
statement:
theorem toMatrix_split {n : ℕ} (s : PauliString (n + 1)) (a b : Bits (n + 1)) :
    toMatrix s a b = qubitXZ (s.x 0) (s.z 0) (a 0) (b 0) *
      toMatrix (dropFirst s) (Fin.tail a) (Fin.tail b)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.toMatrix_tensorRepresentative
statement:
theorem toMatrix_tensorRepresentative {n : ℕ} (p : PauliIndex n) :
    toMatrix (tensorRepresentative p) = tensorPauli n p.1 p.2

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trace_star_tensorPauli_mul
statement:
theorem trace_star_tensorPauli_mul {n : ℕ} (p q : PauliIndex n) :
    (star (tensorPauli n p.1 p.2) * tensorPauli n q.1 q.2).trace =
      if p = q then (2 : ℂ) ^ n else 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trace_tensorPauli_mul
statement:
theorem trace_tensorPauli_mul {n : ℕ} (p q : PauliIndex n) :
    (tensorPauli n p.1 p.2 * tensorPauli n q.1 q.2).trace =
      if p = q then (2 : ℂ) ^ n else 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.two_mul_yPhase
statement:
theorem two_mul_yPhase : ∀ {n : ℕ} (x z : Bits n),
    2 * yPhase x z = signPhase (z ⬝ᵥ x)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.yPhase_succ
statement:
theorem yPhase_succ {n : ℕ} (x z : Bits (n + 1)) :
    yPhase x z = ((x 0 * z 0).val : ZMod 4) + yPhase (Fin.tail x) (Fin.tail z)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.blockEnd_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockEnd_apply (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    blockEnd Gs θ period A = traj Gs θ A period

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.blockEnd_pow_eq_periodic_traj
statement:
theorem blockEnd_pow_eq_periodic_traj (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    ((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ r) O =
      traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (r * period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeffVec_add
statement:
theorem coeffVec_add (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    coeffVec (A + B) = coeffVec A + coeffVec B

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.coeff_add
statement:
theorem coeff_add (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (p : PauliIndex n) :
    coeff (A + B) p = coeff A p + coeff B p

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_add_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_add_le (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (A + B) ≤ pauliNorm A + pauliNorm B

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_blockEnd_pow
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_blockEnd_pow {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (period : ℕ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ r) O) = pauliNorm O

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_periodic_traj_error_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_periodic_traj_error_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (period wstar : ℕ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (r * period) -
        trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O r) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ range r, pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_sum_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_sum_le {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) :
    pauliNorm (∑ i ∈ S, A i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, pauliNorm (A i)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_trotterStep_error_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_trotterStep_error_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (period wstar : ℕ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ r) O - trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O r) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ range r, pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_trotterStep_error_le_highNorm
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_trotterStep_error_le_highNorm {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (period wstar : ℕ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    pauliNorm (((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ r) O - trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O r) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ range r,
        highNorm wstar (traj Gs θ (trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O d) period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_trotterTraj_error_le
statement:
theorem pauliNorm_trotterTraj_error_le {Gs : ℕ → PauliString n}
    (hG : ∀ g, IsSelfAdjoint (Gs g)) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (period wstar : ℕ)
    (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) (hp : 0 < period) :
    pauliNorm (traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (r * period) -
        trotterTraj Gs θ period wstar O (r * period)) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ range r, pauliNorm (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.pauliNorm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pauliNorm_zero : pauliNorm (0 : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) = 0

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.periodic_traj_sub_trotterStepTraj
statement:
theorem periodic_traj_sub_trotterStepTraj (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (r * period) -
        trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O r =
      ∑ d ∈ range r, traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period))
        (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d) ((r - 1 - d) * period)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.traj_add
statement:
theorem traj_add (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A B : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (g : ℕ) :
    traj Gs θ (A + B) g = traj Gs θ A g + traj Gs θ B g

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.traj_periodic_within_step
statement:
theorem traj_periodic_within_step (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (d i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ period) :
    traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (d * period + i) =
      traj Gs θ
        (traj (fun g => Gs (g % period)) (fun g => θ (g % period)) O (d * period)) i

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.traj_zero_input
statement:
theorem traj_zero_input (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ) :

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.trotterStep_telescoping
statement:
theorem trotterStep_telescoping (Gs : ℕ → PauliString n) (θ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (period wstar : ℕ) (O : Matrix (Bits n) (Bits n) ℂ) (r : ℕ) :
    ((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ r) O - trotterStepTraj Gs θ period wstar O r =
      ∑ d ∈ range r, ((blockEnd Gs θ period) ^ (r - 1 - d))
        (discardedStep Gs θ period wstar O d)

name: Lean4LPD.PauliString.rot_toMatrix_eq_exp
statement:
theorem rot_toMatrix_eq_exp (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G) (θ : ℝ) :
    rot (toMatrix G) θ =
      NormedSpace.exp ((Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • toMatrix G)

statement:

      NormedSpace.exp ((-Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • toMatrix G)

name: Lean4LPD.exp_conj_of_anticommute
statement:
theorem exp_conj_of_anticommute (hG : G * G = 1) (h : G * P = -(P * G)) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp ((Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • G) * P *
      NormedSpace.exp ((-Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • G) =
      (Real.cos θ : ℂ) • P + (Complex.I * Real.sin θ) • (G * P)

name: Lean4LPD.exp_conj_of_commute
statement:
theorem exp_conj_of_commute (hG : G * G = 1) (h : Commute G P) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp ((Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • G) * P *
      NormedSpace.exp ((-Complex.I * (θ / 2 : ℝ)) • G) = P

name: Lean4LPD.exp_smul_I_of_involution
statement:
theorem exp_smul_I_of_involution (hG : G * G = 1) (z : ℂ) :
    NormedSpace.exp ((Complex.I * z) • G) =
      Complex.cos z • (1 : A) + (Complex.I * Complex.sin z) • G

name: Lean4LPD.exp_term_even_of_involution
statement:
theorem exp_term_even_of_involution (hG : G * G = 1) (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((2 * n)!⁻¹ : ℂ) • ((z * Complex.I) • G) ^ (2 * n) =
      ((z * Complex.I) ^ (2 * n) / (2 * n)!) • (1 : A)

name: Lean4LPD.exp_term_odd_of_involution
statement:
theorem exp_term_odd_of_involution (hG : G * G = 1) (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((2 * n + 1)!⁻¹ : ℂ) • ((z * Complex.I) • G) ^ (2 * n + 1) =
      (((z * Complex.I) ^ (2 * n + 1) / (2 * n + 1)! / Complex.I) * Complex.I) • G

name: Lean4LPD.rot_eq_exp
statement:
theorem rot_eq_exp (hG : G * G = 1) (θ : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem measure_ball_eq_pow_mul {n : ℕ} [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → K)] [BorelSpace (Fin n → K)]
    (μ : Measure (Fin n → K)) [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant]
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝒪[K]) (hdet : M.det ≠ 0) {π : 𝒪[K]} (hπ : Irreducible π)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : Associated M.det (π ^ k)) (x : Fin n → K) (m : ℕ) :
    μ (ball x π m) =

    {π : 𝒪[K]} (hπ : Irreducible π) (e : Fin n → ℕ) :

    (hnorm : μ (integerBox K n) = 1) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝒪[K]) (hdet : M.det ≠ 0)
    {π : 𝒪[K]} (hπ : Irreducible π) {k : ℕ} (hk : Associated M.det (π ^ k)) :
    μ (imageLattice M) = (q K : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ k

name: MassFormula.measure_integerBox_eq_pow_mul

theorem measure_integerBox_eq_pow_mul {n : ℕ} [MeasurableSpace (Fin n → K)]
    [BorelSpace (Fin n → K)] (μ : Measure (Fin n → K)) [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant]
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝒪[K]) (hdet : M.det ≠ 0) {π : 𝒪[K]} (hπ : Irreducible π)

name: Contrib.MaxFlowMinCut.augEdges_exists
statement:
theorem augEdges_exists {Net : Network N} (F : Flow Net) (hreach : Reaches Net F Net.t) :
    ∃ (P : Finset (N × N)) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧
      (∀ p ∈ P, δ ≤ Net.cap p.1 p.2 - F.f p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ u v, (u, v) ∈ P → (v, u) ∉ P) ∧
      (∀ u, (∑ v, (if (u, v) ∈ P then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
              - (∑ v, if (v, u) ∈ P then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            = (if u = Net.s then 1 else 0) - (if u = Net.t then 1 else 0))

name: Contrib.MaxFlowMinCut.degree_balance

      - (∑ v, if (v, u) ∈ pairs l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    = (if l.head? = some u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if l.getLast? = some u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

statement:
theorem exists_matchings_of_spread {H : Finset (Sym2 V)}
    {U W : Finset V} {q : ℝ} {s₁ s₂ : ℕ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hloop : ∀ e ∈ H, ¬ e.IsDiag)

    (hcodeg : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ x' ∈ U, x ≠ x' → (codegTo H x x' W : ℝ) ≤ q * ((s₂ : ℝ) + 1))

name: BKLOK2.pot_step
statement:
theorem pot_step {β q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} {R : Finset V}
    {x₀ : V} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ R) {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {f : V → V}
    (hmap : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W)
    (hinv : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f (f a) = a)
    (hbound : ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F (R.erase x₀) R y (f y)
      ≤ β * ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, ∑ z ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F (R.erase x₀) R y z)
    (hcodeg : ∀ x ∈ R.erase x₀, β * (codegTo H x x₀ W : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    pot H W q (F ∪ famEdges (involutionMatching (nbhdIn H x₀ W) f)) (R.erase x₀)
      ≤ pot H W q F R

name: BKLOK2.pot_step_mem_sum
statement:
theorem pot_step_mem_sum {β q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W R : Finset V}
    {x₀ : V} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ R) {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {f : V → V}
    (hmap : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W)
    (hinv : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f (f a) = a)
    (hbound : ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F (R.erase x₀) R y (f y)
      ≤ β * ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, ∑ z ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F (R.erase x₀) R y z)
    (hcodeg : ∀ x ∈ R.erase x₀, β * (codegTo H x x₀ W : ℝ) ≤ q) :
    ∑ x ∈ R.erase x₀, ∑ y ∈ (nbhdIn H x W).filter (fun y => y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W),
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W (F ∪ famEdges (involutionMatching (nbhdIn H x₀ W) f)) x y)
          * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y (R.erase x₀))
      ≤ ∑ x ∈ R.erase x₀, ∑ y ∈ (nbhdIn H x W).filter (fun y => y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W),
          (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R)

name: BKLOK2.pot_step_mem_term
statement:
theorem pot_step_mem_term {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} {q : ℝ}
    {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {R : Finset V} {x₀ x y : V} {f : V → V} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ R)
    (hmap : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W)
    (hinv : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f (f a) = a)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hy : y ∈ nbhdIn H x W) (hy0 : y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W) :
    (1 + q) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W (F ∪ famEdges (involutionMatching (nbhdIn H x₀ W) f)) x y)
        * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y (R.erase x₀)))
      ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R))
        + (if f y ∈ nbhdIn H x W then
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R) else 0)

name: BKLOK2.pot_step_notMem_term
statement:
theorem pot_step_notMem_term {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} {q : ℝ}
    {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {R : Finset V} {x₀ x y : V} {f : V → V}
    (hmap : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W)
    (hinv : ∀ a ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, f (f a) = a)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hy : y ∈ nbhdIn H x W) (hy0 : y ∉ nbhdIn H x₀ W) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W (F ∪ famEdges (involutionMatching (nbhdIn H x₀ W) f)) x y)
        * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y (R.erase x₀))
      ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R)

name: BKLOK2.pow_usedCnt_le_pot
statement:
theorem pow_usedCnt_le_pot {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {R : Finset V} {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ R) (hy : y ∈ nbhdIn H x W) :

name: BKLOK2.spread_process
statement:
theorem spread_process {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {U W : Finset V}
    {q : ℝ} {s₁ s₂ : ℕ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hloop : ∀ e ∈ H, ¬ e.IsDiag) (hUW : Disjoint U W)
    (hEven : ∀ x ∈ U, Even (nbhdIn H x W).card)
    (hmindeg : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ nbhdIn H x W,
      (nbhdIn H x W).card / 2 + s₂ + s₁ ≤ edeg (edgesIn H (nbhdIn H x W)) v)
    (hcodeg : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ x' ∈ U, x ≠ x' → (codegTo H x x' W : ℝ) ≤ q * ((s₂ : ℝ) + 1)) :
    ∀ R : Finset V, R ⊆ U → ∀ F : Finset (Sym2 V), pot H W q F R < 2 ^ (s₁ + 1) →
      ∃ Mx : V → Finset (Finset V), (∀ x ∈ R, GoodMatching H W x (Mx x)) ∧
        (R : Set V).Pairwise (fun x y => Disjoint (famEdges (Mx x)) (famEdges (Mx y))) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ R, Disjoint (famEdges (Mx x)) F)

name: BKLOK2.sum_sum_wgt_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sum_wgt_eq (H : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (q : ℝ) (F : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (R' R : Finset V) (x₀ : V) :
    ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, ∑ z ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F R' R y z
      = ∑ x ∈ R', (codegTo H x x₀ W : ℝ) *
          ∑ y ∈ (nbhdIn H x W).filter (fun y => y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W),
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R)

name: BKLOK2.sum_wgt_partner_eq
statement:
theorem sum_wgt_partner_eq (H : Finset (Sym2 V)) (W : Finset V) (q : ℝ) (F : Finset (Sym2 V))
    (R' R : Finset V) (x₀ : V) (f : V → V) :
    ∑ y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W, wgt H W q F R' R y (f y)
      = ∑ x ∈ R', ∑ y ∈ (nbhdIn H x W).filter (fun y => y ∈ nbhdIn H x₀ W),
          (if f y ∈ nbhdIn H x W then
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (usedCnt H W F x y) * (1 + q) ^ (degTo H y R) else 0)

name: BKLOK2.usedCnt_le_of_pot
statement:
theorem usedCnt_le_of_pot {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    {F : Finset (Sym2 V)} {R : Finset V} {s : ℕ} (hpot : pot H W q F R < 2 ^ (s + 1))
    {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ R) (hy : y ∈ nbhdIn H x W) : usedCnt H W F x y ≤ s

name: BKLOK2.usedCnt_union_le
statement:
theorem usedCnt_union_le {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {W : Finset V} (F : Finset (Sym2 V))
    {N : Finset V} {f : V → V} (hmap : ∀ a ∈ N, f a ∈ N) (hinv : ∀ a ∈ N, f (f a) = a)
    (x y : V) :
    usedCnt H W (F ∪ famEdges (involutionMatching N f)) x y
      ≤ usedCnt H W F x y +
        (if y ∈ N ∧ y ∈ nbhdIn H x W ∧ f y ∈ nbhdIn H x W then 1 else 0)

name: BKLOK2.codeg_budget_of_hyps
statement:
theorem codeg_budget_of_hyps {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] {ρ t q : ℝ} {k s₂ : ℕ}
    {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {U W : Finset V}
    (hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k) (hqpos : 0 < q)
    (hst : Real.sqrt ρ * t = ρ ^ 2) (hq : q = 2 * Real.sqrt ρ / (9 * k))
    (hs₂ : s₂ = ⌊9 * (k : ℝ) * t * (W.card : ℝ)⌋₊)
    (hiii : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ x' ∈ U, x ≠ x' →
      (codegTo H x x' W : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ 2 * (W.card : ℝ)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ x' ∈ U, x ≠ x' → (codegTo H x x' W : ℝ) ≤ q * ((s₂ : ℝ) + 1)

name: BKLOK2.lemma107K2_holds
statement:
theorem lemma107K2_holds :
    ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < ρ → 0 < k → ∃ n₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] (H : Finset (Sym2 V)) (S U W : Finset V),
        n₀ ≤ S.card → (∀ e ∈ H, ¬ e.IsDiag) → H ⊆ cliqueEdges S → U ⊆ S → W ⊆ S →
        Disjoint U W → (S.card : ℝ) / (k : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (W.card : ℝ) →
        (∀ x ∈ U, 2 ∣ degTo H x W) →
        (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ nbhdIn H x W,
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (degTo H x W : ℝ) +
              18 * (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ρ ^ 3 * (W.card : ℝ) ≤
            (degTo H y (nbhdIn H x W) : ℝ)) →
        (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ x' ∈ U, x ≠ x' →
          (codegTo H x x' W : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ρ ^ 2 * (W.card : ℝ)) →
        (∀ y ∈ W, (degTo H y U : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) * ρ * (W.card : ℝ)) →
        ∃ Mx : V → Finset (Finset V),
          (∀ x ∈ U, GoodMatching H W x (Mx x)) ∧
          (U : Set V).Pairwise (fun x y => Disjoint (famEdges (Mx x)) (famEdges (Mx y)))

name: BKLOK2.pot_empty_lt_of_hyps
statement:
theorem pot_empty_lt_of_hyps {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] {ρ t q : ℝ} {k s : ℕ}
    {H : Finset (Sym2 V)} {S U W : Finset V}
    (hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k) (hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ))
    (hqpos : 0 < q) (htpos : 0 < t)
    (hts : t = ρ * Real.sqrt ρ) (hq : q = 2 * Real.sqrt ρ / (9 * k))
    (hs : s = ⌊9 * (k : ℝ) * t * (W.card : ℝ)⌋₊)
    (hUS : U ⊆ S) (hWS : W ⊆ S)
    (hiv : ∀ y ∈ W, (degTo H y U : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (k : ℝ) * ρ * (W.card : ℝ))
    (hSsq : ((S.card : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (t * (W.card : ℝ))) :
    pot H W q ∅ U < 2 ^ (s + 1)

theorem inner_map_polarization [CompleteSpace E] {T : E →L[𝕜] E} (hT : IsSelfAdjoint T)
    (x y : E) :
    ⟪T x,y⟫ =
      (⟪T (x + y),x + y⟫ - ⟪T (x - y),x - y⟫ - I * ⟪T (x + (I : 𝕜) • y),x + (I : 𝕜) • y⟫ +
          I * ⟪T (x - (I : 𝕜) • y),x - (I : 𝕜) • y⟫) /
        4

name: Matrix.single.hMul_apply
statement:
theorem Matrix.single.hMul_apply {R : Type _} [Fintype n] [Semiring R]
    (i j k l m p : n) :
    ∑ x : n × n, ∑ x_1 : n × n, ∑ x_2 : n, ∑ x_3 : n,
        Matrix.single l k (Matrix.single p m (1 : R) x_1.snd x_1.fst) x.snd x.fst *
          Matrix.single i x_2 (Matrix.single x_3 j (1 : R) x_1.fst x_1.snd) x.fst x.snd =
      ∑ x : n × n, ∑ x_1 : n × n, ∑ x_2 : n, ∑ x_3 : n,
        ite
          (p = x_1.snd ∧
            m = x_1.fst ∧

name: StarAlgEquiv.comp_eq_iff
statement:
theorem StarAlgEquiv.comp_eq_iff {R E₁ E₂ E₃ : Type _} [CommSemiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid E₁] [AddCommMonoid E₂] [AddCommMonoid E₃]
    [Module R E₁] [Module R E₂] [Module R E₃] [Star E₁] [Star E₂] [Mul E₁] [Mul E₂]
    (f : E₁ ≃⋆ₐ[R] E₂) (x : E₂ →ₗ[R] E₃) (y : E₁ →ₗ[R] E₃) :
    x ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap = y ↔ x = y ∘ₗ f.symm.toLinearMap

name: StarAlgEquiv.comp_inj
statement:

  [AddCommMonoid C] [Mul B] [Mul C] [Module R A] [Module R B] [Module R C]
  [Star B] [Star C]
  (f : B ≃⋆ₐ[R] C) (S T : A →ₗ[R] B) :
    f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S = f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T ↔ S = T

name: StarAlgEquiv.eq_apply_iff_symm_eq
statement:

  (f : A ≃⋆ₐ[R] B) {a : B} {b : A} :

name: StarAlgEquiv.inj_comp
statement:
theorem StarAlgEquiv.inj_comp {R A B C : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid A]

  [Star A] [Star C] (f : C ≃⋆ₐ[R] A) (S T : A →ₗ[R] B) :

  v (X 0 * Y 1) > v (-(Y 1 * Z 0)) ∧

lemma segment_sum_splitting (A : Finset Segment) (AVOID : Set ℝ²) (X : Finset ℝ²)
    (hA : A ⊆ avoidingSegmentSet X AVOID)
    (hDisj : ∀ S T, S ∈ A → T ∈ A → S ≠ T → openHull S ∩ openHull T = ∅)
    (f : Segment → ℕ) (hfTwoMod : twoModFunction f) (hSymm : symmFun f) :
    (∑ S ∈ filter (fun S ↦ closedHull S ⊆ (⋃ T ∈ A, closedHull T))
      (basicAvoidingSegmentSet X AVOID), f S) % 4
    = (2 * ∑ T ∈ A, f T) % 4

 (f : Segment → ℕ) (non_degen : ∀ P ∈ Δ, det P ≠ 0)
    : ∑ T ∈ Δ, ∑ (S ∈ triangleBasicBoundary Δ T), f S =
    ∑ (S ∈ triangulationBoundaryBasicSegments Δ), f S +
    2 * ∑ (S ∈ triangulationInteriorBasicSegments Δ), f S

    (hf₂ : symmFun f) :
    (∑ T ∈ (basicAvoidingSegmentSet X A).filter (fun s ↦ closedHull s ⊆ closedHull S),

    (2 * f S) % 4

MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.zig_terminal
statement:
theorem zig_terminal (H : SimpleGraph V) {x y : V} {n : ℕ} (p : Route H x y n) :
    (∀ a (ha : Linked H a x),
      (Even n → ∃ a', ∃ ha' : Linked H a' y,
        zigFirst H p a ha = bipartiteEdge H a' y ha') ∧
      (Odd n → ∃ b', ∃ hb' : Linked H y b',
        zigFirst H p a ha = bipartiteEdge H y b' hb')) ∧
    (∀ b (hb : Linked H x b),
      (Even n → ∃ b', ∃ hb' : Linked H y b',
        zigSecond H p b hb = bipartiteEdge H y b' hb') ∧
      (Odd n → ∃ a', ∃ ha' : Linked H a' y,
        zigSecond H p b hb = bipartiteEdge H a' y ha'))

theorem bad_predecessor (z r q i : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) (h : ℤ)
    (hlen : xs.length = r + z) (hcount : countTrue xs = r)
    (hi0 : 0 < i) (hin : i < xs.length) (hact : active q i = true)
    (hb : Bad z (phaseN q xs) i h) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ h' : ℤ,
      (j = i - 1 ∨ j = i + 1) ∧ 0 < j ∧ j < xs.length ∧
      Bad z xs j h' ∧ potential z j h' = potential z i h - 1

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.phaseN_perm

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.phase_false

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.phase_perm

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.phase_true_cons

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.potential_left
statement:
theorem potential_left (z i : ℕ) (h : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    potential z (i - 1) (h + low z i - low z (i - 1)) = potential z i h - 1

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.potential_lower_of_initial_bad
statement:
theorem potential_lower_of_initial_bad (xs : List Bool) (z r i : ℕ) (h : ℤ)
    (hcount : countTrue xs = r) (hb : Bad z xs i h) :
    -(r : ℤ) ≤ potential z i h

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.potential_right
statement:
theorem potential_right (z i : ℕ) (h : ℤ) :
    potential z (i + 1) (h + 1 + low z i - low z (i + 1)) = potential z i h - 1

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.potential_upper
statement:
theorem potential_upper (z i : ℕ) (h : ℤ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) :
    potential z i h ≤ (z : ℤ) - 2

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_at_length

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_cons_cons_add
statement:
theorem pref_cons_cons_add (a b : Bool) (xs : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    pref (a :: b :: xs) (i + 2) = bitInt a + bitInt b + pref xs i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_cons_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem pref_cons_succ (a : Bool) (xs : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    pref (a :: xs) (i + 1) = bitInt a + pref xs i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_evolve_full
statement:
theorem pref_evolve_full (z r q : ℕ) (xs : List Bool)
    (hlen : xs.length = r + z) (hcount : countTrue xs = r)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ xs.length) :
    pref (evolve q xs (r + z)) i = low z i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_le_index
statement: theorem pref_le_index (xs : List Bool) (i : ℕ) : pref xs i ≤ i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_le_total

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_lower

    low z i ≤ pref xs i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem pref_nil (i : ℕ) : pref [] i = 0

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_pairPhase_even
statement:
theorem pref_pairPhase_even (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    pref (pairPhase xs) (2 * k) = pref xs (2 * k)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_pairPhase_odd
statement:
theorem pref_pairPhase_odd (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2 * k + 1 < xs.length) :
    pref (pairPhase xs) (2 * k + 1) =
      max (pref xs (2 * k)) (pref xs (2 * k + 2) - 1)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_phaseN
statement:
theorem pref_phaseN (q : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) (i : ℕ)
    (hi0 : 0 < i) (hin : i < xs.length) :
    pref (phaseN q xs) i =
      if active q i then max (pref xs (i - 1)) (pref xs (i + 1) - 1)
      else pref xs i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_phase_false_even
statement:
theorem pref_phase_false_even (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    pref (phase false xs) (2 * k) = pref xs (2 * k)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_phase_false_odd
statement:
theorem pref_phase_false_odd (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2 * k + 1 < xs.length) :

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_phase_true_even
statement:
theorem pref_phase_true_even (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 2 * k + 2 < xs.length) :
    pref (phase true xs) (2 * k + 2) =
      max (pref xs (2 * k + 1)) (pref xs (2 * k + 3) - 1)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_phase_true_odd
statement:
theorem pref_phase_true_odd (xs : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    pref (phase true xs) (2 * k + 1) = pref xs (2 * k + 1)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_succ
statement:
theorem pref_succ (xs : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < xs.length) :
    pref xs (i + 1) = pref xs i + bitInt xs[i]

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.pref_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pref_zero (xs : List Bool) : pref xs 0 = 0

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.prefixSet2_trans_eq_of_take_perm

    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (htake : (l.take i.val).Perm (m.take i.val)) :
    PrefixSet2 ((permOfList l hl).trans π) i =
      PrefixSet2 ((permOfList m hm).trans π) i

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.threshold_evolve_perm_finRange
statement:
theorem threshold_evolve_perm_finRange {n : ℕ} (xs : List (Fin n))
    (hp : xs.Perm (List.finRange n)) (q : ℕ) (a : Fin n) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < n) :
    threshold a ((evolve q xs n)[i]'(by
      have hl : xs.length = n := by simpa using hp.length_eq
      simpa [hl] using hi)) =
      decide (a.val ≤ i)

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.threshold_max
statement:
theorem threshold_max {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (a x y : α) :

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.threshold_min

name: MooreBound.OddEvenSorting.trace_bad_active
statement:
theorem trace_bad_active (z r q : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) (t i : ℕ) (h : ℤ)
    (hlen : xs.length = r + z) (hcount : countTrue xs = r) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hact : active (q + t - 1) i = true)
    (hb : Bad z (evolve q xs t) i h) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ h' : ℤ,
      0 < j ∧ j < xs.length ∧ Bad z xs j h' ∧
      potential z j h' = potential z i h - t

name: MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.oddEvenRoute
statement:
theorem oddEvenRoute {n : ℕ} (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    ∃ route : Fin (n + 1) → Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      route 0 = 1 ∧
      route (Fin.last n) = π ∧
      ∀ s : Fin n, OrderingStep s (route s.castSucc) (route s.succ)

name: MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.ofBasis_reindex_eq_at_of_prefixSet_eq

theorem ofBasis_reindex_eq_at_of_prefixSet_eq {n : ℕ} (b : Basis (Fin n) K V)
    {σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h : PrefixSet σ i = PrefixSet τ i) :
    CompleteFlag.ofBasis (b.reindex σ.symm) i =
      CompleteFlag.ofBasis (b.reindex τ.symm) i

name: MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.edist_chain_le

theorem edist_chain_le {W : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph W) (P : ℕ → W) :

      G.edist (P 0) (P m) ≤ m

      P ≠ P' ∧ ∃ Q : OddPartialFlag (K := K) (V := V) (n := n),
        Compatible P Q ∧ Compatible P' Q

statement:
