name: MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.proposition_3_1_for_prime_power
statement:
theorem proposition_3_1_for_prime_power (q : PrimePowerIndex)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∀ P : Proposition31Vertex (PrimePowerField q) k,
        Nat.card ((Proposition31Graph (PrimePowerField q) k).neighborSet P) =
          proposition31Degree (PrimePowerField q) k) ∧
    Nat.card (Proposition31Vertex (PrimePowerField q) k) * (q.1 + 1) ^ k =
      qFactorial q.1 (2 * k + 1) ∧
    Nat.card (Proposition31Vertex (PrimePowerField q) k) =
      qFactorial q.1 (2 * k + 1) / (q.1 + 1) ^ k ∧
    proposition31Degree (PrimePowerField q) k ≤
      (q.1 + 1) ^ k * ((q.1 + 1) ^ k - 1) ∧
    (Proposition31Graph (PrimePowerField q) k).ediam = (k : ℕ∞)

name: MooreBound.DegreeDiameter.proposition_3_1_over_finite_field
statement:
theorem proposition_3_1_over_finite_field
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Finite K] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    (∀ P : Proposition31Vertex K k,
        Nat.card ((Proposition31Graph K k).neighborSet P) =
          proposition31Degree K k) ∧
    Nat.card (Proposition31Vertex K k) * (Nat.card K + 1) ^ k =
      qFactorial (Nat.card K) (2 * k + 1) ∧
    Nat.card (Proposition31Vertex K k) =
      qFactorial (Nat.card K) (2 * k + 1) / (Nat.card K + 1) ^ k ∧
    proposition31Degree K k ≤
      (Nat.card K + 1) ^ k * ((Nat.card K + 1) ^ k - 1) ∧
    (Proposition31Graph K k).ediam = (k : ℕ∞)

    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, f' t ≤ K * f t + ε) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, f t ≤ (f a + ε * (t - a)) * Real.exp (K * (t - a))

name: Gronwall.le_exp_mul_of_deriv_le
statement:
theorem le_exp_mul_of_deriv_le {a b K : ℝ} {f f' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, f' t ≤ K * f t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, f t ≤ f a * Real.exp (K * (t - a))

name: Gronwall.le_uniform_exp_mul_of_deriv_le_add
statement:
theorem le_uniform_exp_mul_of_deriv_le_add {a b K ε : ℝ} {f f' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hinitial : f a ≤ 0) (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, f' t ≤ K * f t + ε) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, f t ≤ ε * (b - a) * Real.exp (K * (b - a))

Ideal.quotient_finrank_algebra_tower_of_eq
statement:
theorem quotient_finrank_algebra_tower_of_eq {p : Ideal R} {P : Ideal S} {I : Ideal T}
    [IsMaximal p] [IsMaximal P] (hp : p = comap (algebraMap R S) P)
    (hP : P = comap (algebraMap S T) I) :
    let : P.LiesOver p := ⟨hp⟩
    let : I.LiesOver P := ⟨hP⟩
    let : I.LiesOver p := LiesOver.trans I P p
    Module.finrank (R ⧸ p) (T ⧸ I) =
      Module.finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P) * Module.finrank (S ⧸ P) (T ⧸ I)

    (_hf0 : map (algebraMap R S) p ≠ ⊥) (hg0 : map (algebraMap S T) P ≠ ⊥)
    (hfg : map (algebraMap R T) p ≠ ⊥) (_hp0 : P ≠ ⊥) (_hq0 : Q ≠ 0)

    ramificationIdx' p P * ramificationIdx' P Q

name: Nivat.Algebra.dilation_interpolation_identity
statement:
theorem dilation_interpolation_identity (r : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R Lattice)
    (H : Polynomial (AddMonoidAlgebra R Lattice)) :
    H.sum (fun j b => b * dilate (1 + j * r) f) =
      ∑ h ∈ f.coeff.support, AddMonoidAlgebra.single h (f.coeff h) *
        H.eval (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (r • h) 1)

name: Nivat.Algebra.exists_integer_product_differences
statement:

    ∃ hs : List Lattice, hs ≠ [] ∧ (∀ h ∈ hs, h ≠ 0) ∧
      coefficientAct ((hs.map (fun h => AddMonoidAlgebra.single h (1 : ℤ) - 1)).prod) c = 0

name: Nivat.Descent.dotProduct_mem_dualAnnihilator_iff
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mem_dualAnnihilator_iff (d : Configuration ℚ) (R : Finset Lattice)
    (b : R → ℚ) :
    dotProductEquiv ℚ R b ∈ (translatedSpan d R).dualAnnihilator ↔
      act (windowPolynomial R b) d = 0

name: Nivat.Descent.dualAnnihilator_eq_multiplier_range
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_eq_multiplier_range (d : Configuration ℚ) (Φ : Laurent)
    (R S : Finset Lattice)
    (hexact : ∀ f : Laurent, act f d = 0 ↔ Φ ∣ f)
    (hfit : ∀ g : Laurent, (Φ * g).coeff.support ⊆ R ↔ g.coeff.support ⊆ S) :
    (translatedSpan d R).dualAnnihilator =
      LinearMap.range ((dotProductEquiv ℚ R).toLinearMap.comp (multiplierMap Φ R S))

name: Nivat.Descent.localFilter_patternAt
statement:
theorem localFilter_patternAt (Φ : Laurent) (R S : Finset Lattice)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ a ∈ Φ.coeff.support, z + a ∈ R)
    (c : Configuration ℚ) (u : Lattice) :
    localFilter Φ R S hS (patternAt c R u) = patternAt (act Φ c) S u

name: Nivat.Descent.localFilter_patterns_image

theorem localFilter_patterns_image (Φ : Laurent) (R S : Finset Lattice)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ a ∈ Φ.coeff.support, z + a ∈ R) (c : Configuration ℚ) :
    localFilter Φ R S hS '' patterns c R = patterns (act Φ c) S

name: Nivat.Descent.localFilter_transpose
statement:
theorem localFilter_transpose (Φ : Laurent) (R S : Finset Lattice)
    (hfit : ∀ g : Laurent, (Φ * g).coeff.support ⊆ R ↔ g.coeff.support ⊆ S)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ a ∈ Φ.coeff.support, z + a ∈ R) :
    (localFilter Φ R S hS).dualMap.comp (dotProductEquiv ℚ S).toLinearMap =
      (dotProductEquiv ℚ R).toLinearMap.comp (multiplierMap Φ R S)

name: Nivat.Descent.multiplierMap_apply

theorem multiplierMap_apply (Φ : Laurent) (R S : Finset Lattice) (b : S → ℚ) (z : R) :

name: Nivat.Descent.translatedSpan_eq_ker

theorem translatedSpan_eq_ker (d : Configuration ℚ) (Φ : Laurent)
    (R S : Finset Lattice)

    (hfit : ∀ g : Laurent, (Φ * g).coeff.support ⊆ R ↔ g.coeff.support ⊆ S)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ a ∈ Φ.coeff.support, z + a ∈ R) :

theorem eventually_norm_add_lt_of_normal_tendsto (p : ℕ → RealPlane) (ν z : RealPlane)
    (hp : ∀ n, p n ≠ 0) (hr : Tendsto (fun n => ‖p n‖) atTop atTop)
    (hν : Tendsto (fun n => ‖p n‖⁻¹ • p n) atTop (𝓝 ν))

name: Nivat.Dynamics.exists_far_nearest_disagreement
statement:
theorem exists_far_nearest_disagreement {A : Type*} [Finite A]
    (X : Set (Configuration A)) (hX : X.Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ X, ∃ p : Lattice,
      x p ≠ y p ∧ (n : ℝ) < ‖latticeReal p‖ ∧
        ∀ z : Lattice, ‖latticeReal z‖ < ‖latticeReal p‖ → x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.exists_halfPlane_pair
statement:
theorem exists_halfPlane_pair {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [Finite A] (X : Set (Configuration A)) (hX : X.Infinite) (hclosed : IsClosed X)
    (hshift : ∀ h : Lattice, ∀ c ∈ X, shift h c ∈ X) :
    ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ X, ∃ ν : RealPlane,
      ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ x 0 ≠ y 0 ∧
        ∀ z : Lattice, ⟪ν, latticeReal z⟫_ℝ < 0 → x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.exists_halfPlane_pair_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_halfPlane_pair_coordinates {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] [Finite A] (X : Set (Configuration A)) (hX : X.Infinite)
    (hclosed : IsClosed X) (hshift : ∀ h : Lattice, ∀ c ∈ X, shift h c ∈ X) :
    ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ X, ∃ ν : ℝ × ℝ,
      ν.1 ^ 2 + ν.2 ^ 2 = 1 ∧ x 0 ≠ y 0 ∧
        ∀ z : Lattice, ν.1 * (z.1 : ℝ) + ν.2 * (z.2 : ℝ) < 0 → x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.exists_ne_agree_on_finite
statement:
theorem exists_ne_agree_on_finite {A : Type*} [Finite A]
    (X : Set (Configuration A)) (hX : X.Infinite) (D : Finset Lattice) :
    ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ X, x ≠ y ∧ ∀ z ∈ D, x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.exists_nearest_disagreement
statement:
theorem exists_nearest_disagreement {A : Type*} (x y : Configuration A) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ p : Lattice, x p ≠ y p ∧
      ∀ z : Lattice, ‖latticeReal z‖ < ‖latticeReal p‖ → x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.halfPlane_pair_of_finiteRange_not_periodic
statement:
theorem halfPlane_pair_of_finiteRange_not_periodic {A : Type*}
    (c : Configuration A) (hc : FiniteRange c) (hn : ¬ Periodic c) :
    ∃ x y : Configuration A, ∃ ν : ℝ × ℝ,
      FiniteRange x ∧ FiniteRange y ∧ ν.1 ^ 2 + ν.2 ^ 2 = 1 ∧ x 0 ≠ y 0 ∧
        (∀ D : Finset Lattice, patternAt x D 0 ∈ patterns c D) ∧
        (∀ D : Finset Lattice, patternAt y D 0 ∈ patterns c D) ∧
        ∀ z : Lattice, ν.1 * (z.1 : ℝ) + ν.2 * (z.2 : ℝ) < 0 → x z = y z

name: Nivat.Dynamics.periodic_difference_of_nonzero_annihilator
statement:
theorem periodic_difference_of_nonzero_annihilator (c : Configuration ℚ)
    (hc : FiniteRange c) (hn : ¬ Periodic c) (f : Laurent) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hann : act f c = 0) :
    ∃ x y : Configuration ℚ, ∃ e : Lattice ≃+ Lattice, ∃ q : ℕ,
      FiniteRange x ∧ FiniteRange y ∧
      (∀ D : Finset Lattice, patternAt x D 0 ∈ patterns c D) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset Lattice, patternAt y D 0 ∈ patterns c D) ∧
      x - y ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < q ∧ IsPeriod (x - y) (e ((q : ℤ), 0)) ∧
      ∀ b : ℤ, b < 0 → ∀ a : ℤ, (x - y) (e (a, b)) = 0

      (∀ z : Lattice, 1 ≤ z.2 → z.2 ≤ W → shift (0, s) x z = shift (0, s) y z) ∧

statement:
lemma contDiff_schwartz_parametric_integral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
    (f : SchwartzMap E ℝ) (g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)
    (ι : H → ℝ → E)
    (hι_smooth : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ι · t))
    (hι_meas : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : H), AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun t => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y' => f (ι y' t)) y) volume)
    (hι_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y t,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y' => f (ι y' t)) y‖ ≤ C) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∫ t, f (ι y t) * g t) ∧
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : H),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y' => ∫ t, f (ι y' t) * g t) y =
      ∫ t, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y' => f (ι y' t) * g t) y

name: OSforGFF.L2_time_average_bound
statement:
theorem L2_time_average_bound (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ]
    (A : ℝ → Ω → ℂ) (M_sq : ℝ) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0)
    -- Uniform L² bound
    (h_L2_bound : ∀ s, s ∈ Icc 0 T → ∫ ω, ‖A s ω‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ M_sq)
    -- Joint measurability for Fubini
    (h_joint_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry A)
        ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod μ))
    -- Integrability of ‖A‖² on product (needed for Fubini)
    (h_prod_int : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖A p.1 p.2‖ ^ 2)
        ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod μ))
    -- Integrability of slice integrals (for Fubini step)
    (h_slice_int : IntegrableOn (fun s => ∫ ω, ‖A s ω‖^2 ∂μ) (Icc 0 T) volume)
    -- Measurability of time average (technical hypothesis)
    (h_avg_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ω => (1/T : ℂ) * ∫ s in Icc 0 T, A s ω) μ) :
    ∫ ω, ‖(1/T : ℂ) * ∫ s in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, A s ω‖^2 ∂μ ≤ M_sq

name: OSforGFF.L2_variance_time_average_bound
statement:
theorem _root_.OSforGFF.L2_variance_time_average_bound (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : ℝ → Ω → ℂ) (EA : ℂ)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0)
    (h_mean : ∀ s, ∫ ω, A s ω ∂μ = EA)
    -- Fubini integrability for the covariance triple integral swap
    (h_Fubini : Integrable (fun (x : Ω × (ℝ × ℝ)) =>
        (A x.2.1 x.1 - EA) * starRingEnd ℂ (A x.2.2 x.1 - EA))
        (μ.prod ((volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)))))
    -- Each time-slice A_s is L²(Ω) (for bilinear expansion of covariance)
    (h_slice_L2 : ∀ s, MemLp (A s) 2 μ)
    -- Slice integrability: for a.e. ω, s ↦ A_s(ω) is integrable on [0,T]
    (h_slice_int : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Integrable (fun s => A s ω) (volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T))) :
    let Cov := fun s u => ∫ ω, A s ω * starRingEnd ℂ (A u ω) ∂μ - EA * starRingEnd ℂ EA
    ‖∫ ω, ‖(T⁻¹ : ℂ) * (∫ s in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, A s ω) - EA‖^2 ∂μ‖ ≤
      T⁻¹^2 * ‖∫ s in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∫ u in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, Cov s u‖

  ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,

  ∫ k_spatial : SpatialCoords, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
    let ω := Real.sqrt (‖k_spatial‖^2 + m^2)
    (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
    (1 / ω : ℝ) *
    Complex.exp (-(|-(x 0) - y 0| : ℝ) * ω) *
    Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_spatial (spatialPart x - spatialPart y))

name: gaussian_fourier_1d

lemma gaussian_fourier_1d (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (t : ℝ) :
    ∫ k₀ : ℝ, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * k₀ * t) * Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * k₀^2) =
    Real.sqrt (π / s) * Complex.exp (-(t^2 / (4 * s) : ℝ))

name: heatKernel_bilinear_fourier_form
statement:
theorem heatKernel_bilinear_fourier_form (m : ℝ) (f : TestFunctionℂ) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, (Real.exp (-s * m^2) : ℂ) *
      ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
        (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y * heatKernelPositionSpace s ‖timeReflection x - y‖ =
    (1 / (2 * π) ^ STDimension : ℝ) *
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, ∫ k_sp : SpatialCoords, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
      (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
        (Real.sqrt (π / s) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-((-(x 0) - y 0)^2 / (4 * s) : ℝ)) *
        Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2)) *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart x - spatialPart y))

name: heatKernel_bilinear_to_mixed_rep
statement:
theorem heatKernel_bilinear_to_mixed_rep (m : ℝ) [Fact (0 < m)] (f : TestFunctionℂ)
    (hf_supp : ∀ x, x 0 ≤ 0 → f x = 0) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, (Real.exp (-s * m^2) : ℂ) *
      ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
        (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y * heatKernelPositionSpace s ‖timeReflection x - y‖ =
    (1 / (2 * (2 * π) ^ (STDimension - 1)) : ℝ) *
      ∫ k_spatial : SpatialCoords, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
        let ω := Real.sqrt (‖k_spatial‖^2 + m^2)
        (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y * (1 / ω : ℝ) *
          Complex.exp (-(|-(x 0) - y 0| : ℝ) * ω) *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_spatial (spatialPart x - spatialPart y))

name: k_integral_after_k0_eval
statement:
lemma k_integral_after_k0_eval (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (z : SpaceTime) :
    ∫ k : SpaceTime, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ⟪k, z⟫_ℝ) * Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * ‖k‖^2) =
    (Real.sqrt (π / s) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(((z 0)^2 / (4 * s)) : ℝ)) *
      ∫ k_sp : SpatialCoords, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart z)) *
                               Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * ‖k_sp‖^2)

name: laplace_s_integral_with_norm
statement:
theorem laplace_s_integral_with_norm (m : ℝ) [Fact (0 < m)] (f : TestFunctionℂ) :
    (1 / (2 * π) ^ STDimension : ℝ) *
    ∫ k_sp : SpatialCoords, ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
      (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
        (Real.sqrt (π / s) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-((-(x 0) - y 0)^2 / (4 * s) : ℝ)) *
        Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2)) *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart x - spatialPart y)) =
    (1 / (2 * (2 * π) ^ (STDimension - 1)) : ℝ) *
      ∫ k_spatial : SpatialCoords, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
        let ω := Real.sqrt (‖k_spatial‖^2 + m^2)
        (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y * (1 / ω : ℝ) *
          Complex.exp (-(|-(x 0) - y 0| : ℝ) * ω) *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_spatial (spatialPart x - spatialPart y))

name: mixed_rep_to_k0_inside_integrand
statement:
lemma mixed_rep_to_k0_inside_integrand (k_spatial : SpatialCoords) (m : ℝ) [Fact (0 < m)]
    (t : ℝ) :
    let ω := Real.sqrt (‖k_spatial‖^2 + m^2)
    ((1 / ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(|t| : ℝ) * ω) =
    (1 / π : ℝ) * ∫ k0 : ℝ, Complex.exp (-Complex.I * k0 * t) / (k0^2 + ω^2)

name: normalization_constant_laplace
statement:
lemma normalization_constant_laplace :
    (1 / (2 * π) ^ 4 : ℝ) * π = 1 / (2 * (2 * π) ^ 3)

name: s_integral_complex_eval
statement:
lemma s_integral_complex_eval (k_sp : SpatialCoords) (x y : SpaceTime) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (f : TestFunctionℂ) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
      (Real.sqrt (π / s) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-((-(x 0) - y 0)^2 / (4 * s) : ℝ)) *
      Complex.exp (-(s : ℂ) * (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2)) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart x - spatialPart y)) =
    (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y * (π / Real.sqrt (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-(|-(x 0) - y 0| : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2)) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart x - spatialPart y))

name: s_integral_eval
statement:
lemma s_integral_eval (t : ℝ) (ω : ℝ) (hω : 0 < ω) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, Real.sqrt (π / s) * Real.exp (-(t^2 / (4 * s))) *
      Real.exp (-s * ω^2) = (π / ω) * Real.exp (-ω * |t|)

name: s_integral_eval_complex
statement:
lemma s_integral_eval_complex (t : ℝ) (ω : ℝ) (hω : 0 < ω) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, (Real.sqrt (π / s) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-(t^2 / (4 * s) : ℝ)) *
      Complex.exp (-(s * ω^2 : ℝ)) =
    (((π / ω) * Real.exp (-ω * |t|) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: schwinger_bilinear_integrable
statement:
theorem schwinger_bilinear_integrable (m : ℝ) [Fact (0 < m)] (f : TestFunctionℂ) :
    Integrable (fun (p : ℝ × SpaceTime × SpaceTime) =>

      ((volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0)).prod (volume.prod volume))

      (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
        (Real.exp (-s * m^2) : ℂ) * heatKernelPositionSpace s ‖timeReflection x - y‖ =
    ∫ s in Set.Ioi 0, ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,

        (Real.exp (-s * m^2) : ℂ) * heatKernelPositionSpace s ‖timeReflection x - y‖

name: QFT.RPProof.factorization_to_squared_norm_direct
statement:
theorem factorization_to_squared_norm_direct (f : TestFunctionℂ) (k_sp : SpatialCoords)
    (hf_support : ∀ x : SpaceTime, x 0 < 0 → f x = 0) :
    let ω := Real.sqrt (‖k_sp‖^2 + m^2)
    ∫ x : SpaceTime, ∫ y : SpaceTime,
      (starRingEnd ℂ (f x)) * f y *
      (1 / ω : ℝ) *
      Complex.exp (-(|-(x 0) - y 0| : ℝ) * ω) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * spatialDot k_sp (spatialPart x - spatialPart y)) =
    ((1 / ω * Complex.normSq (weightedLaplaceFourier m f (-k_sp)) : ℝ) : ℂ)

    (hcarry : carry ≤ 1)

    (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < oddBase half) :
    (oddDoubleDigitsAux half digits carry).sum +
        (oddBase half - 1) * oddDoubleCarryCountAux half digits carry =
      2 * digits.sum + carry

      oddDoubleCarryCountAux half digits 0

      (half : Polynomial ℕ) * oddCarryPolynomialFrom half 0 length +
        ((half + 1 : ℕ) : Polynomial ℕ) * X *
          oddCarryPolynomialFrom half 1 length

name: OddPrimeValuationDistribution.oddCarryPolynomialFrom_succ

lemma oddCarryPolynomialFrom_succ (half carry length : ℕ) :
    oddCarryPolynomialFrom half carry (length + 1) =
      ∑ digit : Fin (oddBase half),
        X ^ oddDoubleCarryStep half carry digit.val *
          oddCarryPolynomialFrom half
            (oddDoubleCarryStep half carry digit.val) length

name: OddPrimeValuationDistribution.oddCarryPolynomial_recurrence

      ((half + 1 : ℕ) : Polynomial ℕ) * (1 + X) *
        oddCarryPolynomial half (length + 1)

    (length : ℕ) :

        (oddBase half : Polynomial ℕ) * X *
          oddPrimeValuationPolynomial half length =

name: OddPrimeValuationDistribution.oddPrimeValuationGeneratingSeries_identity
statement:
theorem oddPrimeValuationGeneratingSeries_identity
    (half : ℕ) (hhalf : 0 < half) [Fact (oddBase half).Prime] :
    oddPrimeValuationGeneratingSeries half +
          PowerSeries.C ((oddBase half : Polynomial ℕ) * Polynomial.X) *
            ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries (Polynomial ℕ)) ^ 2 *
              oddPrimeValuationGeneratingSeries half) +
          PowerSeries.C Polynomial.X * PowerSeries.X =
      1 + PowerSeries.C
          (((half + 1 : ℕ) : Polynomial ℕ) * (1 + Polynomial.X)) *
        (PowerSeries.X * oddPrimeValuationGeneratingSeries half)

    {s : Set (realSpace K)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.coordinateFourierGaussian_add_intPi
statement:
theorem coordinateFourierGaussian_add_intPi
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

    (b : Basis ι ℤ L) (a : ℝ) (n k : ι → ℤ) (x : ι → ℝ) :

        ((fun i ↦ (k i : ℝ)) + x) =

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.coordinateFourierGaussian_eq_ambient
statement:
theorem coordinateFourierGaussian_eq_ambient
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] [DecidableEq ι]

theorem exp_fourierGaussian_eq_latticeGaussian

theorem innerBilin_nondegenerate [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] :

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.inner_dualLatticePoint_ofZLatticeBasis_equivFun_symm
statement:
theorem inner_dualLatticePoint_ofZLatticeBasis_equivFun_symm
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.inner_dualRealBasis_apply

theorem integrable_coordinateFourierGaussian
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.integral_ambientFourierGaussian
statement:
theorem integral_ambientFourierGaussian
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (w : E) :
    (∫ y : E, ambientFourierGaussian a w y) =
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) / a) ^
          (Module.finrank ℝ E / 2 : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp
          (-(Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 2 * (‖w‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 / a)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.integral_comp_ofZLatticeBasis_equivFun_symm

theorem integral_comp_ofZLatticeBasis_equivFun_symm

        f ((b.ofZLatticeBasis ℝ L).equivFun.symm x)) =
      (Real.toNNReal (ZLattice.covolume L))⁻¹ •
        ∫ y : E, f y

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.integral_eq_tsum_integral_pi_Ico

    ∫ x, f x =
      ∑' n : ι → ℤ,
        ∫ x in {x : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, x i ∈ Ico 0 1},

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_coordinateGaussianTranslate_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_coordinateGaussianTranslate_apply_le
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (b : Basis ι ℤ L) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (x : ι → ℝ) (n : ι → ℤ) :
    ‖coordinateGaussianTranslate L b a n x‖ ≤
      Real.exp (a * ‖coordinateBasisMap L b x‖ ^ 2) *
        ‖latticeGaussian (a / 2) (latticePoint L b n)‖

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_latticeGaussian
statement:

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_restrict_coordinateGaussianTranslate_le
statement:
theorem norm_restrict_coordinateGaussianTranslate_le
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]

    (b : Basis ι ℤ L) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (K : TopologicalSpace.Compacts (ι → ℝ)) (n : ι → ℤ) :
    ‖(coordinateGaussianTranslate L b a n).restrict K‖ ≤

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.innerDualBasis_traceIdealRealBasis_apply

theorem innerDualBasis_traceIdealRealBasis_apply

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.covolume_comap_continuousLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem covolume_comap_continuousLinearEquiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (L : Submodule ℤ E) [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L]
    (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure μ]
    (e : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    ZLattice.covolume
        (ZLattice.comap ℝ L e.toLinearMap) μ =
      |LinearMap.det e.toLinearMap|⁻¹ *
        ZLattice.covolume L μ

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.covolume_shapeIdealLattice
statement:
theorem covolume_shapeIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    ZLattice.covolume (shapeIdealLattice K I q hq) =
      |(∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsReal w}, q w.1) *
        ∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}, (q w.1) ^ 2| *
        (FractionalIdeal.absNorm
          (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) * √|discr K|)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.covolume_shapeIdealLattice_expMapBasis
statement:
theorem covolume_shapeIdealLattice_expMapBasis
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (y : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) :
    ZLattice.covolume
        (shapeIdealLattice K I
          (mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis y)
          (fun w ↦
            (mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis_pos y w).ne')) =
      Real.exp
          (y NumberField.Units.dirichletUnitTheorem.w₀ *
            (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ)) *
        (FractionalIdeal.absNorm
          (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) * √|discr K|)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.covolume_traceIdealLattice
statement:
theorem covolume_traceIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ZLattice.covolume (traceIdealLattice K I) =
      FractionalIdeal.absNorm
          (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) *
        √|discr K|

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.det_radialMixedSpaceUnit
statement:
theorem det_radialMixedSpaceUnit
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.det
        ((radialMixedSpaceUnit K q hq).mulLeftLinearEquiv ℝ
          (mixedSpace K)).toLinearMap =
      (∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsReal w}, q w.1) *
        ∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}, (q w.1) ^ 2

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.det_traceRadialScale
statement:
theorem det_traceRadialScale
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.det (traceRadialScale K q hq).toLinearMap =
      (∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsReal w}, q w.1) *
        ∏ w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}, (q w.1) ^ 2

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.dualLatticeTheta_shapeIdealLattice
statement:
theorem dualLatticeTheta_shapeIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    dualLatticeTheta (shapeIdealLattice K I q hq) Real.pi =
      latticeTheta
        (shapeIdealLattice K (traceDualIdealUnit K I)
          (fun w ↦ (q w)⁻¹) (fun w ↦ inv_ne_zero (hq w))) Real.pi

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.dualLattice_shapeIdealLattice
statement:
theorem dualLattice_shapeIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    dualLattice (shapeIdealLattice K I q hq) =
      conjugateShapeIdealLattice K (traceDualIdealUnit K I)
        (fun w ↦ (q w)⁻¹) (fun w ↦ inv_ne_zero (hq w))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.expMapBasis_add
statement:
theorem expMapBasis_add
    (x y : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) :
    mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis (x + y) =
      mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis x *
        mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis y

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.expMapBasis_neg
statement:
theorem expMapBasis_neg
    (y : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis (-y) w =
      (mixedEmbedding.fundamentalCone.expMapBasis y w)⁻¹

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.fractionalIdealElementShapeEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fractionalIdealElementShapeEquiv_coe
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0)
    (x : ↥((I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) :
      Submodule (𝓞 K) K)) :
    ((fractionalIdealElementShapeEquiv K I q hq x :
        shapeIdealLattice K I q hq) :
      mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) =
      traceRadialScale K q hq (traceEmbedding K (x : K))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.fractionalIdealElementShapeMap_bijective
statement:
theorem fractionalIdealElementShapeMap_bijective
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.fractionalShapeIdealTheta_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem fractionalShapeIdealTheta_eq_tsum
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) :
    fractionalShapeIdealTheta K I q hq =
      ∑' x : ↥((I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) :

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.idealElementShapeEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealElementShapeEquiv_coe
    (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0)
    (x : ↥(J : Ideal (𝓞 K))) :
    ((idealElementShapeEquiv K J q hq x :
        shapeIdealLattice K (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K J) q hq) :
      mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) =
      traceRadialScale K q hq
        (traceEmbedding K (((x : 𝓞 K) : K)))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.idealElementShapeMap_bijective
statement:
theorem idealElementShapeMap_bijective

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.inner_traceRadialScale

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.mem_conjugateShapeIdealLattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_conjugateShapeIdealLattice_iff
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0)
    (v : mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) :
    v ∈ conjugateShapeIdealLattice K I q hq ↔
      traceConjugation K v ∈ shapeIdealLattice K I q hq

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.mem_conjugateTraceIdealLattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_conjugateTraceIdealLattice_iff
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.mem_dualLattice_shapeIdealLattice_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dualLattice_shapeIdealLattice_iff
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0)
    (v : mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) :
    v ∈ dualLattice (shapeIdealLattice K I q hq) ↔
      traceRadialScale K q hq v ∈ dualLattice (traceIdealLattice K I)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.mk0_fractionalIdealNumerator

theorem mk0_fractionalIdealNumerator

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_sq_traceRadialScale_traceEmbedding
statement:
theorem norm_sq_traceRadialScale_traceEmbedding
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) (x : K) :
    ‖traceRadialScale K q hq (traceEmbedding K x)‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, (w x) ^ 2 * (q w) ^ 2

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.radialMixedSpaceUnit_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem radialMixedSpaceUnit_val

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.shapeIdealTheta_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem shapeIdealTheta_eq_tsum
    (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰)

    shapeIdealTheta K J q hq =
      ∑' x : ↥(J : Ideal (𝓞 K)),
        complexPlaceGaussian K (((x : 𝓞 K) : K)) q

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.traceConjugation_traceRadialScale
statement:
theorem traceConjugation_traceRadialScale

    (v : mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) :
    traceConjugation K (traceRadialScale K q hq v) =

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.traceIdealLattice_eq_comap_euclideanIdealLattice
statement:
theorem traceIdealLattice_eq_comap_euclideanIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    traceIdealLattice K I =

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.traceRadialScale_symm_apply
statement:
theorem traceRadialScale_symm_apply

    (v : mixedEmbedding.euclidean.mixedSpace K) :
    (traceRadialScale K q hq).symm v =

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.traceRadialScale_traceEmbedding_mem_shapeIdealLattice
statement:
theorem traceRadialScale_traceEmbedding_mem_shapeIdealLattice
    (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (q : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hq : ∀ w, q w ≠ 0) (x : K) :
    traceRadialScale K q hq (traceEmbedding K x) ∈
        shapeIdealLattice K I q hq ↔
      x ∈ (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.traceToMixed_traceRadialScale
statement:
theorem traceToMixed_traceRadialScale

      mixedSpaceOfRealSpace q * traceToMixed K v

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.centeredFractionalShapeCoordinates_traceDual_neg

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.covolume_shapeIdealLattice_centered
statement:
theorem covolume_shapeIdealLattice_centered

          (expMapBasis (centeredFractionalShapeCoordinates K I y))
          (fun w ↦
            (expMapBasis_pos
              (centeredFractionalShapeCoordinates K I y) w).ne')) =

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.fractionalShapeCovolumeCenter_traceDual

statement:
theorem integrableOn_unitFundamentalParamSet_comp_add_iff
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]

    (hf : ∀ (g : unitCoordinateLattice (K := K)) x,
      f ((g : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) + x) = f x)

    IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ f (x + a)) (unitFundamentalParamSet K) ↔

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.setIntegral_negUnitFundamentalParamSet_eq
statement:
theorem setIntegral_negUnitFundamentalParamSet_eq

    (hf : ∀ (g : unitCoordinateLattice (K := K)) x,

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.setIntegral_negative_eq_positive_comp_neg
statement:
theorem setIntegral_negative_eq_positive_comp_neg
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K → E)
    (hf : ∀ (g : unitCoordinateLattice (K := K)) x,

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.setIntegral_positiveUnitFundamentalParamSet_add_eq
statement:

      f ((g : mixedEmbedding.realSpace K) + x) = f x)

    (∫ x in positiveUnitFundamentalParamSet (K := K), f (x + a)) =
      ∫ x in positiveUnitFundamentalParamSet (K := K), f x

theorem setIntegral_positive_comp_neg_eq_negSlab_negative

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.setIntegral_unitFundamentalParamSet_eq_add_radialHalves
statement:
theorem setIntegral_unitFundamentalParamSet_eq_add_radialHalves

    (hf : IntegrableOn f (unitFundamentalParamSet K)) :
    (∫ y in unitFundamentalParamSet K, f y) =
      (∫ y in nonnegativeUnitFundamentalParamSet (K := K), f y) +

theorem rectangleIntegral_congr {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f g : ℂ → E} {z w : ℂ}
    (hbottom : ∀ x ∈ uIcc z.re w.re,
      f (x + z.im * I) = g (x + z.im * I))
    (htop : ∀ x ∈ uIcc z.re w.re,
      f (x + w.im * I) = g (x + w.im * I))
    (hright : ∀ y ∈ uIcc z.im w.im,
      f (w.re + y * I) = g (w.re + y * I))
    (hleft : ∀ y ∈ uIcc z.im w.im,
      f (z.re + y * I) = g (z.re + y * I)) :

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.logDeriv_canonicalZeroFactor
statement:
theorem logDeriv_canonicalZeroFactor
    {R : ℝ} {u z : ℂ} (hR : R ≠ 0) (hzu : z ≠ u)
    (hreflect : (R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj u * z ≠ 0) :
    logDeriv (canonicalZeroFactor R u) z =
      1 / (z - u) + conj u / ((R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj u * z)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.logDeriv_centeredCanonicalZeroFactor
statement:
theorem logDeriv_centeredCanonicalZeroFactor
    {c u z : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0)
    (hu : u ∈ ball c R) (hz : z ∈ ball c R) (hzu : z ≠ u)
    (hreflect :
      (R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj (u - c) * (z - c) ≠ 0) :
    logDeriv (centeredCanonicalZeroFactor c R u) z =
      1 / (z - u) +
        conj (u - c) /
          ((R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj (u - c) * (z - c))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.logDeriv_centeredCanonicalZeroProduct
statement:
theorem logDeriv_centeredCanonicalZeroProduct
    {D : ℂ → ℤ} (hfin : D.support.Finite)
    {c z : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hinside : ∀ u ∈ D.support, u ∈ ball c R)
    (hz : z ∈ ball c R) (hzD : z ∉ D.support) :
    logDeriv (centeredCanonicalZeroProduct c R D) z =
      ∑ᶠ u,
        (D u : ℂ) *
          (1 / (z - u) +
            conj (u - c) /
              ((R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj (u - c) * (z - c)))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_deriv_le_of_re_le_on_ball
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_le_of_re_le_on_ball
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {R r A : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball 0 R))

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_finsum_canonicalLogDeriv_le
statement:
theorem norm_finsum_canonicalLogDeriv_le
    {D : ℂ → ℤ} (hfin : D.support.Finite) (hD : ∀ u, 0 ≤ D u)
    {c z : ℂ} {δ r R : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    (hinside : ∀ u ∈ D.support, u ∈ ball c R)
    (hz : z ∈ closedBall c r)
    (hsep : ∀ u ∈ D.support, δ ≤ ‖z - u‖) :
    ‖∑ᶠ u,
        (D u : ℂ) *
          (1 / (z - u) +
            conj (u - c) /
              ((R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj (u - c) * (z - c)))‖ ≤
      ((∑ᶠ u, D u : ℤ) : ℝ) / δ +
        ((∑ᶠ u, D u : ℤ) : ℝ) / (R - r)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_finsum_canonicalLogDeriv_le_of_finsum_le
statement:
theorem norm_finsum_canonicalLogDeriv_le_of_finsum_le
    {D : ℂ → ℤ} (hfin : D.support.Finite) (hD : ∀ u, 0 ≤ D u)
    {c z : ℂ} {δ r R B : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    (hinside : ∀ u ∈ D.support, u ∈ ball c R)
    (hz : z ∈ closedBall c r)
    (hsep : ∀ u ∈ D.support, δ ≤ ‖z - u‖)
    (hmass : ((∑ᶠ u, D u : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ‖∑ᶠ u,
        (D u : ℂ) *
          (1 / (z - u) +
            conj (u - c) /
              ((R : ℂ) ^ 2 - conj (u - c) * (z - c)))‖ ≤
      B / δ + B / (R - r)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_finsum_div_sub_le_finsum_div

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_logDeriv_le_of_canonical_factorization
statement:
theorem norm_logDeriv_le_of_canonical_factorization
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} {r R δ M A B : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hM : 0 < M) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (closedBall 0 R))
    (hc : f 0 ≠ 0)
    (hboundary : ∀ w ∈ sphere 0 R, f w ≠ 0)
    (hbound : ∀ w ∈ sphere 0 R, ‖f w‖ ≤ M)
    (hcenter : Real.log M - Real.log ‖f 0‖ ≤ A)
    (hz : z ∈ closedBall 0 r) (hfz : f z ≠ 0)
    (hsep : ∀ u ∈
      (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (ball 0 R)).support,
        δ ≤ ‖z - u‖)
    (hmass :
      ((∑ᶠ u, MeromorphicOn.divisor f (ball 0 R) u : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ‖logDeriv f z‖ ≤
      (B / δ + B / (R - r)) +
        4 * A * (R + r) / (R - r) ^ 2

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_logDeriv_le_of_canonical_factorization_centered
statement:
theorem norm_logDeriv_le_of_canonical_factorization_centered
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c z : ℂ} {r R δ M A B : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hM : 0 < M) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (closedBall c R))
    (hc : f c ≠ 0)
    (hboundary : ∀ w ∈ sphere c R, f w ≠ 0)
    (hbound : ∀ w ∈ sphere c R, ‖f w‖ ≤ M)
    (hcenter : Real.log M - Real.log ‖f c‖ ≤ A)
    (hz : z ∈ closedBall c r) (hfz : f z ≠ 0)
    (hsep : ∀ u ∈
      (MeromorphicOn.divisor (fun w ↦ f (c + w)) (ball 0 R)).support,
        δ ≤ ‖(z - c) - u‖)
    (hmass :
      ((∑ᶠ u,
        MeromorphicOn.divisor (fun w ↦ f (c + w)) (ball 0 R) u : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ‖logDeriv f z‖ ≤
      (B / δ + B / (R - r)) +
        4 * A * (R + r) / (R - r) ^ 2

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.norm_logDeriv_le_of_zeroFree_on_ball
statement:
theorem norm_logDeriv_le_of_zeroFree_on_ball
    {g : ℂ → ℂ} {c z : ℂ} {R r M A : ℝ}

    {f : ℂ → E} {a b u v : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (huv : u ≤ v)
    (hf : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ℂ Icc u v,
      (z.re = a ∨ z.re = b ∨ z.im = u ∨ z.im = v) →
        ContinuousAt f z) :

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.rectangleIntegral_eq_horizontal_sub_add_two_vertical_of_antiInvariant
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_eq_horizontal_sub_add_two_vertical_of_antiInvariant
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    {f : ℂ → E} (hf : ∀ z, f (1 - z) = -f z)
    (b T : ℝ) :
    rectangleIntegral f ((1 - b : ℝ) + (-T) * I) (b + T * I) =
      horizontalIntegral f (1 - b) b (-T) -
        horizontalIntegral f (1 - b) b T +
          (2 : ℂ) • verticalSegmentIntegral f b (-T) T

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.rectangleIntegral_mul_completedZetaPoleLogDeriv
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_mul_completedZetaPoleLogDeriv
    {h : ℂ → ℂ} {a b u v : ℝ}
    (ha : a < 0) (hb : 1 < b) (hu : u < 0) (hv : 0 < v)
    (hh : ∀ z ∈ Icc a b ×ℂ Icc u v, AnalyticAt ℂ h z) :
    rectangleIntegral
        (fun s ↦ h s * completedZetaPoleLogDeriv s)
        (a + u * I) (b + v * I) =
      2 * Real.pi * I * (h 0 + h 1)

name: NumberField.Odlyzko.regularizedPoitou_completedZetaPole_centeredRectangle_identity
statement:
theorem regularizedPoitou_completedZetaPole_centeredRectangle_identity
    {y δ b T : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hb : 1 < b) (hT : 0 < T) :
    horizontalIntegral
        (fun s ↦
          poitouTransform (regularizedScaledTartar y δ) s *
            completedZetaPoleLogDeriv s)
        (1 - b) b (-T) -
      horizontalIntegral
        (fun s ↦
          poitouTransform (regularizedScaledTartar y δ) s *
            completedZetaPoleLogDeriv s)
        (1 - b) b T +
      (2 : ℂ) • verticalSegmentIntegral
        (fun s ↦
          poitouTransform (regularizedScaledTartar y δ) s *
            completedZetaPoleLogDeriv s)
        b (-T) T =
      4 * Real.pi * I *
        poitouTransform (regularizedScaledTartar y δ) 1

  ∧ ∀ ψ, (con (Bset α ℓ ψ) ⋀ signature α ℓ ≡ con ((P α ℓ).map (fun αs => ⌈⌈αs⌉⌉ψ)) ⋀ signature α ℓ )

name: PDL.boxHelperTermination
statement:
theorem boxHelperTermination α (ℓ : TP α) :
  ∀ δ ∈ P α ℓ,
      ( α.isAtomic → δ = [α] )
    ∧ ( ∀ β, α = (∗β) →
          δ = []
        ∨ ( ∃ a δ1n, (δ = (·a : Program) :: δ1n ++ [∗β]
                      ∧ ((·a : Program) :: δ1n) ⊆ (subprograms α).erase α) ) )
    ∧ ( (¬ α.isAtomic ∧ ¬ α.isStar) →
          δ = []
        ∨ ∃ a δ1n, (δ = (·a : Program) :: δ1n
                    ∧ (·a : Program) :: δ1n ⊆ (subprograms α).erase α) )

    (hB : B ≤ c₂ + a * (A + T))

theorem coercivity_core_bound
    (T A U E D V s r a μ' Ln : ℝ)
    (ha_nn : 0 ≤ a) (ha_lt1 : a < 1) (_hμ' : 0 < μ')
    (hs_nn : 0 ≤ s) (_hr_nn : 0 ≤ r)
    (hs_sq : s ^ 2 = μ') (hsr : s * r = a)
    (hE_nn : 0 ≤ E) (hU_nn : 0 ≤ U) (hT_nn : 0 ≤ T)
    (hA_nn : 0 ≤ A) (hD_nn : 0 ≤ D) (_hV_nn : 0 ≤ V)
    (hT_le : T ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Ln) (hU_le : U ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Ln)
    (hD_le : μ' * D ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Ln)
    (hv_orth : V ^ 2 = T ^ 2 + A ^ 2)
    (hA_ub : A ≤ U + s * E)
    (hE_ub : E ≤ D + r * V)
    (hV_ub : V ≤ A + T) :
    (1 - a) ^ 2 * (V ^ 2 + μ' * E ^ 2) ≤ 60 * Ln

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.flat_case_arithmetic
statement:
theorem flat_case_arithmetic
    -- Rate parameter
    (a : ℝ) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_lt1 : a < 1)
    -- Physical parameters
    (η μ sqrtμ sqrtη : ℝ)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (_hμ_pos : 0 < μ)
    (_hsqrtμ_nn : 0 ≤ sqrtμ) (_hsqrtη_nn : 0 ≤ sqrtη)
    (_hsqrtμ_sq : sqrtμ ^ 2 = μ) (_hsqrtη_sq : sqrtη ^ 2 = η)
    (_h_prod : sqrtμ * sqrtη = a)
    -- Curvature parameter
    (εη : ℝ) (hεη_nn : 0 ≤ εη) (hεη_le : εη ≤ a)
    -- Function gap values
    (Fn Fn1 Fnprime : ℝ)
    (_hFn_nn : 0 ≤ Fn) (_hFn1_nn : 0 ≤ Fn1) (_hFnp_nn : 0 ≤ Fnprime)
    -- Squared norms (all ≥ 0)
    (PVsq PperpVsq PGsq PperpGsq Esq : ℝ)
    (hPVsq_nn : 0 ≤ PVsq) (hPperpVsq_nn : 0 ≤ PperpVsq)
    (hPGsq_nn : 0 ≤ PGsq) (_hPperpGsq_nn : 0 ≤ PperpGsq)
    (_hEsq_nn : 0 ≤ Esq)
    -- Inner products (signed, no nonnegativity)
    (ip_PperpG_en ip_PG_PV ip_PperpG_PperpV ip_PperpV_en : ℝ)
    -- Projector-freezing error: |⟨g, Pe⟩| (zero when P kills normals exactly)
    (proj_error : ℝ) (_hproj_nn : 0 ≤ proj_error)
    -- KEY BOUNDS:
    -- 1. Descent (from L-smoothness): f(x_{n+1}) ≤ f(x'_n) − η/2·‖g‖²
    (h_descent : Fn1 ≤ Fnprime - η / 2 * (PGsq + PperpGsq))
    -- 2. Segment estimate (√η·⟨g,v⟩ ≥ f(x'n)−f(xn) − εη/2·‖v‖²)
    (h_segment : sqrtη * (ip_PG_PV + ip_PperpG_PperpV) ≥
        Fnprime - Fn - εη / 2 * (PVsq + PperpVsq))
    -- 3. Aiming inequality (⟨P⊥g, en⟩ ≥ f(x'n)−f* + μ/2·‖en‖² − proj_error)
    (h_aiming : ip_PperpG_en ≥ Fnprime + μ / 2 * Esq - proj_error)
    -- NORM IDENTITIES:
    -- wn_sq = ‖(1-a)·P⊥v + √μ·en − √η·P⊥g‖²
    (wn_sq : ℝ)
    (hwn_sq : wn_sq = (1 - a) ^ 2 * PperpVsq + μ * Esq + η * PperpGsq
        + 2 * (1 - a) * sqrtμ * ip_PperpV_en
        - 2 * (1 - a) * sqrtη * ip_PperpG_PperpV
        - 2 * a * ip_PperpG_en)
    -- Un = ‖P⊥v + √μ·en‖²
    (Un : ℝ)
    (hUn : Un = PperpVsq + 2 * sqrtμ * ip_PperpV_en + μ * Esq)
    -- Tn1 = (1-a)/2·‖Pv − √η·Pg‖²
    (Tn1 : ℝ)
    (hTn1 : Tn1 = (1 - a) / 2 * PVsq - (1 - a) * sqrtη * ip_PG_PV +
        (1 - a) * η / 2 * PGsq)
    -- Tn = (1+a)²/(2(1-a))·‖Pv‖²
    (Tn : ℝ)
    (hTn : Tn = (1 + a) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - a)) * PVsq)
    :
    Fn1 + wn_sq / 2 + Tn1 ≤ (1 - a) * (Fn + Un / 2 + Tn) + a * proj_error

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.inner_proj_decomp
PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.norm_three_term_sq
statement:
theorem norm_three_term_sq (b en ppg : E d) (c1 c2 c3 : ℝ)
    (hc2_nn : 0 ≤ c2) (hc3_nn : 0 ≤ c3) :
    ‖c1 • b + Real.sqrt c2 • en - Real.sqrt c3 • ppg‖ ^ 2 =
      c1 ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 + c2 * ‖en‖ ^ 2 + c3 * ‖ppg‖ ^ 2
      + 2 * c1 * Real.sqrt c2 * @inner ℝ _ _ b en
      - 2 * c1 * Real.sqrt c3 * @inner ℝ _ _ b ppg
      - 2 * Real.sqrt c2 * Real.sqrt c3 * @inner ℝ _ _ en ppg

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.norm_two_term_sq
statement:
theorem norm_two_term_sq (b en : E d) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    ‖b + Real.sqrt c • en‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖b‖ ^ 2 + c * ‖en‖ ^ 2 + 2 * Real.sqrt c * @inner ℝ _ _ b en

statement:
theorem proj_orth_inner (P : E d →L[ℝ] E d)

statement:
theorem pythagorean_proj (P : E d →L[ℝ] E d)

    (hP_idem : ∀ x : E d, P (P x) = P x) (v : E d) :
    ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ‖P v‖ ^ 2 + ‖v - P v‖ ^ 2

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.complete_square_normal
statement:
theorem complete_square_normal {d : ℕ} (v e : E d) (q c : ℝ) (_hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    q / 2 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 + q * c * @inner ℝ _ _ v e + q * c ^ 2 / 2 * ‖e‖ ^ 2
    = q / 2 * ‖v + c • e‖ ^ 2

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.function_value_collection
statement:
theorem function_value_collection (f' f fstar a : ℝ) :

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.perturbation_expansion
statement:

    ‖w + c • ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2 + 2 * c * @inner ℝ _ _ w ξ + c ^ 2 * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.contraction_with_perturbation
statement:
theorem contraction_with_perturbation (a : ℝ)
    (_ha : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1)
    (Ln Ln1 δ : ℝ)
    (_hLn : 0 ≤ Ln)
    -- L_{n+1} ≤ (1-a) L_n + δ
    (h_flat : Ln1 ≤ (1 - a) * Ln + δ)
    -- Perturbation absorbed by slack
    (h_perturb : δ ≤ a / 2 * Ln) :
    Ln1 ≤ (1 - a / 2) * Ln

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.curvature_perturbation_absorption
statement:
theorem curvature_perturbation_absorption
    (a C_w C_ξ Ln : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hLn : 0 ≤ Ln)
    (_hCw : 0 ≤ C_w) (_hCξ : 0 ≤ C_ξ)
    (h_small : 2 * C_w * C_ξ + a * C_ξ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    a * (2 * C_w * C_ξ + a * C_ξ ^ 2) * Ln ≤ a / 2 * Ln

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.flat_contraction_assembly
statement:
theorem flat_contraction_assembly (a : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1)
    -- Components of L_n (all nonneg)
    (Fn Un Tn : ℝ) (hFn : 0 ≤ Fn) (hUn : 0 ≤ Un) (hTn : 0 ≤ Tn)
    -- Lyapunov at step n
    (Ln : ℝ) (hLn : Ln = Fn + Un / 2 + Tn)
    -- Components of L_{n+1}
    (Fn1 Un1 Tn1 : ℝ) (_hFn1 : 0 ≤ Fn1) (_hUn1 : 0 ≤ Un1) (_hTn1 : 0 ≤ Tn1)
    -- Lyapunov at step n+1
    (Ln1 : ℝ) (hLn1 : Ln1 = Fn1 + Un1 / 2 + Tn1)
    -- Component bounds (flat case: each ≤ (1-a) times original)
    (hF : Fn1 ≤ (1 - a) * Fn)
    (hU : Un1 / 2 ≤ (1 - a) * Un / 2)
    (hT : Tn1 ≤ (1 - a) * Tn) :
    Ln1 ≤ (1 - a / 2) * Ln

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.function_descent_with_aiming

theorem function_descent_with_aiming

    (h_desc : F1 ≤ F' - η / 2 * G_sq)

    F1 ≤ A - μ' / 2 * E_sq - η / 2 * G_sq

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.gradient_sq_net
statement:
theorem gradient_sq_net (a η PGsq PperpGsq Gsq : ℝ)
    (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (_ha1 : a ≤ 1) (_hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (_hPGsq : 0 ≤ PGsq) (_hPperpGsq : 0 ≤ PperpGsq)
    (h_orth : Gsq = PGsq + PperpGsq) :
    -η / 2 * Gsq + (1 - a) / 2 * η * PGsq =
    -η * a / 2 * PGsq - η / 2 * PperpGsq

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.lambda_rho_sq'
statement:

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.leading_coeff_slack
statement:
theorem leading_coeff_slack (a F U V : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam = (1 + a) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - a))) :
    (1 - a) * F + (1 - a) / 2 * U + (1 - a) / 2 * V ≤
    (1 - a / 2) * (F + U / 2 + lam * V)

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.leading_coeff_slack_lower
statement:
theorem leading_coeff_slack_lower (a F U V : ℝ)
    (_ha : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1)
    (_hF : 0 ≤ F) (_hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V) :
    (1 - a / 2) * (F + U / 2 + V) -
    ((1 - a) * F + (1 - a) / 2 * U + (1 - a) / 2 * V) ≥
    a / 2 * F + a / 4 * U

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.lyapunov_contraction_arithmetic
statement:
theorem lyapunov_contraction_arithmetic
    (a : ℝ) (_ha : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1)
    -- L_n components (nonneg)
    (Fn Un_half Tn : ℝ)
    (_hFn : 0 ≤ Fn) (_hUn : 0 ≤ Un_half) (_hTn : 0 ≤ Tn)
    (Ln : ℝ) (_hLn_def : Ln = Fn + Un_half + Tn)
    -- L_{n+1} components (nonneg)
    (Fn1 Un1_half Tn1 : ℝ)
    (_hFn1 : 0 ≤ Fn1) (_hUn1 : 0 ≤ Un1_half) (_hTn1 : 0 ≤ Tn1)
    (Ln1 : ℝ) (hLn1_def : Ln1 = Fn1 + Un1_half + Tn1)
    -- The three component bounds (with perturbation δ)
    (δ : ℝ) (_hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hbound : Fn1 + Un1_half + Tn1 ≤ (1 - a) * Ln + δ)
    (habsorb : δ ≤ a / 2 * Ln) :
    Ln1 ≤ (1 - a / 2) * Ln

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.norm_sq_decomp

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.perturbation_bound

    (hεη : 0 ≤ εη) (hLn : 0 ≤ Ln)
    (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (hC_half : C ≤ 1 / 2)

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.sq_contraction_le

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.tangential_cross_absorption
statement:
theorem tangential_cross_absorption (a sqrtη PVsq PGsq PVG : ℝ)
    (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hPVsq : 0 ≤ PVsq) (hPGsq : 0 ≤ PGsq)
    (h_cs : |PVG| ≤ Real.sqrt PVsq * Real.sqrt PGsq)
    (hsqrtη : 0 ≤ sqrtη) :
    -(1 - a) * sqrtη * PVG ≤ (1 - a) / 2 * (PVsq + sqrtη ^ 2 * PGsq)

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.tangential_energy_expansion
statement:
theorem tangential_energy_expansion (a η : ℝ)
    (PVsq PGsq PVG : ℝ) -- ‖Pv_n‖², ‖Pg_n‖², ⟨Pv_n, Pg_n⟩
    (sqrtη : ℝ) (_hsqrtη : sqrtη ^ 2 = η) :
    (1 - a) / 2 * (PVsq - 2 * sqrtη * PVG + η * PGsq) =
    (1 - a) / 2 * PVsq - (1 - a) * sqrtη * PVG + (1 - a) / 2 * η * PGsq

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.two_step_contraction
statement:
theorem two_step_contraction (a Ln Ln1 δ : ℝ)
    (_ha : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1)
    (_hLn : 0 ≤ Ln)
    (h_step1 : Ln1 ≤ (1 - a) * Ln + δ)
    (h_step2 : δ ≤ a / 2 * Ln) :

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.two_step_contraction_general
statement:
theorem two_step_contraction_general (a θ Ln Ln1 δ : ℝ)

    (_hLn : 0 ≤ Ln)
    (h_step1 : Ln1 ≤ (1 - a) * Ln + δ)
    (h_step2 : δ ≤ θ * a * Ln) :

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.gradient_bound_from_lipschitz

name: PLAcceleratedNesterovLean.one_div_one_sub_sqrt_le

name: Pentagonal.gamma_rec
statement:
theorem gamma_rec [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R] [T2Space R]
    (k : ℕ) {x : R} (hx : IsTopologicallyNilpotent x) (hgamma : ∀ k, Summable (gamma k · x))
    (h : ∀ k, Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1))) :
    ∑' n, gamma k n x = 1 - x ^ (2 * k + 3) - x ^ (3 * k + 5) * ∑' n, gamma (k + 1) n x

name: Pentagonal.pentagonalLhs_gamma
statement:
theorem pentagonalLhs_gamma [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R] [T2Space R] (k : ℕ) {x : R}
    (hx : IsTopologicallyNilpotent x)
    (hgamma : ∀ k, Summable (gamma k · x)) (h : ∀ k, Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1)))
    : ∏' n, (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (-1) ^ k *
      (x ^ (k * (3 * k + 1) / 2) - x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 2) / 2))
      + (-1) ^ (k + 1) * x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 4) / 2) * ∑' n, gamma k n x

theorem psi_sub_psi (k n : ℕ) (x : R) :

name: pentagonalNumberTheorem_generic
statement:
theorem pentagonalNumberTheorem_generic [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R] [T2Space R]
    {x : R} (hx : IsTopologicallyNilpotent x)
    (hgamma : ∀ k, Summable (Pentagonal.gamma k · x))
    (hlhs : ∀ k, Multipliable (fun n ↦ 1 - x ^ (n + k + 1)))
    (hrhs : Summable fun (k : ℕ) ↦
      (-1) ^ k * (x ^ (k * (3 * k + 1) / 2) - x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 2) / 2)))
    (htail : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (-1) ^ (k + 1) * x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 4) / 2) *
      ∑' (n : ℕ), Pentagonal.gamma k n x) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∏' n, (1 - x ^ (n + 1)) =
    ∑' k, (-1) ^ k * (x ^ (k * (3 * k + 1) / 2) - x ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 2) / 2))

theorem summable_pentagonalRhs_powerSeries
    [Nontrivial R] [TopologicalSpace R] :
    Summable (fun (k : ℕ) ↦
    ((-1) ^ k * (X ^ (k * (3 * k + 1) / 2) - X ^ ((k + 1) * (3 * k + 2) / 2)) : R⟦X⟧))

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.consecutiveTopRun_Icc
statement:
theorem consecutiveTopRun_Icc (a b m : ℕ) :
    consecutiveTopRun (Icc a b) m = if a ≤ m ∧ m ≤ b then m - a + 1 else 0

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.ctr_eq_of

lemma ctr_ge_of_mem (S : Finset ℕ) (m r : ℕ) (hrm : r ≤ m) (h : ∀ j < r, m - j ∈ S) :

statement: lemma ctr_le (S : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) (h : (0 : ℕ) ∉ S) : consecutiveTopRun S m ≤ m

statement:
lemma ctr_mem_of_lt (S : Finset ℕ) (m j : ℕ) (hj : j < consecutiveTopRun S m) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.ctr_not_mem
statement: lemma ctr_not_mem (S : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) (h : m ∉ S) : consecutiveTopRun S m = 0

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.ctr_succ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ctr_succ (S : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    consecutiveTopRun S (m + 1) = if m + 1 ∈ S then 1 + consecutiveTopRun S m else 0

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.ctr_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ctr_zero (S : Finset ℕ) : consecutiveTopRun S 0 = if (0 : ℕ) ∈ S then 1 else 0

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DP_card_filter_split
statement:
theorem DP_card_filter_split (n : ℕ) (P : Finset ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ((distinctPartitions n).filter P).card =
      ((distinctPartitionsAlpha n).filter P).card + ((distinctPartitionsBeta n).filter P).card +
        ((distinctPartitionsSpecial n).filter P).card

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DP_eq_Icc_of_run_reaches_base
statement:
theorem DP_eq_Icc_of_run_reaches_base (S : Finset ℕ) (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (h : partMax S - partSlope S + 1 ≤ partBase S) :
    S = Icc (partBase S) (partMax S)

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DP_eq_union
statement:
theorem DP_eq_union (n : ℕ) :
    distinctPartitions n =

theorem DPalpha_card_eq_DPbeta_card (n : ℕ) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPalpha_even_card_eq_DPbeta_odd_card

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPalpha_filter_card_eq
statement:
theorem DPalpha_filter_card_eq (n : ℕ) (p q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q]
    (hpq : ∀ a : ℕ, p (a + 1) ↔ q a) :
    ((distinctPartitionsAlpha n).filter fun S => p S.card).card =
      ((distinctPartitionsBeta n).filter fun S => q S.card).card

theorem DPalpha_inter_DPspecial (n : ℕ) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPbeta_inter_DPspecial
statement:
theorem DPbeta_inter_DPspecial (n : ℕ) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPspecial_empty_of_nonpent
statement:
theorem DPspecial_empty_of_nonpent (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (h1 : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → 2 * n ≠ 3 * k ^ 2 - k)
    (h2 : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → 2 * n ≠ 3 * k ^ 2 + k) :
    distinctPartitionsSpecial n = ∅

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPspecial_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem DPspecial_eq_Icc (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : S ∈ distinctPartitionsSpecial n)
    (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    S = Icc (partBase S) (partMax S) ∧ partSlope S = partMax S - partBase S + 1 ∧
      2 * n = partSlope S * (partBase S + partMax S)

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPspecial_pent_minus
statement:
theorem DPspecial_pent_minus (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : 2 * n = 3 * k ^ 2 - k) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.DPspecial_pent_plus
statement:
theorem DPspecial_pent_plus (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : 2 * n = 3 * k ^ 2 + k) :

theorem betaOp_mem_DPalpha (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : S ∈ distinctPartitionsBeta n) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.pe_minus_po_eq_special
statement:
theorem pe_minus_po_eq_special (n : ℕ) :
    (pe n : ℤ) - po n =
    ((distinctPartitionsSpecial n).filter (fun S => S.card % 2 = 0)).card -
    ((distinctPartitionsSpecial n).filter (fun S => S.card % 2 = 1)).card

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.pe_minus_po_nonpent
statement:
theorem pe_minus_po_nonpent (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (h1 : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → 2 * n ≠ 3 * k ^ 2 - k)

theorem pe_minus_po_pent_plus (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : 2 * n = 3 * k ^ 2 + k) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.signed_card_of_singleton
statement:
theorem signed_card_of_singleton (T : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hT : T.card = k) :
    ((({T} : Finset (Finset ℕ)).filter (fun S => S.card % 2 = 0)).card : ℤ) -
      (({T} : Finset (Finset ℕ)).filter (fun S => S.card % 2 = 1)).card = (-1) ^ k

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.coeff_pGenFun_eq_p_count
statement:
theorem coeff_pGenFun_eq_p_count (n : ℕ) :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.coeff_prod_eq_pe_sub_po
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_eq_pe_sub_po (n : ℕ) :
    (coeff n) (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 - X^k : ℤ⟦X⟧)) = (pe n : ℤ) - po n

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.coeff_prod_eq_signed_partition_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_eq_signed_partition_sum (n : ℕ) :

      ∑ S ∈ distinctPartitions n, (-1 : ℤ)^S.card

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.coeff_prod_pentagonal_plus

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.coeff_prod_pentagonal_zero

theorem coeff_prod_pentagonal_zero :

name: PentagonalNumberTheorem.Franklin.euler_pentagonal_number_theorem_packaged
statement:
theorem euler_pentagonal_number_theorem_packaged (n : ℕ) :
  (∃ k : ℤ, (n = (k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2) ∧
  ((pe n : ℤ) - (po n : ℤ) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ (Int.natAbs k) )) ∨
  ((¬ ∃ k : ℤ, n = (k * (3 * k - 1)) / 2 ) ∧

name: QSeries.qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt [CommRing R] (q : R) :
    ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → qBinom n k q = 0
  | 0,     0,     h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | 0,     _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0,     h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
    rw [qBinom_succ_succ,
        qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (show n < k + 1 by omega),
        qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (show n < k by omega)]
    ring

    rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n),
        qBinom_self q n, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero]
    ring

theorem qPochhammerInf_self_eq_qPochhammer_mul {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    qPochhammerInf q q = qPochhammer q q n * qPochhammerInf (q * q ^ n) q

name: QSeries.tsum_split_diagonal
statement:
theorem tsum_split_diagonal {f : ℕ × ℕ → ℂ} (hf : Summable f) :
    ∑' p : ℕ × ℕ, f p =
      (∑' k : ℕ, ∑' m : ℕ, f (m + k, m)) + ∑' l : ℕ, ∑' n : ℕ, f (n, n + (l + 1))

name: QSeries.euler_second_identity'
statement:
theorem euler_second_identity' {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n.choose 2 * z ^ n / qPochhammer q q n)
      (qPochhammerInf (-z) q)

name: QSeries.euler_second_identity_div'
statement:
theorem euler_second_identity_div' {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => q ^ m.choose 2 * q ^ m * z⁻¹ ^ m / qPochhammer q q m)
      (qPochhammerInf (-q / z) q)

name: QSeries.jacobiBilateral_mul_eq_div
statement:
theorem jacobiBilateral_mul_eq_div {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (hq' : q ≠ 0) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1)
    (hz' : z ≠ 0) :
    jacobiBilateral q (q * z) = jacobiBilateral q z / z

name: QSeries.jacobiProd_mul_eq_div
statement:
theorem jacobiProd_mul_eq_div {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (hq' : q ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    jacobiProd q (q * z) = jacobiProd q z / z

name: QSeries.qPochhammerInf_neg_eq_one_add_mul
statement:
theorem qPochhammerInf_neg_eq_one_add_mul {z q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    qPochhammerInf (-z) q = (1 + z) * qPochhammerInf (-(z * q)) q

name: QSeries.summable_euler_second'
statement:
theorem summable_euler_second' {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n.choose 2 * z ^ n / qPochhammer q q n)

name: QSeries.summable_inv_pow_mul_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem summable_inv_pow_mul_pow_choose_two {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun m : ℕ => (z⁻¹) ^ (m + 1) * q ^ (m + 2).choose 2)

name: QSeries.summable_pow_mul_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem summable_pow_mul_pow_choose_two {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (hz : ‖z‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => z ^ k * q ^ k.choose 2)

name: QSeries.tsum_euler_second_eq_one_add_mul
statement:
theorem tsum_euler_second_eq_one_add_mul {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, q ^ n.choose 2 * z ^ n / qPochhammer q q n) =
    (1 + z) * (∑' n : ℕ, q ^ n.choose 2 * (z * q) ^ n / qPochhammer q q n)

name: QSeries.hasSum_pow_choose_two_mul_pow_mul_qPochhammerInf'
statement:
theorem hasSum_pow_choose_two_mul_pow_mul_qPochhammerInf' {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => q ^ n.choose 2 * z ^ n * qPochhammerInf (q * q ^ n) q)
      (qPochhammerInf q q * qPochhammerInf (-z) q)

name: QSeries.jacobiProd_eq_pow_mul_pow_choose_two_mul
statement:
theorem jacobiProd_eq_pow_mul_pow_choose_two_mul {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (hq' : q ≠ 0)
    (hz : z ≠ 0) (N : ℕ) :
    jacobiProd q z = z ^ N * q ^ N.choose 2 * jacobiProd q (q ^ N * z)

name: QSeries.summable_pow_add_mul_norm_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem summable_pow_add_mul_norm_pow_choose_two {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (c : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    Summable fun k : ℕ => c ^ (k + j) * ‖q‖ ^ (k + 2 * j).choose 2

name: QSeries.summable_pow_mul_norm_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem summable_pow_mul_norm_pow_choose_two {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (R : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => R ^ k * ‖q‖ ^ k.choose 2)

name: QSeries.summable_pow_mul_pow_choose_two'
statement:
theorem summable_pow_mul_pow_choose_two' {q z : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => z ^ k * q ^ k.choose 2)

name: QSeries.summable_pow_succ_mul_norm_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem summable_pow_succ_mul_norm_pow_choose_two {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (R' : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun m : ℕ => R' ^ (m + 1) * ‖q‖ ^ (m + 2).choose 2)

name: QSeries.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_jacobiBilateral
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_jacobiBilateral {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun N z =>
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ k * q ^ k.choose 2) +
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, z⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * q ^ (m + 2).choose 2))
      (fun z => jacobiBilateral q z) atTop {z : ℂ | z ≠ 0}

name: QSeries.tendstoLocallyUniformly_qPochhammer
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformly_qPochhammer {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun n a => qPochhammer a q n)
      (fun a => qPochhammerInf a q) atTop

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_mul_of_bounded
statement:
lemma tendstoUniformlyOn_mul_of_bounded {s : Set ℂ}
    {f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ} {F₁ F₂ : ℂ → ℂ}
    (h₁ : TendstoUniformlyOn f₁ F₁ atTop s)
    (h₂ : TendstoUniformlyOn f₂ F₂ atTop s)
    (hb₁ : ∃ C, ∀ n, ∀ z ∈ s, ‖f₁ n z‖ ≤ C)
    (hb₂ : ∃ C, ∀ z ∈ s, ‖F₂ z‖ ≤ C) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => f₁ n z * f₂ n z) (fun z => F₁ z * F₂ z) atTop s

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_closedBall
statement:
lemma tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_closedBall {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (R : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n a => qPochhammer a q n)
      (fun a => qPochhammerInf a q) atTop (Metric.closedBall 0 R)

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_neg_closedBall
statement:
lemma tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_neg_closedBall {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => qPochhammer (-z) q n)
      (fun z => qPochhammerInf (-z) q) atTop (Metric.closedBall z₀ r)

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_neg_div
statement:
lemma tendstoUniformlyOn_qPochhammer_neg_div {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) {z₀ : ℂ} (hz₀ : z₀ ≠ 0) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => qPochhammer (-q / z) q n)
      (fun z => qPochhammerInf (-q / z) q) atTop (Metric.closedBall z₀ (‖z₀‖ / 2))

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_sum_inv_pow_mul_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_sum_inv_pow_mul_pow_choose_two {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (R' : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N z => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, z⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * q ^ (m + 2).choose 2)
      (fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, z⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * q ^ (m + 2).choose 2)
      atTop {z : ℂ | ‖z⁻¹‖ ≤ R'}

name: QSeries.tendstoUniformlyOn_sum_pow_mul_pow_choose_two
statement:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_sum_pow_mul_pow_choose_two {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) (R : ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun N z => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, z ^ k * q ^ k.choose 2)
      (fun z => ∑' k : ℕ, z ^ k * q ^ k.choose 2)
      atTop (Metric.closedBall 0 R)

name: FockSPR.T_pos
statement: lemma T_pos : 0 < T

name: FockSPR.fockNorm_eq_gaussian_integral
statement:
theorem fockNorm_eq_gaussian_integral {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) :
    (1 / Real.pi) * ∫ z : ℂ,
      ‖polyEval a z‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2) =
    fockNormSq a

name: FockSPR.polar_coord_fock
statement:
theorem polar_coord_fock {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) :
    rhoFockNormSq a = 2 * ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), r * Real.exp (-r ^ 2) *
      (∫ t : AddCircle T, (rho (polyEvalCircle a r t)) ^ 2 ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)

name: FockSPR.blocks_cover
statement:
theorem blocks_cover (D : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (_hnD : n ≤ D) :
    ∃ ℓ, 1 ≤ ℓ ∧ n ∈ freqBlock ℓ

name: FockSPR.blocks_disjoint
statement:
theorem blocks_disjoint {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : 1 ≤ ℓ₁) (h₂ : 1 ≤ ℓ₂) (hne : ℓ₁ ≠ ℓ₂) :
    Disjoint (freqBlock ℓ₁) (freqBlock ℓ₂)

name: FockSPR.blocks_orthogonal_circle
statement:
theorem blocks_orthogonal_circle {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : ℕ}
    (_h₁ : 1 ≤ ℓ₁) (_h₂ : 1 ≤ ℓ₂) (hne : ℓ₁ ≠ ℓ₂) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ∫ t : AddCircle T,
      (blockPoly a ℓ₁ (↑r * (fourier 1 t : ℂ))) *
      starRingEnd ℂ (blockPoly a ℓ₂ (↑r * (fourier 1 t : ℂ)))
      ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle = 0

name: FockSPR.fockNorm_decomposes
statement:
theorem fockNorm_decomposes {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) :
    fockNormSq a = ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (maxBlockIndex D),
      ∑ k : Fin D, if (k.val + 1) ∈ freqBlock ℓ
        then ‖a k‖ ^ 2 * (Nat.factorial (k.val + 1) : ℝ) else 0

name: FockSPR.freqBlock_card
statement: lemma freqBlock_card (ℓ : ℕ) : (freqBlock ℓ).card = 2 * ℓ + 1

name: FockSPR.freq_count_localPoly
statement:
theorem freq_count_localPoly {M j : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hj : M + 1 ≤ j) :
    (Finset.Icc (max 1 (j - M)) (j + M)).sum
      (fun ℓ => (freqBlock ℓ).card) =
      (2 * M + 1) * (2 * j + 1)

name: FockSPR.freq_support_localPoly_lower
statement:
theorem freq_support_localPoly_lower {M j : ℕ} (_hM : 1 ≤ M) (hj : M + 1 ≤ j) :
    ∀ n ∈ freqBlock ℓ,
      ℓ ∈ Finset.Icc (max 1 (j - M)) (j + M) → (j - M) ^ 2 ≤ n

name: FockSPR.monomial_peak_localization
statement:
theorem monomial_peak_localization {n ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (hn : n ∈ freqBlock ℓ) :
    (ℓ : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (n + 1 / 2) ∧
      Real.sqrt (n + 1 / 2) < (ℓ + 1 : ℝ)

name: FockSPR.exp_phi_le_factorial
statement:
theorem exp_phi_le_factorial {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Real.exp (phiFunc n (rStar n)) ≤
    Real.exp (1 / 4) * (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) / 2

name: FockSPR.monomial_integral_bound
statement:
theorem monomial_integral_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (j : ℕ) :
    ∫ r in (j : ℝ)..(j + 1 : ℝ), r ^ (2 * n + 1) * Real.exp (-r ^ 2) ≤
      Real.exp (1 / 4) * (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) / 2 *
        Real.exp (-(distToInterval (rStar n) j) ^ 2)

name: FockSPR.phiFunc_concavity
statement:
theorem phiFunc_concavity {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Ioi 0) (phiFunc n)

name: FockSPR.phiFunc_quad_bound
statement:
theorem phiFunc_quad_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    phiFunc n r ≤ phiFunc n (rStar n) - (r - rStar n) ^ 2

name: FockSPR.block_annulus_leakage
statement:
theorem block_annulus_leakage {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (j : ℕ) :
    2 * ∫ r in (j : ℝ)..(j + 1 : ℝ), r * Real.exp (-r ^ 2) *
      (∫ t : AddCircle T, ‖blockPoly a ℓ (↑r * (fourier 1 t : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
        ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle) ≤
      Real.exp (1 / 4) *
        Real.exp (-(max ((j : ℤ) - ℓ - 1) 0 : ℤ) ^ 2) *
        (∑ k : Fin D, if (k.val + 1) ∈ freqBlock ℓ
          then ‖a k‖ ^ 2 * (Nat.factorial (k.val + 1) : ℝ) else 0)

name: FockSPR.eta_5_bound
statement: theorem eta_5_bound : etaCoeff 5 100 < 4 / (10 : ℝ) ^ 11

name: FockSPR.total_leakage_bound
statement:
theorem total_leakage_bound {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ bound, ∀ J ≥ bound,
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range J,
      2 * ∫ r in (j : ℝ)..(j + 1 : ℝ), r * Real.exp (-r ^ 2) *
        (∫ t : AddCircle T, ‖remainderPoly a M j (↑r * (fourier 1 t : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
          ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)) ≤
    (etaCoeff M J + ε) * fockNormSq a

name: FockSPR.rho_lipschitz
statement: theorem rho_lipschitz : LipschitzWith 1 rho

name: FockSPR.rho_pointwise_lower
statement: theorem rho_pointwise_lower (w z : ℂ) : rho w ≥ rho z - ‖w - z‖

name: FockSPR.rho_pointwise_upper
statement: theorem rho_pointwise_upper (w z : ℂ) : rho w ≤ rho z + ‖w - z‖

name: FockSPR.MissingMathlib.poincare_interval
statement:
theorem poincare_interval {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) {f f' : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 h, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 h))
    (hf'_cont : ContinuousOn f' (Icc 0 h)) :
    let f_bar := (1 / h) • ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..h, f x
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..h, ‖f x - f_bar‖ ^ 2 ≤
      h ^ 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..h, ‖f' x‖ ^ 2

name: FockSPR.rotational_averaging_bound
statement:
theorem rotational_averaging_bound {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ∫ t : AddCircle T, (rho (↑r * (fourier 1 t : ℂ))) ^ 2 ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle ≥
      r ^ 2 / 8

name: FockSPR.nonneg_safe_square
statement:
theorem nonneg_safe_square (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hab : a ≥ b - c) : a ^ 2 ≥ (1 / 2) * b ^ 2 - c ^ 2

name: FockSPR.safe_square
statement: theorem safe_square (a b : ℝ) : (a + b) ^ 2 ≥ (1 / 2) * a ^ 2 - b ^ 2

name: HermiteLEAN.annulus_distance_lower_bound
statement:
theorem annulus_distance_lower_bound (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    posPart (|((j : ℕ) : ℝ) - x| - 1)
      ≤ min |((j : ℕ) : ℝ) - x| |(((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - x)|

name: HermiteLEAN.polynomial_times_gaussian_le_gaussian
statement:
theorem polynomial_times_gaussian_le_gaussian
    {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
        (1 + x ^ k) * Real.exp (-a * x ^ 2)
          ≤ C * Real.exp (-(a / 2) * x ^ 2)

statement: theorem squareBlock_card (ℓ : ℕ) : (squareBlock ℓ).card = 2 * ℓ + 1
