statement: lemma T_pos : 0 < T

name: HermitekLEAN.Phi_mem_Hk
statement: theorem Phi_mem_Hk (k n : ℕ) : Phi k n ∈ Hk k

name: HermitekLEAN.circleSeries_fourierCoeff_hermiteCoeff
statement:
theorem circleSeries_fourierCoeff_hermiteCoeff :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r →
          ∀ n : ℕ,
            fourierCoeff (circleSeries k (hermiteCoeff k G) r) (n : ℤ) =
              hermiteCoeff k G n * (qkn k n r : ℂ)

name: HermitekLEAN.circleSeries_l2_identity
statement:
theorem circleSeries_l2_identity :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℕ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        G = hermiteSeries k g →
          Summable (fun n => ‖g n‖ ^ 2) →
          ∀ r : ℝ,
            0 < r →
              circleL2Sq (circleSeries k g r) =
                ∑' n : ℕ, ‖g n‖ ^ 2 * |qkn k n r| ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.circleSeries_l2_identity_hermiteCoeff
statement:
theorem circleSeries_l2_identity_hermiteCoeff :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ r : ℝ,
          0 < r →
            circleL2Sq (circleSeries k (hermiteCoeff k G) r) =
              ∑' n : ℕ, ‖hermiteCoeff k G n‖ ^ 2 * |qkn k n r| ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.circle_representation
statement:
theorem circle_representation :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∃ g : ℕ → ℂ,
          G = hermiteSeries k g ∧
            ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
              ∀ t : Circle,
                G (circlePoint r t) =
                  circleLeadingFactor k r *
                    (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t : ℂ) *
                      circleSeries k g r t

name: HermitekLEAN.circle_representation_hermiteCoeff
statement:
theorem circle_representation_hermiteCoeff :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
          ∀ t : Circle,
            G (circlePoint r t) =
              circleLeadingFactor k r *
                (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t : ℂ) *
                  circleSeries k (hermiteCoeff k G) r t

name: HermitekLEAN.continuous_Phi
statement: theorem continuous_Phi (k n : ℕ) : Continuous (Phi k n)

name: HermitekLEAN.continuous_of_mem_Hk
statement:
theorem continuous_of_mem_Hk :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k → Continuous G

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteCircleCoeff_eq_zero_outside
statement:
theorem finiteCircleCoeff_eq_zero_outside :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (a : Fin D → ℂ) {n : ℕ},
      D ≤ n →
        finiteCircleCoeff k r a n = 0

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteCirclePoly_l2_identity
statement:
theorem finiteCirclePoly_l2_identity :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (a : Fin D → ℂ),
      circleL2Sq (finiteCirclePoly k r a) =
        ∑ n : Fin D, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 * |qkn k n.1 r| ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteCirclePoly_support
statement:
theorem finiteCirclePoly_support :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (a : Fin D → ℂ),
      finiteCirclePoly k r a =
        positiveTrigonometricPolynomial (frequencyBand 0 D) (finiteCircleCoeff k r a)

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteCirclePoly_support_pos
statement:
theorem finiteCirclePoly_support_pos :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (a : Fin (D + 1) → ℂ),
      a 0 = 0 →
        finiteCirclePoly k r a =
          positiveTrigonometricPolynomial (frequencyBand 1 D) (finiteCircleCoeff k r a)

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteHermiteSum_circle
statement:
theorem finiteHermiteSum_circle :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) {r : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        ∀ t : Circle,
          finiteHermiteSum k a (circlePoint r t) =
            circleLeadingFactor k r *
              (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t : ℂ) *
                finiteCirclePoly k r a t

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteHermiteSum_inner
statement:
theorem finiteHermiteSum_inner :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (a b : Fin D → ℂ),
      weightedInner (finiteHermiteSum k a) (finiteHermiteSum k b) =
        ∑ n : Fin D, a n * star (b n)

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteHermiteSum_mem_Hk
statement:
theorem finiteHermiteSum_mem_Hk :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) {D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ), finiteHermiteSum k a ∈ Hk k

name: HermitekLEAN.finiteHermiteSum_normSq
statement:
theorem finiteHermiteSum_normSq :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ),
      weightedNormSq (finiteHermiteSum k a) = ∑ n : Fin D, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.gaussian_monomial_moments
statement:
theorem gaussian_monomial_moments :
    ∀ (a b : ℕ),
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ∫ z : ℂ, ((z ^ a) * (star z) ^ b).re * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2)
        = if a = b then (Nat.factorial a : ℝ) else 0

name: HermitekLEAN.h_k_expansion
statement:
theorem h_k_expansion :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∃ g : ℕ → ℂ,
          G = hermiteSeries k g ∧
            weightedNormSq G = ∑' n : ℕ, ‖g n‖ ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.h_k_expansion_perp_phi0
statement:
theorem h_k_expansion_perp_phi0 :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        weightedInner G (Phi k 0) = 0 →
          ∃ g : ℕ → ℂ,
            G = hermiteSeries k g ∧
              g 0 = 0

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_expansion
statement:
theorem hermiteCoeff_expansion :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ}, G ∈ Hk k → G = hermiteSeries k (hermiteCoeff k G)

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_finiteHermiteSum
statement:
theorem hermiteCoeff_finiteHermiteSum :
    ∀ {k D : ℕ} (a : Fin D → ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      hermiteCoeff k (finiteHermiteSum k a) n = if h : n < D then a ⟨n, h⟩ else 0

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_hermiteSeries
statement:
theorem hermiteCoeff_hermiteSeries :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} (h : ℕ → ℂ),
      G ∈ Hk k →
      G = hermiteSeries k h →
      Summable (fun n => ‖h n‖ ^ 2) →
      (∀ n, hermiteCoeff k G n = h n)

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_parseval
statement:
theorem hermiteCoeff_parseval :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        weightedNormSq G = ∑' n : ℕ, ‖hermiteCoeff k G n‖ ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_phi0
statement:
@[simp] theorem hermiteCoeff_phi0 :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ}, hermiteCoeff k G 0 = weightedInner G (phi0 k)

name: HermitekLEAN.hermiteCoeff_truncate
statement:
theorem hermiteCoeff_truncate :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} (n : ℕ),
      hermiteCoeff k (truncate k J G) n =
        if _h : n < J + 1 then hermiteCoeff k G n else 0

name: HermitekLEAN.hermite_series_locally_uniform
statement:
theorem hermite_series_locally_uniform :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∃ g : ℕ → ℂ,
          G = hermiteSeries k g ∧
            Continuous G

name: HermitekLEAN.integrable_truncate_normSq_exp
statement:
theorem integrable_truncate_normSq_exp (k J : ℕ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℂ => ‖truncate k J G z‖ ^ 2 * rexp (-‖z‖ ^ 2))

name: HermitekLEAN.integrable_weightedCross
statement:
theorem integrable_weightedCross (k m n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℂ =>
      Phi k m z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (Phi k n z) * (Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2) : ℂ))

name: HermitekLEAN.integrable_weightedDiag
statement:
theorem integrable_weightedDiag (k n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℂ => ‖Phi k n z‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-‖z‖ ^ 2))

name: HermitekLEAN.modulusDefect_le_norm
statement:
theorem modulusDefect_le_norm (F0 G : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    modulusDefect F0 G z ≤ ‖G z‖

name: HermitekLEAN.orthogonal_phi0_iff_hermiteCoeff_zero
statement:
theorem orthogonal_phi0_iff_hermiteCoeff_zero :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      weightedInner G (phi0 k) = 0 ↔ hermiteCoeff k G 0 = 0

name: HermitekLEAN.phi_explicit
statement:
theorem phi_explicit :
    ∀ {k n : ℕ} {z : ℂ},
      Phi k n z =
        ((1 / Real.sqrt ((Nat.factorial k : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial n : ℝ))) : ℂ) *
          Finset.sum (Finset.range (min k n + 1)) (fun j =>
            ((-1 : ℂ) ^ j) * (Nat.choose k j : ℂ) *
              ((Nat.factorial n : ℂ) / (Nat.factorial (n - j) : ℂ)) *
              z ^ (n - j) * (star z) ^ (k - j))

name: HermitekLEAN.phi_orthonormal
statement:
theorem phi_orthonormal :
    ∀ {k m n : ℕ},
      weightedInner (Phi k m) (Phi k n) = if m = n then 1 else 0

name: HermitekLEAN.phi_polar
statement:
theorem phi_polar :
    ∀ {k n : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        ∀ t : Circle,
          Phi k n (circlePoint r t) =
            circleLeadingFactor k r *
              (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t : ℂ) *
                ((qkn k n r : ℂ) * fourier (n : ℤ) t)

name: HermitekLEAN.point_eval_bounded
statement:
theorem point_eval_bounded :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (z : ℂ),
      ∃ C : ℝ,
        0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ}, G ∈ Hk k → ‖G z‖ ≤ C * weightedNorm G

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_eventual_lower_bound
statement:
theorem qkn_eventual_lower_bound :
    ∀ k n : ℕ,
      ∃ R c : ℝ,
        1 ≤ R ∧
          0 < c ∧
            ∀ r ≥ R, c * r ^ n ≤ ‖(qkn k n r : ℂ)‖

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_eventually_nonzero
statement:
theorem qkn_eventually_nonzero :
    ∀ k n : ℕ,
      ∃ R0 : ℝ,
        1 ≤ R0 ∧
          ∀ r ≥ R0, qkn k n r ≠ 0

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_explicit
statement:
theorem qkn_explicit :
    ∀ {k n : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        qkn k n r =
          (1 / Real.sqrt (Nat.factorial n : ℝ)) *
            Finset.sum (Finset.range (min k n + 1)) (fun j =>
              ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j) * (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) *
                ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial (n - j) : ℝ)) *
                r ^ ((n : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)))

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_ratio_control
statement:
theorem qkn_ratio_control :
    ∀ {k n d : ℕ},
      n < d →
        ∃ C R0 : ℝ,
          0 < C ∧
            1 ≤ R0 ∧
              ∀ r : ℝ,
                R0 ≤ r →
                  ‖((qkn k n r : ℂ) / (qkn k d r : ℂ))‖ ≤ C / r

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_real
statement:
@[simp] theorem qkn_real :
    ∀ {k n : ℕ} {r : ℝ}, star (qkn k n r : ℂ) = (qkn k n r : ℂ)

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_structure
statement:
theorem qkn_structure :
    ∀ {k n : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        qkn k n r =
          (1 / Real.sqrt (Nat.factorial n : ℝ)) *
            Finset.sum (Finset.range (min k n + 1)) (fun j =>
              ((-1 : ℝ) ^ j) * (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) *
                ((Nat.factorial n : ℝ) / (Nat.factorial (n - j) : ℝ)) *
                r ^ ((n : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)))

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_top_term_asymptotic
statement:
theorem qkn_top_term_asymptotic :
    ∀ k n : ℕ,
      ∃ c : ℝ,
        c ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ ε : ℝ,
            0 < ε →
              ∃ R0 : ℝ,
                ∀ r ≥ R0, ‖(qkn k n r : ℂ) / (r ^ n : ℂ) - (c : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε

name: HermitekLEAN.qkn_top_term_limit
statement:
theorem qkn_top_term_limit :
    ∀ k n : ℕ,
      ∀ ε : ℝ,
        0 < ε →
          ∃ R0 : ℝ,
            1 ≤ R0 ∧
              ∀ r : ℝ,
                R0 ≤ r →
                  ‖(qkn k n r : ℂ) / (r ^ n : ℂ) -
                      ((1 / Real.sqrt (Nat.factorial n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ ε

name: HermitekLEAN.truncCirclePoly_eq_finiteCirclePoly
statement:
theorem truncCirclePoly_eq_finiteCirclePoly :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ} {r : ℝ},
      truncCirclePoly k r J G =
        finiteCirclePoly k r (fun n : Fin (J + 1) => hermiteCoeff k G n.1)

name: HermitekLEAN.truncCirclePoly_l2_identity
statement:
theorem truncCirclePoly_l2_identity :
    ∀ (k J : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      circleL2Sq (truncCirclePoly k r J G) =
        ∑ n : Fin (J + 1), ‖hermiteCoeff k G n.1‖ ^ 2 * |qkn k n.1 r| ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.truncCirclePoly_support
statement:
theorem truncCirclePoly_support :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      truncCirclePoly k r J G =
        positiveTrigonometricPolynomial
          (frequencyBand 0 (J + 1))
          (finiteCircleCoeff k r (fun n : Fin (J + 1) => hermiteCoeff k G n.1))

name: HermitekLEAN.truncCirclePoly_support_pos
statement:
theorem truncCirclePoly_support_pos :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      weightedInner G (phi0 k) = 0 →
        truncCirclePoly k r J G =
          positiveTrigonometricPolynomial
            (frequencyBand 1 J)
            (finiteCircleCoeff k r (fun n : Fin (J + 1) => hermiteCoeff k G n.1))

name: HermitekLEAN.truncCirclePoly_tendsto_circleSeries
statement:
theorem truncCirclePoly_tendsto_circleSeries :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ r : ℝ,
          0 < r →
            ∀ ε : ℝ,
              0 < ε →
                ∃ J0 : ℕ,
                  ∀ J ≥ J0,
                    circleL2Sq
                        (truncCirclePoly k r J G - circleSeries k (hermiteCoeff k G) r) ≤
                      ε

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_circle
statement:
theorem truncate_circle :
    ∀ (k J : ℕ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) {r : ℝ},
      0 < r →
        ∀ t : Circle,
          truncate k J G (circlePoint r t) =
            circleLeadingFactor k r *
              (fourier (-(k : ℤ)) t : ℂ) *
                truncCirclePoly k r J G t

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_eq_finiteHermiteSum
statement:
theorem truncate_eq_finiteHermiteSum :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      truncate k J G =
        finiteHermiteSum k (fun n : Fin (J + 1) => hermiteCoeff k G n.1)

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_locally_uniform
statement:
theorem truncate_locally_uniform :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ R ε : ℝ,
          0 < R →
            0 < ε →
              ∃ J0 : ℕ,
                ∀ J ≥ J0,
                  ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ R → ‖truncate k J G z - G z‖ ≤ ε

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_mem_Hk
statement:
theorem truncate_mem_Hk :
    ∀ (k J : ℕ) (G : ℂ → ℂ), truncate k J G ∈ Hk k

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_normSq
statement:
theorem truncate_normSq :
    ∀ (k J : ℕ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      weightedNormSq (truncate k J G) =
        ∑ n : Fin (J + 1), ‖hermiteCoeff k G n.1‖ ^ 2

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_tendsto
statement:
theorem truncate_tendsto :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} {G : ℂ → ℂ},
      G ∈ Hk k →
        ∀ ε : ℝ,
          0 < ε →
            ∃ J0 : ℕ, ∀ J ≥ J0, weightedNorm (truncate k J G - G) ≤ ε

name: HermitekLEAN.truncate_unique
statement:
theorem truncate_unique :
    ∀ {k J : ℕ} {G H : ℂ → ℂ},
      H ∈ Hk k →
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          hermiteCoeff k H n = if _h : n < J + 1 then hermiteCoeff k G n else 0) →
            H = truncate k J G

name: HermitekLEAN.weightedDefectNorm_smul
statement:
theorem weightedDefectNorm_smul (c : ℂ) (F0 G : ℂ → ℂ) :
    weightedDefectNorm (c • F0) (c • G) = ‖c‖ * weightedDefectNorm F0 G

name: HermitekLEAN.weightedNorm_smul
statement:
theorem weightedNorm_smul (c : ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) :
    weightedNorm (c • G) = ‖c‖ * weightedNorm G

name: HermitekLEAN.phi0_localization
statement:
theorem phi0_localization :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      ∃ C c : ℝ,
        0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧
          ∀ j : ℕ,
            annulusIntegralSq (phi0 k) j ≤
              C * Real.exp (-c * (posPart ((j : ℝ) - ((k + 5 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2)

name: HermitekLEAN.single_basis_localization
statement:
theorem single_basis_localization :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      ∃ C c : ℝ,
        0 < C ∧ 0 < c ∧
          ∀ n j : ℕ,
            1 ≤ n →
              annulusIntegralSq (Phi k n) j ≤
                C *
                  Real.exp
                    (-c *
                      (posPart
                        (|((j : ℕ) : ℝ) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)| - ((k + 4 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ^ 2)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.Cavg_pos
statement: theorem Cavg_pos : 0 < Cavg

name: DimdPolyLEAN.Crot_pos
statement: theorem Crot_pos : 0 < Crot

name: DimdPolyLEAN.L2_eq_zero_of_rep_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem L2_eq_zero_of_rep_ae_eq_zero
    {d : Nat} {f : L2Real d} {fRep : RealVec d -> ℂ}
    (hf_rep : IsL2Rep f fRep)
    (hzero : fRep =ᵐ[(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (RealVec d))]
      fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :
    f = 0

name: DimdPolyLEAN.ae_unimodular_phase_to_L2_eq
statement:
theorem ae_unimodular_phase_to_L2_eq
    {d : Nat} {f g : L2Real d} {fRep gRep : RealVec d -> ℂ} {w : ℂ}
    (hf_rep : IsL2Rep f fRep) (hg_rep : IsL2Rep g gRep)
    (hphase :
      gRep =ᵐ[(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (RealVec d))]
        fun u => w * fRep u) :
    g = w • f

name: DimdPolyLEAN.ambiguityRep_congr_left
statement:
theorem ambiguityRep_congr_left
    {d : Nat} {f f' g : L2Real d} (hf : f = f') :
    ambiguityRep f g = ambiguityRep f' g

name: DimdPolyLEAN.ambiguityRep_congr_right
statement:
theorem ambiguityRep_congr_right
    {d : Nat} {f g g' : L2Real d} (hg : g = g') :
    ambiguityRep f g = ambiguityRep f g'

name: DimdPolyLEAN.ambiguityRep_eq_lpPairing
statement:
theorem ambiguityRep_eq_lpPairing
    {d : Nat} (f g : L2Real d) (ξ : PhaseSpace d) :
    ambiguityRep f g ξ =
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ ℂ).lpPairing
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (RealVec d))
        2 2)
        (translateL2 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ξ.1) f)
        (modulateL2 ξ.2
          (star (translateL2 (-((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ξ.1)) g)))

name: DimdPolyLEAN.arcAverage_eq_arcIntegral_div
statement:
theorem arcAverage_eq_arcIntegral_div
    (I : CircleArc) (f : Circle -> ℂ) :
    arcAverage I f =
      (arcLength I)⁻¹ •
        ∫ x in arcSet I, f x ∂ μCircle

name: DimdPolyLEAN.arcIntegral_nonneg
statement:
theorem arcIntegral_nonneg
    (I : CircleArc) {f : Circle -> ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ arcSet I, 0 <= f x) :
    0 <= arcIntegral I f

name: DimdPolyLEAN.arcLength_nonneg
statement: theorem arcLength_nonneg (I : CircleArc) : 0 <= arcLength I

name: DimdPolyLEAN.arcSet_eq_image
statement:
theorem arcSet_eq_image (I : CircleArc) :
    arcSet I = arcParam I '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

name: DimdPolyLEAN.boxPartialSums_have_L2_limit
statement:
theorem boxPartialSums_have_L2_limit
    {d : Nat} (hd : 0 < d) (kappa : MultiIndex d) :
    True

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_arcIntegral_eq_mk_image_Ioc
statement:
theorem carrierArc_arcIntegral_eq_mk_image_Ioc
    {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) (f : Circle -> ℝ) :
    arcIntegral (carrierArc N k) f =
      ∫ x in QuotientAddGroup.mk ''
          Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right),
        f x ∂ μCircle

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_arcSet_eq_mk_image_Icc
statement:
theorem carrierArc_arcSet_eq_mk_image_Icc {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    arcSet (carrierArc N k) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk ''
        Set.Icc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_arcSet_eq_mk_image_Ioc_union_left
statement:
theorem carrierArc_arcSet_eq_mk_image_Ioc_union_left {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    arcSet (carrierArc N k) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk ''
        Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right)) ∪
        {(QuotientAddGroup.mk ((carrierArc N k).left) : Circle)}

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_left_lt_right
statement:
theorem carrierArc_left_lt_right {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    (carrierArc N k).left < (carrierArc N k).right

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_left_nonneg
statement:
theorem carrierArc_left_nonneg {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    0 <= (carrierArc N k).left

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_length
statement:
theorem carrierArc_length {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    arcLength (carrierArc N k) = (2 * Real.pi) / (N : ℝ)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_length_pos
statement:
theorem carrierArc_length_pos {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    0 < arcLength (carrierArc N k)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_mk_image_Ioc_integral_eq_scaled
statement:
theorem carrierArc_mk_image_Ioc_integral_eq_scaled
    {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) (f : Circle -> ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (fun t : ℝ => (QuotientAddGroup.mk t : Circle)) ''
          Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right),
        f x ∂ μCircle) =
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ t in Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right),
          f (QuotientAddGroup.mk t : Circle)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_mk_preimage_image_Ioc_inter_fundamental
statement:
theorem carrierArc_mk_preimage_image_Ioc_inter_fundamental
    {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    ((fun t : ℝ => (QuotientAddGroup.mk t : Circle)) ⁻¹'
        ((fun t : ℝ => (QuotientAddGroup.mk t : Circle)) ''
          Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right)) ∩
      Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) =
        Set.Ioc ((carrierArc N k).left) ((carrierArc N k).right)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.carrierArc_right_le_period
statement:
theorem carrierArc_right_le_period {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) :
    (carrierArc N k).right <= 2 * Real.pi

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_add
statement:
theorem circleChar_add (m n : Nat) (x : Circle) :
    circleChar (m + n) x = circleChar m x * circleChar n x

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_carrierArc_arcParam
statement:
theorem circleChar_carrierArc_arcParam {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) (t : ℝ) :
    circleChar N (arcParam (carrierArc N k) t) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (2 * Real.pi * t))

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_eq_fourier_nat
statement:
theorem circleChar_eq_fourier_nat (n : Nat) (x : Circle) :
    circleChar n x = fourier (n : Int) x

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_eq_zeta_pow
statement:
theorem circleChar_eq_zeta_pow (n : Nat) (x : Circle) :
    circleChar n x = zeta x ^ n

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_mk
statement:
theorem circleChar_mk (n : Nat) (theta : ℝ) :
    circleChar n (QuotientAddGroup.mk theta : Circle) =
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * theta)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_one
statement: theorem circleChar_one (x : Circle) : circleChar 1 x = zeta x

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleChar_zero
statement: theorem circleChar_zero (x : Circle) : circleChar 0 x = 1

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleFourier_exact_modulus_bridge
statement:
theorem circleFourier_exact_modulus_bridge :
    True

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleIntegral_split_compl
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_split_compl
    (s : Set Circle) (hs : MeasurableSet s) {f : Circle -> ℝ}
    (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μCircle) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂ μCircle =
      ∫ x in s, f x ∂ μCircle + ∫ x in sᶜ, f x ∂ μCircle

name: DimdPolyLEAN.circleIntegral_union_finset
statement:
theorem circleIntegral_union_finset
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (I : ι -> CircleArc)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (arcSet (I i)) (arcSet (I j)))
    {f : Circle -> ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (arcSet (I i)) μCircle) :
    ∫ x in (⋃ i, arcSet (I i)), f x ∂ μCircle =
      ∑ i, arcIntegral (I i) f

name: DimdPolyLEAN.constantCenter_fastRotate_carrierArc_sq_le_defectSq
statement:
theorem constantCenter_fastRotate_carrierArc_sq_le_defectSq
    {N : Nat} (k : Fin N) {c u : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    arcLength (carrierArc N k) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 <=
      Crot *
        arcIntegral (carrierArc N k)
          (fun x => (‖c + circleChar N x * u‖ - ‖c‖) ^ 2)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.continuous_arcParam
statement: theorem continuous_arcParam (I : CircleArc) : Continuous (arcParam I)

name: DimdPolyLEAN.continuous_eq_of_ae_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem continuous_eq_of_ae_eq_gamma
    {d : Nat} (hd : 0 < d) {f g : Cd d -> ℂ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (hfg : f =ᵐ[gammaD d] g) :
    f = g

name: DimdPolyLEAN.continuous_translateL2_apply
statement:
theorem continuous_translateL2_apply {d : Nat} (f : L2Real d) :
    Continuous fun a : RealVec d => translateL2 a f

name: DimdPolyLEAN.dist_translateL2
statement:
theorem dist_translateL2 {d : Nat} (a : RealVec d) (f g : L2Real d) :
    dist (translateL2 a f) (translateL2 a g) = dist f g

name: DimdPolyLEAN.fourier_schwartzCompSubConstCLM_realVec
statement:
theorem fourier_schwartzCompSubConstCLM_realVec {d : Nat}
    (f : SchwartzMap (RealVec d) ℂ) (a : RealVec d) :
    FourierTransform.fourier (schwartzCompSubConstCLM a f : RealVec d -> ℂ) =

statement:
theorem symplecticFourierRep_eq_of_lpNorm_one_approx {d : Nat}
    {G : PhaseSpace d -> ℂ} {Gₙ : Nat -> PhaseSpace d -> ℂ}
    {A : ℂ} {Aₙ : Nat -> ℂ}
    (hG : Integrable G (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
    (hGₙ : ∀ n, Integrable (Gₙ n) (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
    (hLp : Tendsto
      (fun n : Nat => MeasureTheory.lpNorm (fun η : PhaseSpace d => Gₙ n η - G η) 1
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
      atTop (nhds 0))
    (hA : Tendsto Aₙ atTop (nhds A))
    (ξ : PhaseSpace d)
    (hEq : ∀ n : Nat, symplecticFourierRep (Gₙ n) ξ = Aₙ n) :
    symplecticFourierRep G ξ = A

    (h2 : Integrable G₂ (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
    (ξ : PhaseSpace d) :
    ‖symplecticFourierRep G₁ ξ - symplecticFourierRep G₂ ξ‖ ≤
      MeasureTheory.lpNorm (fun η : PhaseSpace d => G₁ η - G₂ η) 1
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d))

theorem tendsto_symplecticFourierRep_of_lpNorm_one {d : Nat}

    (hG : Integrable G (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
    (hGₙ : ∀ n, Integrable (Gₙ n) (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
    (hLp : Tendsto
      (fun n : Nat => MeasureTheory.lpNorm (fun η : PhaseSpace d => Gₙ n η - G η) 1
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (PhaseSpace d)))
      atTop (nhds 0))
    (ξ : PhaseSpace d) :
    Tendsto (fun n : Nat => symplecticFourierRep (Gₙ n) ξ) atTop

    (hequation : ∀ p q (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q),
      dot (resonanceVector p q) (delaunayFrequency (resonantFirstAction p q)) *
          correction p q +
        dot (resonanceVector p q)
            (differential
              ⟨resonantFirstAction p q, resonantFirstAction_pos hp hq⟩) *
          perturbation p q = 0)

    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) {differential : ActionSpace}
    {eccentricity orientation : ℝ} {correction correctionDerivative : ℝ → ℝ}
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (hapoapsis : resonantFirstAction p q ^ 2 * (1 + eccentricity) < 1)
    (hderiv : ∀ time ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (resonantOrbitPeriod p),
      HasDerivAt correction (correctionDerivative time) time)
    (hcorrectionIntegrable : IntervalIntegrable correctionDerivative volume 0
      (resonantOrbitPeriod p))
    (hperiodic : correction (resonantOrbitPeriod p) = correction 0)
    (haverageDeriv :
      deriv (resonantDisturbingAverage p q eccentricity) orientation ≠ 0)
    (hequation : ∀ time ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (resonantOrbitPeriod p),
      correctionDerivative time + dot (resonanceVector p q) differential *
        resonantDisturbingOrientationDerivative p q eccentricity orientation time = 0) :
    ¬LinearIndependent ℝ
      ![delaunayFrequency (resonantFirstAction p q), differential]

    (hperiodic : correction (resonantOrbitPeriod p) = correction 0)

      (-inertialEllipsePosition (resonantFirstAction p q) eccentricity

          (resonantEccentricAnomaly p q eccentricity time) ^ 3) time

theorem hasDerivAt_orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint_momentum
    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    {eccentricity orientation time : ℝ}
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1) :
    let radius := eccentricRadius (resonantFirstAction p q) eccentricity
      (resonantEccentricAnomaly p q eccentricity time)
    HasDerivAt
        (fun t ↦ orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation t 2)
        (orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation time 3 -
          orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation time 0 / radius ^ 3)
        time ∧
      HasDerivAt
        (fun t ↦ orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation t 3)
        (-orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation time 2 -
          orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation time 1 / radius ^ 3)
        time

          orientedResonantKeplerPhasePoint p q eccentricity orientation time 1) time ∧
      HasDerivAt

    let radius := eccentricRadius firstAction eccentricity
      (liftedDelaunayEccentricAnomalyAlongFlow
        firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly time)
    HasDerivAt
        (fun t ↦ liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle t 2)
        (liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle time 3 -
          liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle time 0 /
            radius ^ 3) time ∧
      HasDerivAt
        (fun t ↦ liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle t 3)
        (-liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle time 2 -
          liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle time 1 /
            radius ^ 3) time

        (liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle time 3 -
          liftedDelaunayFlowLine firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly
            periapsisAngle time 0) time

name: LeanPool.PoincareThreeBody.log_lower_bound_resonantPrimaryInverse_local_integral
statement:
theorem log_lower_bound_resonantPrimaryInverse_local_integral
    {p q : ℕ} {lipConstant neighborhoodRadius eccentricity window : ℝ}
    (hconstant : 0 < lipConstant)
    (hlocal : ∀ parameters : ℝ × ℝ,
      dist parameters
          (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q) <
            neighborhoodRadius →
      ‖orientedResonantEllipsePosition p q parameters.1
            (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) parameters.2 - ![(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)]‖ ≤
        lipConstant *
          ‖parameters -
            (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q)‖)
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (hapoapsis : resonantSemimajorAxis p q * (1 + eccentricity) < 1)
    (hdelta : 0 < resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity)
    (hdeltaWindow : resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity < window)
    (hwindow : window < neighborhoodRadius) :
    (1 / (2 * lipConstant)) *
        Real.log (window / (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity)) ≤
      ∫ time in
          resonantApoapsisTime p q +
              (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity)..
            resonantApoapsisTime p q + window,
        resonantPrimaryInverse p q eccentricity
          (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) time

      ‖orientedResonantEllipsePosition p q parameters.1
            (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) parameters.2 - ![(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)]‖ ≤
        lipConstant *

    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)

      dist parameters
          (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q) <
            neighborhoodRadius →
      ‖orientedResonantEllipsePosition p q parameters.1
            (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) parameters.2 - ![(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)]‖ ≤
        lipConstant *
          ‖parameters -
            (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q)‖)
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (hapoapsis : resonantSemimajorAxis p q * (1 + eccentricity) < 1)
    (heccentricityDisplacement :
      0 < resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity)
    (htimeDisplacementLower :
      resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity ≤
        time - resonantApoapsisTime p q)
    (htimeDisplacementUpper :

    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)

      lowerEccentricity < eccentricity ∧ 0 < eccentricity ∧
        eccentricity < resonantCollisionEccentricity p q ∧ eccentricity < 1 ∧
        resonantDisturbingAverage p q eccentricity
          (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) < target

    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (haxisHalf : 1 / 2 < resonantSemimajorAxis p q)
    (haxisOne : resonantSemimajorAxis p q < 1) (target : ℝ) :
    ∃ eccentricity : ℝ,
      0 ≤ eccentricity ∧ eccentricity < resonantCollisionEccentricity p q ∧
        eccentricity < 1 ∧
        resonantDisturbingAverage p q eccentricity
          (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) < target

name: LeanPool.PoincareThreeBody.resonantDisturbingAverage_collisionAligned_le
statement:
theorem resonantDisturbingAverage_collisionAligned_le
    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (haxisHalf : 1 / 2 < resonantSemimajorAxis p q)
    {lipConstant neighborhoodRadius eccentricity window : ℝ}
    (hconstant : 0 < lipConstant)
    (hlocal : ∀ parameters : ℝ × ℝ,
      dist parameters
          (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q) <
            neighborhoodRadius →
      ‖orientedResonantEllipsePosition p q parameters.1
            (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) parameters.2 - ![(1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)]‖ ≤
        lipConstant *
          ‖parameters -
            (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q, resonantApoapsisTime p q)‖)
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (heccentricityBoundary : eccentricity < resonantCollisionEccentricity p q)
    (hdeltaWindow : resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity < window)
    (hwindow : window < neighborhoodRadius)
    (hwindowPeriod : resonantApoapsisTime p q + window ≤ resonantOrbitPeriod p) :
    resonantDisturbingAverage p q eccentricity
        (resonantCollisionOrientation p q) ≤
      resonantOrbitPeriod p *
          (1 / (2 * resonantSemimajorAxis p q - 1) +
            1 / (2 * resonantSemimajorAxis p q - 1) ^ 2) -
        (1 / (2 * lipConstant)) *
          Real.log (window /
            (resonantCollisionEccentricity p q - eccentricity))

name: LeanPool.PoincareThreeBody.resonantDisturbingAverage_eq_regular_sub_primary
statement:
theorem resonantDisturbingAverage_eq_regular_sub_primary
    {p q : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    {eccentricity orientation : ℝ}
    (heccentricity : 0 ≤ eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (hapoapsis : resonantSemimajorAxis p q * (1 + eccentricity) < 1) :
    resonantDisturbingAverage p q eccentricity orientation =
      (∫ time in 0..resonantOrbitPeriod p,
          resonantRegularPart p q eccentricity orientation time) -
        ∫ time in 0..resonantOrbitPeriod p,
          resonantPrimaryInverse p q eccentricity orientation time

    (_hfirstIntegral : IsFirstIntegralFamily δ F)

    {firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle referenceFirstAction : ℝ}
    (hfirstAction : 0 < firstAction)
    (heccentricity : 0 < eccentricity) (heccentricityOne : eccentricity < 1)
    (hapoapsis : firstAction ^ 2 * (1 + eccentricity) < 1)
    (hactionLeaf : ∀ candidateFirstAction ∈ Set.uIcc firstAction referenceFirstAction,
      energyLeafAction
          (delaunayHamiltonian
            ![firstAction,
              angularActionFromEccentricity firstAction eccentricity])
          candidateFirstAction ∈ ProgradeEllipticActions)
    (hapoapsisLeaf : ∀ candidateFirstAction ∈ Set.uIcc firstAction referenceFirstAction,
      candidateFirstAction ^ 2 *
          (1 + eccentricityFromActions
            (energyLeafAction
              (delaunayHamiltonian
                ![firstAction,
                  angularActionFromEccentricity firstAction eccentricity])
              candidateFirstAction)) < 1) :
    let state := liftedDelaunayPhasePoint
      firstAction eccentricity meanAnomaly periapsisAngle
    AnalyticAt ℝ (fun mass ↦
      massNormalizedCandidate F
        (leadingEnergyCoefficient F referenceFirstAction) mass state) 0

      iteratedMassNormalization F energyFunction n 0 state =

statement:
theorem massDifferentialMinor_eq_pow_mul_iteratedNormalization
    {F : ℝ → PhaseSpace → ℝ} {energyFunction : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hcancel : ∀ n state, (0, state) ∈ collisionFree →
      iteratedMassNormalization F energyFunction n 0 state =
        energyFunction n (hamiltonian 0 state))
    {n : ℕ} {mass : ℝ} {state : PhaseSpace}
    (hcollision : (0, state) ∈ collisionFree)
    (hhamiltonian : DifferentiableAt ℝ (hamiltonian mass) state)
    (hnormalized : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (iteratedMassNormalization F energyFunction n mass) state)
    (henergy : ∀ k < n,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (energyFunction k) (hamiltonian mass state))
    (i j : Fin 4) :
    massDifferentialMinor F i j mass state =
      mass ^ n * phaseCovectorMinor (fderiv ℝ (hamiltonian mass) state)

        (resonantDisturbingDifference 1 2 oneTwoEccentricity phaseA phaseB)
        [[0, resonantOrbitPeriod 1]] time| ≤ errorBound)
    (hsteps : 0 < steps)

      |trapezoidal_integral

      (@instHasEquivOfSetoid X (Equiv.Perm.SameCycle.setoid (MulAction.toPerm g))))] :
    (numDistinctColorings X Y G) * (Fintype.card G) =
      ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card X + 1),
        (numGroupOfNumCycles X G i.1) * (Fintype.card Y) ^ i.1

      (∑ g : G, (Fintype.card Y) ^ (CyclesOfGroupElements.numCyclesOfGroup X g))

name: LeanPool.PolyaEnumerationTheorem.ReductionToFin.numDistinctColorings_eq_numDistinctColorings_of_Fin

name: LeanPool.Polylean.bar_involution
statement: theorem bar_involution {G : Graph V E} : (ex : E) → G.bar (G.bar ex) = ex

name: LeanPool.Polylean.basicpath_mult
statement:
theorem basicpath_mult {G : Graph V E} {x y z : V} (ex : E)
    (h₁ : G.init ex = x) (h₂ : term G ex = y) (exy : EdgePath G y z) :
    multiply (basicpath x ex h₁ h₂) exy = cons ex h₁ h₂ exy

name: LeanPool.Polylean.homotopy_inverse
statement:

name: LeanPool.Polylean.homotopy_inverse_quick
statement:
theorem homotopy_inverse_quick {G : Graph V E} {x y : V} {p₁ p₂ : EdgePath G x y} :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.homotopy_left_mult
LeanPool.Polylean.homotopy_left_mult_edge
statement:
theorem homotopy_left_mult_edge {G : Graph V E} {x y z : V} :

theorem ht_left_identity {G : Graph V E} {x : V} :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.ht_mult_assoc
statement:
theorem ht_mult_assoc {G : Graph V E} {x : V} (a b c : ht G x x) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.ht_right_identity

theorem ht_right_identity {G : Graph V E} {x : V} :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.induct_homotopy_inverse_cancel
statement:
theorem induct_homotopy_inverse_cancel {G : Graph V E} (ey ey' : E) {x w y : V}
    (p : EdgePath G x y) (h₁ : G.init ey = y) (h₂ : term G ey = w)
    (t : G.bar ey = ey') (h₃ : G.init ey' = w) (h₄ : term G ey' = y) :
           homotopy p (multiply p (cons ey h₁ h₂ (cons ey' h₃ h₄ (single y)) ))

name: LeanPool.Polylean.induct_homotopy_inverse_mult
statement:
theorem induct_homotopy_inverse_mult {G : Graph V E} {x y z : V}
    (p q : EdgePath G x y) (ey : E) (h₁ : G.init ey = y) (h₂ : term G ey = z) :
    homotopy p q →
      homotopy (multiply p (basicpath y ey h₁ h₂))
        (multiply q (basicpath y ey h₁ h₂))

name: LeanPool.Polylean.init_bar_equals_term
statement:
theorem init_bar_equals_term {G : Graph V E} {x : V} {e : E} :
    (term G e = x) → G.init (G.bar e) = x

name: LeanPool.Polylean.inverse_involution
statement:
theorem inverse_involution {G : Graph V E} {x y : V} (p : EdgePath G x y) :
    inverse (inverse p) = p

name: LeanPool.Polylean.inverse_lemma
statement:
theorem inverse_lemma {G : Graph V E} {x y z : V} (ex : E)
    (h₁ : G.init ex = x) (h₂ : term G ex = y) (exy : EdgePath G y z) :
    inverse (cons ex h₁ h₂ exy) =
      multiply (inverse exy) (basicpath y (G.bar ex) h₂ (term_bar_equals_init h₁))

name: LeanPool.Polylean.inverse_mult
statement:
theorem inverse_mult {G : Graph V E} (x y z : V) (p : EdgePath G x y) (q : EdgePath G y z) :
      inverse (multiply p q) = multiply (inverse q) (inverse p)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.mult_assoc
LeanPool.Polylean.mult_const

theorem mult_const {G : Graph V E} (p : EdgePath G x y) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.term_bar_equals_init

theorem term_bar_equals_init {G : Graph V E} {x : V} {e : E} :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.append_assoc
statement:
theorem append_assoc (p : Path A B) (q : Path B C) (r : Path C D) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.append_cons
statement:
theorem append_cons (p : Path A B) (e : B ⟶ C) (p' : Path C D) :
    append p (cons e p') = append (snoc p e) p'

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.append_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem append_nil (p : Path A B) : .append p .nil = p

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.append_snoc
statement:
theorem append_snoc (p : Path A B) (p' : Path B C) (e : C ⟶ D) :
    append p (snoc p' e) = snoc (append p p') e

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.first_cons
statement: theorem first_cons (A B C : V) (e : A ⟶ B) (p : Path B C) : first (cons e p) = B

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.last_snoc
statement:
theorem last_snoc : (A B C : V) → (p : Path A B) → (e : B ⟶ C) → last (snoc p e) = B
  | _, _, _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, .cons' _ _ _ _ .nil, _ => by rw [snoc_cons]; rfl
  | _, _, _, .cons' _ _ _ _ (.cons _ _), _ => by rw [snoc_cons, snoc, last, ← snoc_cons]; apply last_snoc

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.length_append
statement:
theorem length_append {A B C : V} : (p : Path A B) → (q : Path B C) → (append p q).length = p.length + q.length
  | .nil, q => by rw [Nat.add_comm]; rfl
  | .cons _ p', q => by
    dsimp [append, length]
    simpa [Nat.succ_add] using congrArg Nat.succ (length_append p' q)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.nil_append
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_append (p : Path A B) : .append .nil p = p

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.nil_length
statement:
theorem nil_length {A : V} : (p : Path A A) → p.length = .zero ↔ p = .nil' A
  | .nil => ⟨λ _ => rfl, λ _ => rfl⟩
  | .cons _ p => by apply Iff.intro <;> (intro; simp [length] at *)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.snoc_cons
statement:
theorem snoc_cons (e : A ⟶ B) (p : Path B C) (e' : C ⟶ D) :
  snoc (cons e p) e' = cons e (snoc p e')

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.snoc_length
statement:
theorem snoc_length {A B C : V} : (p : Path A B) → (e : B ⟶ C) → length (.snoc p e) = .succ (length p)
  | .nil, _ => rfl
  | .cons _ p', e => by simp [length, snoc_length p' e]

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Category.Functor.comp_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj : (Φ.obj ∘ Ψ.obj) = (Ψ ⋙ Φ).obj

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Category.Functor.comp_obj'
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_obj' : ∀ x, (Φ.obj (Ψ.obj x)) = (Ψ ⋙ Φ).obj x

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.compose_append
statement:
theorem compose_append {X Y Z : C} : {p : Path X Y} → {q : Path Y Z} → (append p q).compose = p.compose ≫ q.compose
  | .nil, _ => by simp
  | .cons _ _, _ => by
    dsimp [append, compose]
    rw [compose_append, Category.comp_assoc]

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Path.compose_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem compose_nil {X : C} : (Path.nil' X).compose = 𝟙 X

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Groupoid.id_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem id_inv : (𝟙 X)⁻¹ = 𝟙 X

name: LeanPool.Polylean.Groupoid.inv_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_comp : (g ≫ h)⁻¹ = h⁻¹ ≫ g⁻¹

statement: @[simp] theorem inv_inv : (g⁻¹)⁻¹ = g

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.act_sum

statement: theorem action (a b : R) (s : FormalSum R X) : (s.scmul b).scmul a = s.scmul (a * b)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.append_coords
statement:
theorem append_coords (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X) (x₀ : X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.append_equiv
statement:
theorem append_equiv (s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ : FormalSum R X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.coeff_factors
statement: theorem coeff_factors (x : X) (s : FormalSum R X) : FreeModuleAux.coeff x (sum s) = s.coords x

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.cons_equiv_of_equiv
statement:
theorem cons_equiv_of_equiv (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X) (a : R) (x : X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.coords_addMonomial
statement:
theorem coords_addMonomial (term : R × X) (sum : FormalSum R X) (x : X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.coords_combineCoefficients
statement:
theorem coords_combineCoefficients (sum : FormalSum R X) (x : X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.coords_move_invariant

theorem coords_move_invariant (x₀ : X) (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.coords_well_defined
statement:
theorem coords_well_defined (x : X) (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.equiv_e_of_zero_coeffs

theorem equiv_of_equal_coeffs (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X)

theorem nonzero_coeff_has_complement (x₀ : X) (s : FormalSum R X) :

  (∃ ys : FormalSum R X, (((s.coords x₀, x₀) :: ys) ≃ s) ∧

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FormalSum.scmul_coords

theorem scmul_coords (r : R) (s : FormalSum R X) (x₀ : X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FreeModule.addn_comm

name: LeanPool.Polylean.FreeModule.addn_zero

theorem equal_coords_of_approx (s₁ s₂ : FormalSum R X) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.monom_coeff_eq_of_coord_eq

name: LeanPool.Polylean.monom_coords_at_zero

name: LeanPool.Polylean.monom_coords_hom

      monomCoeff R X x₀ (a, x) + monomCoeff R X x₀ (b, x)

name: LeanPool.Polylean.monom_coords_mul

theorem monom_coords_mul (x₀ : X) (a b : R) :

name: LeanPool.Polylean.monom_elem_eq_of_coord_eq_nonzero

name: LeanPool.Polylean.nonzero_coord_in_support

name: LeanPool.Polylean.norm_succ_eq

name: LeanPool.Polylean.normsucc_le

name: LeanPool.Polylean.snd_le_max

name: LeanPool.Polylean.supp_below_max

name: beta_radical
statement:
theorem beta_radical (n k n' : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hn' : n' = UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical n) (hk : n = k * n') (F : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, F x.2 ^ (μ x.1)
      = ∏ t ∈ n'.divisors, F (k * t) ^ (μ (n' / t))

name: indicator_moebius_nonneg
statement:
theorem indicator_moebius_nonneg (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hmin : ∀ x ≥ 1, ∀ y ≥ 1, g (x.gcd y) = min (g x) (g y)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.1 : ℤ) * (if k ≤ g x.2 then 1 else 0)

name: moebius_antidiag_sum_zero
statement:
theorem moebius_antidiag_sum_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.1) = 0

name: moebius_restricted_sum
statement:
theorem moebius_restricted_sum (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hmn : m ∣ n) :
    ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal with m ∣ x.2, (μ x.1 : ℤ) = if n = m then 1 else 0

name: moebius_sign_partition
statement:
theorem moebius_sign_partition (n' : ℕ) (hn'1 : 1 < n') (hsf : Squarefree n') :
    ∃ Sp Sm : Finset ℕ, Disjoint Sp Sm ∧ Sp ∪ Sm = n'.divisors ∧ Sp.card = Sm.card ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Sp, μ (n' / t) = 1) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Sm, μ (n' / t) = -1)

name: moebius_transform_nonneg
statement:
theorem moebius_transform_nonneg (g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hmin : ∀ x ≥ 1, ∀ y ≥ 1, g (x.gcd y) = min (g x) (g y)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.1 : ℤ) * (g x.2 : ℤ)

name: prod_pow_moebius_eq_div
statement:
theorem prod_pow_moebius_eq_div (n k n' : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hn' : n' = UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical n) (hk : n = k * n') (F : ℕ → ℚ)
    {Sp Sm : Finset ℕ} (hdisj : Disjoint Sp Sm) (hunion : Sp ∪ Sm = n'.divisors)
    (hSp : ∀ t ∈ Sp, μ (n' / t) = 1) (hSm : ∀ t ∈ Sm, μ (n' / t) = -1) :
    ∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, F x.2 ^ (μ x.1)
      = (∏ t ∈ Sp, F (k * t)) / (∏ t ∈ Sm, F (k * t))

name: Finset.sum_mul_ite_const
statement:
theorem Finset.sum_mul_ite_const {ι R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] (g : ι → R) (c : R) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, g x * (if p x then c else 0) = c * ∑ x ∈ s with p x, g x

name: sum_zmod_two_smul_eq_sum_filter

theorem sum_zmod_two_smul_eq_sum_filter {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M]

name: factorization_moebiusFactorR
statement:
theorem factorization_moebiusFactorR {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ d ≥ 1, c d ≠ 0)

    [Decidable (IsSquare (algebraMap L (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin L (s' : Set E))) (c y)))] :

      = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (multiquadraticRelations s' c)

    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [∀ r, Fintype (ι r)] [∀ r, DecidableEq (ι r)]
    [∀ r, Fintype (κ r)] [∀ r, DecidableEq (κ r)]
    (G : Game X Y A B)
    (PA : (r : R) → X → POVM A (ι r))
    (PB : (s : R) → Y → POVM B (κ s))
    (r s : R) (x : X) (y : Y) :

      directDSVActualLocalPOVMWinningEffect G (PA r x) (PB s y) x y

    (hφ : ∀ i, IsHom (φ i)) (hi : Measurable[_, ⊤] i)
